Scheduling.Accounting.forcing_capacity_g.source:
theorem forcing_capacity_gap {q c m L processed : ℕ}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hq : q ≤ c)
    (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (hwork : 2 * processed ≤ q * (4 * m + L)) :
    2 * processed < m * L := by
  have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hcL
  have h₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L hcm
  have h₃ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (4 * m + L) hq
  have hp : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos hm hL
  nlinarith

/-- A fully loaded epoch's backlog is exactly its accumulated idle capacity. -/

Scheduling.Accounting.idleBacklog.source:
def idleBacklog (capacity : ℕ) (served : ℕ → ℕ) (N : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ∑ k ∈ range N, (capacity - served k)

Scheduling.Accounting.idleBacklog_conser.source:
theorem idleBacklog_conservation {capacity : ℕ} {served : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hcap : ∀ k, served k ≤ capacity) (N : ℕ) :
    idleBacklog capacity served N + ∑ k ∈ range N, served k = N * capacity := by
  unfold idleBacklog
  rw [← sum_add_distrib]
  have he : ∀ k, capacity - served k + served k = capacity :=
    fun k => Nat.sub_add_cancel (hcap k)
  simp [he, sum_const, Nat.mul_comm]

/-- If every c-th epoch wastes a slot, K such epochs force backlog at least K. -/

Scheduling.Accounting.forcing_epochs_acc.source:
theorem forcing_epochs_accumulate {capacity c K : ℕ} {served : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hc : 0 < c)
    (hidle : ∀ k < K, served (c * k) < capacity) :
    K ≤ idleBacklog capacity served (c * K) := by
  classical
  let forced := (range K).image (fun k => c * k)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => c * k) := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hc hab
  have hcforced : forced.card = K := by simp [forced, card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
  have hsub : forced ⊆ range (c * K) := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hi
    exact mem_range.mpr (Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (mem_range.mp hk) hc)
  have hsum : forced.card ≤ ∑ i ∈ forced, (capacity - served i) := by
    calc
      forced.card = ∑ _i ∈ forced, 1 := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hi
        have := hidle k (mem_range.mp hk)
        omega
  rw [hcforced] at hsum
  exact hsum.trans (sum_le_sum_of_subset hsub)

/-- The final deterministic lower-bound contradiction, after the adversarial
construction has established an idle slot at each forcing epoch. -/

Scheduling.Accounting.forcing_backlog_co.source:
theorem forcing_backlog_contradiction {capacity c : ℕ} {served : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hcapacity : 0 < capacity)
    (hidle : ∀ k < c * capacity, served (c * k) < capacity)
    (hyoung : idleBacklog capacity served (c * (c * capacity)) ≤ (c - 1) * capacity) : False := by
  have hlarge := forcing_epochs_accumulate hc hidle
  have hc1 : c - 1 + 1 = c := by omega
  nlinarith

/-- Theorem 10's final accounting step (a conditional numerical lemma).
`old` is service to the batches already present on admission; `other` is
service to younger batches together with idle capacity. -/

Scheduling.Accounting.sff_duration_bound.source:
theorem sff_duration_bound {m L T old other : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (htotal : m * T = old + other)
    (hold : old ≤ 16 * m * L ^ 2)
    (hother : 2 * other ≤ m * T + 6 * m * L) :
    T ≤ 32 * L ^ 2 + 6 * L := by
  have hscaled : m * T ≤ m * (32 * L ^ 2 + 6 * L) := by nlinarith
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hscaled hm

Scheduling.Accounting.sff_flow_bound.source:
theorem sff_flow_bound {L T flow : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L)
    (hT : T ≤ 32 * L ^ 2 + 6 * L)
    (hflow : flow ≤ 2 * L + 4 * L + T) : flow ≤ 44 * L ^ 2 := by
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.Accounting

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.for.source:
theorem RecordedRun.forcing_trace
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) (initial m hm) Q records)
    (j : Fin jobs) (a : ℕ) (hstart : firstForcingTime c L j.val = a) (harrive : j.val * L ≤ a) :
    ForcingTrace (fun v => A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)))
      a (a + L / 2) (2 * m) 0 (j.val * L) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L hw
  let S := fun v : Fin work => A.schedule I (finProdFinEquiv (j, v))
  let rule := forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm
  have aux : ∀ s w rs, JobLayers rule j s w rs →
      (∀ r ∈ rs, r ∈ records) → ∀ e,
      (∀ v : Fin work, s ≤ v.val → v.val < s + w → e ≤ S v) →
      w ≤ 2 * m → (a < e → e < a + L / 2 → w ≤ 1) →
      ForcingTrace S a (a + L / 2) (2 * m) s e := by
    intro s w rs hl
    induction hl with
    | done => intro _ e _ _ _; exact ForcingTrace.done e
    | step s w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail ih =>
      intro hsub e hready hwide hnarrow
      have hr := hsub r List.mem_cons_self
      have hfinal := h.final_times r hr
      have hkeylo : s ≤ r.key.val := by omega
      have hkeyhi : r.key.val < s + w := by omega
      have hkeyTime : S r.key = r.time := by
        simpa only [S, I, ho] using hfinal.2.2.2.1
      have het : e ≤ r.time := by rw [← hkeyTime]; exact hready r.key hkeylo hkeyhi
      apply ForcingTrace.layer s (s + w) e r.time (by omega) (by omega) het (by omega) (by intros; omega)
      · intro v hvlo hvhi
        refine ⟨hready v hvlo hvhi, ?_⟩
        have ht := hfinal.2.2.2.2 (finProdFinEquiv (j, v))
          (by simpa only [LayeredForest.job_pair] using ho.symm)
          (by simp only [LayeredForest.position_pair]; omega)
          (by simp only [LayeredForest.position_pair]; omega)
        exact ht
      · rw [← hb]
        apply ih (by intro u hu; exact hsub u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu)) (r.time + 1)
        · intro v hvlo hvhi
          have hparent := h.next_parents r hr v hvlo (by rwa [ho])
          have hvisible : v.val < Q.boundary j := by
            have := v.isLt
            simp only [boundary, h.completion.finished]
            omega
          have hedge : I.edge (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) := by
            constructor
            · simpa only [LayeredForest.job_pair] using ho
            · simp only [LayeredForest.job_pair, LayeredForest.position_pair]
              rw [if_pos hvisible]
              simpa only [ho] using hparent
          have htime := (A.valid I).precedence hedge
          have hk : A.schedule I (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key)) = r.time := hfinal.2.2.2.1
          change r.time + 1 ≤ A.schedule I (finProdFinEquiv (j, v))
          omega
        · dsimp only [rule, forcingLayerRule]
          split_ifs
          · exact (min_le_right _ _).trans (by omega)
          · exact min_le_right _ _
        · intro hae heb
          have hwin : firstForcingTime c L j.val ≤ r.time + 1 ∧
              r.time + 1 < firstForcingTime c L j.val + L / 2 := by rw [hstart]; omega
          dsimp only [rule, forcingLayerRule]
          rw [if_pos hwin]
          exact min_le_right _ _
  apply aux 0 (min (2 * m) work) (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)) (h.job_layers j)
    (by intro r hr; exact (List.mem_filter.mp hr).1) (j.val * L)
  · intro v _ _
    simpa only [S, I, toInstance, LayeredForest.job_pair] using (A.valid I).release (finProdFinEquiv (j, v))
  · exact min_le_left _ _
  · intros; omega

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.loc.source:
theorem RecordedRun.local_forcing_work
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) (initial m hm) Q records)
    (j : Fin jobs) (a : ℕ) (hstart : firstForcingTime c L j.val = a) (harrive : j.val * L ≤ a) :
    (univ.filter (fun v : Fin work => a ≤ A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) ∧
      A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) < a + L / 2)).card ≤ 2 * m + L / 2 := by
  have hb := (h.forcing_trace j a hstart harrive).service_bounds.1
  simpa [suffixService] using hb

end LayeredPrefix

Scheduling.firstForcingTime_eq.source:
theorem firstForcingTime_eq {c L j k : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (hlo : c * k < j + c) (hhi : j ≤ c * k) : firstForcingTime c L j = (c * k) * L := by
  have hs : 0 < j + c := by omega
  have hsub : j + c - 1 + 1 = j + c := by omega
  have hlow : k * c ≤ j + c - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hhigh : j + c - 1 < (k + 1) * c := by nlinarith
  have hdiv : (j + c - 1) / c = k := by
    have h₁ := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hc).mpr hlow
    have h₂ := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hc).mpr hhigh
    omega
  unfold firstForcingTime
  rw [hdiv]
  ac_rfl

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

Scheduling.Instance.alive_firstForcingTi.source:
theorem alive_firstForcingTime {c L k : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L) (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L)) (j : Fin jobs) (hj : j ∈ I.alive S ((c * k) * L)) :
    firstForcingTime c L j.val = (c * k) * L := by
  obtain ⟨hr, v, ho, ht⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
  rw [hrelease] at hr
  have hf := hflow v
  rw [ho, hrelease] at hf
  apply firstForcingTime_eq hc
  · by_contra hn
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show j.val + c ≤ c * k by omega)
    nlinarith
  · by_contra hn
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show c * k + 1 ≤ j.val by omega)
    nlinarith

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.recordedKeys.source:
noncomputable def recordedKeys {jobs work : ℕ} (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) : Finset (Fin work) :=
  (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).toFinset.image LayerRecord.key

Scheduling.recordedKeys_card_le.source:
theorem recordedKeys_card_le {jobs work : ℕ} (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (recordedKeys records j).card ≤ (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length :=
  (card_image_le).trans (List.toFinset_card_le _)

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work : ℕ}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.jobVertices_car.source:
theorem jobVertices_card (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    ((P.toInstance L hw).jobVertices j).card = work := by
  let F : LayeredForest jobs work := {
    depth := fun _ => 1
    depth_pos := by intros; omega
    depth_le := by intros; omega
    leafLevel := fun _ _ => 0 }
  exact F.jobVertices_card L j

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.edg.source:
theorem RecordedRun.edge_from_key {m L : ℕ} {hm : 0 < m} {hw : 0 < work}
    {A : DeterministicScheduler m} {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule (initial m hm) Q records)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * work)} (he : (Q.toInstance L hw).edge u v) :
    position u ∈ recordedKeys records (job u) := by
  have hv : (position v).val < Q.boundary (job v) := by
    have := (position v).isLt
    simp only [boundary, h.completion.finished]
    omega
  have hp := he.2
  rw [if_pos hv] at hp
  rw [he.1]
  exact h.parent_is_key _ _ _ hp

/-- The extracted adversarial forest has a valid two-epoch offline
schedule. Its key-first ordering is constructed from the actual recorded
keys, rather than supplied as an unproved scheduling witness. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.off.source:
theorem RecordedRun.offline_schedule {m L c : ℕ} {hm : 0 < m} {hwpos : 0 < work}
    {A : DeterministicScheduler m} {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hwpos A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm)
      (initial m hm) Q records)
    (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hw : work = m * L) (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L) :
    ∃ O, (Q.toInstance L hwpos).Valid m O ∧ (Q.toInstance L hwpos).FlowBound O (2 * L) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L hwpos
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => keyFirstPosition (recordedKeys records (job v)) (position v)
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * L := by
    intro v
    exact (keyFirstPosition_lt _ _).trans_eq hw
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => (I.owner v, pos v)) := by
    intro u v he
    have ho : job u = job v := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.1) he
    have hp : pos u = pos v := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.2) he
    dsimp only [pos] at hp
    rw [ho] at hp
    have hv := keyFirstPosition_injective (recordedKeys records (job v)) hp
    exact LayeredForest.coordinates_injective (Prod.ext ho (congrArg Fin.val hv))
  have hedge : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → pos u < L ∧ pos u < pos v := by
    intro u v he
    have hu := h.edge_from_key he
    have hcard := (recordedKeys_card_le records (job u)).trans (h.forcing_layer_count hw hhalf (job u))
    refine ⟨(keyFirstPosition_key_lt _ _ hu).trans_le hcard, ?_⟩
    have ho := I.same_job he
    change job u = job v at ho
    change keyFirstPosition (recordedKeys records (job u)) (position u) <
      keyFirstPosition (recordedKeys records (job v)) (position v)
    rw [← ho]
    exact keyFirstPosition_edge _ hu (I.rank_increases he)
  refine ⟨fun v => pipelineTime m L (I.owner v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact I.pipeline_valid hm2 pos hpos hinj (by intros; rfl) hedge
  · exact I.pipeline_flowBound hm2 pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.opt.source:
theorem RecordedRun.optimum_bounds {m L c : ℕ} {hm : 0 < m} {hwpos : 0 < work}
    {A : DeterministicScheduler m} {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hwpos A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm)
      (initial m hm) Q records)
    (hm2 : 2 ≤ m) (hj : 0 < jobs) (hw : work = m * L) (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L) :
    L ≤ (Q.toInstance L hwpos).optimum m hm ∧ (Q.toInstance L hwpos).optimum m hm ≤ 2 * L := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := (Q.toInstance L hwpos).optimum_attained hm
  have hwork := (Q.toInstance L hwpos).job_work_bound hO hflow ⟨0, hj⟩
  rw [Q.jobVertices_card] at hwork
  refine ⟨Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hw.symm.le.trans hwork) hm, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hb⟩ := h.offline_schedule hm2 hw hhalf
  exact (Q.toInstance L hwpos).optimum_le hm hS hb

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.append_revealed_befo.source:
theorem append_revealed_before (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : t < d) {v : Fin (vertices₁ + vertices₂)}
    (hv : v ∈ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t) :
    ∃ u, v = Fin.castAdd vertices₂ u ∧ u ∈ I.revealedVertices done t := by
  rcases fin_add_cases v with ⟨u, rfl⟩ | ⟨u, rfl⟩
  · exact ⟨u, rfl, (I.append_revealed_left J d t done u).mp hv⟩
  · exact False.elim (I.append_revealed_right_before J d t done hd u hv)

Scheduling.Instance.append_graphObservat.source:
theorem append_graphObservation_before (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : t < d) :
    (I.append J d).graphObservation done t = I.graphObservation done t := by
  apply GraphObservation.ext_fields
  · change (univ.filter (fun j => (I.append J d).release j ≤ t)).image
      (fun j => (j.val, (I.append J d).release j)) =
      (univ.filter (fun j => I.release j ≤ t)).image (fun j => (j.val, I.release j))
    ext x
    simp only [mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, hx⟩
      rcases fin_add_cases j with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨j, by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hj,
          by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
      · simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right] at hj
        omega
    · rintro ⟨j, hj, hx⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd jobs₂ j, by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hj,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
  · change ((I.append J d).revealedVertices done t).image _ = (I.revealedVertices done t).image _
    ext x
    simp only [mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨u, rfl, hu⟩ := I.append_revealed_before J d t done hd hv
      exact ⟨u, hu, by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, hx⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v, (I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mpr hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
  · ext x
    simp only [mem_graphObservation_edges]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨u, rfl, hleftU⟩ := I.append_revealed_before J d t done hd hu
      obtain ⟨v, rfl, hleftV⟩ := I.append_revealed_before J d t done hd hv
      exact ⟨u, v, hleftU, hleftV, by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using he,
        by simpa only [Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he, hx⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd vertices₂ u, Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v,
        (I.append_revealed_left J d t done u).mpr hu,
        (I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mpr hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using he,
        by simpa only [Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
  · change (((I.append J d).revealedVertices done t).filter (fun v => v.val ∉ done)).image Fin.val =
      ((I.revealedVertices done t).filter (fun v => v.val ∉ done)).image Fin.val
    ext x
    simp only [mem_image, mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, ⟨hv, hn⟩, hx⟩
      obtain ⟨v, rfl, hleft⟩ := I.append_revealed_before J d t done hd hv
      exact ⟨v, ⟨hleft, hn⟩, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨v, ⟨hv, hn⟩, hx⟩
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v, ⟨(I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mpr hv, hn⟩, hx⟩

end Instance

namespace DeterministicScheduler
variable {m jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m)

Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.append.source:
theorem append_slots_before (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {d t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) :
    executionSlot (A.schedule (I.append J d)) t = executionSlot (A.schedule I) t := by
  symm
  apply A.transfer_slots I (I.append J d) (T := t) ?_ t le_rfl
  intro u hu
  exact (I.append_graphObservation_before J d u _ (by omega)).symm

theorem append_time_before (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {d t : ℕ} (ht : t < d) (v : Fin vertices₁) :
    A.schedule (I.append J d) (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v) = t ↔ A.schedule I v = t := by
  have he := A.append_slots_before I J ht
  have hm : (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v).val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule (I.append J d)) t ↔
      v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule I) t := by
    rw [he]
    rfl
  simpa only [val_mem_executionSlot] using hm

/-- A later copy cannot erase a flow lower bound whose deadline falls
before its release. The earlier schedule need not have completed. -/

theorem append_flow_lower (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {d F : ℕ} (hbad : F ≤ I.maxFlow (A.schedule I))
    (hgap : ∀ j, I.release j + F ≤ d) :
    F ≤ (I.append J d).maxFlow (A.schedule (I.append J d)) := by
  let U := A.schedule (I.append J d)
  let B := (I.append J d).maxFlow U
  by_contra hn
  have hBF : B < F := by change ¬ F ≤ B at hn; omega
  have hflow : (I.append J d).FlowBound U B :=
    ((I.append J d).flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le U B).mpr le_rfl
  have hlocal : I.FlowBound (A.schedule I) B := by
    intro v
    have hf := hflow (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v)
    simp only [Instance.append, Fin.addCases_left] at hf
    have htime : U (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v) < d := by have := hgap (I.owner v); omega
    have he := (A.append_time_before I J htime v).mp rfl
    rw [he]
    exact hf
  have hh := (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mp hlocal
  omega

end DeterministicScheduler
end Scheduling

Scheduling.right_executionPrefix.source:
theorem right_executionPrefix {a b d t : ℕ} (U : Assignment (vertices := a + b))
    (hstart : ∀ v, d ≤ U (Fin.natAdd a v)) (ht : d ≤ t) :
    shiftedDone a (executionPrefix U t) = executionPrefix (Instance.rightSchedule U d) (t - d) := by
  ext n
  rw [mem_shiftedDone]
  by_cases hn : n < b
  · let v : Fin b := ⟨n, hn⟩
    change (Fin.natAdd a v).val ∈ executionPrefix U t ↔
      v.val ∈ executionPrefix (Instance.rightSchedule U d) (t - d)
    rw [val_mem_executionPrefix, val_mem_executionPrefix]
    have hh := hstart v
    dsimp only [Instance.rightSchedule]
    omega
  · constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := mem_image.mp h
      have hl := v.isLt
      omega
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := mem_image.mp h
      have hl := v.isLt
      omega

Scheduling.right_executionSlot.source:
theorem right_executionSlot {a b d : ℕ} (U : Assignment (vertices := a + b))
    (hstart : ∀ v, d ≤ U (Fin.natAdd a v)) (t : ℕ) :
    shiftedDone a (executionSlot U (d + t)) = executionSlot (Instance.rightSchedule U d) t := by
  ext n
  rw [mem_shiftedDone]
  by_cases hn : n < b
  · let v : Fin b := ⟨n, hn⟩
    change (Fin.natAdd a v).val ∈ executionSlot U (d + t) ↔
      v.val ∈ executionSlot (Instance.rightSchedule U d) t
    rw [val_mem_executionSlot, val_mem_executionSlot]
    have hh := hstart v
    dsimp only [Instance.rightSchedule]
    omega
  · constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := mem_image.mp h
      have hl := v.isLt
      omega
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨v, _, hv⟩ := mem_image.mp h
      have hl := v.isLt
      omega

namespace DeterministicScheduler
variable {m jobs vertices : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m)

/-- Restricting to an appended instance preserves full revealed-graph
causality, even if old jobs remain unfinished when the new copy starts. -/

Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.contin.source:
theorem continuation_causal (I : Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ)
    {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ}
    (J : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (K : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (t : ℕ)
    (hobs : ∀ u ≤ t,
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append J d)) d) u) u =
      K.graphObservation (executionPrefix (Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append K d)) d) u) u) :
    executionSlot (Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append J d)) d) t =
      executionSlot (Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append K d)) d) t := by
  let U := A.schedule (I.append J d)
  let V := A.schedule (I.append K d)
  have hU : ∀ v, d ≤ U (Fin.natAdd vertices v) := I.append_right_time J (A.valid _) 
  have hV : ∀ v, d ≤ V (Fin.natAdd vertices v) := I.append_right_time K (A.valid _)
  have hslots : ∀ s ≤ d + t, executionSlot U s = executionSlot V s := by
    intro s
    induction s using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h s ih =>
      intro hs
      apply A.causal (I.append J d) (I.append K d) s
      intro u hu
      have hp : executionPrefix U u = executionPrefix V u :=
        executionPrefix_eq_of_slots (fun v hv => ih v (by omega) (by omega))
      change (I.append J d).graphObservation (executionPrefix U u) u =
        (I.append K d).graphObservation (executionPrefix V u) u
      by_cases hud : u < d
      · rw [I.append_graphObservation_before J d u _ hud,
          I.append_graphObservation_before K d u _ hud, hp]
      · have hdu : d ≤ u := by omega
        rw [I.append_graphObservation J d u _ hdu, I.append_graphObservation K d u _ hdu]
        have hnew := hobs (u - d) (by omega)
        change J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (Instance.rightSchedule U d) (u - d)) (u - d) =
          K.graphObservation (executionPrefix (Instance.rightSchedule V d) (u - d)) (u - d) at hnew
        rw [← right_executionPrefix U hU hdu, ← right_executionPrefix V hV hdu] at hnew
        rw [hp] at hnew
        rw [hp, hnew]
  rw [← right_executionSlot U hU t, ← right_executionSlot V hV t]
  rw [hslots (d + t) le_rfl]

noncomputable def continuation (I : Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ) : DeterministicScheduler m where
  schedule J := Instance.rightSchedule (A.schedule (I.append J d)) d
  valid J := I.rightSchedule_valid J (A.valid _)
  causal := A.continuation_causal I d

theorem continuation_flow_le (I : Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ)
    {jobs₂ vertices₂ : ℕ} (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) :
    J.maxFlow ((A.continuation I d).schedule J) ≤
      (I.append J d).maxFlow (A.schedule (I.append J d)) :=
  I.maxFlow_right_le J (A.valid _)

end DeterministicScheduler
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.append.source:
def append (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d : ℕ) :
    Instance (jobs₁ + jobs₂) (vertices₁ + vertices₂) where
  owner := Fin.addCases (fun v => Fin.castAdd jobs₂ (I.owner v)) (fun v => Fin.natAdd jobs₁ (J.owner v))
  release := Fin.addCases I.release (fun j => d + J.release j)
  edge u v := Fin.addCases
    (fun u => Fin.addCases (fun v => I.edge u v) (fun _ => False) v)
    (fun u => Fin.addCases (fun _ => False) (fun v => J.edge u v) v) u
  same_job := by
    intro u v
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ u <;> intro u
    · refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v <;> simp only [Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
      · intro h; exact congrArg (Fin.castAdd jobs₂) (I.same_job h)
      · simp
    · refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v <;> simp only [Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
      · simp
      · intro h; exact congrArg (Fin.natAdd jobs₁) (J.same_job h)
  rank := Fin.addCases I.rank J.rank
  rank_increases := by
    intro u v
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ u <;> intro u
    · refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v <;> simp only [Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
      · exact I.rank_increases
      · simp
    · refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v <;> simp only [Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right]
      · simp
      · exact J.rank_increases
  nonempty_job := by
    intro j
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro j
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := I.nonempty_job j
      exact ⟨Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v, by simp only [Fin.addCases_left, hv]⟩
    · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := J.nonempty_job j
      exact ⟨Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v, by simp only [Fin.addCases_right, hv]⟩

Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule_left.source:
@[simp] theorem appendSchedule_left (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁))
    (T : Assignment (vertices := vertices₂)) (d : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices₁) :
    appendSchedule S T d (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v) = S v := by
  simp only [appendSchedule, Fin.addCases_left]

Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule_right.source:
@[simp] theorem appendSchedule_right (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁))
    (T : Assignment (vertices := vertices₂)) (d : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices₂) :
    appendSchedule S T d (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v) = d + T v := by
  simp only [appendSchedule, Fin.addCases_right]

Scheduling.Instance.appendSchedule_slot_.source:
theorem appendSchedule_slot_card (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁))
    (T : Assignment (vertices := vertices₂)) (d t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => appendSchedule S T d v = t)).card =
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card + (univ.filter (fun v => d + T v = t)).card := by
  simp only [card_eq_sum_ones, sum_filter]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_add]
  simp only [appendSchedule_left, appendSchedule_right]

Scheduling.Instance.append_valid.source:
theorem append_valid (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {m d : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁)} {T : Assignment (vertices := vertices₂)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hT : J.Valid m T) (hfinish : ∀ v, S v < d) :
    (I.append J d).Valid m (appendSchedule S T d) := by
  constructor
  · intro v
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v
    · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, appendSchedule_left] using hS.release v
    · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right, appendSchedule_right] using Nat.add_le_add_left (hT.release v) d
  · intro u v
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ u <;> intro u
    · refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v <;>
        simp only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, appendSchedule_left, appendSchedule_right]
      · exact hS.precedence
      · simp
    · refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v <;>
        simp only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, appendSchedule_left, appendSchedule_right]
      · simp
      · intro h; exact Nat.add_lt_add_left (hT.precedence h) d
  · intro t
    rw [appendSchedule_slot_card]
    by_cases ht : t < d
    · have hz : (univ.filter (fun v => d + T v = t)).card = 0 := by
        apply card_eq_zero.mpr
        apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro v hv
        have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        omega
      rw [hz, Nat.add_zero]
      exact hS.capacity t
    · have hz : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = 0 := by
        apply card_eq_zero.mpr
        apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro v hv
        have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hf := hfinish v
        omega
      have he : univ.filter (fun v => d + T v = t) = univ.filter (fun v => T v = t - d) := by
        ext v
        simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
        omega
      rw [hz, Nat.zero_add, he]
      exact hT.capacity (t - d)

Scheduling.Instance.append_flowBound.source:
theorem append_flowBound (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {d B : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁)} {T : Assignment (vertices := vertices₂)}
    (hS : I.FlowBound S B) (hT : J.FlowBound T B) :
    (I.append J d).FlowBound (appendSchedule S T d) B := by
  intro v
  refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v
  · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, appendSchedule_left] using hS v
  · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right, appendSchedule_right, Nat.add_assoc] using
      Nat.add_lt_add_left (hT v) d

Scheduling.Instance.append_offline.source:
theorem append_offline (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {m B d : ℕ} (hI : ∃ S, I.Valid m S ∧ I.FlowBound S B)
    (hJ : ∃ T, J.Valid m T ∧ J.FlowBound T B)
    (hgap : ∀ j, I.release j + B ≤ d) :
    ∃ U, (I.append J d).Valid m U ∧ (I.append J d).FlowBound U B := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hfS⟩ := hI
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hfT⟩ := hJ
  exact ⟨appendSchedule S T d, I.append_valid J hS hT (fun v => (hfS v).trans_le (hgap _)),
    I.append_flowBound J hfS hfT⟩

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.GraphObservation.ext_fields.source:
theorem GraphObservation.ext_fields {O P : GraphObservation}
    (ha : O.arrivals = P.arrivals) (hv : O.visible = P.visible)
    (he : O.edges = P.edges) (hr : O.ready = P.ready) : O = P := by
  cases O
  cases P
  cases ha
  cases hv
  cases he
  cases hr
  rfl

Scheduling.GraphObservation.merge.source:
def GraphObservation.merge (O P : GraphObservation) : GraphObservation where
  arrivals := O.arrivals ∪ P.arrivals
  visible := O.visible ∪ P.visible
  edges := O.edges ∪ P.edges
  ready := O.ready ∪ P.ready

Scheduling.GraphObservation.shift.source:
def GraphObservation.shift (O : GraphObservation) (jobs vertices d : ℕ) : GraphObservation where
  arrivals := O.arrivals.image (fun p => (jobs + p.1, d + p.2))
  visible := O.visible.image (fun p => (vertices + p.1, jobs + p.2))
  edges := O.edges.image (fun p => (vertices + p.1, vertices + p.2))
  ready := O.ready.image (fun v => vertices + v)

Scheduling.shiftedDone.source:
def shiftedDone (vertices : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (done.filter (vertices ≤ ·)).image (· - vertices)

Scheduling.mem_shiftedDone.source:
@[simp] theorem mem_shiftedDone (vertices n : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) :
    n ∈ shiftedDone vertices done ↔ vertices + n ∈ done := by
  simp only [shiftedDone, mem_image, mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, ⟨hv, hlo⟩, he⟩
    have hh : vertices + n = v := by omega
    rwa [hh]
  · intro h
    exact ⟨vertices + n, ⟨h, by omega⟩, by omega⟩

Scheduling.fin_add_cases.source:
theorem fin_add_cases {a b : ℕ} (v : Fin (a + b)) :
    (∃ u : Fin a, v = Fin.castAdd b u) ∨ ∃ u : Fin b, v = Fin.natAdd a u := by
  exact Fin.addCases (fun u => Or.inl ⟨u, rfl⟩) (fun u => Or.inr ⟨u, rfl⟩) v

namespace Instance
variable {jobs₁ jobs₂ vertices₁ vertices₂ : ℕ}

Scheduling.Instance.append_revealed_left.source:
theorem append_revealed_left (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (v : Fin vertices₁) :
    Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v ∈ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t ↔ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hr
    · intro u hu
      exact hp (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ u) (by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hu)
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hr
    · intro u
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ u <;> intro u
      · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hp u
      · simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right, Fin.addCases_left, false_implies]

Scheduling.Instance.append_revealed_righ.source:
theorem append_revealed_right (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : d ≤ t) (v : Fin vertices₂) :
    Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v ∈ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t ↔
      v ∈ J.revealedVertices (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d) := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right] at hr
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, by omega, ?_⟩
    intro u hu
    apply (mem_shiftedDone vertices₁ u.val done).mpr
    exact hp (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ u) (by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right] using hu)
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨hr, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right]
      omega
    · intro u
      refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ u <;> intro u
      · simp only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, false_implies]
      · intro hu
        exact (mem_shiftedDone vertices₁ u.val done).mp
          (hp u (by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right] using hu))

theorem append_revealed_right_before (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : t < d) (v : Fin vertices₂) :
    Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v ∉ (I.append J d).revealedVertices done t := by
  intro hv
  have hr := (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1
  simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right] at hr
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_a.source:
theorem append_observation_arrivals (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : d ≤ t) :
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).arrivals =
      (I.graphObservation done t).arrivals ∪
      (J.graphObservation (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).arrivals.image
        (fun p => (jobs₁ + p.1, d + p.2)) := by
  change (univ.filter (fun j => (I.append J d).release j ≤ t)).image
    (fun j => (j.val, (I.append J d).release j)) =
    (univ.filter (fun j => I.release j ≤ t)).image (fun j => (j.val, I.release j)) ∪
      ((univ.filter (fun j => J.release j ≤ t - d)).image (fun j => (j.val, J.release j))).image
        (fun p => (jobs₁ + p.1, d + p.2))
  ext x
  simp only [mem_union, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, hx⟩
    rcases fin_add_cases j with ⟨j, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨j, by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hj,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · have hr : J.release j ≤ t - d := by
        simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right] at hj
        omega
      exact Or.inr ⟨(j.val, J.release j), ⟨j, hr, rfl⟩,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right, Fin.val_natAdd] using hx⟩
  · rintro (⟨j, hj, hx⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨j, hj, hp⟩, hx⟩)
    · exact ⟨Fin.castAdd jobs₂ j, by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hj,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · subst p
      refine ⟨Fin.natAdd jobs₁ j, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right]; omega
      · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right, Fin.val_natAdd] using hx

Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_v.source:
theorem append_observation_visible (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : d ≤ t) :
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).visible =
      (I.graphObservation done t).visible ∪
      (J.graphObservation (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).visible.image
        (fun p => (vertices₁ + p.1, jobs₁ + p.2)) := by
  change ((I.append J d).revealedVertices done t).image _ =
    (I.revealedVertices done t).image _ ∪
      ((J.revealedVertices (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).image _).image _
  ext x
  simp only [mem_union, mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hx⟩
    revert hv hx
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v hv hx
    · exact Or.inl ⟨v, (I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mp hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨(v.val, (J.owner v).val), ⟨v, (I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd v).mp hv, rfl⟩,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right, Fin.val_natAdd] using hx⟩
  · rintro (⟨v, hv, hx⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨v, hv, hp⟩, hx⟩)
    · exact ⟨Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v, (I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mpr hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · subst p
      exact ⟨Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v, (I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd v).mpr hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right, Fin.val_natAdd] using hx⟩

Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_r.source:
theorem append_observation_ready (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : d ≤ t) :
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).ready =
      (I.graphObservation done t).ready ∪
      (J.graphObservation (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).ready.image (vertices₁ + ·) := by
  change (((I.append J d).revealedVertices done t).filter (fun v => v.val ∉ done)).image Fin.val =
    ((I.revealedVertices done t).filter (fun v => v.val ∉ done)).image Fin.val ∪
      (((J.revealedVertices (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).filter
        (fun v => v.val ∉ shiftedDone vertices₁ done)).image Fin.val).image (vertices₁ + ·)
  ext x
  simp only [mem_union, mem_image, mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, ⟨hv, hn⟩, hx⟩
    revert hx
    revert hn
    revert hv
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v hv hn hx
    · exact Or.inl ⟨v, ⟨(I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mp hv, hn⟩, hx⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨v.val, ⟨v, ⟨(I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd v).mp hv,
        by simpa only [mem_shiftedDone, Fin.val_natAdd] using hn⟩, rfl⟩, hx⟩
  · rintro (⟨v, ⟨hv, hn⟩, hx⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨v, ⟨hv, hn⟩, hp⟩, hx⟩)
    · exact ⟨Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v, ⟨(I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mpr hv, hn⟩, hx⟩
    · subst p
      exact ⟨Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v, ⟨(I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd v).mpr hv,
        by simpa only [mem_shiftedDone, Fin.val_natAdd] using hn⟩, hx⟩

Scheduling.Instance.mem_graphObservation.source:
theorem mem_graphObservation_edges {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)
    (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ) (x : ℕ × ℕ) :
    x ∈ (I.graphObservation done t).edges ↔
      ∃ u v, u ∈ I.revealedVertices done t ∧ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t ∧
        I.edge u v ∧ (u.val, v.val) = x := by
  change x ∈ (((I.revealedVertices done t).product (I.revealedVertices done t)).filter
    (fun e => I.edge e.1 e.2)).image (fun e => (e.1.val, e.2.val)) ↔ _
  simp only [mem_image, mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨u, v⟩, ⟨huv, he⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨u, v, (mem_product.mp huv).1, (mem_product.mp huv).2, he, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he, hx⟩
    exact ⟨(u, v), ⟨mem_product.mpr ⟨hu, hv⟩, he⟩, hx⟩

Scheduling.Instance.append_observation_e.source:
theorem append_observation_edges (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : d ≤ t) :
    ((I.append J d).graphObservation done t).edges =
      (I.graphObservation done t).edges ∪
      (J.graphObservation (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).edges.image
        (fun p => (vertices₁ + p.1, vertices₁ + p.2)) := by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_union, mem_image, mem_graphObservation_edges]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he, hx⟩
    rcases fin_add_cases u with ⟨u, rfl⟩ | ⟨u, rfl⟩ <;>
      rcases fin_add_cases v with ⟨v, rfl⟩ | ⟨v, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨u, v, (I.append_revealed_left J d t done u).mp hu,
        (I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mp hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using he,
        by simpa only [Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · simp only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right] at he
    · simp only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right] at he
    · exact Or.inr ⟨(u.val, v.val),
        ⟨u, v, (I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd u).mp hu,
          (I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd v).mp hv,
          by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right] using he, rfl⟩,
        by simpa only [Fin.val_natAdd] using hx⟩
  · rintro (⟨u, v, hu, hv, he, hx⟩ | ⟨p, ⟨u, v, hu, hv, he, hp⟩, hx⟩)
    · exact ⟨Fin.castAdd vertices₂ u, Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v,
        (I.append_revealed_left J d t done u).mpr hu,
        (I.append_revealed_left J d t done v).mpr hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using he,
        by simpa only [Fin.val_castAdd] using hx⟩
    · subst p
      exact ⟨Fin.natAdd vertices₁ u, Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v,
        (I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd u).mpr hu,
        (I.append_revealed_right J d t done hd v).mpr hv,
        by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right] using he,
        by simpa only [Fin.val_natAdd] using hx⟩

Scheduling.Instance.append_graphObservat.source:
theorem append_graphObservation (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (d t : ℕ) (done : Finset ℕ) (hd : d ≤ t) :
    (I.append J d).graphObservation done t =
      (I.graphObservation done t).merge
        ((J.graphObservation (shiftedDone vertices₁ done) (t - d)).shift jobs₁ vertices₁ d) := by
  apply GraphObservation.ext_fields
  · exact I.append_observation_arrivals J d t done hd
  · exact I.append_observation_visible J d t done hd
  · exact I.append_observation_edges J d t done hd
  · exact I.append_observation_ready J d t done hd

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.leftSchedule.source:
def leftSchedule (U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)) : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁) :=
  fun v => U (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v)

Scheduling.Instance.rightSchedule.source:
def rightSchedule (U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)) (d : ℕ) : Assignment (vertices := vertices₂) :=
  fun v => U (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v) - d

Scheduling.Instance.append_right_time.source:
theorem append_right_time (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)} (hU : (I.append J d).Valid m U)
    (v : Fin vertices₂) : d ≤ U (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v) := by
  have hr := hU.release (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v)
  simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right] at hr
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.leftSchedule_valid.source:
theorem leftSchedule_valid (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)} (hU : (I.append J d).Valid m U) :
    I.Valid m (leftSchedule U) := by
  constructor
  · intro v
    simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, leftSchedule] using hU.release (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v)
  · intro u v he
    exact hU.precedence (by simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using he)
  · intro t
    have hh := card_le_card_of_injOn (Fin.castAdd vertices₂)
      (s := univ.filter (fun v => leftSchedule U v = t))
      (t := univ.filter (fun v => U v = t))
      (by intro v hv; exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hv).2⟩)
      (by
        intro u _ v _ he
        have hh := congrArg (fun v : Fin (vertices₁ + vertices₂) => v.val) he
        exact Fin.ext hh)
    exact hh.trans (hU.capacity t)

Scheduling.Instance.rightSchedule_valid.source:
theorem rightSchedule_valid (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)} (hU : (I.append J d).Valid m U) :
    J.Valid m (rightSchedule U d) := by
  constructor
  · intro v
    have hr := hU.release (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v)
    simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right] at hr
    dsimp only [rightSchedule]
    omega
  · intro u v he
    have hp := hU.precedence
      (show (I.append J d).edge (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ u) (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v) from by
        simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right] using he)
    have hu := I.append_right_time J hU u
    dsimp only [rightSchedule]
    omega
  · intro t
    have hh := card_le_card_of_injOn (Fin.natAdd vertices₁)
      (s := univ.filter (fun v => rightSchedule U d v = t))
      (t := univ.filter (fun v => U v = d + t))
      (by
        intro v hv
        have ht := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hr := I.append_right_time J hU v
        dsimp only [rightSchedule] at ht
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩)
      (by
        intro u _ v _ he
        apply Fin.ext
        have hh := congrArg Fin.val he
        change vertices₁ + u.val = vertices₁ + v.val at hh
        omega)
    exact hh.trans (hU.capacity (d + t))

Scheduling.Instance.leftSchedule_flowBou.source:
theorem leftSchedule_flowBound (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)} {B : ℕ}
    (hflow : (I.append J d).FlowBound U B) : I.FlowBound (leftSchedule U) B := by
  intro v
  simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left, leftSchedule] using hflow (Fin.castAdd vertices₂ v)

Scheduling.Instance.rightSchedule_flowBo.source:
theorem rightSchedule_flowBound (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)} {B : ℕ}
    (hU : (I.append J d).Valid m U) (hflow : (I.append J d).FlowBound U B) :
    J.FlowBound (rightSchedule U d) B := by
  intro v
  have hf := hflow (Fin.natAdd vertices₁ v)
  have hr := I.append_right_time J hU v
  simp only [append, Fin.addCases_right] at hf
  dsimp only [rightSchedule]
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.maxFlow_left_le.source:
theorem maxFlow_left_le (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)) :
    I.maxFlow (leftSchedule U) ≤ (I.append J d).maxFlow U := by
  apply (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mp
  exact I.leftSchedule_flowBound J (((I.append J d).flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le U _).mpr le_rfl)

Scheduling.Instance.maxFlow_right_le.source:
theorem maxFlow_right_le (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {U : Assignment (vertices := vertices₁ + vertices₂)} (hU : (I.append J d).Valid m U) :
    J.maxFlow (rightSchedule U d) ≤ (I.append J d).maxFlow U := by
  apply (J.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mp
  exact I.rightSchedule_flowBound J hU (((I.append J d).flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le U _).mpr le_rfl)

Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_ge_le.source:
theorem append_optimum_ge_left (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (hm : 0 < m) (d : ℕ) : I.optimum m hm ≤ (I.append J d).optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hf⟩ := (I.append J d).optimum_attained hm
  exact I.optimum_le hm (I.leftSchedule_valid J hU) (I.leftSchedule_flowBound J hf)

Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_ge_ri.source:
theorem append_optimum_ge_right (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (hm : 0 < m) (d : ℕ) : J.optimum m hm ≤ (I.append J d).optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hf⟩ := (I.append J d).optimum_attained hm
  exact J.optimum_le hm (I.rightSchedule_valid J hU) (I.rightSchedule_flowBound J hU hf)

Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_le.source:
theorem append_optimum_le (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (hm : 0 < m) {B d : ℕ} (hI : I.optimum m hm ≤ B) (hJ : J.optimum m hm ≤ B)
    (hgap : ∀ j, I.release j + B ≤ d) : (I.append J d).optimum m hm ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hfS⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hfT⟩ := J.optimum_attained hm
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hfU⟩ := I.append_offline J
    ⟨S, hS, fun v => (hfS v).trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left hI _)⟩
    ⟨T, hT, fun v => (hfT v).trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left hJ _)⟩ hgap
  exact (I.append J d).optimum_le hm hU hfU

Scheduling.Instance.append_optimum_eq.source:
theorem append_optimum_eq (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    (hm : 0 < m) {B d : ℕ} (hI : I.optimum m hm = B) (hJ : J.optimum m hm ≤ B)
    (hgap : ∀ j, I.release j + B ≤ d) : (I.append J d).optimum m hm = B := by
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (I.append_optimum_le J hm hI.le hJ hgap)
  rw [← hI]
  exact I.append_optimum_ge_left J hm d

Scheduling.Instance.append_batched_relea.source:
theorem append_batched_releases (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂)
    {L d : ℕ} (hI : ∀ j, L ∣ I.release j) (hJ : ∀ j, L ∣ J.release j) (hd : L ∣ d) :
    ∀ j, L ∣ (I.append J d).release j := by
  intro j
  refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro j
  · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_left] using hI j
  · simpa only [append, Fin.addCases_right] using dvd_add hd (hJ j)

Scheduling.Instance.append_outForest.source:
theorem append_outForest (I : Instance jobs₁ vertices₁) (J : Instance jobs₂ vertices₂) (d : ℕ)
    (hI : ∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v)
    (hJ : ∀ u v w, J.edge u w → J.edge v w → u = v) :
    ∀ u v w, (I.append J d).edge u w → (I.append J d).edge v w → u = v := by
  intro u v w
  refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ w <;> intro w
  all_goals
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ u <;> intro u
  all_goals
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ v <;> intro v
  all_goals simp only [append, Fin.addCases_left, Fin.addCases_right, false_implies, implies_true]
  · intro hu hv
    exact congrArg (Fin.castAdd vertices₂) (hI u v w hu hv)
  · intro hu hv
    exact congrArg (Fin.natAdd vertices₁) (hJ u v w hu hv)

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.Instance.remaining_le_alive_w.source:
theorem remaining_le_alive_work {m L : ℕ}
    {O S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (t : ℕ) :
    (I.remaining S t).card ≤ (I.alive S t).card * (m * L) := by
  classical
  have heq : (I.remaining S t).card =
      ∑ j ∈ I.alive S t, ((I.remaining S t).filter (fun v => I.owner v = j)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by
      intro v hv
      have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, h.1, v, rfl, h.2⟩)
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ I.alive S t, m * L := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      apply (card_le_card (t := I.jobVertices j) ?_).trans (I.job_work_bound hO hL j)
      intro v hv
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hv).2⟩
    _ = _ := by simp

Scheduling.Instance.full_of_many_alive.source:
theorem full_of_many_alive {m : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) {t : ℕ}
    (ha : m ≤ (I.alive S t).card) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m := by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  have hlt : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (hS.capacity t) hne
  have hsub : I.alive S t ⊆ (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).image I.owner := by
    intro j hj
    have hj' := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hr⟩ := I.exists_ready hj'.1 hj'.2
    have he : S v = t := by
      by_contra he
      exact hne (hF.work_conserving t v hr he)
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, by simp [he], hv⟩
  have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_image_le)
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.executedDuring.source:
noncomputable def executedDuring (_I : Instance jobs vertices) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (a b : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin vertices) := univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)

Scheduling.Instance.executedDuring_card.source:
theorem executedDuring_card {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {m a b : ℕ}
    (full : ∀ t, a ≤ t → t < b → (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m) :
    (I.executedDuring S a b).card = m * (b - a) := by
  classical
  have heq : (I.executedDuring S a b).card =
      ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, ((I.executedDuring S a b).filter (fun v => S v = t)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by intro v hv; exact mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2)
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ = ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, m := by
      apply sum_congr rfl
      intro t ht
      have ht' := mem_Ico.mp ht
      have he : (I.executedDuring S a b).filter (fun v => S v = t) =
          univ.filter (fun v => S v = t) := by
        ext v
        simp only [executedDuring, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
        constructor
        · exact fun h => h.2
        · intro h; exact ⟨by omega, h⟩
      rw [he, full t ht'.1 ht'.2]
    _ = _ := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

/-- Conservation of work between the last sparse state and the present.
The old state includes slot `s-1`; ignoring service in that slot only weakens
the inequality. -/

Scheduling.Instance.backlog_accounting.source:
theorem backlog_accounting {m s t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hst : s ≤ t) :
    (I.remaining S t).card + (I.executedDuring S s t).card ≤
      (if s = 0 then 0 else (I.remaining S (s - 1)).card) +
      (univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t)).card := by
  classical
  let old : Finset (Fin vertices) := if s = 0 then ∅ else I.remaining S (s - 1)
  let new := univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t)
  have hd : Disjoint (I.remaining S t) (I.executedDuring S s t) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hv hw
    have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hw' := (mem_filter.mp hw).2
    omega
  have hsub : I.remaining S t ∪ I.executedDuring S s t ⊆ old ∪ new := by
    intro v hv
    have hr : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t := by
      rcases mem_union.mp hv with h | h
      · exact (mem_filter.mp h).2.1
      · have := (mem_filter.mp h).2; have := hS.release v; omega
    have hs : s ≤ S v := by
      rcases mem_union.mp hv with h | h
      · have := (mem_filter.mp h).2; omega
      · exact (mem_filter.mp h).2.1
    by_cases hnew : s ≤ I.release (I.owner v)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hnew, hr⟩)
    · apply mem_union_left
      have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by omega
      simp only [old, hs0, ↓reduceIte]
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega, by omega⟩
  have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_union_le old new)
  rw [card_union_of_disjoint hd] at hc
  by_cases hs : s = 0 <;> simpa [old, new, hs] using hc

/-- Lemma 9. This theorem derives the backlog bound from concrete finite
schedule constraints, not from a backlog-bound hypothesis. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_backlog_bound.source:
theorem fifo_backlog_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (t : ℕ) :
    (I.remaining S t).card ≤ m * m * L := by
  classical
  have sparse : ∀ u, (I.alive S u).card < m →
      (I.remaining S u).card ≤ (m - 1) * m * L := by
    intro u hu
    have h := I.remaining_le_alive_work hO hL (S := S) u
    have hc : (I.alive S u).card ≤ m - 1 := by omega
    exact h.trans (by simpa [Nat.mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m * L) hc)
  by_cases ht : (I.alive S t).card < m
  · exact (sparse t ht).trans (by exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (Nat.sub_le m 1)))
  · let P := fun s => s ≤ t ∧ ∀ u, s ≤ u → u ≤ t → m ≤ (I.alive S u).card
    have hex : ∃ s, P s := by
      refine ⟨t, le_rfl, ?_⟩
      intro u hu hut
      have he : u = t := by omega
      rw [he]
      omega
    let s := Nat.find hex
    have hs := Nat.find_spec hex
    have hst : s ≤ t := hs.1
    have hold : (if s = 0 then 0 else (I.remaining S (s - 1)).card) ≤
        (m - 1) * m * L := by
      split_ifs with hzero
      · exact Nat.zero_le _
      · apply sparse
        by_contra hn
        have hp : P (s - 1) := by
          refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
          intro u hu hut
          by_cases he : u = s - 1
          · subst u; omega
          · exact hs.2 u (by omega) hut
        have hmin := Nat.find_min' hex hp
        change s ≤ s - 1 at hmin
        omega
    have hfull : (I.executedDuring S s t).card = m * (t - s) :=
      I.executedDuring_card (fun u hu hut => I.full_of_many_alive hS hF (hs.2 u hu (by omega)))
    have hacc := I.backlog_accounting hS hst
    have harr := I.arrival_work_bound (a := s) (b := t) hO hL
    rw [hfull] at hacc
    have htL : t + L - s = t - s + L := by omega
    rw [htL] at harr
    have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
    nlinarith

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.card_before_orderEmb.source:
theorem card_before_orderEmb {L : ℕ} (W : Finset (Fin L)) (q : Fin W.card) :
    (W.filter (fun i => i < W.orderEmbOfFin rfl q)).card = q.val := by
  let e := W.orderEmbOfFin rfl
  have he : W.filter (fun i => i < e q) = (Iio q).image e := by
    ext i
    constructor
    · intro hi
      obtain ⟨hiW, hiq⟩ := mem_filter.mp hi
      let p := (W.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨i, hiW⟩
      have hp : e p = i := congrArg Subtype.val ((W.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨i, hiW⟩)
      refine mem_image.mpr ⟨p, mem_Iio.mpr ?_, hp⟩
      exact e.lt_iff_lt.mp (by rwa [hp])
    · rintro hi
      obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hi
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨W.orderEmbOfFin_mem rfl p, e.strictMono (mem_Iio.mp hp)⟩
  change (W.filter (fun i => i < e q)).card = q.val
  rw [he, card_image_of_injective _ e.injective, Fin.card_Iio]

/-- The layer order of each job has equally many wide and narrow layers,
and no prefix has more narrow layers than wide layers. -/

Scheduling.BalancedLayers.source:
structure BalancedLayers (jobs L : ℕ) where
  wide : Fin jobs → Finset (Fin L)
  half : ∀ j, 2 * (wide j).card = L
  balanced_prefix : ∀ j (i : Fin L), i.val ≤ 2 * ((wide j).filter (fun w => w < i)).card

namespace BalancedLayers
variable {jobs L : ℕ} (F : BalancedLayers jobs L)

Scheduling.BalancedLayers.wide_early.source:
theorem wide_early (j : Fin jobs) (q : Fin (F.wide j).card) :
    ((F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl q).val ≤ 2 * q.val := by
  have h := F.balanced_prefix j ((F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl q)
  rwa [card_before_orderEmb] at h

/-- Each wide layer contributes `2(m-1)` leaves, listed in layer order. -/

Scheduling.BalancedLayers.leafGroup.source:
def leafGroup {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin (m * L))
    (hk : L ≤ k.val) : Fin (F.wide j).card :=
  ⟨(k.val - L) / (2 * (m - 1)), by
    have hp : 0 < 2 * (m - 1) := by omega
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hp).mpr
    have hh := F.half j
    have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
    have he : k.val - L + L = k.val := Nat.sub_add_cancel hk
    have hlt := k.isLt
    nlinarith⟩

Scheduling.BalancedLayers.forest.source:
def forest {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) : LayeredForest jobs (m * L) where
  depth _ := L
  depth_pos _ := hL
  depth_le _ := by nlinarith
  leafLevel j k := if hk : k.val < L then ⟨0, hL⟩ else
    (F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl (F.leafGroup hm j k (by omega))

Scheduling.BalancedLayers.leaf_level_bou.source:
theorem leaf_level_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin (m * L)) (hk : L ≤ k.val) :
    (F.forest hm hL).level j k * (m - 1) ≤ k.val - L := by
  have hn : ¬ k.val < L := by omega
  have he := F.wide_early j (F.leafGroup hm j k hk)
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m - 1) he
  have hdiv := Nat.div_mul_le_self (k.val - L) (2 * (m - 1))
  dsimp [LayeredForest.level, forest]
  rw [if_neg hn, dif_neg hn]
  change ((F.wide j).orderEmbOfFin rfl (F.leafGroup hm j k hk)).val * (m - 1) ≤ k.val - L
  dsimp [leafGroup] at hmul ⊢
  nlinarith

Scheduling.BalancedLayers.offline_schedu.source:
theorem offline_schedule {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) :
    ∃ O, ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).Valid m O ∧
      ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).FlowBound O L := by
  let G := F.forest hm hL
  let I := G.toInstance L
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * (m * L)) => (LayeredForest.position v).val
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * L := fun v => (LayeredForest.position v).isLt
  refine ⟨fun v => batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply I.batched_valid hm pos hpos LayeredForest.coordinates_injective (by intros; rfl)
    intro u v huv
    have hk := G.edge_from_key L huv
    have he := huv.2
    change (LayeredForest.position u).val + 1 =
      G.level (LayeredForest.job v) (LayeredForest.position v) at he
    refine ⟨hk.1, ?_⟩
    by_cases hv : pos v < L
    · simpa only [if_pos hv] using hk.2
    · rw [if_neg hv]
      change ((LayeredForest.position u).val + 1) * (m - 1) ≤
        (LayeredForest.position v).val - L
      rw [he]
      exact F.leaf_level_bound hm hL _ _ (Nat.le_of_not_gt hv)
  · exact I.batched_flowBound hm pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

/-- The optimum is exactly the release spacing, as required by batched
arrivals. The lower bound follows from the exact `mL` work in each job. -/

Scheduling.BalancedLayers.optimum_eq.source:
theorem optimum_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (hj : 0 < jobs) :
    ((F.forest hm hL).toInstance L).optimum m (by omega) = L := by
  let G := F.forest hm hL
  let I := G.toInstance L
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := F.offline_schedule hm hL
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (I.optimum_le hm0 hO hflow)
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hp⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm0
  have hwork := I.job_work_bound hP hp ⟨0, hj⟩
  rw [G.jobVertices_card] at hwork
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hwork hm0

end BalancedLayers
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.batchRemaining.source:
noncomputable def batchRemaining (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin vertices) := univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) = r ∧ t ≤ S v)

/-- Lemma 17: residual work of jobs sharing release r fits into the last
L-z slots of an offline schedule, where z counts prefix-idle slots under FIFO.
This result does not require the other arrivals to be batched. -/

Scheduling.Instance.batch_remaining_work.source:
theorem batch_remaining_work_bound {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (hrt : r ≤ t) :
    (I.batchRemaining S r t).card ≤ m * (L - (I.partialSlots m S r t).card) := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_slots O m (r + (I.partialSlots m S r t).card) (r + L)
    (I.batchRemaining S r t) hO.capacity (by
      intro v hv
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hp := I.partial_progress hS hF hO (I.owner v) t (by rw [hv'.1]; exact hrt) v rfl hv'.2
      have hb := hL v
      rw [hv'.1] at hp hb
      exact ⟨hp, hb⟩)
  have heq : r + L - (r + (I.partialSlots m S r t).card) =
      L - (I.partialSlots m S r t).card := by omega
  rw [heq] at h
  exact h

Scheduling.Instance.batch_prefix_idle_lt.source:
theorem batch_prefix_idle_lt {m L r t : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (hrt : r ≤ t) (hu : (I.batchRemaining S r t).Nonempty) :
    (I.partialSlots m S r t).card < L := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have h := I.partial_slots_lt hS hF hO hL (I.owner v) (by rw [hv'.1]; exact hrt) ⟨v, rfl, hv'.2⟩
  simpa [hv'.1] using h

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.Accounting
open Finset

/-- Integer record inequalities force exponential growth of the prefix-idle
counts. Indices run from newest to oldest, reversing the order in Lemma 18. -/

Scheduling.Accounting.geometric_record_s.source:
theorem geometric_record_sum (z : ℕ → ℕ) (q : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i < q, 1 + ∑ j ∈ range i, z j ≤ z i) :
    2 ^ q ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ range q, z i := by
  induction q with
  | zero => simp
  | succ q ih =>
    have hp := ih (by intro i hi; exact hz i (by omega))
    have hq := hz q (by omega)
    rw [sum_range_succ, pow_succ]
    omega

Scheduling.Accounting.geometric_record_o.source:
theorem geometric_record_oldest (z : ℕ → ℕ) {q L : ℕ} (hq : 0 < q)
    (hz : ∀ i < q, 1 + ∑ j ∈ range i, z j ≤ z i)
    (hL : z (q - 1) < L) : 2 ^ (q - 1) < L := by
  have hsum := geometric_record_sum z (q - 1) (by intro i hi; exact hz i (by omega))
  have hlast := hz (q - 1) (by omega)
  omega

end Scheduling.Accounting

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.offline_sche.source:
theorem offline_schedule (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) :
    ∃ O, (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).Valid m O ∧
      (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound O L := by
  let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
  let I := Q.toInstance L hw
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := h.flexible.recorded
  have hcard : ∀ j, (recordedKeys records j).card = L := by
    intro j
    rw [hr.keys_card]
    exact final_job_length hm hL heven A h j
  have hparent : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → Q.parent (job v) (position v) = some (position u) := by
    intro u v he
    have hpos : (position v).val < Q.boundary (job v) := by
      have hlt := (position v).isLt
      simp only [boundary, hr.completion.finished]
      omega
    have hp := he.2
    rwa [if_pos hpos] at hp
  have hsource : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → position u ∈ recordedKeys records (job v) := by
    intro u v he
    rcases hr.parent_origins _ _ _ (hparent u v he) with hnone | ⟨r, hr', ho, hk⟩
    · simp [initial] at hnone
    · exact mem_image.mpr ⟨r, List.mem_toFinset.mpr
        (List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hr', decide_eq_true ho⟩), hk⟩
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * (m * L)) => keyFirstPosition (recordedKeys records (job v)) (position v)
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * L := fun v => keyFirstPosition_lt _ _
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => (I.owner v, pos v)) := by
    intro u v he
    have ho : job u = job v := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.1) he
    have hp : pos u = pos v := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.2) he
    dsimp only [pos] at hp
    rw [ho] at hp
    have hv := keyFirstPosition_injective (recordedKeys records (job v)) hp
    exact LayeredForest.coordinates_injective (Prod.ext ho (congrArg Fin.val hv))
  have hedge : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → pos u < L ∧
      (if pos v < L then pos u < pos v else (pos u + 1) * (m - 1) ≤ pos v - L) := by
    intro u v he
    have ho : job u = job v := he.1
    have hu := hsource u v he
    have hup : pos u < L := by
      dsimp only [pos]
      rw [ho]
      exact (keyFirstPosition_key_lt _ _ hu).trans_eq (hcard (job v))
    refine ⟨hup, ?_⟩
    by_cases hv : pos v < L
    · rw [if_pos hv]
      dsimp only [pos]
      rw [ho]
      exact keyFirstPosition_edge _ hu (I.rank_increases he)
    · rw [if_neg hv]
      have hvkey : position v ∉ recordedKeys records (job v) := by
        intro hh
        have hb := keyFirstPosition_key_lt _ _ hh
        rw [hcard] at hb
        exact hv hb
      have hcut := history_parent_cut hm hL heven A h (initial_budget hm hL heven)
        (by simp) (job v) (position v) (position u) (hparent u v he)
      simp only [List.nil_append] at hcut
      rcases hcut with hnone | ⟨p, n, hpu, hpv, hwork, hkeys⟩
      · simp [initial] at hnone
      · dsimp only [pos]
        rw [ho]
        simpa only [hcard] using
          keyFirstPosition_leaf_after_cut (by omega : 0 < m) _ _ _ hu hvkey hpu hpv hwork hkeys
  refine ⟨fun v => batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact I.batched_valid hm pos hpos hinj (by intros; rfl) hedge
  · exact I.batched_flowBound hm pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.optimum_eq.source:
theorem optimum_eq (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hj : 0 < jobs) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) :
    (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).optimum m (by omega) = L := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := offline_schedule hm hL heven A h
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (I.optimum_le hm0 hO hflow)
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hp⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm0
  have hwork := I.job_work_bound hP hp ⟨0, hj⟩
  rw [Q.jobVertices_card] at hwork
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hwork hm0

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideServi.source:
theorem jobWideService_mono_start (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) {a u b : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ u) :
    jobWideService m records j S u b ≤ jobWideService m records j S a b := by
  apply card_le_card
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨hw, hlo, hhi⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hw, ha.trans hlo, hhi⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideService_.source:
theorem wideService_eq_sum_jobs (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (a b : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin jobs))
    (howners : ∀ v, WideRecorded m records (job v) v → a ≤ S v → S v < b → job v ∈ J) :
    wideService m records S a b = ∑ j ∈ J, jobWideService m records j S a b := by
  unfold wideService
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := job) (fun v hv =>
    howners v (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1 (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2.1 (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2.2)]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  unfold jobWideService
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hw, ht⟩, ho⟩
    rw [ho] at hw
    exact ⟨hw, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨hw, ht⟩
    exact ⟨⟨by simpa only [hw.1] using hw, ht⟩, hw.1⟩

/-- Per-job cutoffs and the full-slot lower bound imply the aggregate
recurrence after sorting the cutoffs of jobs that can execute this epoch. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.cutoffs_pass.source:
theorem cutoffs_passivity (records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (i c : ℕ) (J : Finset (Fin jobs))
    (T : Fin jobs → ℕ) (hcut : JobCutoffs m L records S i T) (hcard : J.card ≤ c)
    (howners : ∀ v, WideRecorded m records (job v) v → i * L ≤ S v →
      S v < (i + 1) * L → job v ∈ J)
    (hlower : ∀ u, i * L ≤ u → u ≤ (i + 1) * L →
      (m - c) * ((i + 1) * L - u) ≤ wideService m records S u ((i + 1) * L)) :
    ∃ ds : List ℕ, ds.length ≤ c ∧ BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds) := by
  let xs := J.toList.mergeSort (fun x y => decide (T x ≤ T y))
  have hp : xs.Perm J.toList := List.mergeSort_perm _ _
  have hlen : xs.length ≤ c := by
    rw [hp.length_eq, Finset.length_toList]
    exact hcard
  have hsort : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => T x ≤ T y) := by
    simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using
      (List.pairwise_mergeSort (le := fun x y : Fin jobs => decide (T x ≤ T y))
        (by intro x y z hxy hyz; simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at *; omega)
        (by intro x y; simp only [Bool.or_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]; omega) J.toList)
  have hsum : ∀ u, i * L ≤ u → (xs.map (fun j => jobWideService m records j S u ((i + 1) * L))).sum =
      wideService m records S u ((i + 1) * L) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [(hp.map _).sum_eq, Finset.sum_map_toList]
    symm
    exact wideService_eq_sum_jobs m records S u ((i + 1) * L) J
      (fun v hw hvlo hvhi => howners v hw (hu.trans hvlo) hvhi)
  have hb := BatchedForcing.sorted_cutoffs_passivity m c (i * L) ((i + 1) * L) xs T
    (fun j u => jobWideService m records j S u ((i + 1) * L)) hlen hsort
    (fun j _ => ⟨(hcut j).1, (hcut j).2.1⟩)
    (by intro u hlo hhi; rw [hsum u hlo]; exact hlower u hlo hhi)
    (by
      intro j _ u hlo _
      have hh := (jobWideService_mono_start m records j S hlo).trans (hcut j).2.2.1
      have hx := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1)
        (show (i + 1) * L - T j + 1 ≤ (i + 1) * L - T j + 2 by omega)
      exact hh.trans hx)
    (fun j _ u hu => (hcut j).2.2.2 u hu) (by nlinarith)
  have hlength : (i + 1) * L - i * L = L := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact ⟨xs.map (fun j => (i + 1) * L - T j), by simpa only [List.length_map] using hlen,
    by simpa only [hlength] using hb⟩

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.idleEarlier_.source:
theorem idleEarlier_mono_same_epoch (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work))
    {e u : ℕ} (heu : e ≤ u) (hepoch : e / L = u / L)
    (h : IdleEarlier m L S e) : IdleEarlier m L S u := by
  obtain ⟨t, hlo, hhi, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨t, by rwa [← hepoch], hhi.trans_le heu, hc⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_w.source:
theorem finalWidth_wide_implies_choose (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hw : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 2 * m - 1) :
    ChooseWide m L history j S t := by
  by_contra hn
  simp only [finalWidth, if_neg hn] at hw
  have hh := min_le_right (work - p) 1
  omega

/-- With unspent wide-layer budget, a full wide layer fits in the
remaining work. Thus truncation cannot turn a wide choice into a narrow
layer. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_n.source:
theorem finalWidth_narrow_implies_not_choose (hm : 2 ≤ m) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (t : ℕ)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hprefix : p = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j)
    (hn : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1) :
    ¬ ChooseWide m L history j S t := by
  intro hc
  have htotal : (2 * m - 1) * (L / 2) + L / 2 = m * L := by
    have hb : 2 * m - 1 + 1 = 2 * m := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hw := hc.1
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1)
    (show wideCount m history j + 1 ≤ L / 2 by omega)
  have hfit : 2 * m - 1 ≤ m * L - p := by
    have hs : p + (2 * m - 1) ≤ m * L := by nlinarith
    omega
  simp only [finalWidth, if_pos hc, min_eq_right hfit] at hn
  omega

theorem finalWidth_narrow_threshold (hm : 2 ≤ m) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (t : ℕ)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hprefix : p = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j)
    (hquota : wideCount m history j < L / 2)
    (hn : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 1) :
    (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L) ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S t := by
  have hc := finalWidth_narrow_implies_not_choose hm heven history j p S t hbalance hprefix hn
  by_contra hh
  exact hc ⟨hquota, Or.inr (Or.inr (by omega))⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth_w.source:
theorem finalWidth_wide_threshold (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) (p : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hcredit : BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - t % L)
      (wideCount m history j) (narrowCount history j) (epochWideWork m L history j S t))
    (hfull : ¬ IdleEarlier m L S t)
    (hw : finalWidth m L history j p S t = 2 * m - 1) :
    epochWideWork m L history j S t < (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L) := by
  have hc := finalWidth_wide_implies_choose hm history j p S t hw
  apply hcredit.wide_below (by omega) (by have := Nat.mod_lt t hL; omega) hbalance
  rcases hc.2 with hg | hi | hx
  · exact Or.inl hg
  · exact False.elim (hfull hi)
  · exact Or.inr hx

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideRecorded.source:
theorem wideRecorded_append (m : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (v : Fin (jobs * work)) :
    WideRecorded m (history ++ [r]) j v ↔ WideRecorded m history j v ∨
      (job v = j ∧ r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧
        r.start ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < r.stop) := by
  unfold WideRecorded
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨ho, s, hs, hrest⟩
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hs with hs | hs
    · exact Or.inl ⟨ho, s, hs, hrest⟩
    · have he : s = r := List.mem_singleton.mp hs
      subst s
      exact Or.inr ⟨ho, hrest⟩
  · rintro (⟨ho, s, hs, hrest⟩ | ⟨ho, hrest⟩)
    · exact ⟨ho, s, List.mem_append_left _ hs, hrest⟩
    · exact ⟨ho, r, List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_singleton_self r), hrest⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount_ap.source:
theorem wideCount_append (m : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j = wideCount m history j +
      if r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases ho : r.owner = j <;> by_cases hw : r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 <;>
    simp [wideCount, List.filter_append, ho, hw]

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount_.source:
theorem narrowCount_append (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j = narrowCount history j +
      if r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases ho : r.owner = j <;> by_cases hw : r.stop - r.start = 1 <;>
    simp [narrowCount, List.filter_append, ho, hw]

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.owner_interv.source:
theorem owner_interval_card_le (j : Fin jobs) (a b : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => job v = j ∧ a ≤ (position v).val ∧
      (position v).val < b)).card ≤ b - a := by
  have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => (position v).val)
    (s := univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ a ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < b))
    (t := Ico a b) (by intro v hv; exact mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2) (by
      intro u hu v hv he
      exact LayeredForest.coordinates_injective (Prod.ext
        ((mem_filter.mp hu).2.1.trans (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1.symm) he))
  simpa only [Nat.card_Ico] using hc

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWor.source:
theorem epochWideWork_append_le (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ) :
    epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S t + (r.stop - r.start) := by
  let old := univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m history j v ∧ (t / L) * L ≤ S v ∧ S v < t)
  let layer := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => job v = j ∧
    r.start ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < r.stop)
  have hs : univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m (history ++ [r]) j v ∧
      (t / L) * L ≤ S v ∧ S v < t) ⊆ old ∪ layer := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hw, ht⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    rcases (wideRecorded_append m history r j v).mp hw with hw | hw
    · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hw, ht⟩)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hw.1, hw.2.2.2⟩)
  have hc := (card_le_card hs).trans (card_union_le old layer)
  exact hc.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (owner_interval_card_le j r.start r.stop) old.card)

theorem epochWideWork_append_unchanged (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hr : r.owner ≠ j ∨ r.stop - r.start ≠ 2 * m - 1) :
    epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S t = epochWideWork m L history j S t := by
  unfold epochWideWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, wideRecorded_append]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hw | hw, ht⟩
    · exact ⟨hw, ht⟩
    · rcases hr with howner | hwidth
      · exact False.elim (howner hw.2.1)
      · exact False.elim (hwidth hw.2.2.1)
  · rintro ⟨hw, ht⟩; exact ⟨Or.inl hw, ht⟩

theorem epochWideWork_time_closed (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) {t u : ℕ}
    (htu : t ≤ u) (hepoch : t / L = u / L)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < t) :
    epochWideWork m L history j S u = epochWideWork m L history j S t := by
  unfold epochWideWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hepoch]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hw, hlo, _⟩; exact ⟨hw, hlo, hclosed v hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨hw, hlo, hhi⟩; exact ⟨hw, hlo, hhi.trans_le htu⟩
