theorem epochWideWork_zero_closed (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < (t / L) * L) :
    epochWideWork m L history j S t = 0 := by
  unfold epochWideWork
  apply card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have ht := hclosed v hh.1
  omega

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epoch_start_.source:
theorem epoch_start_after {L t u : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (htu : t ≤ u) (hne : t / L ≠ u / L) :
    t ≤ (u / L) * L := by
  have hdiv : t / L ≤ u / L := Nat.div_le_div_right htu
  have hlt : t / L < u / L := by omega
  exact Nat.le_of_lt ((Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mp hlt)

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.remaining_ep.source:
theorem remaining_epoch_strict {L t u : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (htu : t < u)
    (hepoch : t / L = u / L) :
    L - u % L < L - t % L := by
  have ht := Nat.div_add_mod t L
  have hu := Nat.div_add_mod u L
  rw [hepoch] at ht
  have hmt := Nat.mod_lt t hL
  have hmu := Nat.mod_lt u hL
  omega

/-- Completing a layer preserves threshold credit for the actual service
counter. When the completion enters a new epoch, all older completed
layers disappear from that counter. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.credit_after.source:
theorem credit_after_record (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (r : LayerRecord jobs work)
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (e u : ℕ)
    (ho : r.owner = j) (heu : e < u)
    (hshape : r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < e)
    (hcredit : e / L = u / L → BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - e % L)
      (wideCount m history j) (narrowCount history j) (epochWideWork m L history j S e))
    (hwide : e / L = u / L → r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 →
      wideCount m history j ≤ narrowCount history j ∨
        epochWideWork m L history j S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L))
    (hnarrow : e / L = u / L → r.stop - r.start = 1 →
      (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L) ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S e) :
    BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - u % L)
      (wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j) (narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j)
      (epochWideWork m L (history ++ [r]) j S u) := by
  have hb : 0 < 2 * m - 1 := by omega
  have hbne : 2 * m - 1 ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hd : 0 < L - e % L := by have := Nat.mod_lt e hL; omega
  rcases hshape with hw | hn
  · simp only [wideCount_append, narrowCount_append, ho, hw, hbne,
      and_self, if_true, and_false, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
    have hwork := epochWideWork_append_le m L history r j S u
    rw [hw] at hwork
    by_cases hepoch : e / L = u / L
    · rw [epochWideWork_time_closed m L history j S heu.le hepoch hclosed] at hwork
      exact (hcredit hepoch).wide_step hb hd hbalance (hwide hepoch hw) hwork
    · have hs := epoch_start_after hL heu.le hepoch
      have hz := epochWideWork_zero_closed m L history j S u
        (fun v hv => (hclosed v hv).trans_le hs)
      rw [hz, Nat.zero_add] at hwork
      exact BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_wide hbalance hwork
  · have hw : r.stop - r.start ≠ 2 * m - 1 := by omega
    simp only [wideCount_append, narrowCount_append, ho, hn, Ne.symm hbne,
      and_self, if_true, and_false, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
    rw [epochWideWork_append_unchanged m L history r j S u (Or.inr hw)]
    by_cases hepoch : e / L = u / L
    · rw [epochWideWork_time_closed m L history j S heu.le hepoch hclosed]
      exact (hcredit hepoch).narrow_step hb hbalance (hnarrow hepoch hn)
        (remaining_epoch_strict hL heu hepoch)
    · have hs := epoch_start_after hL heu.le hepoch
      rw [epochWideWork_zero_closed m L history j S u
        (fun v hv => (hclosed v hv).trans_le hs)]
      exact BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit.first_narrow

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredi.source:
def ThresholdCredit (b d w n x : ℕ) : Prop :=
  x ≤ b * (w - n) ∨ (b * d ≤ x ∧ d ≤ w - n)

theorem ThresholdCredit.first_wide {b d w n x : ℕ} (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hx : x ≤ b) :
    ThresholdCredit b d (w + 1) n x := by
  left
  have hs : 1 ≤ w + 1 - n := by omega
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left b hs
  omega

theorem ThresholdCredit.first_narrow {b d w n : ℕ} : ThresholdCredit b d w n 0 := by
  left
  omega

/-- Even when a wide layer is permitted by the prefix guard, the work
counter is below the passivity threshold. Thus the guard does not restart
wide service after passivity. -/

theorem ThresholdCredit.wide_below {b d w n x : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x)
    (hchoose : w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d) : x < b * d := by
  rcases hchoose with hguard | hx
  · have he : w - n = 0 := by omega
    rcases hcredit with ha | hp
    · rw [he, Nat.mul_zero] at ha
      have hbd := Nat.mul_pos hb hd
      omega
    · rw [he] at hp
      omega
  · exact hx

theorem ThresholdCredit.wide_step {b d d' w n x x' : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (hd : 0 < d)
    (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x)
    (hchoose : w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d) (hwork : x' ≤ x + b) :
    ThresholdCredit b d' (w + 1) n x' := by
  have hsmall := hcredit.wide_below hb hd hbalance hchoose
  have ha : x ≤ b * (w - n) := hcredit.resolve_right (by intro h; omega)
  have hs : w + 1 - n = (w - n) + 1 := by omega
  left
  rw [hs, Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one]
  omega

theorem ThresholdCredit.narrow_step {b d d' w n x : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x)
    (hthreshold : b * d ≤ x) (htime : d' + 1 ≤ d) :
    ThresholdCredit b d' w (n + 1) x := by
  have hsurplus : d ≤ w - n := by
    rcases hcredit with ha | hp
    · exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hthreshold.trans ha) hb
    · exact hp.2
  right
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left b (show d' ≤ d by omega)).trans hthreshold
  · omega

/-- A trace of completed layers within one epoch. The counter can rise
by at most one layer's width at a wide completion and cannot rise at a
narrow completion. Time advances by at least one slot per layer. -/

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.CreditTrace.source:
inductive CreditTrace (b : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  | initial (d w n x : ℕ) (hbalance : n ≤ w) (hcredit : ThresholdCredit b d w n x) :
      CreditTrace b d w n x
  | wide {d w n x : ℕ} (prev : CreditTrace b d w n x)
      (d' x' : ℕ) (htime : d' < d) (hchoose : w ≤ n ∨ x < b * d)
      (hwork : x' ≤ x + b) : CreditTrace b d' (w + 1) n x'
  | narrow {d w n x : ℕ} (prev : CreditTrace b d w n x)
      (d' : ℕ) (htime : d' < d) (hthreshold : b * d ≤ x) :
      CreditTrace b d' w (n + 1) x

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.CreditTrace.cr.source:
theorem CreditTrace.credit {b d w n x : ℕ} (hb : 0 < b) (h : CreditTrace b d w n x) :
    n ≤ w ∧ ThresholdCredit b d w n x := by
  induction h with
  | initial d w n x hbalance hcredit => exact ⟨hbalance, hcredit⟩
  | wide prev d' x' htime hchoose hwork ih =>
    exact ⟨by omega, ih.2.wide_step hb (by omega) ih.1 hchoose hwork⟩
  | @narrow d w n x prev d' htime hthreshold ih =>
    have hs : d ≤ w - n := by
      rcases ih.2 with ha | hp
      · exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hthreshold.trans ha) hb
      · exact hp.2
    exact ⟨by omega, ih.2.narrow_step hb ih.1 hthreshold (by omega)⟩

end Scheduling.BatchedForcing

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.list_sum_le_mu.source:
theorem list_sum_le_mul_sum {α : Type*} (xs : List α) (f g : α → ℕ) (b : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ b * g x) : (xs.map f).sum ≤ b * (xs.map g).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hh := h x List.mem_cons_self
    have ht := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Nat.mul_add]
    omega

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.list_sum_le_le.source:
theorem list_sum_le_length_mul {α : Type*} (xs : List α) (f : α → ℕ) (b : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ xs, f x ≤ b) : (xs.map f).sum ≤ xs.length * b := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hh := h x List.mem_cons_self
    have ht := ih (fun y hy => h y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy))
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.passivityBound.source:
theorem passivityBounds_map {α : Type*} (m c : ℕ) (xs : List α) (D : α → ℕ)
    (h : ∀ before x after, xs = before ++ x :: after →
      (m - c) * D x ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (c + (after.map (fun y => D y + 2)).sum)) :
    PassivityBounds m c (xs.map D) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact PassivityBounds.nil
  | cons x xs ih =>
    apply PassivityBounds.cons
    · rw [List.map_map]
      exact h [] x xs rfl
    · apply ih
      intro before y after he
      exact h (x :: before) y after (by simp only [List.cons_append, he])

/-- Summing per-job cutoff bounds in chronological cutoff order gives
exactly the suffix inequalities used by the geometric recurrence. -/

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.sorted_cutoffs.source:
theorem sorted_cutoffs_passivity {α : Type*} (m c a z : ℕ) (xs : List α)
    (T : α → ℕ) (F : α → ℕ → ℕ)
    (hlen : xs.length ≤ c)
    (hsort : xs.Pairwise (fun x y => T x ≤ T y))
    (htimes : ∀ x ∈ xs, a ≤ T x ∧ T x ≤ z)
    (hcapacity : ∀ u, a ≤ u → u ≤ z → (m - c) * (z - u) ≤ (xs.map (fun x => F x u)).sum)
    (htotal : ∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ u, a ≤ u → u ≤ z → F x u ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (z - T x + 2))
    (hsuffix : ∀ x ∈ xs, ∀ u, T x ≤ u → F x u ≤ 2 * m - 1)
    (haz : a ≤ z) :
    PassivityBounds m c ((z - a) :: xs.map (fun x => z - T x)) := by
  apply PassivityBounds.cons
  · have hu := hcapacity a le_rfl haz
    have hh := list_sum_le_mul_sum xs (fun x => F x a) (fun x => z - T x + 2)
      (2 * m - 1) (fun x hx => htotal x hx a le_rfl haz)
    simp only [List.map_map]
    have hadd := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1)
      (Nat.le_add_left (xs.map (fun x => z - T x + 2)).sum c)
    exact hu.trans (hh.trans hadd)
  · apply passivityBounds_map
    intro before x after he
    have hx : x ∈ xs := he ▸ List.mem_append_right before List.mem_cons_self
    have hbefore : ∀ y ∈ before, y ∈ xs := fun y hy => he ▸ List.mem_append_left _ hy
    have hafter : ∀ y ∈ after, y ∈ xs := fun y hy =>
      he ▸ List.mem_append_right before (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy)
    have horder : ∀ y ∈ before, T y ≤ T x := by
      rw [he, List.pairwise_append] at hsort
      intro y hy
      exact hsort.2.2 y hy x List.mem_cons_self
    have hlen' : before.length + 1 ≤ c := by
      rw [he, List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hlen
      omega
    have htime := htimes x hx
    have hu := hcapacity (T x) htime.1 htime.2
    have hb := list_sum_le_length_mul before (fun y => F y (T x)) (2 * m - 1)
      (fun y hy => hsuffix y (hbefore y hy) (T x) (horder y hy))
    have hxbound := hsuffix x hx (T x) le_rfl
    have ha := list_sum_le_mul_sum after (fun y => F y (T x)) (fun y => z - T y + 2)
      (2 * m - 1) (fun y hy => htotal y (hafter y hy) (T x) htime.1 htime.2)
    rw [he, List.map_append, List.sum_append, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at hu
    have hprefix := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 * m - 1) hlen'
    nlinarith

end Scheduling.BatchedForcing

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.full_epoch_p.source:
theorem full_epoch_passivity (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) (c * L)) (i : ℕ)
    (hfull : ∀ t, i * L ≤ t → t < (i + 1) * L →
      (univ.filter (fun v => A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v = t)).card = m) :
    ∃ ds : List ℕ, ds.length ≤ c ∧ BatchedForcing.PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  let S := A.schedule I
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := full_epoch_job_cutoffs hm hL heven A h i hfull
  apply cutoffs_passivity records S i c (I.alive S (i * L)) T hT
    (I.regular_alive_card_le hL (by intros; rfl) hflow i)
  · intro v _ hlo hhi
    have hr := I.regular_epoch_no_arrivals (i := i) (A.valid I) hL (by intros; rfl) v hhi
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hr, v, rfl, hlo⟩
  · intro u hlo _
    exact full_epoch_wide_lower hm hL heven A h hflow hlo le_rfl
      (by intro t ht; exact hfull t (hlo.trans (mem_Ico.mp ht).1) (mem_Ico.mp ht).2)

/-- In the actual threshold construction, the geometric epoch length
forces an idle slot in every epoch under the small-flow hypothesis. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.forcing_epoc.source:
theorem forcing_epoch_deficit (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m) (hscale : L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) (c * L)) (i : ℕ) :
    (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).epochWork
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) L i < m * L := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  let S := A.schedule I
  by_contra hnot
  have hfull : ∀ t, i * L ≤ t → t < (i + 1) * L →
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m := by
    intro t hlo hhi
    have hcap := (A.valid I).capacity t
    change (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card ≤ m at hcap
    by_contra hne
    have hidle : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by omega
    exact hnot (I.epochWork_lt_of_idle (A.valid I) hL (mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hlo, hhi⟩) hidle)
  obtain ⟨ds, hlen, hb⟩ := full_epoch_passivity hm hL heven A h hflow i hfull
  apply BatchedForcing.no_full_epoch (by omega) hc hcm hlen
  simpa only [← hscale] using hb

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.flow_lower.source:
theorem flow_lower (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m) (hscale : L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) (hn : jobs = c * (m * L)) :
    c * L ≤ (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).maxFlow
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  apply I.regular_every_epoch_flow_lower (by omega) hL hc hn (A.valid I) (by intros; rfl)
    (fun j => Q.jobVertices_card L _ j)
  intro hflow i _
  exact forcing_epoch_deficit hm hL heven hc hcm hscale A h hflow i

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBound.source:
inductive PassivityBounds (m c : ℕ) : List ℕ → Prop
  | nil : PassivityBounds m c []
  | cons (d : ℕ) (tail : List ℕ)
      (bound : (m - c) * d ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (c + (tail.map (· + 2)).sum))
      (rest : PassivityBounds m c tail) : PassivityBounds m c (d :: tail)

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.passivity_step.source:
theorem passivity_step {m c d s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (h : (m - c) * d ≤ (2 * m - 1) * (c + s)) :
    d + 2 ≤ 4 * c + 2 + 4 * s := by
  have hp : 0 < m - c := by omega
  have hb : 2 * m - 1 ≤ 4 * (m - c) := by omega
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (c + s) hb
  have hd : d ≤ 4 * (c + s) := by
    have hh : (m - c) * d ≤ (m - c) * (4 * (c + s)) := by nlinarith
    exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hh hp
  omega

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.PassivityBound.source:
theorem PassivityBounds.sum_bound {m c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 2 * c ≤ m)
    {ds : List ℕ} (h : PassivityBounds m c ds) :
    4 * (ds.map (· + 2)).sum + (4 * c + 2) ≤ (4 * c + 2) * 5 ^ ds.length := by
  induction h with
  | nil => simp
  | cons d tail bound rest ih =>
    have hd := passivity_step hm hc bound
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, pow_succ]
    nlinarith

/-- The geometric estimate used in the batched lower bound. The service
inequalities must still be derived from the adaptive execution. -/

theorem PassivityBounds.epoch_length_bound {m c L : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 2 * c ≤ m)
    {ds : List ℕ} (h : PassivityBounds m c (L :: ds)) (hlen : ds.length ≤ c) :
    L + 2 ≤ (4 * c + 2) * 5 ^ c := by
  cases h with
  | cons d tail bound rest =>
    have hd := passivity_step hm hc bound
    have hs := rest.sum_bound hm hc
    have hp : 5 ^ ds.length ≤ 5 ^ c := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) hlen
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (4 * c + 2) hp
    omega

Scheduling.BatchedForcing.no_full_epoch.source:
theorem no_full_epoch {m c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    {ds : List ℕ} (hlen : ds.length ≤ c) :
    ¬ PassivityBounds m c ((8 * c * 5 ^ c) :: ds) := by
  intro h
  have hb := h.epoch_length_bound hm hcm hlen
  have hp : 0 < 5 ^ c := pow_pos (by omega) c
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.BatchedForcing

namespace Scheduling.Instance
open Finset
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- With one deficit in every epoch, `cmL` jobs suffice for the final
backlog contradiction. This is the counting step of the batched lower
bound, conditional on its epoch-forcing property. -/

Scheduling.Instance.regular_every_epoch_.source:
theorem regular_every_epoch_flow_lower {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hc : 0 < c) (hn : jobs = c * (m * L))
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L)
    (hidle : I.FlowBound S (c * L) → ∀ i < jobs, I.epochWork S L i < m * L) :
    c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S := by
  by_contra hh
  have hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L) := (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hp : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos hm hL
  have hcj : c ≤ jobs := by
    rw [hn]
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (show 1 ≤ m * L from hp)
    simpa only [Nat.mul_one] using h
  have hy := I.regular_young_backlog hcj hL hrelease hwork hflow
  rw [← I.regular_idleBacklog_eq hS hL hwork] at hy
  have hacc : jobs ≤ Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) jobs := by
    simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using
      Accounting.forcing_epochs_accumulate (c := 1) (K := jobs) (by omega)
        (by simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using hidle hflow)
  have hc1 : c - 1 + 1 = c := by omega
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.source:
structure RevealCredit (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (e width : ℕ) : Prop where
  closed_before : ∀ v, WideRecorded m history j v → S v < e
  credit : ¬ IdleEarlier m L S e → wideCount m history j < L / 2 →
    BatchedForcing.ThresholdCredit (2 * m - 1) (L - e % L)
      (wideCount m history j) (narrowCount history j) (epochWideWork m L history j S e)
  wide_choice : width = 2 * m - 1 → wideCount m history j ≤ narrowCount history j ∨
    IdleEarlier m L S e ∨ epochWideWork m L history j S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L)
  narrow_threshold : width = 1 → wideCount m history j < L / 2 →
    (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L) ≤ epochWideWork m L history j S e

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial_fron.source:
theorem initial_frontierCredit (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L)))
    (hrelease : ∀ v, (job v).val * L ≤ S v) :
    FrontierCredit m L [] (initial jobs m L hm) S := by
  have hfit : 2 * m - 1 ≤ m * L := by
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (show 2 ≤ L by omega)
    omega
  intro j
  refine ⟨j.val * L, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    have ho := (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1
    simpa only [ho] using hrelease v
  · refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨_, r, hr, _⟩ := hv
      simp at hr
    · intro _ _
      left
      simp [epochWideWork, WideRecorded]
    · intro _
      left
      simp [wideCount, narrowCount]
    · intro hn _
      simp only [initial, min_eq_left hfit] at hn
      omega

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RevealCredit.source:
theorem RevealCredit.after_record (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (e width p : ℕ)
    (h : RevealCredit m L history j S e width)
    (ho : r.owner = j) (hw : r.stop - r.start = width) (he : e ≤ r.time)
    (hshape : width = 2 * m - 1 ∨ width = 1)
    (hbalance : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hnewbalance : narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j ≤ wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j)
    (hprefix : p = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j + narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j)
    (htimes : ∀ v, job v = j → r.start ≤ (position v).val → (position v).val < r.stop →
      S v ≤ r.time) :
    RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S (r.time + 1)
      (finalWidth m L (history ++ [r]) j p S (r.time + 1)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    rcases (wideRecorded_append m history r j v).mp hv with hv | hv
    · exact (h.closed_before v hv).trans_le (by omega)
    · have ht := htimes v hv.1 hv.2.2.2.1 hv.2.2.2.2
      omega
  · intro hfull hquota
    have hquota' : wideCount m history j < L / 2 := by
      rw [wideCount_append] at hquota
      omega
    have hfull' : e / L = (r.time + 1) / L → ¬ IdleEarlier m L S e := by
      intro hep hi
      exact hfull (idleEarlier_mono_same_epoch S (by omega) hep hi)
    apply credit_after_record hm hL history r j S e (r.time + 1) ho (by omega)
      (by simpa only [hw] using hshape) hbalance h.closed_before
    · intro hep
      exact h.credit (hfull' hep) hquota'
    · intro hep hr
      rcases h.wide_choice (hw.symm.trans hr) with hg | hi | hx
      · exact Or.inl hg
      · exact False.elim (hfull' hep hi)
      · exact Or.inr hx
    · intro _ hr
      exact h.narrow_threshold (hw.symm.trans hr) hquota'
  · intro hwide
    exact (finalWidth_wide_implies_choose hm _ j p S _ hwide).2
  · intro hn hquota
    exact finalWidth_narrow_threshold hm heven _ j p S _ hnewbalance hprefix hquota hn

theorem RevealCredit.append_other
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (e width : ℕ)
    (ho : r.owner ≠ j) (h : RevealCredit m L history j S e width) :
    RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) j S e width := by
  have hw : wideCount m (history ++ [r]) j = wideCount m history j := by
    simp only [wideCount_append, ho, false_and, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
  have hn : narrowCount (history ++ [r]) j = narrowCount history j := by
    simp only [narrowCount_append, ho, false_and, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
  have hx := epochWideWork_append_unchanged m L history r j S e (Or.inl ho)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v hv
    rcases (wideRecorded_append m history r j v).mp hv with hv | hv
    · exact h.closed_before v hv
    · exact False.elim (ho hv.2.1)
  · simpa only [hw, hn, hx] using h.credit
  · simpa only [hw, hn, hx] using h.wide_choice
  · simpa only [hw, hx] using h.narrow_threshold

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.frontierCred.source:
theorem frontierCredit_advance (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L))
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v ≤
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
    (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < m * L →
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤
        P.finishTime (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A i)
    (records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (tail : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A)
      (history ++ [P.record (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A j key])
      (P.advance j key hk
        ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size
          (history ++ [P.record (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A j key]) P j
          (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
        ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _) ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _))
      Q records)
    (hb : Budget m L history P)
    (hc : FrontierCredit m L history P (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)))) :
    let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
    let next := history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]
    let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
    FrontierCredit m L next (P.advance j key hk ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t)
      ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _) ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _))
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw)) := by
  dsimp only
  let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
  let r := P.record (L := L) hw A j key
  let next := history ++ [r]
  let t := r.time + 1
  let q := (rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t
  let R := P.advance j key hk q ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _)
    ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _)
  let S := A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw)
  change FrontierCredit m L next R S
  have hfull := HistoryRun.step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := hfull.flexible.recorded
  have htimes := hr.final_times r List.mem_cons_self
  have hkey : S (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) = r.time := htimes.2.2.2.1
  have hbnext : Budget m L next R := budget_advance hm hL heven A history P hb j key hk
  have hq : q = finalWidth m L next j (P.boundary j) S t := by
    have hpast := hfull.past_agreement r.time hearliest
    have hchoose := chooseWide_congr m L next j hpast
    change min (m * L - P.boundary j)
      (if ChooseWide m L next j (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw)) t then 2 * m - 1 else 1) = _
    unfold finalWidth
    rw [hchoose]
  intro i
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    obtain ⟨e, he, hcredit⟩ := hc j
    have hekey := he (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) (by
      apply mem_filter.mpr
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, LayeredForest.job_pair j key, by
        simpa only [LayeredForest.position_pair] using hk⟩)
    change e ≤ S (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) at hekey
    rw [hkey] at hekey
    refine ⟨t, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨tailRule, ht⟩ := tail.flexible.recorded
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      change job v = j ∧ R.closed j ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < R.boundary j at hv'
      have hp := ht.completion.parent_visible j (position v) hv'.2.2
      have hnew : R.parent j (position v) = some key := by
        have hlo : P.boundary j ≤ (position v).val := by simpa only [R, advance_closed] using hv'.2.1
        have hhi : (position v).val < P.boundary j + q := by simpa only [R, advance_boundary] using hv'.2.2
        exact if_pos ⟨rfl, hlo, hhi⟩
      have hvQ : (position v).val < Q.boundary j := by
        have hf := ht.completion.finished j
        have hpos := (position v).isLt
        dsimp only [boundary]
        omega
      have hedge : (Q.toInstance L hw).edge (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) v := by
        refine ⟨(LayeredForest.job_pair j key).trans hv'.1.symm, ?_⟩
        simp only [hv'.1, if_pos hvQ, LayeredForest.position_pair]
        exact hp.trans hnew
      have htime := (A.valid (Q.toInstance L hw)).precedence hedge
      change S (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) < S v at htime
      rw [hkey] at htime
      exact htime
    · have hshape : P.width j = 2 * m - 1 ∨ P.width j = 1 := by
        rcases (hb j).2.2.2 with ⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hw', _⟩ | ⟨hn, _⟩
        · have hbound : P.boundary j = P.closed j := by simp only [boundary, hz, Nat.add_zero]
          omega
        · exact Or.inl hw'
        · exact Or.inr hn
      have hstep := hcredit.after_record hm hL heven history r j S e (P.width j) (P.boundary j)
        rfl (by simp only [r, record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]) hekey hshape
        (hb j).2.1 (hbnext j).2.1
        (by simpa only [R, advance_closed] using (hbnext j).2.2.1)
        (fun v ho hlo hhi => htimes.2.2.2.2 v ho hlo hhi)
      simp only [R, advance]
      rw [hq]
      exact hstep
  · obtain ⟨e, he, hcredit⟩ := hc i
    refine ⟨e, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro v hv
      exact he v (by simpa only [R, P.advance_other_frontier j i hij] using hv)
    · change RevealCredit m L (history ++ [r]) i S e (if i = j then q else P.width i)
      rw [if_neg hij]
      exact hcredit.append_other history r i S e (P.width i) (Ne.symm hij)

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.PastAgreement.source:
def PastAgreement {vertices : ℕ} (S T : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ u < t, ∀ v, S v = u ↔ T v = u

Scheduling.pastAgreement_of_slots.source:
theorem pastAgreement_of_slots {vertices t : ℕ} {S T : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (h : ∀ u < t, executionSlot S u = executionSlot T u) : PastAgreement S T t := by
  intro u hu v
  have he := h u hu
  simpa only [val_mem_executionSlot] using
    (show v.val ∈ executionSlot S u ↔ v.val ∈ executionSlot T u from by rw [he])

namespace PastAgreement
variable {vertices t : ℕ} {S T : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}

Scheduling.PastAgreement.time_eq.source:
theorem time_eq (h : PastAgreement S T t) (v : Fin vertices) (hv : S v < t) : T v = S v :=
  (h _ hv v).mp rfl

Scheduling.PastAgreement.symm.source: theorem symm (h : PastAgreement S T t) : PastAgreement T S t := fun u hu v => (h u hu v).symm

Scheduling.PastAgreement.interval.source:
theorem interval (h : PastAgreement S T t) (a : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (a ≤ S v ∧ S v < t) ↔ (a ≤ T v ∧ T v < t) := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rw [h.time_eq v hv.2]
    exact hv
  · intro hv
    rw [h.symm.time_eq v hv.2]
    exact hv

Scheduling.PastAgreement.slot_card.source:
theorem slot_card (h : PastAgreement S T t) (u : ℕ) (hu : u < t) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => S v = u)).card = (univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).card := by
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  exact h u hu v

end PastAgreement

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun.past.source:
theorem HistoryRun.past_agreement {rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work}
    {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    (h : HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records) (t : ℕ)
    (hbefore : ∀ i, P.closed i < work → t ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i) :
    PastAgreement (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw)) (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw)) (t + 1) := by
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := h.flexible.recorded
  exact pastAgreement_of_slots (fun u hu => hr.completion.preserves_slots t hbefore u (by omega))

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.sta.source:
theorem RecordedRun.start_width {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    ∀ r ∈ records, r.start = P.closed r.owner → r.stop - r.start = P.width r.owner := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => simp
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro r hr ha
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr
    · simp only [record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    · by_cases ho : r.owner = j
      · have hs := tail.start_lower r hr
        rw [ho, advance_closed] at hs
        rw [ho] at ha
        omega
      · have he := ih r hr (by simpa only [advance, if_neg ho] using ha)
        simpa only [advance, if_neg ho] using he

end LayeredPrefix

namespace BatchedAdversary
open LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work m L : ℕ}

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWor.source:
theorem epochWideWork_congr (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) {S T : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)} {t : ℕ}
    (h : PastAgreement S T t) : epochWideWork m L history j S t = epochWideWork m L history j T t := by
  unfold epochWideWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, h.interval ((t / L) * L) v]

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.idleEarlier_.source:
theorem idleEarlier_congr (m L : ℕ) {S T : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)} {t : ℕ}
    (h : PastAgreement S T t) : IdleEarlier m L S t ↔ IdleEarlier m L T t := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hlo, hhi, hc⟩
    exact ⟨u, hlo, hhi, by rwa [← h.slot_card u hhi]⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hlo, hhi, hc⟩
    exact ⟨u, hlo, hhi, by rwa [h.slot_card u hhi]⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.chooseWide_c.source:
theorem chooseWide_congr (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) {S T : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)} {t : ℕ}
    (h : PastAgreement S T t) : ChooseWide m L history j S t ↔ ChooseWide m L history j T t := by
  unfold ChooseWide
  rw [epochWideWork_congr m L history j h, idleEarlier_congr m L h]

/-- The rule evaluated directly on a fixed execution, without a partial
graph or a scheduler call hidden inside its definition. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.finalWidth.source:
noncomputable def finalWidth (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
    (p : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  min (work - p) (if ChooseWide m L history j S t then 2 * m - 1 else 1)

/-- Each actual layer choice agrees with its evaluation on the final
fixed execution. The premise identifies the immediately following layer
of the same job by its starting position. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.history_rule.source:
theorem history_rule_in_final (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) history P Q records) :
    ∀ before r after, records = before ++ r :: after →
      ∀ s ∈ after, s.owner = r.owner → s.start = r.stop →
        s.stop - s.start = finalWidth m L (history ++ before ++ [r]) r.owner r.stop
          (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) (r.time + 1) := by
  induction h with
  | done history P hd =>
    intro before r after he
    have hl := congrArg List.length he
    simp only [List.length_nil, List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hl
    omega
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro before r after he s hs ho ha
    cases before with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at he
      obtain ⟨heq, htail⟩ := he
      subst r
      subst after
      obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := tail.flexible.recorded
      have hwidth := hr.start_width s hs (by
        rw [ho]
        simpa only [record, advance_closed] using ha)
      have hfull := HistoryRun.step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail
      have hpast := hfull.past_agreement _ hearliest
      have hc := chooseWide_congr m L (history ++ [P.record (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < m by omega) hL) A j key]) j hpast
      simp only [advance, ho, record, if_true] at hwidth
      change s.stop - s.start = min (m * L - P.boundary j)
        (if ChooseWide m L (history ++ [P.record (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < m by omega) hL) A j key]) j
          (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < m by omega) hL)))
          (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (show 0 < m by omega) hL)) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1) then 2 * m - 1 else 1) at hwidth
      dsimp only [record] at hc hwidth
      simp only [finalWidth, List.append_nil, record]
      rw [← hc]
      exact hwidth
    | cons a before =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at he
      have hh := ih before r after he.2 s hs ho ha
      rw [← he.1]
      simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hh

end BatchedAdversary
end Scheduling

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount_ap.source:
theorem wideCount_append_record (m : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (L : ℕ) (j i : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work) :
    wideCount m (history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]) i = wideCount m history i +
      if j = i ∧ P.width j = 2 * m - 1 then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases ho : j = i
  · subst i
    by_cases hw : P.width j = 2 * m - 1 <;>
      simp [wideCount, List.filter_append, record, boundary, hw]
  · simp [wideCount, List.filter_append, record, boundary, ho]

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount_.source:
theorem narrowCount_append_record (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (L : ℕ) (j i : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work) :
    narrowCount (history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]) i = narrowCount history i +
      if j = i ∧ P.width j = 1 then 1 else 0 := by
  by_cases ho : j = i
  · subst i
    by_cases hw : P.width j = 1 <;>
      simp [narrowCount, List.filter_append, record, boundary, hw]
  · simp [narrowCount, List.filter_append, record, boundary, ho]

/-- Counts of committed layers, together with the budget reserved for
the currently revealed frontier. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.Budget.source:
def Budget (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) : Prop := ∀ j,
  wideCount m history j ≤ L / 2 ∧
  narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j ∧
  P.closed j = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j ∧
  ((P.width j = 0 ∧ P.closed j = m * L) ∨
    (P.width j = 2 * m - 1 ∧ wideCount m history j < L / 2) ∨
    (P.width j = 1 ∧ narrowCount history j < wideCount m history j))

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial_budg.source:
theorem initial_budget (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) :
    Budget m L [] (initial jobs m L hm) := by
  have hL2 : 2 ≤ L := by omega
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hL2
  have hb : 2 * m - 1 ≤ m * L := by omega
  intro j
  simp [wideCount, narrowCount, initial, min_eq_left hb, show 0 < L / 2 by omega]

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.budget_advan.source:
theorem budget_advance (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (hbudget : Budget m L history P)
    (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L))
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j) :
    let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
    let next := history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]
    let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
    Budget m L next (P.advance j key hk ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t)
      ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _) ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _)) := by
  dsimp only
  let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
  let next := history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]
  let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
  have hb1 : 2 * m - 1 ≠ 1 := by omega
  have hcounts : wideCount m next j ≤ L / 2 ∧ narrowCount next j ≤ wideCount m next j ∧
      P.boundary j = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m next j + narrowCount next j := by
    obtain ⟨hwc, hnc, hp, hs⟩ := hbudget j
    rcases hs with ⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hwide, hspace⟩ | ⟨hnarrow, hspace⟩
    · have hbd : P.boundary j = P.closed j := by simp only [boundary, hz, Nat.add_zero]
      omega
    · dsimp only [next]
      rw [wideCount_append_record, narrowCount_append_record]
      simp only [hwide, true_and, if_true, hb1, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, ?_⟩
      dsimp only [boundary]
      rw [hp, hwide]
      ring
    · dsimp only [next]
      rw [wideCount_append_record, narrowCount_append_record]
      simp only [hnarrow, true_and, if_true, Ne.symm hb1, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
      refine ⟨hwc, by omega, ?_⟩
      dsimp only [boundary]
      rw [hp, hnarrow]
      omega
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i = j
  · subst i
    have hs := rule_width_shape hm hL heven A next P j t hcounts.1 hcounts.2.1 hcounts.2.2
    refine ⟨hcounts.1, hcounts.2.1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [advance_closed] using hcounts.2.2
    · simpa only [advance, if_pos rfl, if_true, next, t] using hs
  · have hwc : wideCount m next i = wideCount m history i := by
      dsimp only [next]
      rw [wideCount_append_record]
      simp only [Ne.symm hi, false_and, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
    have hnc : narrowCount next i = narrowCount history i := by
      dsimp only [next]
      rw [narrowCount_append_record]
      simp only [Ne.symm hi, false_and, if_false, Nat.add_zero]
    dsimp only [next] at hwc hnc
    simpa only [advance, if_neg hi, hwc, hnc] using hbudget i

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.history_budg.source:
theorem history_budget_end (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) history P Q records)
    (hb : Budget m L history P) : Budget m L (history ++ records) Q := by
  induction h with
  | done history P hd => simpa only [List.append_nil] using hb
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    have hn := budget_advance hm hL heven A history P hb j key hk
    have hh := ih hn
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hh

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.final_layer_.source:
theorem final_layer_counts (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) :
    ∀ j, wideCount m records j = L / 2 ∧ narrowCount records j = L / 2 := by
  have hb := history_budget_end hm hL heven A h (initial_budget hm hL heven)
  simp only [List.nil_append] at hb
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := h.flexible.recorded
  intro j
  obtain ⟨hwc, hnc, hp, _⟩ := hb j
  rw [hr.completion.finished] at hp
  have ht : (2 * m - 1) * (L / 2) + L / 2 = m * L := by
    have hm1 : 2 * m - 1 + 1 = 2 * m := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hnle := hnc.trans hwc
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1) hwc
  have hw : wideCount m records j = L / 2 := by
    by_contra hh
    have hlt : wideCount m records j + 1 ≤ L / 2 := by omega
    have hm' := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1) hlt
    nlinarith
  exact ⟨hw, by rw [hw] at hp; omega⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.history_pref.source:
theorem history_prefix_counts (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) history P Q records)
    (hb : Budget m L history P) (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ j, narrowCount (history ++ records.take n) j ≤ wideCount m (history ++ records.take n) j := by
  induction h generalizing n with
  | done history P hd =>
    intro j
    simpa only [List.take_nil, List.append_nil] using (hb j).2.1
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      intro i
      simpa only [List.take_zero, List.append_nil] using (hb i).2.1
    | succ n =>
      have hn := budget_advance hm hL heven A history P hb j key hk
      have hh := ih hn n
      simpa only [List.take_succ_cons, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hh

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.history_widt.source:
theorem history_widths (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) history P Q records)
    (hb : Budget m L history P) :
    ∀ r ∈ records, r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1 := by
  induction h with
  | done history P hd => simp
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro r hr
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr
    · have hs := (hb j).2.2.2
      rcases hs with ⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hw, _⟩ | ⟨hn, _⟩
      · have he : P.boundary j = P.closed j := by simp only [boundary, hz, Nat.add_zero]
        omega
      · left
        simpa only [record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hw
      · right
        simpa only [record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hn
    · exact ih (budget_advance hm hL heven A history P hb j key hk) r hr

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.job_count_eq.source:
theorem job_count_eq (hm : 2 ≤ m) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (hwidth : ∀ r ∈ history, r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1)
    (j : Fin jobs) :
    (history.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length = wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j := by
  have hb1 : 2 * m - 1 ≠ 1 := by omega
  induction history with
  | nil => simp [wideCount, narrowCount]
  | cons r rs ih =>
    have ht := ih (fun s hs => hwidth s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs))
    have hr := hwidth r List.mem_cons_self
    by_cases ho : r.owner = j
    · rcases hr with hw | hn
      · simp only [wideCount, narrowCount] at ht ⊢
        simp [ho, hw, hb1] at ht ⊢
        omega
      · simp only [wideCount, narrowCount] at ht ⊢
        simp [ho, hn, Ne.symm hb1] at ht ⊢
        omega
    · simp only [wideCount, narrowCount] at ht ⊢
      simpa [List.filter_cons, ho] using ht

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.final_job_le.source:
theorem final_job_length (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length = L := by
  have hc := final_layer_counts hm hL heven A h j
  rw [job_count_eq hm records (history_widths hm hL heven A h (initial_budget hm hL heven)) j,
    hc.1, hc.2]
  omega

/-- The actual threshold construction has exactly the required layer
counts and a balanced prefix at every commitment. Causality and key-last
timing are supplied by the associated recorded run. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.exists_balan.source:
theorem exists_balanced_layer_run (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ Q records,
      HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
        (initial jobs m L hm) Q records ∧
      (∃ staticRule, RecordedRun (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A staticRule
        (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) ∧
      (∀ r ∈ records, r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1) ∧
      (∀ j, wideCount m records j = L / 2 ∧ narrowCount records j = L / 2) ∧
      (∀ n j, narrowCount (records.take n) j ≤ wideCount m (records.take n) j) := by
  obtain ⟨Q, records, hh, hr, _⟩ := exists_candidate jobs m L hm hL A
  have hb := initial_budget (jobs := jobs) hm hL heven
  refine ⟨Q, records, hh, hr, history_widths hm hL heven A hh hb,
    final_layer_counts hm hL heven A hh, ?_⟩
  intro n j
  simpa only [List.nil_append] using history_prefix_counts hm hL heven A hh hb n j

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideCount.source:
def wideCount (m : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) : ℕ :=
  (history.filter (fun r => r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1)).length

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrowCount.source:
def narrowCount (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) : ℕ :=
  (history.filter (fun r => r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 1)).length

/-- All vertices of completed wide layers, identified by their original
local labels. The execution-time filter below counts only service in the
current epoch, even when a layer straddles its boundary. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.WideRecorded.source:
def WideRecorded (m : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (v : Fin (jobs * work)) : Prop :=
  job v = j ∧ ∃ r ∈ history, r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧
    r.start ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < r.stop

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.epochWideWor.source:
noncomputable def epochWideWork (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m history j v ∧ (t / L) * L ≤ S v ∧ S v < t)).card

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.IdleEarlier.source:
def IdleEarlier (m L : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ u, (t / L) * L ≤ u ∧ u < t ∧ (univ.filter (fun v => S v = u)).card < m

/-- The intended threshold rule, with explicit budget and prefix guards.
The guards make the rule total; the forcing analysis must show that the
prefix guard never overrides a passive job during a full epoch. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.ChooseWide.source:
def ChooseWide (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  wideCount m history j < L / 2 ∧
    (wideCount m history j ≤ narrowCount history j ∨ IdleEarlier m L S t ∨
      epochWideWork m L history j S t < (2 * m - 1) * (L - t % L))

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule.source:
noncomputable def rule (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) : HistoryLayerRule jobs (m * L) where
  size history P j t := min (m * L - P.boundary j)
    (if ChooseWide m L history j
      (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) t then 2 * m - 1 else 1)
  fits := by
    intro history P j t
    have hh := min_le_left (m * L - P.boundary j)
      (if ChooseWide m L history j
        (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) t then 2 * m - 1 else 1)
    have hb := P.fits j
    change P.boundary j ≤ m * L at hb
    omega
  positive := by
    intro history P j t hp
    apply lt_min (by omega)
    split_ifs <;> omega

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial.source:
def initial (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L) where
  closed _ := 0
  width _ := min (2 * m - 1) (m * L)
  fits _ := by simp
  frontier_pos := by intro j hp; exact lt_min (by omega) hp
  parent _ _ := none
  parent_lt := by intros; contradiction

/-- Once the completed-layer counts respect their budgets, the total
rule never truncates a layer: it chooses a whole wide or narrow layer,
and preserves the prefix condition, or returns zero at the exact end. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.rule_width_s.source:
theorem rule_width_shape (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (j : Fin jobs) (t : ℕ)
    (hwide : wideCount m history j ≤ L / 2)
    (hnarrow : narrowCount history j ≤ wideCount m history j)
    (hprefix : P.boundary j = (2 * m - 1) * wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j) :
    ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size history P j t = 0 ∧ P.boundary j = m * L) ∨
    ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size history P j t = 2 * m - 1 ∧ wideCount m history j < L / 2) ∨
    ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).size history P j t = 1 ∧ narrowCount history j < wideCount m history j) := by
  let W := wideCount m history j
  let N := narrowCount history j
  let S := A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))
  have htotal : (2 * m - 1) * (L / 2) + L / 2 = m * L := by
    have hb : 2 * m - 1 + 1 = 2 * m := by omega
    nlinarith
  by_cases hend : P.boundary j = m * L
  · exact Or.inl ⟨by simp only [rule, hend, Nat.sub_self, min_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _)], hend⟩
  · have hremaining : P.boundary j < m * L := lt_of_le_of_ne (P.fits j) hend
    by_cases hchoose : ChooseWide m L history j S t
    · have hw : W < L / 2 := hchoose.1
      have hn : N ≤ L / 2 := hnarrow.trans hwide
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m - 1) (show W + 1 ≤ L / 2 by omega)
      have hfit : 2 * m - 1 ≤ m * L - P.boundary j := by
        change P.boundary j = (2 * m - 1) * W + N at hprefix
        have hsum : P.boundary j + (2 * m - 1) ≤ m * L := by nlinarith
        omega
      refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨?_, hw⟩)
      change min (m * L - P.boundary j) (if ChooseWide m L history j S t then 2 * m - 1 else 1) = _
      rw [if_pos hchoose, min_eq_right hfit]
    · have hn : N < W := by
        by_contra hh
        have hsame : N = W := by change N ≤ W at hnarrow; omega
        have hw : W = L / 2 := by
          by_contra hw'
          have hlt : W < L / 2 := by change W ≤ L / 2 at hwide; omega
          exact hchoose ⟨hlt, Or.inl (by change W ≤ N; omega)⟩
        change P.boundary j = (2 * m - 1) * W + N at hprefix
        rw [hsame, hw] at hprefix
        omega
      refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨?_, hn⟩)
      change min (m * L - P.boundary j) (if ChooseWide m L history j S t then 2 * m - 1 else 1) = _
      rw [if_neg hchoose, min_eq_right (by omega)]

/-- The threshold construction has a finite fixed outcome, with both
the actual history-dependent choices and the generic key-last trace
available for further analysis. This is not yet the forcing theorem. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.exists_candi.source:
theorem exists_candidate (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ Q records,
      HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
        (initial jobs m L hm) Q records ∧
      (∃ staticRule, RecordedRun (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A staticRule
        (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) ∧
      (∀ u v w, (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).edge u w →
        (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).edge v w → u = v) := by
  obtain ⟨Q, records, hh, staticRule, hr⟩ :=
    exists_history_certificates (rule jobs m L hm hL A) (initial jobs m L hm)
      (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L
  exact ⟨Q, records, hh, ⟨staticRule, hr⟩, fun _ _ _ hu hv => hr.completion.outForest hu hv⟩

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.batched_lower_bound.source:
theorem batched_lower_bound {m c : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ I : Instance (c * (m * (8 * c * 5 ^ c)))
        ((c * (m * (8 * c * 5 ^ c))) * (m * (8 * c * 5 ^ c))),
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
      (∀ j, I.release j = j.val * I.optimum m (by omega)) ∧
      c * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  let L := 8 * c * 5 ^ c
  have hL : 0 < L := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hc) (pow_pos (by omega) c)
  have hdiv : 2 ∣ L := ⟨4 * c * 5 ^ c, by dsimp [L]; ring⟩
  have heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L := by
    have := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
    omega
  have hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
  obtain ⟨Q, records, hrun, _, hforest⟩ := BatchedAdversary.exists_candidate (c * (m * L)) m L hm hL A
  have hj : 0 < c * (m * L) := Nat.mul_pos hc hw
  have hopt := BatchedAdversary.optimum_eq hm hL heven hj A hrun
  refine ⟨Q.toInstance L hw, hforest, hopt, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    rw [hopt]
    rfl
  · rw [hopt]
    exact BatchedAdversary.flow_lower hm hL heven hc hcm rfl A hrun rfl

Scheduling.batched_scale_clog_le.source:
theorem batched_scale_clog_le {c : ℕ} (hc : 0 < c) : Nat.clog 2 (8 * c * 5 ^ c) ≤ 7 * c := by
  apply Nat.clog_le_of_le_pow
  have h8 : 8 ≤ 2 ^ (3 * c) := by
    have hh := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 0 < 2) (show 3 ≤ 3 * c by omega)
    norm_num at hh
    exact hh
  have hc2 : c ≤ 2 ^ c := (Nat.lt_two_pow_self).le
  have h5 : 5 ^ c ≤ 2 ^ (3 * c) := by
    calc
      5 ^ c ≤ 8 ^ c := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (by omega) c
      _ = 2 ^ (3 * c) := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num
  calc
    8 * c * 5 ^ c ≤ 2 ^ (3 * c) * 2 ^ c * 2 ^ (3 * c) := Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.mul_le_mul h8 hc2) h5
    _ = 2 ^ (7 * c) := by rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add]; congr 1; omega

/-- The logarithmic batched lower bound with an explicit absolute
constant, at every scale `8*c*5^c` permitted by `2*c ≤ m`. -/

Scheduling.batched_competitive_lower.source:
theorem batched_competitive_lower {m c : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
      (∀ j, I.release j = j.val * I.optimum m (by omega)) ∧
      min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega))) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        7 * I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  obtain ⟨I, hforest, hopt, hrelease, hflow⟩ := batched_lower_bound hm hc hcm A
  refine ⟨_, _, I, hforest, hopt, hrelease, ?_⟩
  have hlog : Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)) ≤ 7 * c := by
    rw [hopt]
    exact batched_scale_clog_le hc
  have hmin := (min_le_right m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)))).trans hlog
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (I.optimum m (by omega)) hmin
  nlinarith

end Scheduling

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.budget_prefi.source:
theorem budget_prefix_work (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))) (P : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L))
    (hb : Budget m L history P)
    (hwidth : ∀ r ∈ history, r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1)
    (j : Fin jobs) : m * (history.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length ≤ P.closed j := by
  rw [job_count_eq hm history hwidth j, (hb j).2.2.1]
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m - 1) (hb j).2.1
  have hbval : 2 * m - 1 = (m - 1) + m := by omega
  have hmval : m = (m - 1) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hbval]
  calc
    m * (wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j) =
        m * wideCount m history j + (m - 1) * narrowCount history j + narrowCount history j := by
          have he := congrArg (fun x : ℕ => x * narrowCount history j) hmval
          nlinarith
    _ ≤ m * wideCount m history j + (m - 1) * wideCount m history j + narrowCount history j := by omega
    _ = _ := by ring

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.budget_recor.source:
theorem budget_record_width (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)) (hb : Budget m L history P)
    (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin (m * L))
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j) :
    let r := P.record (L := L) (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A j key
    r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1 := by
  have hs := (hb j).2.2.2
  rcases hs with ⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨hw, _⟩ | ⟨hn, _⟩
  · have he : P.boundary j = P.closed j := by simp only [boundary, hz, Nat.add_zero]
    omega
  · left; simpa only [record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hw
  · right; simpa only [record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hn

/-- Every parent edge introduced by the construction crosses a balanced
prefix boundary. Later records have no keys before that boundary. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.history_pare.source:
theorem history_parent_cut (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) history P Q records)
    (hb : Budget m L history P)
    (hwidth : ∀ r ∈ history, r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ r.stop - r.start = 1) :
    ∀ j (v u : Fin (m * L)), Q.parent j v = some u →
      P.parent j v = some u ∨ ∃ p n, u.val < p ∧ p ≤ v.val ∧ m * n ≤ p ∧
        ((recordedKeys (history ++ records) j).filter (fun k => k.val < p)).card ≤ n := by
  induction h with
  | done history P hd => intro j v u hp; exact Or.inl hp
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    let hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
    let r := P.record (L := L) hw A j key
    let next := history ++ [r]
    let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
    let q := (rule jobs m L hm hL A).size next P j t
    let R := P.advance j key hk q ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).fits _ _ _ _)
      ((rule jobs m L hm hL A).positive _ _ _ _)
    have hn : Budget m L next R := budget_advance hm hL heven A history P hb j key hk
    have hnext : ∀ s ∈ next, s.stop - s.start = 2 * m - 1 ∨ s.stop - s.start = 1 := by
      intro s hs
      rcases List.mem_append.mp hs with hs | hs
      · exact hwidth s hs
      · have he : s = r := List.mem_singleton.mp hs
        subst s
        exact budget_record_width hm hL A history P hb j key hk
    obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := tail.flexible.recorded
    intro i v u hp
    rcases ih hn hnext i v u hp with hprev | hcut
    · change (if i = j ∧ P.boundary j ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < P.boundary j + q then some key
        else P.parent i v) = some u at hprev
      split_ifs at hprev with hnew
      · have hkey : key = u := Option.some.inj hprev
        obtain ⟨hij, hvlo, hvhi⟩ := hnew
        subst i
        refine Or.inr ⟨P.boundary j, (next.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length, ?_, hvlo, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa only [hkey] using hk.2
        · have hh := budget_prefix_work hm next R hn hnext j
          simpa only [R, advance_closed] using hh
        · have hh := recordedKeys_prefix_le next records j (by
            intro k hkey
            have hl := hr.keys_lower j k hkey
            simpa only [advance_closed] using hl)
          simpa only [next, r, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hh
      · exact Or.inl hprev
    · right
      simpa only [next, r, List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using hcut

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.RecordCredit.source:
structure RecordCredit (m L : ℕ) (history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L)) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (e : ℕ) : Prop where
  before_completion : e ≤ r.time
  layer_after : ∀ v, job v = r.owner → r.start ≤ (position v).val →
    (position v).val < r.stop → e ≤ S v
  reveal : RevealCredit m L history r.owner S e (r.stop - r.start)
  balance : narrowCount history r.owner ≤ wideCount m history r.owner
  wide_quota : r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 → wideCount m history r.owner < L / 2

theorem RecordCredit.wide_below (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    {history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L)}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))} {e : ℕ}
    (h : RecordCredit m L history r S e) (hw : r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1)
    (hfull : ¬ IdleEarlier m L S e) :
    epochWideWork m L history r.owner S e < (2 * m - 1) * (L - e % L) := by
  have hc := h.reveal.credit hfull (h.wide_quota hw)
  apply hc.wide_below (by omega) (by have := Nat.mod_lt e hL; omega) h.balance
  rcases h.reveal.wide_choice hw with hg | hi | hx
  · exact Or.inl hg
  · exact False.elim (hfull hi)
  · exact Or.inr hx

/-- Every later layer is revealed strictly after the execution of an
earlier wide layer's key. This follows from the concrete completed-work
certificate, even when other jobs' records occur between the layers. -/

theorem RecordCredit.after_wide_key
    {history : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))} {r s : LayerRecord jobs (m * L)}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))} {e : ℕ}
    (h : RecordCredit m L history s S e) (hr : r ∈ history) (ho : r.owner = s.owner)
    (hw : r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1)
    (hk : r.start ≤ r.key.val ∧ r.key.val < r.stop)
    (ht : S (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key)) = r.time) : r.time < e := by
  have hh := h.reveal.closed_before (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key))
    ⟨(LayeredForest.job_pair r.owner r.key).trans ho, r, hr, ho, hw, by
      simpa only [LayeredForest.position_pair] using hk⟩
  rwa [ht] at hh

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.history_reco.source:
theorem history_record_credit (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) history P Q records)
    (hb : Budget m L history P)
    (hc : FrontierCredit m L history P (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)))) :
    ∀ before r after, records = before ++ r :: after →
      ∃ e, RecordCredit m L (history ++ before) r
        (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) e := by
  induction h with
  | done history P hd =>
    intro before r after he
    have hh := congrArg List.length he
    simp only [List.length_nil, List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hh
    omega
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro before r after heq
    cases before with
    | nil =>
      simp only [List.nil_append, List.cons.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨hr, ht⟩ := heq
      subst r
      subst after
      simp only [List.append_nil]
      obtain ⟨e, he, hcredit⟩ := hc j
      refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
      have hfull := HistoryRun.step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail
      obtain ⟨staticRule, hrun⟩ := hfull.flexible.recorded
      have htimes := hrun.final_times _ List.mem_cons_self
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, (hb j).2.1, ?_⟩
      · have hkey := he (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) (by
          apply mem_filter.mpr
          exact ⟨mem_univ _, LayeredForest.job_pair j key, by
            simpa only [LayeredForest.position_pair] using hk⟩)
        exact hkey.trans_eq htimes.2.2.2.1
      · intro v ho hlo hhi
        exact he v (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ho, hlo, hhi⟩)
      · simpa only [record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hcredit
      · intro hw
        have hw' : P.width j = 2 * m - 1 := by
          simpa only [record, boundary, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using hw
        rcases (hb j).2.2.2 with ⟨hz, _⟩ | ⟨_, hquota⟩ | ⟨hn, _⟩
        · omega
        · exact hquota
        · omega
    | cons a before =>
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.cons.injEq] at heq
      have hb' := budget_advance hm hL heven A history P hb j key hk
      have hc' := frontierCredit_advance hm hL heven A history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest
        records tail hb hc
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := ih hb' hc' before r after heq.2
      refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
      rw [← heq.1]
      simpa only [List.append_assoc, List.singleton_append] using he

/-- Every actual layer of the adaptive construction has a reveal-time
credit certificate. In particular, the prefix guard cannot choose a
wide layer above the passivity threshold during a full epoch. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.initial_reco.source:
theorem initial_record_credit (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) :
    ∀ before r after, records = before ++ r :: after →
      ∃ e, RecordCredit m L before r
        (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) e := by
  have hc := initial_frontierCredit hm hL heven
    (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)))
    (A.valid (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))).release
  simpa only [List.nil_append] using history_record_credit hm hL heven A h
    (initial_budget hm hL heven) hc

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.Instance.beforeArrival.source:
noncomputable def beforeArrival (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) < t ∧ t ≤ S v)

/-- All releases are multiples of the batch spacing. -/

Scheduling.Instance.BatchedArrivals.source:
def BatchedArrivals (L : ℕ) : Prop := ∀ j, L ∣ I.release j

/-- The earlier batches still unfinished just before boundary `h * L`. -/

Scheduling.Instance.unfinishedBatches.source:
noncomputable def unfinishedBatches (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (L h : ℕ) :
    Finset ℕ := (range h).filter (fun i => (I.batchRemaining S (i * L) (h * L)).Nonempty)

/-- A prefix retains exactly its unprocessed work; no later arrival joins it. -/

Scheduling.Instance.prefix_conservation.source:
theorem prefix_conservation {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {r t : ℕ}
    (hrt : r ≤ t) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r ∧ t ≤ S v)).card +
      (I.prefixWork S r t).card = (I.remaining S r).card := by
  classical
  let A := univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r ∧ t ≤ S v)
  have hd : Disjoint A (I.prefixWork S r t) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hv hw
    have ha := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hb := (mem_filter.mp hw).2
    try dsimp at ha
    omega
  have he : A ∪ I.prefixWork S r t = I.remaining S r := by
    ext v
    simp only [A, prefixWork, remaining, mem_union, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    omega
  rw [← card_union_of_disjoint hd, he]

/-- Full prefix slots contribute `m` units even when the target batch has
already finished. This form is useful for comparing record backlogs. -/

Scheduling.Instance.prefix_full_work.source:
theorem prefix_full_work {m r t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} :
    m * (t - r) ≤ (I.prefixWork S r t).card +
      m * (I.partialSlots m S r t).card := by
  classical
  let F := (Ico r t).filter (I.PrefixFull m S r)
  have hpart : F.card + (I.partialSlots m S r t).card = t - r := by
    simpa [F, partialSlots] using
      card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Ico r t) (I.PrefixFull m S r)
  have hsum : m * F.card ≤ (I.prefixWork S r t).card := by
    rw [I.prefixWork_card]
    calc
      _ = ∑ s ∈ F, (I.prefixService S r s).card := by
        have he : (∑ s ∈ F, (I.prefixService S r s).card) = ∑ _s ∈ F, m := by
          apply sum_congr rfl
          intro s hs
          exact (mem_filter.mp hs).2
        rw [he]
        simp [Nat.mul_comm]
      _ ≤ ∑ s ∈ Ico r t, (I.prefixService S r s).card :=
        sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (filter_subset _ _) (by intros; omega)
  rw [← hpart, Nat.mul_add]
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.remaining_at_arrival.source:
theorem remaining_at_arrival {m L r : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) :
    (I.remaining S r).card ≤ (I.beforeArrival S r).card + m * L := by
  classical
  let A := univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) = r)
  have hsub : I.remaining S r ⊆ I.beforeArrival S r ∪ A := by
    intro v hv
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    by_cases he : I.release (I.owner v) = r
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, he⟩)
    · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega, h.2⟩)
  have ha : A.card ≤ m * L := by
    have h := I.arrival_work_bound (a := r) (b := r) hO hL
    simpa [A, Nat.le_antisymm_iff, and_comm] using h
  exact (card_le_card hsub).trans ((card_union_le _ _).trans (Nat.add_le_add_left ha _))

Scheduling.Instance.beforeArrival_partit.source:
theorem beforeArrival_partition {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {L h r : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals L) (hr : r < h * L) :
    (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card =
      (univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r ∧ h * L ≤ S v)).card +
      ∑ i ∈ (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).filter (fun i => r < i * L),
        (I.batchRemaining S (i * L) (h * L)).card := by
  classical
  let A := univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r ∧ h * L ≤ S v)
  let Y := univ.filter (fun v => r < I.release (I.owner v) ∧
    I.release (I.owner v) < h * L ∧ h * L ≤ S v)
  have hd : Disjoint A Y := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hv hw
    have ha := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hy := (mem_filter.mp hw).2
    try dsimp at ha hy
    omega
  have he : I.beforeArrival S (h * L) = A ∪ Y := by
    ext v
    simp only [beforeArrival, A, Y, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_union]
    omega
  have hdiv (v : Fin vertices) : I.release (I.owner v) / L * L = I.release (I.owner v) :=
    Nat.div_mul_cancel (hb _)
  have hsum : Y.card = ∑ i ∈ (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).filter (fun i => r < i * L),
      (Y.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) / L = i)).card := by
    apply card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    intro v hv
    have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    try dsimp at hv'
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mpr hv'.2.1
    · exact ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (hdiv v).symm, hv'.2.2⟩⟩
    · simpa [hdiv v] using hv'.1
  rw [he, card_union_of_disjoint hd, hsum]
  congr 1
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hi' := (mem_filter.mp hi)
  have hir : i < h := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hi'.1).1
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [Y, batchRemaining, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  have hm : i * L < h * L := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hir hL
  have hdivi : i * L / L = i := Nat.mul_div_cancel i hL
  constructor
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨by rw [← hdiv v, hv.2], hv.1.2.2⟩
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, hv.2⟩, by rw [hv.1, hdivi]⟩

/-- The strict record inequality is derived from the concrete schedule and
the offline comparison, rather than assumed as a numerical premise. -/

Scheduling.Instance.record_prefix_idle.source:
theorem record_prefix_idle {m L h i : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (_hm : 0 < m) (hLpos : 0 < L) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals L)
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (hrecord : ∀ j < h, (I.beforeArrival S (j * L)).card <
      (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card)
    (hi : i ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h) :
    1 + ∑ j ∈ (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).filter (fun j => i < j),
      (I.partialSlots m S (j * L) (h * L)).card ≤
      (I.partialSlots m S (i * L) (h * L)).card := by
  classical
  have hih : i < h := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hi).1
  have hit : i * L < h * L := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hih hLpos
  let Y := (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).filter (fun j => i < j)
  let z := fun j => (I.partialSlots m S (j * L) (h * L)).card
  let w := fun j => (I.batchRemaining S (j * L) (h * L)).card
  have hycard : Y.card + 1 ≤ h - i := by
    have hsub : Y ⊆ Ico (i + 1) h := by
      intro j hj
      have hj' := mem_filter.mp hj
      have hjh := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hj'.1).1
      exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, hjh⟩
    have := card_le_card hsub
    rw [Nat.card_Ico] at this
    omega
  have hwz : (∑ j ∈ Y, w j) + m * (∑ j ∈ Y, z j) ≤ Y.card * (m * L) := by
    have hterm : ∀ j ∈ Y, w j + m * z j ≤ m * L := by
      intro j hj
      have hj' := (mem_filter.mp hj).1
      have hjh := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hj').1
      have hjt : j * L ≤ h * L := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (by omega)
      have hz := I.batch_prefix_idle_lt hS hF hO hL hjt (mem_filter.mp hj').2
      have hw := I.batch_remaining_work_bound hS hF hO hL hjt
      change z j < L at hz
      change w j ≤ m * (L - z j) at hw
      have he : L - z j + z j = L := by omega
      nlinarith
    have hh := sum_le_sum hterm
    simpa [sum_add_distrib, mul_sum] using hh
  have hc := I.prefix_conservation (S := S) hit.le
  have hf := I.prefix_full_work (S := S) (m := m) (r := i * L) (t := h * L)
  have ha := I.remaining_at_arrival (S := S) (r := i * L) hO hL
  have hp := I.beforeArrival_partition (S := S) hLpos hb hit
  have he : (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).filter (fun j => i * L < j * L) = Y := by
    ext j
    simp [Y, Nat.mul_lt_mul_right hLpos]
  rw [he] at hp
  have hr := hrecord i hih
  have htime : h * L - i * L = (h - i) * L := (Nat.sub_mul h i L).symm
  rw [htime] at hf
  have hage := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (m * L) hycard
  change 1 + ∑ j ∈ Y, z j ≤ z i
  change (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card = _ + ∑ j ∈ Y, w j at hp
  change m * ((h - i) * L) ≤ _ + m * z i at hf
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.Accounting
open Finset

/-- Exponential growth for a finite set of batch indices, with newer indices
on the right. This avoids requiring unfinished batches to be consecutive. -/

Scheduling.Accounting.geometric_finset_s.source:
theorem geometric_finset_sum (B : Finset ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i ∈ B, 1 + ∑ j ∈ B.filter (fun j => i < j), z j ≤ z i) :
    2 ^ B.card ≤ 1 + ∑ i ∈ B, z i := by
  classical
  induction B using Finset.induction_on_min with
  | empty => simp
  | insert a B hmin ih =>
    have ha : a ∉ B := by intro ha; exact (lt_irrefl a) (hmin a ha)
    have hB : (insert a B).filter (fun j => a < j) = B := by
      ext j
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_insert]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨rfl | hj, hlt⟩
        · omega
        · exact hj
      · intro hj; exact ⟨Or.inr hj, hmin j hj⟩
    have hza := hz a (mem_insert_self _ _)
    rw [hB] at hza
    have hsub : ∀ i ∈ B, 1 + ∑ j ∈ B.filter (fun j => i < j), z j ≤ z i := by
      intro i hi
      have hzi := hz i (mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      have hnot : ¬ i < a := by have := hmin i hi; omega
      simpa [filter_insert, hnot] using hzi
    have hpow := ih hsub
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem ha, pow_succ, sum_insert ha]
    omega

Scheduling.Accounting.geometric_finset_c.source:
theorem geometric_finset_card (B : Finset ℕ) (z : ℕ → ℕ) (L : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ i ∈ B, 1 + ∑ j ∈ B.filter (fun j => i < j), z j ≤ z i)
    (hL : ∀ i ∈ B, z i < L) : B.card ≤ Nat.clog 2 L := by
  classical
  by_cases hn : B.Nonempty
  · let a := B.min' hn
    have ha : a ∈ B := B.min'_mem hn
    have hmin : ∀ j ∈ B, a ≤ j := fun j hj => B.min'_le j hj
    have he : B.filter (fun j => a < j) = B.erase a := by
      ext j
      simp only [mem_filter, mem_erase]
      constructor
      · intro hj; exact ⟨by omega, hj.1⟩
      · intro hj; have := hmin j hj.2; exact ⟨hj.2, by omega⟩
    have hza := hz a ha
    rw [he] at hza
    have hsub : ∀ i ∈ B.erase a,
        1 + ∑ j ∈ (B.erase a).filter (fun j => i < j), z j ≤ z i := by
      intro i hi
      apply le_trans _ (hz i (mem_of_mem_erase hi))
      apply Nat.add_le_add_left
      apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg
      · intro j hj
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_of_mem_erase (mem_filter.mp hj).1, (mem_filter.mp hj).2⟩
      · intros; omega
    have hp := geometric_finset_sum (B.erase a) z hsub
    have hlt : 2 ^ (B.erase a).card < L := lt_of_le_of_lt (hp.trans hza) (hL a ha)
    have hc := (Nat.lt_clog_iff_pow_lt (by omega : 1 < 2)).mpr hlt
    have hec := card_erase_add_one ha
    omega
  · simp [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn]

end Scheduling.Accounting

namespace Scheduling.Instance
open Finset
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- Lemma 18, now for the actual unfinished batches of a valid FIFO schedule. -/

Scheduling.Instance.record_batch_count.source:
theorem record_batch_count {m L h : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hLpos : 0 < L) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals L)
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (hrecord : ∀ j < h, (I.beforeArrival S (j * L)).card <
      (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card) :
    (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).card ≤ Nat.clog 2 L := by
  apply Scheduling.Accounting.geometric_finset_card _
    (fun i => (I.partialSlots m S (i * L) (h * L)).card) L
  · intro i hi
    exact I.record_prefix_idle hm hLpos hb hS hF hO hL hrecord hi
  · intro i hi
    have hi' := mem_filter.mp hi
    have hit : i * L ≤ h * L := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (le_of_lt (mem_range.mp hi'.1))
    exact I.batch_prefix_idle_lt hS hF hO hL hit hi'.2

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.Instance
open Finset
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

Scheduling.Instance.beforeArrival_sum.source:
