theorem beforeArrival_sum {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {L h : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals L) :
    (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card =
      ∑ i ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h, (I.batchRemaining S (i * L) (h * L)).card := by
  classical
  have hdiv (v : Fin vertices) : I.release (I.owner v) / L * L = I.release (I.owner v) :=
    Nat.div_mul_cancel (hb _)
  have he : (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card =
      ∑ i ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h,
        ((I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) / L = i)).card := by
    apply card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    intro v hv
    have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr ((Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mpr hv'.1), ?_⟩
    exact ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (hdiv v).symm, hv'.2⟩⟩
  rw [he]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hi' := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hi).1
  have hit : i * L < h * L := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hi' hL
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [beforeArrival, batchRemaining, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨by rw [← hdiv v, hv.2], hv.1.2⟩
  · intro hv
    exact ⟨⟨by omega, hv.2⟩, by rw [hv.1]; exact Nat.mul_div_cancel i hL⟩

/-- A bound at strict records bounds all arrival-boundary backlogs. -/

Scheduling.Instance.batched_backlog_boun.source:
theorem batched_backlog_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hLpos : 0 < L) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals L)
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (h : ℕ) :
    (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card ≤ Nat.clog 2 L * (m * L) := by
  classical
  induction h using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h h ih =>
    by_cases hr : ∀ j < h, (I.beforeArrival S (j * L)).card <
        (I.beforeArrival S (h * L)).card
    · have hc := I.record_batch_count hm hLpos hb hS hF hO hL hr
      rw [I.beforeArrival_sum hLpos hb]
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ _i ∈ I.unfinishedBatches S L h, m * L := by
          apply sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have hi' := mem_range.mp (mem_filter.mp hi).1
          have hw := I.batch_remaining_work_bound hS hF hO hL
            (Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (le_of_lt hi'))
          exact hw.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (Nat.sub_le _ _))
        _ = (I.unfinishedBatches S L h).card * (m * L) := by simp
        _ ≤ _ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hc
    · push Not at hr
      obtain ⟨j, hj, hle⟩ := hr
      exact hle.trans (ih j hj)

/-- The batched FIFO upper bound, with its ceiling logarithm and additive
constant, for any positive offline flow bound equal to the batch spacing. -/

Scheduling.Instance.batched_fifo_flowBou.source:
theorem batched_fifo_flowBound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hLpos : 0 < L) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals L)
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L) : I.FlowBound S ((Nat.clog 2 L + 2) * L) := by
  classical
  intro v
  let r := I.release (I.owner v)
  let C := S v + 1
  let P := (I.partialSlots m S r C).card
  let F := ((Ico r C).filter (I.PrefixFull m S r)).card
  have hr : r ≤ S v := hS.release v
  have hp0 := I.partial_slots_lt hS hF hO hL (I.owner v) hr ⟨v, rfl, le_rfl⟩
  have hrec := I.partialSlots_succ (m := m) (S := S) hr
  have hp : P ≤ L := by
    dsimp [P, C, r]
    dsimp [r] at hrec
    split_ifs at hrec <;> omega
  have hpartition : F + P = C - r := by
    dsimp [F, P, partialSlots]
    simpa using card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Ico r C) (I.PrefixFull m S r)
  have hwork := I.fifo_service_accounting hS hF (I.owner v) v rfl (t := C) le_rfl
  have ha := I.remaining_at_arrival (S := S) (r := r) hO hL
  have hbkl := I.batched_backlog_bound hm hLpos hb hS hF hO hL (r / L)
  have hrdiv : r / L * L = r := Nat.div_mul_cancel (hb _)
  rw [hrdiv] at hbkl
  change m * F + P ≤ _ at hwork
  have hF : F ≤ (Nat.clog 2 L + 1) * L := by nlinarith
  have hC : C - r ≤ (Nat.clog 2 L + 2) * L := by nlinarith
  dsimp [C, r] at hC hr
  omega

/-- Theorem 4, logarithmic upper bound, specialized to the attained optimum. -/

Scheduling.Instance.batched_fifo_competi.source:
theorem batched_fifo_competitive {m : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals (I.optimum m hm))
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) :
    I.maxFlow S ≤ (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m hm) + 2) * I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  exact (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mp
    (I.batched_fifo_flowBound hm (I.optimum_pos hm hj) hb hS hF hO hL)

/-- Both FIFO guarantees apply to the same schedule. The minimum is written
without division, preserving the exact general-arrival coefficient. -/

Scheduling.Instance.batched_fifo_combine.source:
theorem batched_fifo_combined_bound {m : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs) (hb : I.BatchedArrivals (I.optimum m hm))
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) :
    m * I.maxFlow S ≤ min
      ((m * m + m - 1) * I.optimum m hm)
      (m * ((Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m hm) + 2) * I.optimum m hm)) := by
  exact le_min (I.fifo_competitive hm hS hF)
    (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (I.batched_fifo_competitive hm hj hb hS hF))

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.nod.source:
theorem RecordedRun.nodup {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) : records.Nodup := by
  apply h.ordered_intervals.imp_of_mem
  intro r s hr _ horder he
  subst s
  have ht := h.final_times r hr
  have hh := horder rfl
  omega

end LayeredPrefix

namespace BatchedAdversary
open LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs m L : ℕ}

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedRev.source:
theorem CertifiedReveals.layer_after {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))} {E : LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ}
    (h : CertifiedReveals m L records S E) (r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L)) (hr : r ∈ records)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))) (ho : LayeredForest.job v = r.owner)
    (hlo : r.start ≤ (LayeredForest.position v).val) (hhi : (LayeredForest.position v).val < r.stop) :
    E r ≤ S v := by
  obtain ⟨before, after, he⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp hr
  exact (h before r after he).layer_after v ho hlo hhi

/-- One fixed reveal time for each actual layer. The certificate is
valid at its unique position in the chronological record list. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.exists_recor.source:
theorem exists_record_reveal_times (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) :
    ∃ E : LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ,
      CertifiedReveals m L records (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) E := by
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := h.flexible.recorded
  have hn := hr.nodup
  have hex : ∀ r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L), ∃ e,
      ∀ before after, records = before ++ r :: after →
        RecordCredit m L before r (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) e := by
    intro r
    by_cases hmemb : r ∈ records
    · obtain ⟨before, after, heq⟩ := List.mem_iff_append.mp hmemb
      obtain ⟨e, hc⟩ := initial_record_credit hm hL heven A h before r after heq
      refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
      intro before' after' heq'
      have hn' : (before ++ r :: after).Nodup := heq ▸ hn
      have hparts := List.nodup_append'.mp hn'
      have hnb : r ∉ before := fun hh => hparts.2.2 hh List.mem_cons_self
      have hna : r ∉ after := (List.nodup_cons.mp hparts.2.1).1
      have he := (List.append_cons_inj_of_notMem hnb hna).mp (heq.symm.trans heq')
      simpa only [← he.1] using hc
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      intro before after heq
      exact False.elim (hmemb (heq ▸ List.mem_append_right before List.mem_cons_self))
  choose E hE using hex
  exact ⟨E, fun before r after he => hE r before after he⟩

end BatchedAdversary
end Scheduling

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.jobWideServi.source:
noncomputable def jobWideService (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (a b : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m records j v ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card

theorem jobWideService_zero_before (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (a b e : ℕ)
    (hea : e ≤ a) (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m records j v → S v < e) :
    jobWideService m records j S a b = 0 := by
  apply card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have ht := hclosed v hv'.1
  omega

theorem jobWideService_zero_after (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (a b : ℕ)
    (hfuture : ∀ v, WideRecorded m records j v → b ≤ S v) :
    jobWideService m records j S a b = 0 := by
  apply card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have ht := hfuture v hv'.1
  omega

/-- After the last wide layer revealed before the interval ends, only
that one layer can add service beyond the already completed prefix. -/

theorem jobWideService_cut_le (m : ℕ) (before after : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work))
    (a b e : ℕ)
    (hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m before j v → S v < e)
    (hfuture : ∀ v, WideRecorded m after j v → b ≤ S v) :
    jobWideService m (before ++ r :: after) j S a b ≤
      jobWideService m before j S a e + (r.stop - r.start) := by
  let old := univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m before j v ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < e)
  let layer := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => job v = j ∧
    r.start ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < r.stop)
  have hs : univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m (before ++ r :: after) j v ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)
      ⊆ old ∪ layer := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨⟨ho, s, hmem, hsowner, hswidth, hlo, hhi⟩, htime⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    rcases List.mem_append.mp hmem with hpast | htail
    · have hw : WideRecorded m before j v := ⟨ho, s, hpast, hsowner, hswidth, hlo, hhi⟩
      exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hw, htime.1, hclosed v hw⟩)
    · rcases List.mem_cons.mp htail with he | hafter
      · subst s
        exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ho, hlo, hhi⟩)
      · have ht := hfuture v ⟨ho, s, hafter, hsowner, hswidth, hlo, hhi⟩
        omega
  have hc := (card_le_card hs).trans (card_union_le old layer)
  exact hc.trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (owner_interval_card_le j r.start r.stop) old.card)

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.exists_last_.source:
private theorem exists_last_satisfying {α : Type*} (p : α → Prop) (xs : List α) :
    (∀ x ∈ xs, ¬ p x) ∨ ∃ before x after, xs = before ++ x :: after ∧ p x ∧ ∀ y ∈ after, ¬ p y := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => exact Or.inl (by simp)
  | cons x xs ih =>
    rcases ih with hn | ⟨before, y, after, he, hy, hafter⟩
    · by_cases hx : p x
      · exact Or.inr ⟨[], x, xs, rfl, hx, hn⟩
      · left
        intro y hy
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hy with rfl | hy
        · exact hx
        · exact hn y hy
    · exact Or.inr ⟨x :: before, y, after, by simp only [List.cons_append, he], hy, hafter⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.CertifiedRev.source:
theorem CertifiedReveals.future_wide {records after : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))} {E : LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ}
    (h : CertifiedReveals m L records S E) (j : Fin jobs) (b : ℕ)
    (hsub : ∀ r ∈ after, r ∈ records)
    (hlast : ∀ r ∈ after, ¬ (r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧ E r < b)) :
    ∀ v, WideRecorded m after j v → b ≤ S v := by
  rintro v ⟨ho, r, hr, hrj, hrw, hlo, hhi⟩
  have hn := hlast r hr
  have ht := h.layer_after r (hsub r hr) v (ho.trans hrj.symm) hlo hhi
  omega

/-- Each job admits a cutoff in the epoch: its total wide service is
bounded by the remaining epoch length at that cutoff, and its suffix
service after the cutoff is at most one wide layer. -/

theorem CertifiedReveals.job_wide_cutoff (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L)
    {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))} {E : LayerRecord jobs (m * L) → ℕ}
    (h : CertifiedReveals m L records S E) (j : Fin jobs) (i : ℕ)
    (hfull : ∀ t, i * L ≤ t → t < (i + 1) * L → ¬ IdleEarlier m L S t) :
    ∃ t, i * L ≤ t ∧ t ≤ (i + 1) * L ∧
      jobWideService m records j S (i * L) ((i + 1) * L) ≤
        (2 * m - 1) * ((i + 1) * L - t + 1) ∧
      ∀ u, t ≤ u → jobWideService m records j S u ((i + 1) * L) ≤ 2 * m - 1 := by
  have hend : (i + 1) * L = i * L + L := by ring
  rcases exists_last_satisfying
      (fun r : LayerRecord jobs (m * L) => r.owner = j ∧ r.stop - r.start = 2 * m - 1 ∧ E r < (i + 1) * L)
      records with hnone | ⟨before, r, after, heq, ⟨hrj, hrw, hre⟩, hlast⟩
  · have hf := h.future_wide j ((i + 1) * L) (fun _ hr => hr) hnone
    refine ⟨(i + 1) * L, by omega, le_rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [jobWideService_zero_after m records j S _ _ hf]
      omega
    · intro u _
      rw [jobWideService_zero_after m records j S _ _ hf]
      omega
  · have hc := h before r after heq
    have hclosed : ∀ v, WideRecorded m before j v → S v < E r := by
      simpa only [hrj] using hc.reveal.closed_before
    have hf := h.future_wide j ((i + 1) * L)
      (fun s hs => heq ▸ List.mem_append_right before (List.mem_cons_of_mem r hs)) hlast
    have hcut : ∀ a, jobWideService m records j S a ((i + 1) * L) ≤
        jobWideService m before j S a (E r) + (2 * m - 1) := by
      intro a
      rw [heq]
      simpa only [hrw] using jobWideService_cut_le m before after r j S a ((i + 1) * L) (E r) hclosed hf
    by_cases hstart : i * L ≤ E r
    · have hep : E r / L = i := by
        apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le hstart
        exact hre
      have hx := hc.wide_below hm hL hrw (hfull _ hstart hre)
      rw [hrj] at hx
      have hxeq : epochWideWork m L before j S (E r) = jobWideService m before j S (i * L) (E r) := by
        simp only [epochWideWork, jobWideService, hep]
      rw [hxeq] at hx
      have hmod := Nat.div_add_mod (E r) L
      rw [hep] at hmod
      have hmod' : i * L + E r % L = E r := by nlinarith
      have hd : L - E r % L = (i + 1) * L - E r := by
        have := Nat.mod_lt (E r) hL
        omega
      rw [hd] at hx
      refine ⟨E r, hstart, hre.le, ?_, ?_⟩
      · have hh := hcut (i * L)
        nlinarith
      · intro u hu
        have hh := hcut u
        rw [jobWideService_zero_before m before j S u (E r) (E r) hu hclosed] at hh
        simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hh
    · have hzero := jobWideService_zero_before m before j S (i * L) (E r) (E r) (by omega) hclosed
      have htotal := hcut (i * L)
      rw [hzero, Nat.zero_add] at htotal
      refine ⟨(i + 1) * L, by omega, le_rfl, by simpa only [Nat.sub_self, Nat.zero_add, Nat.mul_one] using htotal, ?_⟩
      intro u hu
      have hh := hcut u
      rw [jobWideService_zero_before m before j S u (E r) (E r) (by omega) hclosed] at hh
      simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hh

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.JobCutoffs.source:
def JobCutoffs (m L : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L)))
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (m * L))) (i : ℕ) (T : Fin jobs → ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, i * L ≤ T j ∧ T j ≤ (i + 1) * L ∧
    jobWideService m records j S (i * L) ((i + 1) * L) ≤
      (2 * m - 1) * ((i + 1) * L - T j + 1) ∧
    ∀ u, T j ≤ u → jobWideService m records j S u ((i + 1) * L) ≤ 2 * m - 1

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.noIdleEarlie.source:
theorem noIdleEarlier_of_full_epoch (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work))
    (i t : ℕ) (hlo : i * L ≤ t) (hhi : t < (i + 1) * L)
    (hfull : ∀ u, i * L ≤ u → u < (i + 1) * L → (univ.filter (fun v => S v = u)).card = m) :
    ¬ IdleEarlier m L S t := by
  have hep : t / L = i := Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le hlo hhi
  rintro ⟨u, hu, hut, hc⟩
  rw [hep] at hu
  have he := hfull u hu (hut.trans hhi)
  omega

/-- The actual adaptive construction supplies all per-job cutoffs in
any full epoch. No passivity times or service bounds are assumed. -/

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.full_epoch_j.source:
theorem full_epoch_job_cutoffs (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records) (i : ℕ)
    (hfull : ∀ u, i * L ≤ u → u < (i + 1) * L →
      (univ.filter (fun v => A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v = u)).card = m) :
    ∃ T, JobCutoffs m L records (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) i T := by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := exists_record_reveal_times hm hL heven A h
  have hc := fun j => hE.job_wide_cutoff hm hL j i
    (fun t hlo hhi => noIdleEarlier_of_full_epoch _ i t hlo hhi hfull)
  choose T hT using hc
  exact ⟨T, hT⟩

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.rec.source:
theorem RecordedRun.record_time_injective {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records)
    {r s : LayerRecord jobs work} (hr : r ∈ records) (hs : s ∈ records)
    (ho : r.owner = s.owner) (ht : r.time = s.time) : r = s := by
  let rs := records.filter (fun x => x.owner = r.owner)
  have hpair : rs.Pairwise (fun a b => a.time ≠ b.time) :=
    (h.job_times_pairwise r.owner).imp (fun h => ne_of_lt h)
  let : Std.Symm (fun a b : LayerRecord jobs work => a.time ≠ b.time) :=
    ⟨fun _ _ hh => Ne.symm hh⟩
  by_contra hne
  apply (hpair.forall (by simp [rs, hr]) (by simp [rs, hs, ho]) hne) ht

end Scheduling.LayeredPrefix

namespace Scheduling.BatchedAdversary
open Finset
open LayeredForest (job position)
open LayeredPrefix
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {jobs m L : ℕ}

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.nonwide_is_n.source:
theorem nonwide_is_narrow_key (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))) (hv : ¬ WideRecorded m records (job v) v) :
    ∃ r ∈ records, r.owner = job v ∧ r.stop - r.start = 1 ∧
      v = finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key) := by
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := h.flexible.recorded
  obtain ⟨r, hmem, ho, hlo, hhi⟩ := hr.covers (job v) (position v) (by simp [initial])
  have hwidth := history_widths hm hL heven A h (initial_budget hm hL heven) r hmem
  have hn : r.stop - r.start = 1 := hwidth.resolve_left (by
    intro hw
    exact hv ⟨rfl, r, hmem, ho, hw, hlo, hhi⟩)
  have ht := hr.final_times r hmem
  have hkey : (position v).val = r.key.val := by omega
  refine ⟨r, hmem, ho, hn, ?_⟩
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  simp only [LayeredForest.job_pair, LayeredForest.position_pair]
  exact Prod.ext ho.symm hkey

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.nonwide_same.source:
theorem nonwide_same_slot_injective (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * (m * L))}
    (hu : ¬ WideRecorded m records (job u) u) (hv : ¬ WideRecorded m records (job v) v)
    (ho : job u = job v)
    (ht : A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) u =
      A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v) : u = v := by
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := h.flexible.recorded
  obtain ⟨r, hr', hro, _, hu'⟩ := nonwide_is_narrow_key hm hL heven A h u hu
  obtain ⟨s, hs', hso, _, hv'⟩ := nonwide_is_narrow_key hm hL heven A h v hv
  have hrt := (hr.final_times r hr').2.2.2.1
  have hst := (hr.final_times s hs').2.2.2.1
  have he : r = s := hr.record_time_injective hr' hs' (hro.trans (ho.trans hso.symm)) (by
    rw [hu', hv', hrt, hst] at ht
    exact ht)
  rw [hu', hv', he]

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.narrow_slot_.source:
theorem narrow_slot_le (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    {c i t : ℕ}
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) (c * L))
    (ht : i * L ≤ t ∧ t < (i + 1) * L) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => ¬ WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧
      A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v = t)).card ≤ c := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)
  let S := A.schedule I
  have hS := A.valid I
  have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn job
    (s := univ.filter (fun v => ¬ WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧ S v = t))
    (t := I.alive S (i * L)) (by
      intro v hv
      have htime := (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2
      have hr := I.regular_epoch_no_arrivals (i := i) hS hL (by intros; rfl) v
        (show S v < (i + 1) * L from by omega)
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hr, v, rfl, by omega⟩) (by
      intro u hu v hv ho
      obtain ⟨hnu, htu⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
      obtain ⟨hnv, htv⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      exact nonwide_same_slot_injective hm hL heven A h hnu hnv ho (htu.trans htv.symm))
  exact hc.trans (I.regular_alive_card_le hL (by intros; rfl) hflow i)

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideService.source:
noncomputable def wideService {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (a b : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.wideService_.source:
theorem wideService_eq_sum {jobs work : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) (a b : ℕ) :
    wideService m records S a b = ∑ t ∈ Ico a b,
      (univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧ S v = t)).card := by
  unfold wideService
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := S) (fun v hv => mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2)]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hw, _⟩, htime⟩; exact ⟨hw, htime⟩
  · rintro ⟨hw, htime⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hw, by rw [htime]; exact mem_Ico.mp ht⟩, htime⟩

Scheduling.BatchedAdversary.full_epoch_w.source:
theorem full_epoch_wide_lower (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) {records : List (LayerRecord jobs (m * L))}
    {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs (m * L)}
    (h : HistoryRun (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL) A L (rule jobs m L hm hL A) []
      (initial jobs m L hm) Q records)
    {c i a b : ℕ}
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).FlowBound
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) (c * L))
    (ha : i * L ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ (i + 1) * L)
    (hfull : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      (univ.filter (fun v => A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) v = t)).card = m) :
    (m - c) * (b - a) ≤ wideService m records
      (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) a b := by
  let S := A.schedule (Q.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))
  rw [wideService_eq_sum]
  have hs : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b,
      m - c ≤ (univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧ S v = t)).card := by
    intro t ht
    have hn := narrow_slot_le hm hL heven A h hflow (i := i) (t := t)
      ⟨ha.trans (mem_Ico.mp ht).1, (mem_Ico.mp ht).2.trans_le hb⟩
    have hp := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ.filter (fun v => S v = t))
      (fun v => WideRecorded m records (job v) v)
    have hwide : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).filter (fun v => WideRecorded m records (job v) v) =
        univ.filter (fun v => WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧ S v = t) := by
      ext v; simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]; tauto
    have hnarrow : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).filter (fun v => ¬ WideRecorded m records (job v) v) =
        univ.filter (fun v => ¬ WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧ S v = t) := by
      ext v; simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]; tauto
    rw [hwide, hnarrow, hfull t ht] at hp
    change (univ.filter (fun v => ¬ WideRecorded m records (job v) v ∧ S v = t)).card ≤ c at hn
    omega
  have hh := sum_le_sum hs
  simpa only [sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.mul_comm] using hh

end Scheduling.BatchedAdversary

Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux.source:
noncomputable def combinedAux (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (fuel B : ℕ) → (0 < B) → Assignment (vertices := vertices) → ℕ → Assignment (vertices := vertices)
  | 0, B, _, S, s => I.fifoPhase m hm B S s
  | fuel + 1, B, hB, S, s => by
    classical
    exact if B < m then
      let C := I.sffPhase m B hB S s
      if hf : I.PhaseFails C s B then
        combinedAux m hm fuel (2 * B) (by omega) C (I.failureTime hf)
      else C
    else I.fifoPhase m hm B S s

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_final_phase.source:
theorem fifo_final_phase {m B s K : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hS : I.Valid m S)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hprefix : ∀ v, S v < s → S v < I.release (I.owner v) + K)
    (hbudget : 44 * B ^ 2 + 44 * m * I.optimum m hm ≤ K) :
    I.Valid m (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) ∧ I.FlowBound (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) K ∧
      ∀ v, S v < s → I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = S v := by
  classical
  refine ⟨I.fifoPhase_valid hm hS, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro v
    by_cases hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s
    · have hb := I.fifoPhase_survivor_bound hm hs v hv
      omega
    · have hvs : S v < s := by simpa [survivors] using hv
      have he := I.splice_preserves_prefix
        ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).fifoSchedule m hm) hvs
      change I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = S v at he
      rw [he]
      exact hprefix v hvs
  · intro v hv
    exact I.splice_preserves_prefix _ hv

/-- The controller's invariant includes feasibility, the final flow bound,
and preservation of the already executed prefix. No performance property
of a phase is supplied as a hypothesis. -/

Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_spec.source:
theorem combinedAux_spec {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ)
    (hfuel : m ≤ 2 ^ fuel * B)
    (hBO : B ≤ 2 * I.optimum m hm) (hBm : B < 2 * m)
    (hS : I.Valid m S)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hprefix : ∀ v, S v < s →
      S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm)) :
    I.Valid m (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s) ∧
      I.FlowBound (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s)
        (352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm)) ∧
      ∀ v, S v < s → I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = S v := by
  classical
  induction fuel generalizing B S s with
  | zero =>
    have hswitch : m ≤ B := by simpa using hfuel
    exact I.fifo_final_phase hm hS hs hprefix
      (Accounting.combined_fifo_budget hBO hBm hswitch)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hswitch : B < m
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_pos hswitch]
      let C := I.sffPhase m B hB S s
      have hC : I.Valid m C := I.sffPhase_valid hm hB hS
      have hstart : ∀ v, s ≤ C v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 :=
        I.sffPhase_start_bound hB hs
      have hbudget := Accounting.combined_sff_budget hBO hBm
      have hagree : ∀ v, S v < s → C v = S v := by
        intro v hv
        exact I.splice_preserves_prefix _ hv
      have hold : ∀ v, C v < s →
          C v < I.release (I.owner v) + 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm) := by
        intro v hv
        have hvs : S v < s := by
          have he := I.splice_survives (S := S) (s := s)
            ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).sffSchedule m B hB) v
          change (s ≤ C v ↔ s ≤ S v) at he
          omega
        rw [hagree v hvs]
        exact hprefix v hvs
      by_cases hf : I.PhaseFails C s B
      · change I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B at hf
        rw [dif_pos hf]
        have hsmall := I.failed_guess_lt hm hB hs hf
        have hnextfuel : m ≤ 2 ^ fuel * (2 * B) := by
          simpa [pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc] using hfuel
        have hnextprefix : ∀ v, C v < I.failureTime hf →
            C v < I.release (I.owner v) + 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm) := by
          intro v hv
          by_cases hvs : C v < s
          · exact hold v hvs
          · have ha := I.failure_completed_age hf hstart v (show s ≤ C v by omega) hv
            change C v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 at ha
            omega
        have hrec := ih (2 * B) (by omega) C (I.failureTime hf) hnextfuel
          (by omega) (by omega) hC (I.doubled_phase_start hB hs hf) hnextprefix
        refine ⟨hrec.1, hrec.2.1, ?_⟩
        intro v hv
        have he := hagree v hv
        have ht := (I.failureTime_spec hf).1
        exact (hrec.2.2 v (by omega)).trans he
      · change ¬ I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B at hf
        rw [dif_neg hf]
        refine ⟨hC, ?_, hagree⟩
        intro v
        by_cases hvs : C v < s
        · exact hold v hvs
        · have ha := I.no_failure_flow hf hstart v (show s ≤ C v by omega)
          change C v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 at ha
          exact ha.trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left hbudget _)
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_neg hswitch]
      exact I.fifo_final_phase hm hS hs hprefix
        (Accounting.combined_fifo_budget hBO hBm (by omega))

/-- The initial comparison assignment supplies an empty prefix at time zero;
none of its slots are used by the controller. -/

Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule.source:
noncomputable def combinedSchedule (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  I.combinedAux m hm m 1 (by omega) I.serialSchedule 0

Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_spe.source:
theorem combinedSchedule_spec {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs) :
    I.Valid m (I.combinedSchedule m hm) ∧
      I.maxFlow (I.combinedSchedule m hm) ≤
        352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm) := by
  have hp : ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ 2 ^ n := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero => simp
    | succ n ih =>
      have hpos : 0 < 2 ^ n := by positivity
      rw [pow_succ]
      omega
  have hopt := I.optimum_pos hm hj
  have h := I.combinedAux_spec hm m 1 (by omega) I.serialSchedule 0
    (by simpa using hp m) (by omega) (by omega) (I.serialSchedule_valid hm)
    (by intros; omega) (by intros; omega)
  exact ⟨h.1, (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mp h.2.1⟩

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.card_le_slots.source:
theorem card_le_slots {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (S : V → ℕ) (m a b : ℕ) (s : Finset V)
    (cap : ∀ t, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card ≤ m)
    (times : ∀ v ∈ s, a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b) :
    s.card ≤ m * (b - a) := by
  classical
  have heq : s.card = ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, (s.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun v hv => mem_Ico.mpr (times v hv))
  rw [heq]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _t ∈ Ico a b, m := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro t _
      exact (card_le_card (by intro v hv; simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] at *; exact hv.2)).trans (cap t)
    _ = m * (b - a) := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- Proposition 5(2), in the paper's inclusive release interval convention. -/

Scheduling.Instance.arrival_work_bound.source:
theorem arrival_work_bound {m L a b : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ I.release (I.owner v) ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ b)).card
      ≤ m * (b + L - a) := by
  classical
  apply card_le_slots O m a (b + L) _ hO.capacity
  intro v hv
  have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have := hO.release v
  have := hL v
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.job_work_bound.source:
theorem job_work_bound {m L : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (I.jobVertices j).card ≤ m * L := by
  classical
  have h := I.arrival_work_bound (a := I.release j) (b := I.release j) hO hL
  have hsub : I.jobVertices j ⊆
      univ.filter (fun v => I.release j ≤ I.release (I.owner v) ∧
        I.release (I.owner v) ≤ I.release j) := by
    intro v hv
    have ho := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    simp_all
  exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (by simpa using h)

/-- Proposition 5(1): every nonempty directed path has at most L vertices.
The vertex sequence need not be assumed injective: precedence already forces
its execution times to increase. -/

Scheduling.Instance.path_length_bound.source:
theorem path_length_bound {m L n : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (p : Fin (n + 1) → Fin vertices)
    (he : ∀ k : Fin n, I.edge (p k.castSucc) (p k.succ)) : n + 1 ≤ L := by
  have hpath : ∀ k : Fin (n + 1),
      I.owner (p k) = I.owner (p 0) ∧
      I.release (I.owner (p 0)) + k.val ≤ O (p k) := by
    intro k
    induction k using Fin.induction with
    | zero => exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using hO.release (p 0)⟩
    | succ k ih =>
      simp only [Fin.val_castSucc] at ih
      have hp := hO.precedence (he k)
      have ho := I.same_job (he k)
      exact ⟨ho.symm.trans ih.1, by simpa using (show I.release (I.owner (p 0)) + (k.val + 1) ≤ O (p k.succ) by omega)⟩
  have hlast := hpath (Fin.last n)
  have hb := hL (p (Fin.last n))
  rw [hlast.1] at hb
  simp only [Fin.val_last] at hlast
  omega

/-- Every nonempty finite residual DAG has a ready vertex. The proof descends
in the supplied topological rank, rather than assuming a ready vertex exists. -/

Scheduling.Instance.exists_ready.source:
theorem exists_ready {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {j : Fin jobs} {t : ℕ}
    (hr : I.release j ≤ t) (hu : ∃ v, I.owner v = j ∧ t ≤ S v) :
    ∃ v, I.owner v = j ∧ I.Ready S t v := by
  classical
  have aux : ∀ n v, I.rank v = n → I.owner v = j → t ≤ S v →
      ∃ w, I.owner w = j ∧ I.Ready S t w := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro v hv hj ht
      by_cases hpred : ∀ u, I.edge u v → S u < t
      · exact ⟨v, hj, by rw [Ready, hj]; exact ⟨hr, ht, hpred⟩⟩
      · push Not at hpred
        obtain ⟨u, he, hu⟩ := hpred
        exact ih (I.rank u) (by have := I.rank_increases he; omega) u rfl
          ((I.same_job he).trans hj) hu
  obtain ⟨v, hj, ht⟩ := hu
  exact aux (I.rank v) v rfl hj ht

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.job_interval_card.source:
theorem job_interval_card {jobs work : ℕ} (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work))
    (j : Fin jobs) (a b : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card =
      (univ.filter (fun v : Fin work => a ≤ S (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) ∧
        S (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) < b)).card := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin work => a ≤ S (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) ∧ S (finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) < b)
  have he : univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b) =
      R.image (fun v => finProdFinEquiv (j, v)) := by
    ext v
    simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨ho, ht⟩
      have hv : finProdFinEquiv (j, position v) = v := by
        rw [← ho]; exact finProdFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply v
      exact ⟨position v, by simpa only [R, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hv] using ht, hv⟩
    · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨LayeredForest.job_pair _ _, (mem_filter.mp hu).2⟩
  rw [he, card_image_of_injective]
  intro u v huv
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (finProdFinEquiv.injective huv)

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work m c L : ℕ} {hm : 0 < m} {hwpos : 0 < work}
  {A : DeterministicScheduler m} {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.for.source:
theorem RecordedRun.forcing_interval_work
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hwpos A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) (initial m hm) Q records)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L hwpos).FlowBound (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hwpos)) (c * L)) (k : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => (c * k) * L ≤ A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hwpos) v ∧
      A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hwpos) v < (c * k) * L + L / 2)).card ≤
      ((Q.toInstance L hwpos).alive (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hwpos)) ((c * k) * L)).card * (2 * m + L / 2) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L hwpos
  let S := A.schedule I
  let a := (c * k) * L
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < a + L / 2)
  have hf : ∀ v ∈ R, job v ∈ I.alive S a := by
    intro v hv
    have ht := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hhalf : L / 2 ≤ L := Nat.div_le_self _ _
    have hr := I.regular_epoch_no_arrivals (A.valid I) hL (by intros; rfl) v
      (show S v < (c * k + 1) * L by dsimp [a] at ht; nlinarith)
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hr, v, rfl, ht.1⟩
  have he := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hf
  change R.card ≤ (I.alive S a).card * (2 * m + L / 2)
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ I.alive S a, (2 * m + L / 2) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      have hstart := I.alive_firstForcingTime hc hL (by intros; rfl) hflow j hj
      have harrive : j.val * L ≤ a := (mem_filter.mp hj).2.1
      have hset : R.filter (fun v => job v = j) =
          univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < a + L / 2) := by
        ext v; simp only [R, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]; tauto
      rw [hset, job_interval_card]
      exact h.local_forcing_work j a hstart harrive
    _ = _ := by simp

theorem RecordedRun.forcing_epoch_deficit
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hwpos A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) (initial m hm) Q records)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L) (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (hflow : (Q.toInstance L hwpos).FlowBound (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hwpos)) (c * L)) (k : ℕ) :
    (Q.toInstance L hwpos).epochWork (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hwpos)) L (c * k) < m * L := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L hwpos
  let S := A.schedule I
  let a := (c * k) * L
  have hwork := h.forcing_interval_work hc hL hflow k
  have halive := I.regular_alive_card_le hL (by intros; rfl) hflow (c * k)
  have hscaled : 2 * (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < a + L / 2)).card ≤
      (I.alive S a).card * (4 * m + L) := by
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hwork
    change 2 * (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < a + L / 2)).card ≤
      2 * ((I.alive S a).card * (2 * m + L / 2)) at hh
    nlinarith
  have hgap := Accounting.forcing_capacity_gap hm hL halive hcL hcm hscaled
  have hdeficit : (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < a + L / 2)).card < m * (a + L / 2 - a) := by
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hidle⟩ := I.interval_deficit_has_idle (A.valid I) hdeficit
  apply I.epochWork_lt_of_idle (A.valid I) hL (t := t) _ hidle
  have ht' := mem_Ico.mp ht
  have hhalf_le : L / 2 ≤ L := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  apply mem_Ico.mpr
  refine ⟨ht'.1, ?_⟩
  dsimp [a] at ht' ⊢
  nlinarith

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.flo.source:
theorem RecordedRun.flow_lower
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hwpos A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) (initial m hm) Q records)
    (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L) (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (hn : jobs = c * (c * (m * L))) (hw : work = m * L) :
    c * L ≤ (Q.toInstance L hwpos).maxFlow (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hwpos)) := by
  let I := Q.toInstance L hwpos
  let S := A.schedule I
  by_contra hnflow
  change ¬ c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S at hnflow
  have hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L) := (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hbound := I.regular_forcing_flow_lower hm hL hc hn (A.valid I) (by intros; rfl)
    (by intro j; exact (Q.jobVertices_card L hwpos j).trans hw)
    (by intro k _; exact h.forcing_epoch_deficit hc hL hhalf hcL hcm hflow k)
  exact hnflow hbound

end LayeredPrefix

/-- Deterministic part of Theorem 1, with explicit parameters and finite
instance size. There are no adversarial trace or offline schedule hypotheses. -/

Scheduling.deterministic_lower_bound.source:
theorem deterministic_lower_bound {m c L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ I : Instance (c * (c * (m * L))) ((c * (c * (m * L))) * (m * L)),
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ I.optimum m (by omega) ∧ I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * L ∧
      c * L ≤ I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  have hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos hm0 hL
  obtain ⟨Q, records, hrun, _, hforest⟩ := LayeredPrefix.exists_recorded_forcing_forest
    (jobs := c * (c * (m * L))) (work := m * L) (L := L) (c := c) hm0 hw A
  have hj : 0 < c * (c * (m * L)) := Nat.mul_pos hc (Nat.mul_pos hc hw)
  have ho := hrun.optimum_bounds hm hj rfl hhalf
  exact ⟨Q.toInstance L hw, hforest, ho.1, ho.2, hrun.flow_lower hc hL hhalf hcL hcm rfl rfl⟩

/-- An explicit absolute constant in the deterministic
`Ω(min(m, OPT))` lower bound. The scale `L` may be any positive multiple
of sixteen, so the instances exist at arbitrarily large flow scales. -/

Scheduling.deterministic_competitive_low.source:
theorem deterministic_competitive_lower {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hL : 16 ≤ L) (hdiv : 16 ∣ L) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ I.optimum m (by omega) ∧ I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * L ∧
      min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 64 * I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  let c := min (m / 2) (L / 16)
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hcL : 16 * c ≤ L := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hcm : 2 * c ≤ m := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hmod := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
  have hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L := by omega
  obtain ⟨I, hforest, hlo, hhi, hflow⟩ := deterministic_lower_bound hm hc (by omega) hhalf hcL hcm A
  refine ⟨_, _, I, hforest, hlo, hhi, ?_⟩
  have hmin : min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) ≤ 32 * c := by
    by_cases hh : m / 2 ≤ L / 16
    · have he : c = m / 2 := min_eq_left hh
      omega
    · have he : c = L / 16 := min_eq_right (by omega)
      omega
  have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (I.optimum m (by omega)) hmin
  have h₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c hhi
  nlinarith

end Scheduling

Scheduling.Examples.forkAndChain.source:
def forkAndChain : Instance 2 6 where
  owner := fun v => if v.val < 3 then 0 else 1
  release := fun _ => 0
  edge := fun u v => (u.val = 0 ∧ v.val = 1) ∨ (u.val = 1 ∧ v.val = 2) ∨
    (u.val = 3 ∧ v.val = 4) ∨ (u.val = 3 ∧ v.val = 5)
  same_job := by decide
  rank := Fin.val
  rank_increases := by decide
  nonempty_job := by decide

instance : DecidableRel forkAndChain.edge := by
  intro u v
  dsimp [forkAndChain]
  infer_instance

Scheduling.Examples.sample_valid.source:
theorem sample_valid : forkAndChain.Valid 2 sampleSchedule :=
  forkAndChain.sffSchedule_valid (by decide) (by decide)

-- Runtime regression: the chain and fork both complete at time 9. This
-- checks compiled execution output, while `sample_valid` uses the general
-- kernel-checked theorem. It is not a native-evaluation proof shortcut.
/-- info: [6, 7, 8, 6, 7, 8] -/
#guard_msgs in
#eval (List.finRange 6).map sampleSchedule

/-- info: [0, 1, 2, 0, 1, 2] -/
#guard_msgs in
#eval (List.finRange 6).map (forkAndChain.fifoSchedule 2 (by decide))

end Scheduling.Examples

Scheduling.ExecutionState.source:
structure ExecutionState (vertices : ℕ) where
  clock : ℕ
  stamp : Fin vertices → Option ℕ

namespace ExecutionState

Scheduling.ExecutionState.initial.source: def initial : ExecutionState vertices := ⟨0, fun _ => none⟩

Scheduling.ExecutionState.completed.source:
def completed (s : ExecutionState vertices) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => s.stamp v ≠ none)
end ExecutionState

namespace Batching
variable {I : Instance jobs vertices} {L : ℕ} (B : Batching I L batches)
variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

/-- Environment observation: only admitted ready vertices are exposed. The
planner itself receives this snapshot, not the instance or its hidden edges. -/

Scheduling.Batching.observe.source:
def observe (s : ExecutionState vertices) : ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches where
  batchOf := B.vertexBatch
  ready := fun b => univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ s.clock ∧
    s.stamp v = none ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u v → s.stamp u ≠ none)
  ready_batch := by intro b v hv; exact (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1

Scheduling.Batching.advance.source:
def advance (m : ℕ) (s : ExecutionState vertices) : ExecutionState vertices where
  clock := s.clock + (B.observe s).duration m
  stamp :=
    let cached := Vector.ofFn (fun v : Fin vertices => match (B.observe s).assignSlot m v with
      | none => s.stamp v
      | some k => some (s.clock + k))
    fun v => cached[v.val]

Scheduling.Batching.run.source:
def run (B : Batching I L batches) (m : ℕ) : ℕ → ExecutionState vertices
  | 0 => ExecutionState.initial
  | k + 1 => B.advance m (run B m k)

Scheduling.Batching.selected_ready.source:
theorem selected_ready {m k : ℕ} {s : ExecutionState vertices} {v : Fin vertices}
    (hk : (B.observe s).assignSlot m v = some k) :
    B.eligible (B.vertexBatch v) ≤ s.clock ∧ s.stamp v = none ∧
      ∀ u, I.edge u v → s.stamp u ≠ none := by
  have hs := (B.observe s).assignSlot_sound hk
  rcases (B.observe s).action_scope hs.2 with h | h
  · exact (mem_filter.mp h.2).2.2
  · exact (mem_filter.mp h.2).2.2

Scheduling.Batching.preserves_stamp.source:
theorem preserves_stamp {m : ℕ} {s : ExecutionState vertices} {v : Fin vertices} {t : ℕ}
    (hv : s.stamp v = some t) : (B.advance m s).stamp v = some t := by
  unfold advance
  cases h : (B.observe s).assignSlot m v with
  | none => simp [h, hv]
  | some k =>
    have hn := (B.selected_ready h).2.1
    rw [hv] at hn
    cases hn

Scheduling.Batching.completed_mono.source:
theorem completed_mono (m : ℕ) (s : ExecutionState vertices) :
    s.completed ⊆ (B.advance m s).completed := by
  intro v hv
  have hn := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  cases h : s.stamp v with
  | none => exact False.elim (hn h)
  | some t => exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [B.preserves_stamp h]; simp⟩

Scheduling.Batching.clock_strict.source:
theorem clock_strict (m : ℕ) (s : ExecutionState vertices) : s.clock < (B.advance m s).clock := by
  have h := Packing.duration_pos (B.observe s |>.smallFront m).card m
  change s.clock < s.clock + (B.observe s).duration m
  exact Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right h

/-- Prefix feasibility invariant. Timestamps record only completed work;
every recorded predecessor completed earlier and every slot respects capacity. -/

Scheduling.Batching.Safe.source:
structure Safe (m : ℕ) (s : ExecutionState vertices) : Prop where
  stamps : ∀ v t, s.stamp v = some t → B.eligible (B.vertexBatch v) ≤ t ∧ t < s.clock ∧
    ∀ u, I.edge u v → ∃ a, s.stamp u = some a ∧ a < t
  capacity : ∀ t, (univ.filter (fun v => s.stamp v = some t)).card ≤ m

omit [DecidableRel I.edge] in

Scheduling.Batching.safe_initial.source:
theorem safe_initial (m : ℕ) : B.Safe m (ExecutionState.initial (vertices := vertices)) := by
  constructor
  · intro v t h; cases h
  · intro t; simp [ExecutionState.initial]

Scheduling.Batching.safe_advance.source:
theorem safe_advance {m : ℕ} {s : ExecutionState vertices} (hs : B.Safe m s) :
    B.Safe m (B.advance m s) := by
  constructor
  · intro v t ht
    cases hk : (B.observe s).assignSlot m v with
    | none =>
      have hold : s.stamp v = some t := by simpa [advance, hk] using ht
      have h := hs.stamps v t hold
      refine ⟨h.1, h.2.1.trans (B.clock_strict m s), ?_⟩
      intro u he
      obtain ⟨a, ha, hat⟩ := h.2.2 u he
      exact ⟨a, B.preserves_stamp ha, hat⟩
    | some k =>
      have htime : s.clock + k = t := Option.some.inj (by simpa [advance, hk] using ht)
      have hr := B.selected_ready hk
      have hslot := (B.observe s).assignSlot_sound hk
      refine ⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change t < s.clock + (B.observe s).duration m
        omega
      · intro u he
        have hu := hr.2.2 u he
        cases ha : s.stamp u with
        | none => exact False.elim (hu ha)
        | some a =>
          have hat := (hs.stamps u a ha).2.1
          exact ⟨a, B.preserves_stamp ha, by omega⟩
  · intro t
    by_cases hbefore : t < s.clock
    · apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v => s.stamp v = some t)) ?_).trans (hs.capacity t)
      intro v hv
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      cases hk : (B.observe s).assignSlot m v with
      | none => exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by simpa [advance, hk] using hv'⟩
      | some k =>
        have he : s.clock + k = t := Option.some.inj (by simpa [advance, hk] using hv')
        omega
    · apply (card_le_card (t := (B.observe s).action m (t - s.clock)) ?_).trans
        ((B.observe s).action_card_le m (t - s.clock))
      intro v hv
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      cases hk : (B.observe s).assignSlot m v with
      | none =>
        have hold : s.stamp v = some t := by simpa [advance, hk] using hv'
        have he := (hs.stamps v t hold).2.1
        omega
      | some k =>
        have he : s.clock + k = t := Option.some.inj (by simpa [advance, hk] using hv')
        have hslot := (B.observe s).assignSlot_sound hk
        have heq : k = t - s.clock := by omega
        simpa [heq] using hslot.2

Scheduling.Batching.run_safe.source:
theorem run_safe (m k : ℕ) : B.Safe m (B.run m k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact B.safe_initial m
  | succ k ih => exact B.safe_advance ih

Scheduling.Batching.run_clock_strict.source:
theorem run_clock_strict (m : ℕ) : StrictMono (fun k => (B.run m k).clock) := by
  apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
  intro k
  exact B.clock_strict m (B.run m k)

Scheduling.Batching.run_completed_mono.source:
theorem run_completed_mono (m : ℕ) : Monotone (fun k => (B.run m k).completed) := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro k
  exact B.completed_mono m (B.run m k)

end Batching
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Batching.future_stamp_lower.source:
theorem future_stamp_lower {m a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {v : Fin vertices} {t : ℕ}
    (hn : (B.run m a).stamp v = none) (ht : (B.run m b).stamp v = some t) :
    (B.run m a).clock ≤ t := by
  induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => rw [hn] at ht; cases ht
  | succ b hab ih =>
    cases hk : (B.observe (B.run m b)).assignSlot m v with
    | none =>
      have hp : (B.run m b).stamp v = some t := by simpa [run, advance, hk] using ht
      exact ih hp
    | some k =>
      have hp : (B.run m b).clock + k = t := Option.some.inj (by simpa [run, advance, hk] using ht)
      have hm := (B.run_clock_strict m).monotone hab
      omega

Scheduling.Batching.run_stamp_exact.source:
theorem run_stamp_exact {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (B.run m k).stamp v =
      if B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock then some (B.execution m v) else none := by
  by_cases hk : k ≤ B.completionRound
  · cases hs : (B.run m k).stamp v with
    | none =>
      have hl := B.future_stamp_lower hk hs (B.execution_stamp hm v)
      simp [show ¬B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock by omega]
    | some t =>
      have hp := B.run_preserves_stamp hk hs
      have he := Option.some.inj (hp.symm.trans (B.execution_stamp hm v))
      have ht := (B.run_safe m k).stamps v t hs
      simp [show B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock by omega, he]
  · have hrev : B.completionRound ≤ k := by omega
    have hs := B.run_preserves_stamp hrev (B.execution_stamp hm v)
    have ht := (B.run_safe m k).stamps v (B.execution m v) hs
    rw [if_pos ht.2.1]
    exact hs

Scheduling.Batching.run_stamp_some_iff.source:
theorem run_stamp_some_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ) :
    (B.run m k).stamp v = some t ↔ B.execution m v = t ∧ t < (B.run m k).clock := by
  rw [B.run_stamp_exact hm]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp_all <;> intro he <;> omega

Scheduling.Batching.run_stamp_none_iff.source:
theorem run_stamp_none_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (B.run m k).stamp v = none ↔ (B.run m k).clock ≤ B.execution m v := by
  rw [B.run_stamp_exact hm]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

Scheduling.Batching.run_stamp_done_iff.source:
theorem run_stamp_done_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (B.run m k).stamp v ≠ none ↔ B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock := by
  rw [B.run_stamp_exact hm]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

/-- The executable action at local slot j is exactly the set of vertices
assigned to that global execution timestep. -/

Scheduling.Batching.action_iff_execution.source:
theorem action_iff_execution {m k j : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hj : j < (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    v ∈ (B.observe (B.run m k)).action m j ↔
      B.execution m v = (B.run m k).clock + j := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have ha := (B.observe (B.run m k)).assignSlot_complete hj hv
    have hs : (B.run m (k + 1)).stamp v = some ((B.run m k).clock + j) := by
      simp [run, advance, ha]
    exact ((B.run_stamp_some_iff hm (k + 1) v _).mp hs).1
  · intro hv
    have hn : (B.run m k).stamp v = none := (B.run_stamp_none_iff hm k v).mpr (by omega)
    have ht : B.execution m v < (B.run m (k + 1)).clock := by
      change B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m
      omega
    have hs := (B.run_stamp_some_iff hm (k + 1) v (B.execution m v)).mpr ⟨rfl, ht⟩
    cases ha : (B.observe (B.run m k)).assignSlot m v with
    | none =>
      have hnone : (B.run m (k + 1)).stamp v = none := by simp [run, advance, ha, hn]
      rw [hnone] at hs
      cases hs
    | some a =>
      have he : (B.run m k).clock + a = B.execution m v :=
        Option.some.inj (by simpa [run, advance, ha] using hs)
      have haj : a = j := by omega
      simpa [haj] using ((B.observe (B.run m k)).assignSlot_sound ha).2

Scheduling.Batching.execution_slot_eq.source:
theorem execution_slot_eq {m k t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (h₁ : (B.run m k).clock ≤ t) (h₂ : t < (B.run m (k + 1)).clock) :
    univ.filter (fun v => B.execution m v = t) =
      (B.observe (B.run m k)).action m (t - (B.run m k).clock) := by
  have hj : t - (B.run m k).clock < (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m := by
    change t < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m at h₂
    omega
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  rw [B.action_iff_execution hm hj]
  omega

Scheduling.Batching.observed_ready_iff.source:
theorem observed_ready_iff {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (b : Fin batches) (v : Fin vertices) :
    v ∈ (B.observe (B.run m k)).ready b ↔
      B.vertexBatch v = b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ (B.run m k).clock ∧
        I.Ready (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock v := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    refine ⟨h.1, h.2.1, ?_⟩
    have hr := B.released_by_eligible h.1
    refine ⟨by omega, (B.run_stamp_none_iff hm k v).mp h.2.2.1, ?_⟩
    intro u he
    exact (B.run_stamp_done_iff hm k u).mp (h.2.2.2 u he)
  · rintro ⟨hb, he, hr⟩
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hb, he, (B.run_stamp_none_iff hm k v).mpr hr.2.1,
      by intro u hu; exact (B.run_stamp_done_iff hm k u).mpr (hr.2.2 u hu)⟩

Scheduling.Batching.observed_frontier_eq.source:
theorem observed_frontier_eq {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {b : Fin batches}
    (hb : B.eligible b ≤ (B.run m k).clock) :
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).ready b = B.frontier (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock b := by
  ext v
  rw [B.observed_ready_iff hm]
  simp only [frontier, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, _, h₃⟩; exact ⟨h₁, h₃⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₃⟩; exact ⟨h₁, hb, h₃⟩

Scheduling.Batching.observed_small_eq.source:
theorem observed_small_eq {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).small m = B.small m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock := by
  ext b
  constructor
  · intro hb
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := card_pos.mp h.1
    have hv' := (B.observed_ready_iff hm b v).mp hv
    have ha : B.Active (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock b :=
      ⟨hv'.2.1, v, hv'.1, hv'.2.2.2.1⟩
    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm hv'.2.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ha, by rw [← heq]; exact h.2⟩
  · intro hb
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hu⟩ := h.1.2
    have hrel := (B.released_by_eligible hv).le.trans h.1.1
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hr⟩ := I.exists_ready hrel ⟨v, rfl, hu⟩
    have hb' : B.vertexBatch w = b := by simpa [vertexBatch, hw] using hv
    have hobs := (B.observed_ready_iff hm b w).mpr ⟨hb', h.1.1, hr⟩
    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm h.1.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, card_pos.mpr ⟨w, hobs⟩, by rw [heq]; exact h.2⟩

Scheduling.Batching.observed_large_eq.source:
theorem observed_large_eq {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).large m = B.large m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock := by
  ext b
  constructor
  · intro hb
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    have hp : 0 < ((B.observe (B.run m k)).ready b).card := by omega
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := card_pos.mp hp
    have hv' := (B.observed_ready_iff hm b v).mp hv
    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm hv'.2.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ⟨hv'.2.1, v, hv'.1, hv'.2.2.2.1⟩, by rw [← heq]; exact h⟩
  · intro hb
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    have heq := B.observed_frontier_eq hm h.1.1
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [heq]; exact h.2⟩

Scheduling.Batching.observed_smallFront_.source:
theorem observed_smallFront_eq {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).smallFront m =
      univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock ∧
        I.Ready (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock v) := by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have h := (B.observe (B.run m k)).smallFront_ready hv
    have hr := (B.observed_ready_iff hm (B.vertexBatch v) v).mp h.2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [← B.observed_small_eq hm]; exact h.1, hr.2.2⟩
  · intro hv
    have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hs : B.vertexBatch v ∈ (B.observe (B.run m k)).small m := by rw [B.observed_small_eq hm]; exact h.1
    have he := (mem_filter.mp h.1).2.1.1
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨B.vertexBatch v, hs,
      (B.observed_ready_iff hm _ v).mpr ⟨rfl, he, h.2⟩⟩

end Scheduling.Batching

Scheduling.Instance.prefixService.source:
noncomputable def prefixService (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => S v = t ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r)

Scheduling.Instance.PrefixFull.source:
def PrefixFull (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (I.prefixService S r t).card = m

Scheduling.Instance.partialSlots.source:
noncomputable def partialSlots (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Ico r t).filter (fun s => ¬ I.PrefixFull m S r s)

Scheduling.Instance.partialSlots_succ.source:
theorem partialSlots_succ {m r t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hrt : r ≤ t) :
    (I.partialSlots m S r (t + 1)).card = (I.partialSlots m S r t).card +
      (if I.PrefixFull m S r t then 0 else 1) := by
  classical
  have hi : Ico r (t + 1) = insert t (Ico r t) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_Ico, mem_insert]
    omega
  rw [partialSlots, hi]
  by_cases h : I.PrefixFull m S r t
  · simp [Finset.filter_insert, h, partialSlots]
  · simp [Finset.filter_insert, h, partialSlots]

Scheduling.Instance.prefixService_card_l.source:
theorem prefixService_card_le {m r t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) : (I.prefixService S r t).card ≤ m := by
  classical
  apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)) ?_).trans (hS.capacity t)
  intro v hv
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1⟩

/-- If a slot is not full on the old-job prefix, FIFO processes every ready
vertex of the target job in that slot. -/

Scheduling.Instance.ready_processed_of_p.source:
theorem ready_processed_of_partial {m r t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hp : ¬ I.PrefixFull m S r t)
    {v : Fin vertices} (hv : I.Ready S t v) (hr : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r) : S v = t := by
  classical
  by_contra hne
  have hg := hF.work_conserving t v hv hne
  have hsub : univ.filter (fun u => S u = t) ⊆ I.prefixService S r t := by
    intro u hu
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, he,
      (hF.fifo_priority t v u hv hne he).trans hr⟩
  apply hp
  apply Nat.le_antisymm (I.prefixService_card_le hS)
  rw [← hg]
  exact card_le_card hsub

/-- Sequential progress measured using an offline schedule: after `p` partial
slots, every remaining vertex has offline slot at least release + p.
This proves the longest-path step without postulating a depth-decrease axiom. -/

Scheduling.Instance.partial_progress.source:
theorem partial_progress {m : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (j : Fin jobs) (t : ℕ) (hrt : I.release j ≤ t)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hj : I.owner v = j) (htv : t ≤ S v) :
    I.release j + (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card ≤ O v := by
  classical
  induction t using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing v with
  | h t ih =>
    by_cases he : t = I.release j
    · subst t
      simpa [partialSlots, hj] using hO.release v
    · have hrprev : I.release j ≤ t - 1 := by omega
      have htprev : t - 1 < t := by omega
      have hvprev : t - 1 ≤ S v := by omega
      have hprev := ih (t - 1) htprev hrprev v hj hvprev
      have ht : t - 1 + 1 = t := by omega
      have hrec := I.partialSlots_succ (m := m) (S := S) hrprev
      rw [ht] at hrec
      by_cases hf : I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) (t - 1)
      · rw [if_pos hf] at hrec
        omega
      · rw [if_neg hf] at hrec
        have hnotready : ¬ I.Ready S (t - 1) v := by
          intro hready
          have := I.ready_processed_of_partial hS hF hf hready (by rw [hj])
          omega
        have hpred : ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ t - 1 ≤ S u := by
          by_contra hn
          push Not at hn
          exact hnotready ⟨by rw [hj]; exact hrprev, hvprev,
            by intro u hu; have := hn u hu; omega⟩
        obtain ⟨u, heuv, hu⟩ := hpred
        have hju : I.owner u = j := (I.same_job heuv).trans hj
        have hpu := ih (t - 1) htprev hrprev u hju hu
        have hprec := hO.precedence heuv
        omega

/-- At most L-1 partial slots have occurred while a job is still unfinished. -/

Scheduling.Instance.partial_slots_lt.source:
theorem partial_slots_lt {m L t : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (hO : I.Valid m O)
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (j : Fin jobs) (hrt : I.release j ≤ t)
    (hu : ∃ v, I.owner v = j ∧ t ≤ S v) :
    (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card < L := by
  obtain ⟨v, hj, hv⟩ := hu
  have h := I.partial_progress hS hF hO j t hrt v hj hv
  have hbound := hL v
  rw [hj] at hbound
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork.source:
noncomputable def prefixWork (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (r t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => r ≤ S v ∧ S v < t ∧ I.release (I.owner v) ≤ r)

Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork_card.source:
theorem prefixWork_card {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (r t : ℕ) :
    (I.prefixWork S r t).card = ∑ s ∈ Ico r t, (I.prefixService S r s).card := by
  classical
  have hf : ∀ s ∈ Ico r t,
      (I.prefixWork S r t).filter (fun v => S v = s) = I.prefixService S r s := by
    intro s hs
    have hs' := mem_Ico.mp hs
    ext v
    simp only [prefixWork, prefixService, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ⟨h.2, h.1.2.2⟩
    · intro h; exact ⟨⟨by omega, by omega, h.2⟩, h.1⟩
  have heq : (I.prefixWork S r t).card =
      ∑ s ∈ Ico r t, ((I.prefixWork S r t).filter (fun v => S v = s)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by intro v hv; have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2; exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩)
  rw [heq]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro s hs
  rw [hf s hs]

Scheduling.Instance.prefixWork_le_remain.source:
theorem prefixWork_le_remaining {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (r t : ℕ) :
    (I.prefixWork S r t).card ≤ (I.remaining S r).card := by
  classical
  apply card_le_card
  intro v hv
  have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, h.2.2, h.1⟩

/-- Charge m units to full slots and one unit to each partial slot in a
target job's lifetime. All charges are to distinct old-prefix vertices. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_service_account.source:
theorem fifo_service_accounting {m t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) (j : Fin jobs)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hj : I.owner v = j) (ht : t ≤ S v + 1) :
    m * ((Ico (I.release j) t).filter (I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j))).card +
      (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card ≤ (I.remaining S (I.release j)).card := by
  classical
  have hslot : ∀ s ∈ Ico (I.release j) t,
      (if I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) s then m else 1) ≤
        (I.prefixService S (I.release j) s).card := by
    intro s hs
    have hs' := mem_Ico.mp hs
    by_cases hf : I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) s
    · simp only [if_pos hf]; exact le_of_eq hf.symm
    · simp only [if_neg hf]
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hready⟩ := I.exists_ready (S := S) hs'.1 ⟨v, hj, by omega⟩
      have he := I.ready_processed_of_partial hS hF hf hready (by rw [hw])
      have hmem : w ∈ I.prefixService S (I.release j) s :=
        mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, he, by rw [hw]⟩
      exact card_pos.mpr ⟨w, hmem⟩
  have hsum := sum_le_sum hslot
  have heq : (∑ s ∈ Ico (I.release j) t,
      if I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j) s then m else 1) =
      m * ((Ico (I.release j) t).filter (I.PrefixFull m S (I.release j))).card +
      (I.partialSlots m S (I.release j) t).card := by
    rw [sum_ite]
    simp [partialSlots, Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [heq, ← I.prefixWork_card] at hsum
  exact hsum.trans (I.prefixWork_le_remaining _ _)

/-- Theorem 8, as a denominator-free inequality on each vertex's completion
time. It is exactly the factor m + 1 - 1/m, without rounding a rational. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_vertex_bound.source:
theorem fifo_vertex_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (v : Fin vertices) :
    m * (S v + 1 - I.release (I.owner v)) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L := by
  classical
  let r := I.release (I.owner v)
  let C := S v + 1
  let P := (I.partialSlots m S r C).card
  let F := ((Ico r C).filter (I.PrefixFull m S r)).card
  have hr : r ≤ S v := hS.release v
  have hp0 := I.partial_slots_lt hS hF hO hL (I.owner v) hr ⟨v, rfl, le_rfl⟩
  have hrec := I.partialSlots_succ (m := m) (S := S) hr
  have hp : P ≤ L := by
    dsimp [P, C, r]
    dsimp [r] at hrec
    split_ifs at hrec <;> omega
  have hpartition : F + P = C - r := by
    dsimp [F, P, partialSlots]
    simpa using card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Ico r C) (I.PrefixFull m S r)
  have hwork : m * F + P ≤ m * m * L :=
    (I.fifo_service_accounting hS hF (I.owner v) v rfl (t := C) le_rfl).trans
      (I.fifo_backlog_bound hm hS hF hO hL r)
  have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  have hmul : (m - 1) * P ≤ (m - 1) * L := Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hp
  have heq : (m * m + m - 1) * L = m * m * L + (m - 1) * L := by
    have haux : m * m + m - 1 = m * m + (m - 1) := by omega
    rw [haux, Nat.add_mul]
  change m * (C - r) ≤ _
  rw [← hpartition, Nat.mul_add, heq]
  nlinarith

/-- Theorem 8 for maximum flow time of a concrete FIFO schedule. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_maxFlow_bound.source:
theorem fifo_maxFlow_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) :
    m * I.maxFlow S ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L := by
  classical
  have hj : ∀ j, m * (I.completion S j - I.release j) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * L := by
    intro j
    have hn : (I.jobVertices j).Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := I.nonempty_job j
      exact ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, heq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (I.jobVertices j) hn (fun v => S v + 1)
    have ho := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have h := I.fifo_vertex_bound hm hS hF hO hL v
    simpa [completion, ← heq, ho] using h
  by_cases hjobs : (univ : Finset (Fin jobs)).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨j, _, heq⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup univ hjobs (fun j => I.completion S j - I.release j)
    simpa [maxFlow, ← heq] using hj j
  · have he : (univ : Finset (Fin jobs)) = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hjobs
    simp [maxFlow, he]

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.Instance.fifoPriority.source:
def fifoPriority (v : Fin vertices) : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ :=
  toLex (I.release (I.owner v), v.val)

Scheduling.Instance.fifoPriority_injecti.source:
theorem fifoPriority_injective : Function.Injective I.fifoPriority := by
  intro u v he
  exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ => (ofLex x).2) he)

/-- This planner reads only the exposed ready vertices and their release
times. Hidden vertices and edges are used only by the environment below. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect.source:
def fifoSelect (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  ready.filter (fun v => I.fifoPriority v ∈ Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m)

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_subset.source:
theorem fifoSelect_subset (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    I.fifoSelect m ready ⊆ ready := filter_subset _ _

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_image.source:
theorem fifoSelect_image (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    (I.fifoSelect m ready).image I.fifoPriority =
      Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    exact (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ hx)
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, hx⟩, rfl⟩

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_card.source:
theorem fifoSelect_card (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    (I.fifoSelect m ready).card = min m ready.card := by
  rw [← card_image_of_injective _ I.fifoPriority_injective, I.fifoSelect_image,
    Packing.slice_card, Nat.sub_zero, card_image_of_injective _ I.fifoPriority_injective]

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_full.source:
theorem fifoSelect_full {m : ℕ} {ready : Finset (Fin vertices)} {v : Fin vertices}
    (hv : v ∈ ready) (hn : v ∉ I.fifoSelect m ready) : (I.fifoSelect m ready).card = m := by
  have hnot : I.fifoPriority v ∉ Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m := by
    intro h; exact hn (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, h⟩)
  have hf := Packing.first_slice_full (mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩) hnot
  rw [← I.fifoSelect_image, card_image_of_injective _ I.fifoPriority_injective] at hf
  exact hf

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_priority.source:
theorem fifoSelect_priority {m : ℕ} {ready : Finset (Fin vertices)} {u v : Fin vertices}
    (hu : u ∈ I.fifoSelect m ready) (hv : v ∈ ready) (hn : v ∉ I.fifoSelect m ready) :
    I.release (I.owner u) ≤ I.release (I.owner v) := by
  have hnot : I.fifoPriority v ∉ Packing.slice (ready.image I.fifoPriority) 0 m := by
    intro h; exact hn (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, h⟩)
  have hlt := Packing.first_slice_lt (mem_filter.mp hu).2 (mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩) hnot
  exact Prod.Lex.monotone_fst _ _ hlt.le

/-- Changing hidden DAGs, job ownership, or releases outside the exposed
frontier cannot affect the planner when the ready vertices and their public
release times agree. The two instances may have different numbers of jobs. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_observati.source:
theorem fifoSelect_observation_eq {otherJobs : ℕ} (J : Instance otherJobs vertices)
    (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (hr : ∀ v ∈ ready, I.release (I.owner v) = J.release (J.owner v)) :
    I.fifoSelect m ready = J.fifoSelect m ready := by
  have hp : ∀ v ∈ ready, I.fifoPriority v = J.fifoPriority v := by
    intro v hv
    simp only [fifoPriority, hr v hv]
  have him : ready.image I.fifoPriority = ready.image J.fifoPriority := by
    apply image_congr
    intro v hv
    exact hp v hv
  apply filter_congr
  intro v hv
  rw [hp v hv, him]

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

Scheduling.Instance.fifoAction.source:
def fifoAction (m t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  I.fifoSelect m (I.fifoReady (I.fifoRun m t) t)

Scheduling.Instance.fifoRun_mono.source:
theorem fifoRun_mono (m : ℕ) : Monotone (I.fifoRun m) := by
  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ
  intro t
  exact subset_union_left

Scheduling.Instance.fifoAction_ready.source:
theorem fifoAction_ready {m t : ℕ} {v : Fin vertices} (hv : v ∈ I.fifoAction m t) :
    I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t ∧ v ∉ I.fifoRun m t ∧
      ∀ u, I.edge u v → u ∈ I.fifoRun m t :=
  (mem_filter.mp (I.fifoSelect_subset _ _ hv)).2

Scheduling.Instance.fifoAction_card.source:
theorem fifoAction_card (m t : ℕ) : (I.fifoAction m t).card ≤ m := by
  unfold fifoAction
  rw [I.fifoSelect_card]
  exact min_le_left _ _

Scheduling.Instance.fifoHorizon.source: def fifoHorizon : ℕ := univ.sup I.release + vertices

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_ready_exists.source:
theorem fifo_ready_exists {done : Finset (Fin vertices)} {t : ℕ}
    (hr : ∀ j, I.release j ≤ t) (hu : ∃ v, v ∉ done) : (I.fifoReady done t).Nonempty := by
  have aux : ∀ n v, I.rank v = n → v ∉ done → (I.fifoReady done t).Nonempty := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro v hv hn
      by_cases hp : ∀ u, I.edge u v → u ∈ done
      · exact ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hr _, hn, hp⟩⟩
      · push Not at hp
        obtain ⟨u, he, hu⟩ := hp
        exact ih (I.rank u) (by have := I.rank_increases he; omega) u rfl hu
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
  exact aux _ v rfl hv

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_step_progress.source:
theorem fifo_step_progress {m t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hr : ∀ j, I.release j ≤ t) (hu : ∃ v, v ∉ I.fifoRun m t) :
    (I.fifoRun m t).card + 1 ≤ (I.fifoRun m (t + 1)).card := by
  have hready := I.fifo_ready_exists hr hu
  have hpos : 0 < (I.fifoAction m t).card := by
    rw [fifoAction, I.fifoSelect_card]
    exact lt_min hm (card_pos.mpr hready)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := card_pos.mp hpos
  have hn := (I.fifoAction_ready hv).2.1
  have hsub : insert v (I.fifoRun m t) ⊆ I.fifoRun m (t + 1) := by
    apply insert_subset_iff.mpr
    exact ⟨mem_union_right _ hv, I.fifoRun_mono m (by omega)⟩
  have hc := card_le_card hsub
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hn] at hc
  exact hc

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_terminates.source:
theorem fifo_terminates {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    v ∈ I.fifoRun m I.fifoHorizon := by
  by_contra hv
  have hcount : ∀ k, k ≤ vertices → k ≤ (I.fifoRun m (univ.sup I.release + k)).card := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => intro _; omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      have hp := ih (by omega)
      have hn : v ∉ I.fifoRun m (univ.sup I.release + k) := by
        intro hvk
        exact hv (I.fifoRun_mono m (by unfold fifoHorizon; omega) hvk)
      have hr : ∀ j, I.release j ≤ univ.sup I.release + k := by
        intro j; have : I.release j ≤ univ.sup I.release := le_sup (mem_univ j); omega
      have hstep := I.fifo_step_progress hm hr ⟨v, hn⟩
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using (show k + 1 ≤ _ from (Nat.add_le_add_right hp 1).trans hstep)
  have hc := hcount vertices le_rfl
  have heq : I.fifoRun m I.fifoHorizon = univ :=
    eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ _) (by simpa [fifoHorizon] using hc)
  exact hv (heq ▸ mem_univ v)

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_exists_done.source:
theorem fifo_exists_done {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    ∃ t, v ∈ I.fifoRun m t := ⟨I.fifoHorizon, I.fifo_terminates hm v⟩

/-- The execution slot is one less than the first completed-state index.
The search uses just the operational run; the finite horizon only proves
that the search terminates. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule.source:
def fifoSchedule (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  fun v => Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) - 1

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_first_done_pos.source:
theorem fifo_first_done_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    0 < Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) := by
  have hv := Nat.find_spec (I.fifo_exists_done hm v)
  by_contra hn
  have he : Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) = 0 := by omega
  rw [he] at hv
  simp [fifoRun] at hv

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_done_iff.source:
theorem fifo_done_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ) :
    v ∈ I.fifoRun m t ↔ I.fifoSchedule m hm v < t := by
  have hp := I.fifo_first_done_pos hm v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hf := Nat.find_min' (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) hv
    dsimp [fifoSchedule]
    omega
  · intro hv
    have hf : Nat.find (I.fifo_exists_done hm v) ≤ t := by
      dsimp [fifoSchedule] at hv
      omega
    exact I.fifoRun_mono m hf (Nat.find_spec (I.fifo_exists_done hm v))

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_action_iff.source:
theorem fifo_action_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ) :
    v ∈ I.fifoAction m t ↔ I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t := by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hn := (I.fifoAction_ready hv).2.1
    have hd : v ∈ I.fifoRun m (t + 1) := mem_union_right _ hv
    rw [I.fifo_done_iff hm] at hn hd
    omega
  · intro hv
    have hd : v ∈ I.fifoRun m (t + 1) := (I.fifo_done_iff hm _ _).mpr (by omega)
    have hn : v ∉ I.fifoRun m t := by rw [I.fifo_done_iff hm]; omega
    change v ∈ I.fifoRun m t ∪ I.fifoAction m t at hd
    exact (mem_union.mp hd).resolve_left hn

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_action_eq.source:
theorem fifo_action_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    I.fifoAction m t = univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t) := by
  ext v
  simpa only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and] using I.fifo_action_iff hm v t

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_valid.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_valid {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : I.Valid m (I.fifoSchedule m hm) := by
  constructor
  · intro v
    exact (I.fifoAction_ready ((I.fifo_action_iff hm _ _).mpr rfl)).1
  · intro u v he
    have hready := I.fifoAction_ready ((I.fifo_action_iff hm v _).mpr rfl)
    exact (I.fifo_done_iff hm _ _).mp (hready.2.2 u he)
  · intro t
    rw [← I.fifo_action_eq hm t]
    exact I.fifoAction_card m t

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_ready_iff.source:
theorem fifo_ready_iff {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) (t : ℕ) :
    v ∈ I.fifoReady (I.fifoRun m t) t ↔ I.Ready (I.fifoSchedule m hm) t v := by
  simp only [fifoReady, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Ready, I.fifo_done_iff hm,
    Nat.not_lt]

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_isFIFO.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_isFIFO {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : I.IsFIFO m (I.fifoSchedule m hm) := by
  constructor
  · intro t v hv hn
    rw [← I.fifo_action_eq hm t]
    exact I.fifoSelect_full ((I.fifo_ready_iff hm _ _).mpr hv)
      (by change v ∉ I.fifoAction m t; rw [I.fifo_action_iff hm]; exact hn)
  · intro t v u hv hn hu
    exact I.fifoSelect_priority ((I.fifo_action_iff hm _ _).mpr hu)
      ((I.fifo_ready_iff hm _ _).mpr hv)
      (by change v ∉ I.fifoAction m t; rw [I.fifo_action_iff hm]; exact hn)
