/-- The general FIFO bound now applies to an explicitly constructed schedule. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_competi.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_competitive {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    m * I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * I.optimum m hm :=
  I.fifo_competitive hm (I.fifoSchedule_valid hm) (I.fifoSchedule_isFIFO hm)

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_batched.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_batched_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs)
    (hb : I.BatchedArrivals (I.optimum m hm)) :
    I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤
      (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m hm) + 2) * I.optimum m hm :=
  I.batched_fifo_competitive hm hj hb (I.fifoSchedule_valid hm) (I.fifoSchedule_isFIFO hm)

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.StarChain.consistent_flow_low.source:
theorem consistent_flow_lower {jobs m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hn : jobs = (3 * (m - 1) + 1) * m * m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (3 * m)))
    (hS : (toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)).IsFIFO m S)
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long (show 0 < m by omega) S j) :
    3 * (m - 1) ≤ (toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)).maxFlow S := by
  let I := toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)
  let B := 3 * (m - 1) + 1
  let N := 3 * m * m
  have hB : 0 < B := by dsimp [B]; omega
  by_contra hh
  change ¬ 3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow S at hh
  have hflow : I.FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)) :=
    (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hidle : ∀ k < N, I.epochWork S B k < m * B := by
    intro k _
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hidle⟩ := block_has_idle hS hfifo hflow hc (k * B)
    have ht' : t ∈ Ico (k * B) ((k + 1) * B) := by
      simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using ht
    exact I.epochWork_lt_of_idle hS hB ht' hidle
  have hacc : N ≤ Accounting.idleBacklog (m * B) (I.epochWork S B) N := by
    simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using
      Accounting.forcing_epochs_accumulate (c := 1) (K := N) (by omega)
        (by simpa only [Nat.one_mul] using hidle)
  have hvcount : jobs * (3 * m) = N * (m * B) := by rw [hn]; dsimp [N, B]; ring
  have htime : N * B = jobs * 3 := by rw [hn]; dsimp [N, B]; ring
  rw [I.idleBacklog_eq_remaining hS hB hvcount, htime] at hacc
  have hcj : m - 1 ≤ jobs := by
    have hprod := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m * m) (show 1 ≤ B from hB)
    have hm2 : m ≤ m * m := by nlinarith
    change jobs = B * m * m at hn
    rw [Nat.mul_assoc] at hn
    simp only [Nat.one_mul] at hprod
    omega
  have hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * 3 := by
    intro j
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using jobVertices_card long (show 0 < m by omega) j
  have hflow' : I.FlowBound S ((m - 1) * 3) := by
    simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hflow
  have hy := I.regular_young_backlog hcj (by omega : 0 < 3) (by intros; rfl) hwork hflow'
  have hsub : m - 1 - 1 + 2 = m := by omega
  change 3 * m * m ≤ _ at hacc
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.StarChain

namespace Scheduling

/-- The FIFO lower bound on trees with constant optimum. The finite
instance is derived from the scheduler's causality and FIFO properties;
no adaptive trace or type-consistency premise remains in the conclusion. -/

Scheduling.fifo_constant_optimum_lower.source:
theorem fifo_constant_optimum_lower {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hfifo : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices), I.IsFIFO m (A.schedule I)) :
    ∃ (jobs vertices : ℕ) (I : Instance jobs vertices),
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 ∧
      3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  let n := (3 * (m - 1) + 1) * m * m
  obtain ⟨long, hc⟩ := StarChain.exists_type_consistent A (show 0 < m by omega) n
  let I := StarChain.toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)
  refine ⟨n, n * (3 * m), I, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u v w hu hv
    exact StarChain.at_most_one_parent long (show 0 < m by omega) hu hv
  · exact StarChain.optimum_le_six long hm
  · exact StarChain.consistent_flow_lower hm rfl long (A.schedule I) (A.valid I) (hfifo I) hc

Scheduling.fifo_competitive_lower.source:
theorem fifo_competitive_lower {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hfifo : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices), I.IsFIFO m (A.schedule I)) :
    ∃ (jobs vertices : ℕ) (I : Instance jobs vertices),
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 ∧
      m * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 4 * I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) := by
  obtain ⟨jobs, vertices, I, htree, hopt, hflow⟩ := fifo_constant_optimum_lower hm A hfifo
  refine ⟨jobs, vertices, I, htree, hopt, ?_⟩
  have hm1 : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  nlinarith

end Scheduling

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safeWords.source:
noncomputable def safeWords (bad : List α → Prop) (k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin k → α) :=
  univ.filter (fun w => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w))

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safe_next.source:
theorem safe_next_card (bad : List α → Prop) (xs : List α)
    (hnext : ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) :
    (univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (xs ++ [x]))).card ≤ Fintype.card α - 1 := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hnext
  have hs : univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (xs ++ [x])) ⊂ univ := by
    apply ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr
    refine ⟨filter_subset _ _, ?_⟩
    intro he
    have hm : x ∈ univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (xs ++ [x])) := by rw [he]; exact mem_univ x
    exact (mem_filter.mp hm).2 hx
  have hh := card_lt_card hs
  rw [card_univ] at hh
  omega

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.safe_card.source:
theorem safe_card_step (bad : List α → Prop)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) (k : ℕ) :
    (safeWords bad (k + 1)).card ≤ (safeWords bad k).card * (Fintype.card α - 1) := by
  have hprefix : ∀ w ∈ safeWords bad (k + 1), Fin.init w ∈ safeWords bad k := by
    intro w hw
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    intro hb
    have hh := hpersist (List.ofFn (Fin.init w)) (w (Fin.last k)) hb
    have he : List.ofFn w = List.ofFn (Fin.init w) ++ [w (Fin.last k)] := List.ofFn_succ_last
    rw [← he] at hh
    exact (mem_filter.mp hw).2 hh
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := Fin.init) hprefix]
  have hf : ∀ w ∈ safeWords bad k,
      ((safeWords bad (k + 1)).filter (fun v => Fin.init v = w)).card ≤ Fintype.card α - 1 := by
    intro w _
    have hi := card_le_card_of_injOn (fun v : Fin (k + 1) → α => v (Fin.last k))
      (s := (safeWords bad (k + 1)).filter (fun v => Fin.init v = w))
      (t := univ.filter (fun x => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w ++ [x])))
      (by
        intro v hv
        obtain ⟨hv, he⟩ := mem_filter.mp hv
        apply mem_filter.mpr
        refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
        have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hseq : List.ofFn v = List.ofFn (Fin.init v) ++ [v (Fin.last k)] := List.ofFn_succ_last
        rwa [hseq, he] at hh)
      (by
        intro u hu v hv he
        have hup := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
        have hvp := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        change u (Fin.last k) = v (Fin.last k) at he
        calc
          u = Fin.snoc (Fin.init u) (u (Fin.last k)) := (Fin.snoc_init_self u).symm
          _ = Fin.snoc (Fin.init v) (v (Fin.last k)) := by rw [hup, hvp, he]
          _ = v := Fin.snoc_init_self v)
    exact hi.trans (safe_next_card bad (List.ofFn w) (hnext _))
  have hh := sum_le_sum hf
  simpa only [sum_const, Nat.nsmul_eq_mul] using hh

theorem safe_card_le (bad : List α → Prop)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) (k : ℕ) :
    (safeWords bad k).card ≤ (Fintype.card α - 1) ^ k := by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have hh := card_le_card (filter_subset (fun w : Fin 0 → α => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w)) univ)
    simpa only [safeWords, card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, pow_zero] using hh
  | succ k ih =>
    exact (safe_card_step bad hpersist hnext k).trans
      (by simpa only [pow_succ] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (Fintype.card α - 1) ih)

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.pow_succ_.source:
theorem pow_succ_first_terms (x k : ℕ) :
    x ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * x ^ k ≤ (x + 1) ^ (k + 1) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (x + 1) ih
    calc
      x ^ (k + 1 + 1) + (k + 1 + 1) * x ^ (k + 1) ≤
          x ^ (k + 1 + 1) + (k + 1 + 1) * x ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * x ^ k := Nat.le_add_right _ _
      _ = (x ^ (k + 1) + (k + 1) * x ^ k) * (x + 1) := by rw [pow_succ, pow_succ]; ring
      _ ≤ (x + 1) ^ (k + 1 + 1) := by simpa only [pow_succ] using hh

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.twice_pre.source:
theorem twice_pred_pow_le {N : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) : 2 * (N - 1) ^ N ≤ N ^ N := by
  have hn : N - 1 + 1 = N := by omega
  have hh := pow_succ_first_terms (N - 1) (N - 1)
  rw [hn] at hh
  have hp : (N - 1) ^ N = (N - 1) ^ (N - 1) * (N - 1) := by
    calc
      (N - 1) ^ N = (N - 1) ^ (N - 1 + 1) := by rw [hn]
      _ = _ := pow_succ _ _
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right ((N - 1) ^ (N - 1)) (Nat.sub_le N 1)
  nlinarith

/-- Uniformly sampling `N` symbols from an alphabet of size `N` reaches
a bad word with probability at least one half. This is the exact finite
counting statement, with no independence or conditioning premise. -/

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.half_word.source:
theorem half_words_bad [Nonempty α] (bad : List α → Prop)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, bad xs → bad (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, bad (xs ++ [x])) :
    Fintype.card α ^ Fintype.card α ≤
      2 * (univ.filter (fun w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α => bad (List.ofFn w))).card := by
  have hs := safe_card_le bad hpersist hnext (Fintype.card α)
  have hp := twice_pred_pow_le (Fintype.card_pos (α := α))
  have hpartition := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α)))
    (fun w => bad (List.ofFn w))
  simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin] at hpartition
  change (univ.filter (fun w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α => ¬ bad (List.ofFn w))).card ≤ _ at hs
  omega

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.cost_sum_.source:
theorem cost_sum_lower [Nonempty α] (cost : List α → ℕ) (F : ℕ)
    (hpersist : ∀ xs x, F ≤ cost xs → F ≤ cost (xs ++ [x]))
    (hnext : ∀ xs, ∃ x, F ≤ cost (xs ++ [x])) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α) * F ≤
      2 * ∑ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α, cost (List.ofFn w) := by
  have hb := half_words_bad (fun xs => F ≤ cost xs) hpersist hnext
  let s := univ.filter (fun w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α => F ≤ cost (List.ofFn w))
  have hs : s.card * F ≤ ∑ w ∈ s, cost (List.ofFn w) := by
    calc
      s.card * F = ∑ _w ∈ s, F := by simp
      _ ≤ _ := sum_le_sum (fun w hw => (mem_filter.mp hw).2)
  have ht : ∑ w ∈ s, cost (List.ofFn w) ≤ ∑ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α, cost (List.ofFn w) :=
    sum_le_sum_of_subset (filter_subset _ _)
  have hb' : Fintype.card α ^ Fintype.card α ≤ 2 * s.card := by
    convert hb using 1
    congr 2
    ext w
    simp [s]
  have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right F hb'
  rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.FiniteAmplification

Scheduling.Instance.ext_data.source:
theorem Instance.ext_data {jobs vertices : ℕ} {I J : Instance jobs vertices}
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (he : I.edge = J.edge) (hk : I.rank = J.rank) : I = J := by
  cases I
  cases J
  cases ho
  cases hr
  cases he
  cases hk
  rfl

/-- A finite encoding of an out-forest on fixed job and vertex labels.
The local vertex order witnesses acyclicity. Releases are supplied
separately, so this code contains no unbounded numerical data. -/

Scheduling.ForestCode.source:
structure ForestCode (jobs work : ℕ) where
  parent : Fin jobs → Fin work → Option (Fin work)
  parent_lt : ∀ j v u, parent j v = some u → u.val < v.val

namespace ForestCode
variable {jobs work : ℕ}

Scheduling.ForestCode.parent_injective.source:
theorem parent_injective : Function.Injective (parent : ForestCode jobs work → _) := by
  intro P Q he
  cases P
  cases Q
  cases he
  rfl

noncomputable instance : Fintype (ForestCode jobs work) :=
  Fintype.ofInjective parent parent_injective

noncomputable instance : DecidableEq (ForestCode jobs work) := Classical.decEq _

Scheduling.ForestCode.toInstance.source:
def toInstance (P : ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) : Instance jobs (jobs * work) where
  owner := job
  release j := j.val * L
  edge u v := job u = job v ∧ P.parent (job v) (position v) = some (position u)
  same_job h := h.1
  rank v := (position v).val
  rank_increases := by intro u v h; exact P.parent_lt _ _ _ h.2
  nonempty_job j := ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, hw⟩), LayeredForest.job_pair _ _⟩

Scheduling.ForestCode.outForest.source:
theorem outForest (P : ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work)
    {u v w : Fin (jobs * work)}
    (hu : (P.toInstance L hw).edge u w) (hv : (P.toInstance L hw).edge v w) : u = v := by
  have hp := Option.some.inj (hu.2.symm.trans hv.2)
  exact LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
    (Prod.ext (hu.1.trans hv.1.symm) (congrArg Fin.val hp))

Scheduling.ForestCode.ofPrefix.source:
def ofPrefix (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) : ForestCode jobs work :=
  ⟨P.parent, P.parent_lt⟩

Scheduling.ForestCode.ofPrefix_toInstanc.source:
theorem ofPrefix_toInstance (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work)
    (hd : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) : (ofPrefix P).toInstance L hw = P.toInstance L hw := by
  apply Instance.ext_data (I := (ofPrefix P).toInstance L hw) (J := P.toInstance L hw) rfl rfl ?_ rfl
  funext u v
  apply propext
  have hv : (position v).val < P.boundary (job v) := by
    have hh := (position v).isLt
    dsimp only [LayeredPrefix.boundary]
    rw [hd]
    omega
  simp only [toInstance, ofPrefix, LayeredPrefix.toInstance, if_pos hv]

Scheduling.ForestCode.jobVertices_card.source:
theorem jobVertices_card (P : ForestCode jobs work) (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    ((P.toInstance L hw).jobVertices j).card = work := by
  let Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work := {
    closed := fun _ => work
    width := fun _ => 0
    fits := by simp
    frontier_pos := by intros; omega
    parent := P.parent
    parent_lt := P.parent_lt }
  have he : (ofPrefix Q).toInstance L hw = P.toInstance L hw := rfl
  rw [← he, ofPrefix_toInstance Q L hw (by intros; rfl)]
  exact Q.jobVertices_card L hw j

end ForestCode
end Scheduling

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.cha.source:
theorem RecordedRun.change_rule {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work}
    {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records)
    (rule' : LayerSizeRule jobs work)
    (hagree : ∀ j p t, P.closed j < p → p ≤ work → rule.size j p t = rule'.size j p t) :
    RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule' P Q records := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => exact RecordedRun.done P hd
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
    have he : rule.size j (P.boundary j) t = rule'.size j (P.boundary j) t :=
      hagree j _ t (by omega) (P.fits j)
    have ht := ih (by
      intro i p u hp hwork
      apply hagree i p u ?_ hwork
      have hclosed : P.closed i ≤
          (P.advance j key hk (rule.size j (P.boundary j) t)
            (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)).closed i := by
        by_cases hi : i = j
        · subst i
          rw [advance_closed]
          dsimp [boundary]
          omega
        · simp only [advance, if_neg hi, le_refl]
      dsimp [t] at hclosed
      omega)
    have hstate : P.advance j key hk (rule.size j (P.boundary j) t)
        (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _) =
      P.advance j key hk (rule'.size j (P.boundary j) t)
        (rule'.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule'.positive _ _ _) := by
      congr 1
    change RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule' _ Q records at ht
    rw [hstate] at ht
    exact RecordedRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records ht

/-- A chronological hidden-key construction whose next width can depend
on the entire current state and execution history, rather than just the
job, prefix length, and reveal time. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.FlexibleRun.source:
inductive FlexibleRun (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ) :
    LayeredPrefix jobs work → LayeredPrefix jobs work → List (LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
  | done (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (h : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) :
      FlexibleRun hw A L P P []
  | step (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
      (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
      (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < work →
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
      (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q)
      (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
      (tail : FlexibleRun hw A L (P.advance j key hk q hq hp) Q records) :
      FlexibleRun hw A L P Q (P.record (L := L) hw A j key :: records)

/-- After a finite adaptive construction, its choices can be encoded in
a static rule. This transfers all previously proved chronological,
parent-edge, coverage, and key-last certificates to history-dependent
width choices. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.FlexibleRun.rec.source:
theorem FlexibleRun.recorded {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} (h : FlexibleRun hw A L P Q records) :
    ∃ rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work, RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd =>
    let rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work := {
      size := fun _ p _ => min 1 (work - p)
      fits := by intro j p t hp; have := min_le_right 1 (work - p); omega
      positive := by intro j p t hp; exact lt_min (by omega) (by omega) }
    exact ⟨rule, RecordedRun.done P hd⟩
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest q hq hp records tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨rule, hr⟩ := ih
    let rule' : LayerSizeRule jobs work := {
      size := fun i p t => if i = j ∧ p = P.boundary j then q else rule.size i p t
      fits := by
        intro i p t hwork
        split_ifs with he
        · simpa only [he.2] using hq
        · exact rule.fits i p t hwork
      positive := by
        intro i p t hwork
        split_ifs with he
        · exact hp (by omega)
        · exact rule.positive i p t hwork }
    have hr' := hr.change_rule rule' (by
      intro i p t hclosed hwork
      have hn : ¬ (i = j ∧ p = P.boundary j) := by
        rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        rw [advance_closed] at hclosed
        omega
      simp only [rule', if_neg hn])
    have hsize : rule'.size j (P.boundary j)
        (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1) = q := by
      simp only [rule', and_self, if_true]
    have hstate : P.advance j key hk q hq hp =
      P.advance j key hk
        (rule'.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
        (rule'.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule'.positive _ _ _) := by
      congr 1
      exact hsize.symm
    rw [hstate] at hr'
    exact ⟨rule', RecordedRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records hr'⟩

/-- The history supplied to the rule includes the layer just completed.
Its records contain the actual key timestamps, so a rule can reset its
counters at epoch boundaries and inspect earlier layer types. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryLayerRul.source:
structure HistoryLayerRule (jobs work : ℕ) where
  size : List (LayerRecord jobs work) → LayeredPrefix jobs work → Fin jobs → ℕ → ℕ
  fits : ∀ history P j t, P.boundary j + size history P j t ≤ work
  positive : ∀ history P j t, P.boundary j < work → 0 < size history P j t

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun.source:
inductive HistoryRun (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ)
    (rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work) : List (LayerRecord jobs work) →
    LayeredPrefix jobs work → LayeredPrefix jobs work → List (LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
  | done (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work)
      (h : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) : HistoryRun hw A L rule history P P []
  | step (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work)
      (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
      (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
      (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < work →
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
      (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
      (tail : HistoryRun hw A L rule (history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key])
        (P.advance j key hk
          (rule.size (history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]) P j
            (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
          (rule.fits _ _ _ _) (rule.positive _ _ _ _)) Q records) :
      HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q (P.record (L := L) hw A j key :: records)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.HistoryRun.flex.source:
theorem HistoryRun.flexible {rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work}
    {history records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    (h : HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records) : FlexibleRun hw A L P Q records := by
  induction h with
  | done history P hd => exact FlexibleRun.done P hd
  | step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    exact FlexibleRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest _ _ _ records ih

/-- Arbitrary history-dependent width rules terminate, provided every
unfinished job receives a nonempty frontier within its remaining budget. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.exists_history_.source:
theorem exists_history_run (rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work)
    (history : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work)
    (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q records, HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records := by
  have aux : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ history (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work), P.remainingMass = n →
      ∃ Q records, HistoryRun hw A L rule history P Q records := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro history P hn
      by_cases ha : ∃ j, P.closed j < work
      · obtain ⟨j, key, hk, hmax, hearliest⟩ := P.exists_earliest (L := L) hw A ha
        let next := history ++ [P.record (L := L) hw A j key]
        let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1
        let q := rule.size next P j t
        let R := P.advance j key hk q (rule.fits _ _ _ _) (rule.positive _ _ _ _)
        have hlt : R.remainingMass < n := by
          rw [← hn]
          exact P.advance_mass_lt j key hk q _ _
        obtain ⟨Q, records, hQ⟩ := ih R.remainingMass hlt next R rfl
        exact ⟨Q, _, HistoryRun.step history P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records hQ⟩
      · have hd : ∀ j, P.closed j = work := by
          intro j
          have hf := P.fits j
          have hh : ¬ P.closed j < work := fun h => ha ⟨j, h⟩
          omega
        exact ⟨P, [], HistoryRun.done history P hd⟩
  exact aux P.remainingMass history P rfl

theorem exists_history_certificates (rule : HistoryLayerRule jobs work)
    (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (L : ℕ) :
    ∃ Q records, HistoryRun hw A L rule [] P Q records ∧
      ∃ staticRule, RecordedRun (L := L) hw A staticRule P Q records := by
  obtain ⟨Q, records, h⟩ := exists_history_run rule [] P hw A L
  exact ⟨Q, records, h, h.flexible.recorded⟩

end Scheduling.LayeredPrefix

Scheduling.ForcingTrace.source:
inductive ForcingTrace {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b W : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → Prop
  | done (e : ℕ) : ForcingTrace S a b W work e
  | layer (s d e t : ℕ) (hsd : s < d) (hd : d ≤ work) (het : e ≤ t)
      (hwidth : d - s ≤ W) (hnarrow : a < e → e < b → d - s ≤ 1)
      (htimes : ∀ v : Fin work, s ≤ v.val → v.val < d → e ≤ S v ∧ S v ≤ t)
      (tail : ForcingTrace S a b W d (t + 1)) : ForcingTrace S a b W s e

Scheduling.suffixService.source:
noncomputable def suffixService {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ v.val ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card

Scheduling.layerService.source:
noncomputable def layerService {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < d ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card

Scheduling.suffixService_split.source:
theorem suffixService_split {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ) (hsd : s ≤ d) :
    suffixService S a b s = layerService S a b s d + suffixService S a b d := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin work => s ≤ v.val ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)
  have h := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := R) (fun v => v.val < d)
  have h₁ : R.filter (fun v => v.val < d) =
      univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < d ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b) := by
    ext v; simp only [R, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]; tauto
  have h₂ : R.filter (fun v => ¬ v.val < d) =
      univ.filter (fun v => d ≤ v.val ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b) := by
    ext v
    simp only [R, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, not_lt]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, ha, hb⟩, hd⟩; exact ⟨hd, ha, hb⟩
    · rintro ⟨hd, ha, hb⟩; exact ⟨⟨hsd.trans hd, ha, hb⟩, hd⟩
  rw [h₁, h₂] at h
  exact h.symm

Scheduling.layerService_le_width.source:
theorem layerService_le_width {work : ℕ} (S : Fin work → ℕ) (a b s d : ℕ) :
    layerService S a b s d ≤ d - s := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.val
    (s := univ.filter (fun v : Fin work => s ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < d ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b))
    (t := Ico s d) (by intro v hv; exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨(mem_filter.mp hv).2.1, (mem_filter.mp hv).2.2.1⟩)
    (by intro u _ v _ he; exact Fin.ext he)
  simpa [layerService] using h

namespace ForcingTrace
variable {work a b W s e : ℕ} {S : Fin work → ℕ}

Scheduling.ForcingTrace.execution_lower.source:
theorem execution_lower (h : ForcingTrace S a b W s e) :
    ∀ v : Fin work, s ≤ v.val → e ≤ S v := by
  induction h with
  | done e => intro v hv; have := v.isLt; omega
  | layer s d e t hsd hd het hwidth hnarrow htimes tail ih =>
    intro v hv
    by_cases hvd : v.val < d
    · exact (htimes v hv hvd).1
    · have ht := ih v (by omega)
      omega

Scheduling.ForcingTrace.service_zero.source:
theorem service_zero (h : ForcingTrace S a b W s e) (hb : b ≤ e) : suffixService S a b s = 0 := by
  unfold suffixService
  apply card_eq_zero.mpr
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro v hv
  have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have ht := h.execution_lower v hh.1
  omega

/-- Initial service is charged to at most one frontier of width `W`;
all later service is charged to distinct sequential slots. -/

Scheduling.ForcingTrace.service_bounds.source:
theorem service_bounds (h : ForcingTrace S a b W s e) :
    suffixService S a b s ≤ W + (b - a) ∧
      (a < e → suffixService S a b s ≤ b - e) := by
  induction h with
  | done e =>
    have hz : suffixService S a b work = 0 := by
      unfold suffixService
      apply card_eq_zero.mpr
      apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro v hv
      have := (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1
      have := v.isLt
      omega
    rw [hz]
    omega
  | layer s d e t hsd hd het hwidth hnarrow htimes tail ih =>
    have hsplit := suffixService_split S a b s d hsd.le
    have hhead := layerService_le_width S a b s d
    constructor
    · by_cases ht : t < a
      · have hz : layerService S a b s d = 0 := by
          unfold layerService
          apply card_eq_zero.mpr
          apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
          intro v hv
          have hh := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
          have htime := (htimes v hh.1 hh.2.1).2
          omega
        omega
      · have htail := ih.2 (by omega)
        omega
    · intro hae
      by_cases hbe : b ≤ e
      · have hz := (ForcingTrace.layer s d e t hsd hd het hwidth hnarrow htimes tail).service_zero hbe
        rw [hz]
        omega
      · have hn := hnarrow hae (by omega)
        have htail := ih.2 (by omega)
        omega

end ForcingTrace
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.PredecessorClosed.source:
def PredecessorClosed (B : Finset (Fin vertices)) : Prop :=
  ∀ {u v}, v ∈ B → I.edge u v → u ∈ B

Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds.source:
noncomputable def markedRounds (mark : ℕ → Prop) (K : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (range K).filter mark

Scheduling.Instance.markedRounds_succ.source:
theorem markedRounds_succ (mark : ℕ → Prop) (K : ℕ) :
    (markedRounds mark (K + 1)).card = (markedRounds mark K).card +
      (if mark K then 1 else 0) := by
  classical
  by_cases h : mark K <;> simp [markedRounds, range_add_one, filter_insert, h]

/-- Frontier processing in rounds. On every marked round, all vertices ready
at its start are processed before its end. Any other work is unrestricted.
This is the structural progress lemma used by SFF, for the concrete DAG model. -/

Scheduling.Instance.frontier_round_progr.source:
theorem frontier_round_progress {m : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (B : Finset (Fin vertices)) (hB : I.PredecessorClosed B)
    (boundary : ℕ → ℕ) (mono : Monotone boundary) (mark : ℕ → Prop)
    (released : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.release (I.owner v) ≤ boundary k)
    (advance : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.Ready S (boundary k) v → S v < boundary (k + 1))
    (K : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ B) (hu : boundary K ≤ S v) :
    I.release (I.owner v) + (markedRounds mark K).card ≤ O v := by
  classical
  induction K generalizing v with
  | zero => simpa [markedRounds] using hO.release v
  | succ K ih =>
    have hb : boundary K ≤ boundary (K + 1) := mono (by omega)
    have hprev := ih v hv (by omega)
    have hc := markedRounds_succ mark K
    by_cases hm : mark K
    · rw [if_pos hm] at hc
      have hn : ¬ I.Ready S (boundary K) v := by
        intro hr
        have := advance K hm v hv hr
        omega
      have he : ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ boundary K ≤ S u := by
        by_contra hn'
        push Not at hn'
        apply hn
        refine ⟨released K hm v hv, by omega, ?_⟩
        intro u he
        have := hn' u he
        omega
      obtain ⟨u, he, hu⟩ := he
      have hp := ih u (hB hv he) hu
      have ho := I.same_job he
      rw [ho] at hp
      have := hO.precedence he
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hm] at hc
      omega

/-- SFF's first progress observation: a batch can be small at the start of
at most L rounds. The premises describe frontier processing, not a depth or
round-count bound. Instantiating the complete SFF trace is separate work. -/

Scheduling.Instance.frontier_round_count.source:
theorem frontier_round_count_bound {m L : ℕ} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (B : Finset (Fin vertices)) (hB : I.PredecessorClosed B)
    (boundary : ℕ → ℕ) (mono : Monotone boundary) (mark : ℕ → Prop)
    (released : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.release (I.owner v) ≤ boundary k)
    (advance : ∀ k, mark k → ∀ v ∈ B, I.Ready S (boundary k) v → S v < boundary (k + 1))
    (active : ∀ k, mark k → ∃ v ∈ B, boundary k ≤ S v)
    (K : ℕ) : (markedRounds mark K).card ≤ L := by
  classical
  induction K with
  | zero => simp [markedRounds]
  | succ K ih =>
    rw [markedRounds_succ]
    by_cases hm : mark K
    · rw [if_pos hm]
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hu⟩ := active K hm
      have hp := I.frontier_round_progress hO B hB boundary mono mark released advance K v hv hu
      have hl := hL v
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hm]
      omega

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.HardFamily.general_hard_after.source:
theorem general_hard_after (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (I : Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ P ∈ general (c * (c * (m * L))) m L (by omega) hL,
      c * L ≤ (I.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) d).maxFlow
        (A.schedule (I.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) d)) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hbad⟩ := general_hard hm hc hL heven hcL hcm (A.continuation I d)
  exact ⟨P, hP, hbad.trans (A.continuation_flow_le I d _)⟩

Scheduling.HardFamily.batched_hard_after.source:
theorem batched_hard_after (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m) (hscale : L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (I : Instance jobs vertices) (d : ℕ) :
    ∃ P ∈ batched (c * (m * L)) m L (by omega) hL,
      c * L ≤ (I.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) d).maxFlow
        (A.schedule (I.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)) d)) := by
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hbad⟩ := batched_hard hm hc hL heven hcm hscale (A.continuation I d)
  exact ⟨P, hP, hbad.trans (A.continuation_flow_le I d _)⟩

end Scheduling.HardFamily

Scheduling.HardFamily.general.source:
noncomputable def general (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) :
    Finset (ForestCode jobs (m * L)) :=
  univ.filter (fun P => L ≤ (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ∧
    (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ≤ 2 * L)

/-- The batched family has exact optimum `L`, so concatenating copies
at multiples of `L` can preserve the batched-arrival restriction. -/

Scheduling.HardFamily.batched.source:
noncomputable def batched (jobs m L : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) :
    Finset (ForestCode jobs (m * L)) :=
  univ.filter (fun P => (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm = L)

Scheduling.HardFamily.mem_general.source:
theorem mem_general {hm : 0 < m} {hL : 0 < L} (P : ForestCode jobs (m * L)) :
    P ∈ general jobs m L hm hL ↔
      L ≤ (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ∧
      (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ≤ 2 * L := by
  simp only [general, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]

Scheduling.HardFamily.mem_batched.source:
theorem mem_batched {hm : 0 < m} {hL : 0 < L} (P : ForestCode jobs (m * L)) :
    P ∈ batched jobs m L hm hL ↔ (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm = L := by
  simp only [batched, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]

Scheduling.HardFamily.general_offline.source:
theorem general_offline {hm : 0 < m} {hL : 0 < L} {P : ForestCode jobs (m * L)}
    (hP : P ∈ general jobs m L hm hL) :
    ∃ O, (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).Valid m O ∧
      (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).FlowBound O (2 * L) := by
  let I := P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  refine ⟨O, hO, ?_⟩
  have hb := (mem_general P).mp hP
  intro v
  exact (hflow v).trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left hb.2 _)

Scheduling.HardFamily.batched_offline.source:
theorem batched_offline {hm : 0 < m} {hL : 0 < L} {P : ForestCode jobs (m * L)}
    (hP : P ∈ batched jobs m L hm hL) :
    ∃ O, (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).Valid m O ∧
      (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).FlowBound O L := by
  let I := P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  have he := (mem_batched P).mp hP
  change I.optimum m hm = L at he
  exact ⟨O, hO, by simpa only [he] using hflow⟩

/-- Every deterministic causal scheduler has a hard member of the same
finite family. The family itself does not depend on that scheduler. -/

Scheduling.HardFamily.general_hard.source:
theorem general_hard (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ P ∈ general (c * (c * (m * L))) m L (by omega) hL,
      c * L ≤ (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).maxFlow
        (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) := by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  have hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos hm0 hL
  obtain ⟨Q, records, hrun, _, _⟩ := LayeredPrefix.exists_recorded_forcing_forest
    (jobs := c * (c * (m * L))) (work := m * L) (L := L) (c := c) hm0 hw A
  have he := ForestCode.ofPrefix_toInstance Q L hw hrun.completion.finished
  have hj : 0 < c * (c * (m * L)) := Nat.mul_pos hc (Nat.mul_pos hc hw)
  refine ⟨ForestCode.ofPrefix Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (mem_general _).mpr
    rw [he]
    exact hrun.optimum_bounds hm hj rfl heven
  · rw [he]
    exact hrun.flow_lower hc hL heven hcL hcm rfl rfl

Scheduling.HardFamily.batched_hard.source:
theorem batched_hard (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m) (hscale : L = 8 * c * 5 ^ c)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ P ∈ batched (c * (m * L)) m L (by omega) hL,
      c * L ≤ (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL)).maxFlow
        (A.schedule (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL))) := by
  have hw : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hL
  obtain ⟨Q, records, hrun, _, _⟩ := BatchedAdversary.exists_candidate (c * (m * L)) m L hm hL A
  obtain ⟨staticRule, hr⟩ := hrun.flexible.recorded
  have he := ForestCode.ofPrefix_toInstance Q L hw hr.completion.finished
  have hj : 0 < c * (m * L) := Nat.mul_pos hc hw
  refine ⟨ForestCode.ofPrefix Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (mem_batched _).mpr
    rw [he]
    exact BatchedAdversary.optimum_eq hm hL heven hj A hrun
  · rw [he]
    exact BatchedAdversary.flow_lower hm hL heven hc hcm hscale A hrun rfl

end Scheduling.HardFamily

Scheduling.Instance.gate.source:
def gate (frontier hidden : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (hjob : ∀ u ∈ frontier, ∀ v ∈ hidden, I.owner u = I.owner v)
    (hrank : ∀ u ∈ frontier, ∀ v ∈ hidden, I.rank u < I.rank v) : Instance jobs vertices where
  owner := I.owner
  release := I.release
  edge u v := I.edge u v ∨ u ∈ frontier ∧ v ∈ hidden
  same_job := by
    intro u v h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact I.same_job h
    · exact hjob u h.1 v h.2
  rank := I.rank
  rank_increases := by
    intro u v h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact I.rank_increases h
    · exact hrank u h.1 v h.2
  nonempty_job := I.nonempty_job

end Instance

namespace DeterministicScheduler
variable {m jobs vertices : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m)

/-- Deferred key selection against an arbitrary causal scheduler. Run the
temporary barrier to find a last frontier vertex. Any acyclic completion
whose hidden suffix is blocked by that key or by other hidden vertices
preserves the entire prefix, including all revealed predecessor information. -/

Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.select.source:
theorem select_hidden_key (B : Instance jobs vertices)
    (frontier hidden : Finset (Fin vertices)) (hne : frontier.Nonempty)
    (hjob : ∀ u ∈ frontier, ∀ v ∈ hidden, B.owner u = B.owner v)
    (hrank : ∀ u ∈ frontier, ∀ v ∈ hidden, B.rank u < B.rank v) :
    ∃ key ∈ frontier,
      let I := B.gate frontier hidden hjob hrank
      (∀ v ∈ frontier, A.schedule I v ≤ A.schedule I key) ∧
      ∀ J : Instance jobs vertices,
        B.owner = J.owner → B.release = J.release →
        (∀ u v, v ∉ hidden → (B.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v)) →
        (∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ (u = key ∨ u ∈ hidden)) →
        (∀ t ≤ A.schedule I key, executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = executionSlot (A.schedule J) t) ∧
        (∀ v ∈ frontier, A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v) ∧
        (∀ v ∈ frontier, A.schedule J v ≤ A.schedule J key) := by
  let I := B.gate frontier hidden hjob hrank
  obtain ⟨key, hk, hmax⟩ := exists_max_image frontier (A.schedule I) hne
  refine ⟨key, hk, hmax, ?_⟩
  intro J ho hr he hblocked
  have hI : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ A.schedule I key ≤ A.schedule I u := by
    intro v hv
    exact ⟨key, Or.inr ⟨hk, hv⟩, le_rfl⟩
  have hJ : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ A.schedule I key ≤ A.schedule I u := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hloc⟩ := hblocked v hv
    refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
    rcases hloc with rfl | hhidden
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact ((A.valid I).precedence (Or.inr ⟨hk, hhidden⟩)).le
  have hedge : ∀ u v, v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v) := by
    intro u v hv
    change (B.edge u v ∨ u ∈ frontier ∧ v ∈ hidden) ↔ J.edge u v
    simp only [hv, and_false, or_false]
    exact he u v hv
  have htransfer := A.hidden_replacement I J hidden ho hr hedge hI hJ
  have htimes : ∀ v ∈ frontier, A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v :=
    fun v hv => htransfer.2 v (hmax v hv)
  refine ⟨htransfer.1, htimes, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rw [htimes v hv, htimes key hk]
  exact hmax v hv

end DeterministicScheduler
end Scheduling

Scheduling.fifoPolicy.source:
def fifoPolicy (m : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Packing.slice Q 0 m).image (fun x => (ofLex x).2)

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- The planner is a single function of a public observation, independent
of the instance's dimensions, ownership map, and hidden edges. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSelect_public.source:
theorem fifoSelect_public (m : ℕ) (ready : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    (I.fifoSelect m ready).image Fin.val = fifoPolicy m (ready.image I.fifoPriority) := by
  unfold fifoPolicy
  rw [← I.fifoSelect_image, image_image]
  rfl

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

Scheduling.Instance.fifoObservation.source:
def fifoObservation (m t : ℕ) : FIFOObservation :=
  (I.fifoReady (I.fifoRun m t) t).image I.fifoPriority

Scheduling.Instance.fifoAction_public.source:
theorem fifoAction_public (m t : ℕ) :
    (I.fifoAction m t).image Fin.val = fifoPolicy m (I.fifoObservation m t) :=
  I.fifoSelect_public m _

/-- Full cross-instance indistinguishability for FIFO: even when the hidden
numbers of vertices and jobs differ, equal current observations imply equal
execution decisions. FIFO needs no history beyond the current frontier. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_nonclai.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_nonclairvoyant {otherJobs otherVertices m : ℕ}
    (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ)
    (hobs : I.fifoObservation m t = J.fifoObservation m t) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (univ.filter (fun v => J.fifoSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val := by
  rw [← I.fifo_action_eq hm, ← J.fifo_action_eq hm,
    I.fifoAction_public, J.fifoAction_public, hobs]

end Instance

/-- A general stateful policy with a public observation interface. `step`
returns both its decision and its next internal state. -/

Scheduling.OnlinePolicy.source:
structure OnlinePolicy (Observation State Action : Type*) where
  initial : State
  step : ℕ → Observation → State → Action × State

namespace OnlinePolicy
variable {Observation State Action : Type*} (P : OnlinePolicy Observation State Action)

Scheduling.OnlinePolicy.state.source:
def state (history : ℕ → Observation) : ℕ → State
  | 0 => P.initial
  | t + 1 => (P.step t (history t) (state history t)).2

Scheduling.OnlinePolicy.decision.source:
def decision (history : ℕ → Observation) (t : ℕ) : Action :=
  (P.step t (history t) (P.state history t)).1

/-- Equal observed prefixes yield equal states, regardless of the hidden
environments that produced those prefixes. -/

Scheduling.OnlinePolicy.state_eq_of_hist.source:
theorem state_eq_of_history_eq (a b : ℕ → Observation) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u < t, a u = b u) : P.state a t = P.state b t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [state, h t (by omega), ih (by intro u hu; exact h u (by omega))]

Scheduling.OnlinePolicy.decision_eq_of_h.source:
theorem decision_eq_of_history_eq (a b : ℕ → Observation) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) : P.decision a t = P.decision b t := by
  unfold decision
  rw [P.state_eq_of_history_eq a b t (by intro u hu; exact h u (by omega)), h t le_rfl]

end OnlinePolicy
end Scheduling

Scheduling.PackedInstance.source:
structure PackedInstance where
  jobs : ℕ
  vertices : ℕ
  graph : Instance jobs vertices

namespace PackedInstance

Scheduling.PackedInstance.empty.source:
def empty : PackedInstance where
  jobs := 0
  vertices := 0
  graph := {
    owner := Fin.elim0
    release := Fin.elim0
    edge := fun _ _ => False
    same_job := by intros; contradiction
    rank := Fin.elim0
    rank_increases := by intros; contradiction
    nonempty_job := by intro j; exact Fin.elim0 j }

Scheduling.PackedInstance.append.source:
def append (P Q : PackedInstance) (d : ℕ) : PackedInstance :=
  ⟨P.jobs + Q.jobs, P.vertices + Q.vertices, P.graph.append Q.graph d⟩

Scheduling.PackedInstance.onlineFlow.source:
noncomputable def onlineFlow (P : PackedInstance) {m : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m) : ℕ :=
  P.graph.maxFlow (A.schedule P.graph)

Scheduling.PackedInstance.empty_offline.source:
theorem empty_offline (m B : ℕ) : ∃ O, empty.graph.Valid m O ∧ empty.graph.FlowBound O B := by
  dsimp only [empty]
  refine ⟨fun v => Fin.elim0 v, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro v; exact Fin.elim0 v
  · intro u; exact Fin.elim0 u
  · intro t; simp
  · intro v; exact Fin.elim0 v

end PackedInstance

namespace InstanceSequence
variable {α : Type*}

/-- Append successive copies at offsets `0,D,2D,...`. -/

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.concatenate.source:
def concatenate (G : α → PackedInstance) (D : ℕ) (xs : List α) : PackedInstance :=
  xs.reverseRecOn PackedInstance.empty (fun ys x P => P.append (G x) (ys.length * D))

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.concatenate_.source:
@[simp] theorem concatenate_nil (G : α → PackedInstance) (D : ℕ) :
    concatenate G D [] = PackedInstance.empty := by simp [concatenate]

@[simp] theorem concatenate_snoc (G : α → PackedInstance) (D : ℕ) (xs : List α) (x : α) :
    concatenate G D (xs ++ [x]) = (concatenate G D xs).append (G x) (xs.length * D) := by
  simp [concatenate]

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.release_gap.source:
theorem release_gap (G : α → PackedInstance) (D B : ℕ)
    (hlocal : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + B ≤ D) (xs : List α) :
    ∀ j, (concatenate G D xs).graph.release j + B ≤ xs.length * D := by
  induction xs using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => rw [concatenate_nil]; intro j; exact Fin.elim0 j
  | append_singleton xs x ih =>
    rw [concatenate_snoc]
    intro j
    refine Fin.addCases ?_ ?_ j <;> intro j
    · have hj := ih j
      simp only [PackedInstance.append, Instance.append, Fin.addCases_left,
        List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
      omega
    · have hj := hlocal x j
      simp only [PackedInstance.append, Instance.append, Fin.addCases_right,
        List.length_append, List.length_singleton, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
      omega

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.offline.source:
theorem offline (G : α → PackedInstance) (D B m : ℕ)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, ∃ O, (G x).graph.Valid m O ∧ (G x).graph.FlowBound O B)
    (hgap : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + B ≤ D) (xs : List α) :
    ∃ O, (concatenate G D xs).graph.Valid m O ∧ (concatenate G D xs).graph.FlowBound O B := by
  induction xs using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => rw [concatenate_nil]; exact PackedInstance.empty_offline m B
  | append_singleton xs x ih =>
    rw [concatenate_snoc]
    exact (concatenate G D xs).graph.append_offline (G x).graph ih (hlocal x)
      (release_gap G D B hgap xs)

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.outForest.source:
theorem outForest (G : α → PackedInstance) (D : ℕ)
    (hlocal : ∀ x u v w, (G x).graph.edge u w → (G x).graph.edge v w → u = v) (xs : List α) :
    ∀ u v w, (concatenate G D xs).graph.edge u w → (concatenate G D xs).graph.edge v w → u = v := by
  induction xs using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => rw [concatenate_nil]; intro u; exact Fin.elim0 u
  | append_singleton xs x ih =>
    rw [concatenate_snoc]
    exact (concatenate G D xs).graph.append_outForest (G x).graph _ ih (hlocal x)

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.batched_rele.source:
theorem batched_releases (G : α → PackedInstance) (D L : ℕ) (hD : L ∣ D)
    (hlocal : ∀ x j, L ∣ (G x).graph.release j) (xs : List α) :
    ∀ j, L ∣ (concatenate G D xs).graph.release j := by
  induction xs using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => rw [concatenate_nil]; intro j; exact Fin.elim0 j
  | append_singleton xs x ih =>
    rw [concatenate_snoc]
    exact (concatenate G D xs).graph.append_batched_releases (G x).graph ih (hlocal x)
      (dvd_mul_of_dvd_right hD _)

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.optimum_ge.source:
theorem optimum_ge (G : α → PackedInstance) (D L : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hlocal : ∀ x, L ≤ (G x).graph.optimum m hm) (xs : List α) (hne : xs ≠ []) :
    L ≤ (concatenate G D xs).graph.optimum m hm := by
  induction xs using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => exact False.elim (hne rfl)
  | append_singleton xs x _ =>
    rw [concatenate_snoc]
    exact (hlocal x).trans ((concatenate G D xs).graph.append_optimum_ge_right (G x).graph hm _)

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.bad_persists.source:
theorem bad_persists (G : α → PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hgap : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + F ≤ D) (xs : List α) (x : α)
    (hbad : F ≤ (concatenate G D xs).onlineFlow A) :
    F ≤ (concatenate G D (xs ++ [x])).onlineFlow A := by
  rw [concatenate_snoc]
  exact A.append_flow_lower (concatenate G D xs).graph (G x).graph hbad (release_gap G D F hgap xs)

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.exists_bad_n.source:
theorem exists_bad_next (G : α → PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hhard : ∀ P : PackedInstance, ∀ d, ∃ x, F ≤ (P.append (G x) d).onlineFlow A)
    (xs : List α) : ∃ x, F ≤ (concatenate G D (xs ++ [x])).onlineFlow A := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hhard (concatenate G D xs) (xs.length * D)
  exact ⟨x, by simpa only [concatenate_snoc] using hx⟩

end InstanceSequence
end Scheduling

Scheduling.JobLayers.source:
inductive JobLayers {jobs work : ℕ} (rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) :
    ℕ → ℕ → List (LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
  | done : JobLayers rule j work 0 []
  | step (a w : ℕ) (r : LayerRecord jobs work) (rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
      (ho : r.owner = j) (ha : r.start = a) (hb : r.stop = a + w)
      (hp : 0 < w) (hf : r.stop ≤ work)
      (tail : JobLayers rule j r.stop (rule.size j r.stop (r.time + 1)) rs) :
      JobLayers rule j a w (r :: rs)

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work : ℕ}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.job.source:
theorem RecordedRun.job_layers {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    ∀ j, JobLayers rule j (P.closed j) (P.width j) (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)) := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd =>
    intro j
    have hz : P.width j = 0 := by have := P.fits j; rw [hd] at this; omega
    rw [hd, hz]
    exact JobLayers.done
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro i
    by_cases he : i = j
    · subst i
      simp only [List.filter_cons, record, decide_true, ite_true]
      refine JobLayers.step (rule := rule) (j := j) (P.closed j) (P.width j)
        (P.record (L := L) hw A j key) _ rfl rfl rfl ?_ ?_ ?_
      · dsimp [boundary] at hk; omega
      · exact P.fits j
      · simpa [advance, record] using ih j
    · have hne : j ≠ i := Ne.symm he
      simp only [List.filter_cons, record, hne, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
      simpa only [advance, if_neg he] using ih i

/-- A fixed out-forest and its complete layer trace exist for every
deterministic causal scheduler. This theorem uses the paper's actual
forcing-window size rule; the quantitative layer-count and forcing-window
analysis are separate obligations. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.exists_recorded.source:
theorem exists_recorded_forcing_forest {m L c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hw : 0 < work)
    (A : DeterministicScheduler m) :
    ∃ Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work, ∃ records : List (LayerRecord jobs work),
      RecordedRun (L := L) hw A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) (initial m hm) Q records ∧
      (∀ j, JobLayers (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) j 0 (min (2 * m) work)
        (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j))) ∧
      (∀ u v w, (Q.toInstance L hw).edge u w → (Q.toInstance L hw).edge v w → u = v) := by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := (initial (jobs := jobs) (work := work) m hm).exists_completion (L := L) hw A
    (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm)
  obtain ⟨records, hr⟩ := hQ.records
  exact ⟨Q, records, hr, hr.job_layers, fun _ _ _ hu hv => hQ.outForest hu hv⟩

end LayeredPrefix

namespace JobLayers
variable {jobs work : ℕ} {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {j : Fin jobs}

Scheduling.JobLayers.fits.source:
theorem fits {a w : ℕ} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} (h : JobLayers rule j a w rs) :
    a + w ≤ work := by
  cases h with
  | done => omega
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail => omega

Scheduling.JobLayers.nonempty_iff.source:
theorem nonempty_iff {a w : ℕ} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} (h : JobLayers rule j a w rs) :
    rs ≠ [] ↔ a < work := by
  cases h with
  | done => simp
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail => simp; omega

Scheduling.JobLayers.total_size.source:
theorem total_size {a w : ℕ} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} (h : JobLayers rule j a w rs) :
    (rs.map (fun r => r.stop - r.start)).sum = work - a := by
  induction h with
  | done => simp
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, ha, hb, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    rw [ih]
    omega

Scheduling.JobLayers.intervals.source:
theorem intervals {a w : ℕ} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)} (h : JobLayers rule j a w rs) :
    ∀ r ∈ rs, r.owner = j ∧ a ≤ r.start ∧ r.start < r.stop ∧ r.stop ≤ work := by
  induction h with
  | done => simp
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail ih =>
    intro s hs
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hs with rfl | hs
    · exact ⟨ho, by omega, by omega, hf⟩
    · have hh := ih s hs
      exact ⟨hh.1, by omega, hh.2.2⟩

Scheduling.JobLayers.head_width.source:
theorem head_width {a w : ℕ} {r : LayerRecord jobs work} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : JobLayers rule j a w (r :: rs)) : r.stop - r.start = w := by
  cases h with
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail => omega

Scheduling.JobLayers.tail_rule.source:
theorem tail_rule {a w : ℕ} {r : LayerRecord jobs work} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : JobLayers rule j a w (r :: rs)) :
    JobLayers rule j r.stop (rule.size j r.stop (r.time + 1)) rs := by
  cases h with
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail => exact tail

Scheduling.JobLayers.head_endpoints.source:
theorem head_endpoints {a w : ℕ} {r : LayerRecord jobs work} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : JobLayers rule j a w (r :: rs)) : r.start = a ∧ r.stop = a + w := by
  cases h with
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail => exact ⟨ha, hb⟩

Scheduling.JobLayers.times_pairwise.source:
theorem times_pairwise {a w : ℕ} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : JobLayers rule j a w rs)
    (hstep : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ s ∈ rs, s.start = r.stop →
      s.stop = r.stop + rule.size j r.stop (r.time + 1) → r.time < s.time) :
    rs.Pairwise (fun r s => r.time < s.time) := by
  induction h with
  | done => exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail ih =>
    have hsub : ∀ s ∈ rs, ∀ u ∈ rs, u.start = s.stop →
        u.stop = s.stop + rule.size j s.stop (s.time + 1) → s.time < u.time := by
      intro s hs u hu
      exact hstep s (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hs) u (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hu)
    have hi := ih hsub
    rw [List.pairwise_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, hi⟩
    intro s hs
    cases rs with
    | nil => simp at hs
    | cons first rest =>
      have hbounds : first.start = r.stop ∧
          first.stop = r.stop + rule.size j r.stop (r.time + 1) := tail.head_endpoints
      have hfirst := hstep r List.mem_cons_self first (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ List.mem_cons_self)
        hbounds.1 hbounds.2
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hs with rfl | hs
      · exact hfirst
      · exact hfirst.trans ((List.pairwise_cons.mp hi).1 s hs)

end JobLayers

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work : ℕ}

/-- Distinct layers of one job close at strictly increasing times in the
final schedule. This supplies the injection used to count narrow layers
inside a bounded forcing interval. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.job.source:
theorem RecordedRun.job_times_pairwise {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).Pairwise (fun r s => r.time < s.time) := by
  apply (h.job_layers j).times_pairwise
  intro r hr s hs hstart hstop
  have hrmem := (List.mem_filter.mp hr).1
  have hsmem := (List.mem_filter.mp hs).1
  have hro : r.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp hr).2
  have hso : s.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp hs).2
  have hrf := h.final_times r hrmem
  have hsf := h.final_times s hsmem
  have hp := h.next_parents r hrmem s.key (by omega) (by rw [hro]; omega)
  have hedge : (Q.toInstance L hw).edge (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key))
      (finProdFinEquiv (s.owner, s.key)) := by
    constructor
    · simpa only [LayeredForest.job_pair] using hro.trans hso.symm
    · have hvis : s.key.val < Q.boundary s.owner := by
        have := s.key.isLt
        simp only [boundary, h.completion.finished]
        omega
      simp only [LayeredForest.job_pair, LayeredForest.position_pair]
      rw [if_pos hvis]
      simpa only [hro, hso] using hp
  have ht := (A.valid (Q.toInstance L hw)).precedence hedge
  rw [hrf.2.2.2.1, hsf.2.2.2.1] at ht
  exact ht

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition.source:
noncomputable def keyFirstPosition {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work)) (v : Fin work) : ℕ :=
  if hv : v ∈ keys then ((keys.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩).val else
    keys.card + (((univ \ keys).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, by simp [hv]⟩).val

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_key_lt.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_key_lt {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work))
    (v : Fin work) (hv : v ∈ keys) : keyFirstPosition keys v < keys.card := by
  rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_pos hv]
  exact ((keys.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩).isLt

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_nonkey_ge.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_nonkey_ge {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work))
    (v : Fin work) (hv : v ∉ keys) : keys.card ≤ keyFirstPosition keys v := by
  rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_neg hv]
  omega

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_lt.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_lt {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work)) (v : Fin work) :
    keyFirstPosition keys v < work := by
  have hc : keys.card + (univ \ keys).card = work := by
    have h := card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (subset_univ keys)
    simp only [card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at h
    omega
  by_cases hv : v ∈ keys
  · have hk := keyFirstPosition_key_lt keys v hv
    omega
  · rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_neg hv]
    have ht := (((univ \ keys).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, by simp [hv]⟩).isLt
    omega

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_injective.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_injective {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work)) :
    Function.Injective (keyFirstPosition keys) := by
  intro u v he
  by_cases hu : u ∈ keys <;> by_cases hv : v ∈ keys
  · rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_pos hu, keyFirstPosition, dif_pos hv] at he
    have hh := (keys.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm.injective (Fin.ext he)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hh
  · have h₁ := keyFirstPosition_key_lt keys u hu
    have h₂ := keyFirstPosition_nonkey_ge keys v hv
    omega
  · have h₁ := keyFirstPosition_nonkey_ge keys u hu
    have h₂ := keyFirstPosition_key_lt keys v hv
    omega
  · rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_neg hu, keyFirstPosition, dif_neg hv] at he
    have hh := ((univ \ keys).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm.injective (Fin.ext (Nat.add_left_cancel he))
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hh

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_edge.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_edge {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work))
    {u v : Fin work} (hu : u ∈ keys) (huv : u < v) :
    keyFirstPosition keys u < keyFirstPosition keys v := by
  by_cases hv : v ∈ keys
  · rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_pos hu, keyFirstPosition, dif_pos hv]
    exact (keys.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm.strictMono (show (⟨u, hu⟩ : keys) < ⟨v, hv⟩ from huv)
  · exact (keyFirstPosition_key_lt keys u hu).trans_le (keyFirstPosition_nonkey_ge keys v hv)

end Scheduling

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_key_eq.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_key_eq {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work))
    (v : Fin work) (hv : v ∈ keys) :
    keyFirstPosition keys v = (keys.filter (fun k => k < v)).card := by
  let q := (keys.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have he : keys.orderEmbOfFin rfl q = v :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((keys.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have hc := card_before_orderEmb keys q
  rw [he] at hc
  rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_pos hv]
  exact hc.symm

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_nonkey_eq.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_nonkey_eq {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work))
    (v : Fin work) (hv : v ∉ keys) :
    keyFirstPosition keys v - keys.card = ((univ \ keys).filter (fun k => k < v)).card := by
  have hv' : v ∈ univ \ keys := by simp [hv]
  let q := ((univ \ keys).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv'⟩
  have he : (univ \ keys).orderEmbOfFin rfl q = v :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (((univ \ keys).orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv'⟩)
  have hc := card_before_orderEmb (univ \ keys) q
  rw [he] at hc
  rw [keyFirstPosition, dif_neg hv, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  exact hc.symm

Scheduling.key_nonkey_prefix_card.source:
theorem key_nonkey_prefix_card {work : ℕ} (keys : Finset (Fin work)) (p : Fin work) :
    (keys.filter (fun k => k < p)).card + ((univ \ keys).filter (fun k => k < p)).card = p.val := by
  have hh := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := Iio p) (fun k => k ∈ keys)
  have hk : (Iio p).filter (fun k => k ∈ keys) = keys.filter (fun k => k < p) := by
    ext k; simp only [mem_filter, mem_Iio]; tauto
  have hn : (Iio p).filter (fun k => k ∉ keys) = (univ \ keys).filter (fun k => k < p) := by
    ext k; simp only [mem_filter, mem_Iio, mem_sdiff, mem_univ, true_and]; tauto
  rw [hk, hn, Fin.card_Iio] at hh
  exact hh

/-- If a layer boundary has at least `m` vertices per earlier key, the
leaf order leaves room to execute every earlier key before these leaves. -/

Scheduling.keyFirstPosition_leaf_after_c.source:
theorem keyFirstPosition_leaf_after_cut {work m p n : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (keys : Finset (Fin work)) (u v : Fin work) (hu : u ∈ keys) (hv : v ∉ keys)
    (hup : u.val < p) (hpv : p ≤ v.val)
    (hwork : m * n ≤ p) (hkeys : (keys.filter (fun k => k.val < p)).card ≤ n) :
    (keyFirstPosition keys u + 1) * (m - 1) ≤ keyFirstPosition keys v - keys.card := by
  let cut : Fin work := ⟨p, lt_of_le_of_lt hpv v.isLt⟩
  have hkey : keyFirstPosition keys u + 1 ≤ n := by
    rw [keyFirstPosition_key_eq keys u hu]
    have hsub : insert u (keys.filter (fun k => k < u)) ⊆ keys.filter (fun k => k.val < p) := by
      intro k hk
      rcases mem_insert.mp hk with rfl | hk
      · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hu, hup⟩
      · have hh := mem_filter.mp hk
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hh.1, lt_trans hh.2 hup⟩
    have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans hkeys
    have hn : u ∉ keys.filter (fun k => k < u) := by simp
    rw [card_insert_of_notMem hn] at hc
    exact hc
  have hsplit := key_nonkey_prefix_card keys cut
  have hsmall : (keys.filter (fun k => k < cut)).card ≤ n := hkeys
  have hbase : (m - 1) * n + n = m * n := by
    have h := Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ m from hm)
    nlinarith
  have hleaf : (m - 1) * n ≤ ((univ \ keys).filter (fun k => k < cut)).card := by
    change _ + _ = p at hsplit
    omega
  have hsub : (univ \ keys).filter (fun k => k < cut) ⊆
      (univ \ keys).filter (fun k => k < v) := by
    intro k hk
    have hh := mem_filter.mp hk
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨hh.1, lt_of_lt_of_le hh.2 hpv⟩
  rw [keyFirstPosition_nonkey_eq keys v hv]
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m - 1) hkey
  exact hmul.trans (by simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using hleaf.trans (card_le_card hsub))

end Scheduling

Scheduling.LayerSizeRule.source:
structure LayerSizeRule (jobs work : ℕ) where
  size : Fin jobs → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  fits : ∀ j p t, p ≤ work → p + size j p t ≤ work
  positive : ∀ j p t, p < work → 0 < size j p t

Scheduling.firstForcingTime.source: def firstForcingTime (c L j : ℕ) : ℕ := ((j + c - 1) / c) * c * L

Scheduling.forcingLayerRule.source:
def forcingLayerRule (jobs work m c L : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : LayerSizeRule jobs work where
  size j p t := min (work - p)
    (if firstForcingTime c L j.val ≤ t ∧ t < firstForcingTime c L j.val + L / 2 then 1 else 2 * m)
  fits := by
    intro j p t hp
    have := min_le_left (work - p)
      (if firstForcingTime c L j.val ≤ t ∧ t < firstForcingTime c L j.val + L / 2 then 1 else 2 * m)
    omega
  positive := by
    intro j p t hp
    apply lt_min (by omega)
    split_ifs <;> omega

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work : ℕ}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.initial.source:
def initial (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : LayeredPrefix jobs work where
  closed _ := 0
  width _ := min (2 * m) work
  fits _ := by simp
  frontier_pos := by intro j hw; exact lt_min (by omega) hw
  parent _ _ := none
  parent_lt := by intros; contradiction

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.exists_earliest.source:
theorem exists_earliest (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) {m L : ℕ}
    (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hactive : ∃ j, P.closed j < work) :
    ∃ j : Fin jobs, ∃ key : Fin work,
      (P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))) ∧
      (∀ i, P.closed i < work → A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤
        P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i) := by
  let active := univ.filter (fun j => P.closed j < work)
  have ha : active.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hactive
    exact ⟨j, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hj⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hmin⟩ := exists_min_image active (P.finishTime (L := L) hw A) ha
  obtain ⟨key, hk, hmax⟩ := P.exists_last_key (L := L) hw A j (mem_filter.mp hj).2
  refine ⟨j, key, hk, hmax, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hm := hmin i (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hi⟩)
  apply le_trans ?_ hm
  apply le_sup (f := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw))
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _, LayeredForest.job_pair j key, ?_⟩
  simpa only [LayeredForest.position_pair] using hk

/-- A finite chronological sequence of commitments. Each step selects the
earliest finishing current frontier, commits one of its last vertices as
key, and chooses the new width from its actual reveal time. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.CompletionRun.source:
inductive CompletionRun {m L : ℕ} (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work) : LayeredPrefix jobs work → LayeredPrefix jobs work → Prop
  | done (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (h : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P P
  | step (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
      (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
      (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < work →
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
      (tail : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule
        (P.advance j key hk
          (rule.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
          (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)) Q) :
      CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q

/-- The construction terminates because every commitment closes at least
one additional vertex. Its stopping criterion does not assume an online
performance guarantee. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.exists_completi.source:
theorem exists_completion (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) {m L : ℕ}
    (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work) :
    ∃ Q, CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q := by
  have aux : ∀ n, ∀ P : LayeredPrefix jobs work, P.remainingMass = n →
      ∃ Q, CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro P hn
      by_cases ha : ∃ j, P.closed j < work
      · obtain ⟨j, key, hk, hmax, hearliest⟩ := P.exists_earliest (L := L) hw A ha
        let q := rule.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1)
        have hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work := rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)
        have hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q := rule.positive _ _ _
        let R := P.advance j key hk q hq hp
        have hlt : R.remainingMass < n := by rw [← hn]; exact P.advance_mass_lt j key hk q hq hp
        obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := ih R.remainingMass hlt R rfl
        exact ⟨Q, CompletionRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest hQ⟩
      · have hd : ∀ j, P.closed j = work := by
          intro j
          have hf := P.fits j
          have hh : ¬ P.closed j < work := by intro h; exact ha ⟨j, h⟩
          omega
        exact ⟨P, CompletionRun.done P hd⟩
  exact aux P.remainingMass P rfl

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.CompletionRun.o.source:
theorem CompletionRun.outForest {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    (h : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q)
    {u v w : Fin (jobs * work)} (hu : (Q.toInstance L hw).edge u w)
    (hv : (Q.toInstance L hw).edge v w) : u = v :=
  Q.no_barrier_at_completion L hw h.finished hu hv

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.finishTime_eq_k.source:
theorem finishTime_eq_key {m L : ℕ} (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))) :
    P.finishTime (L := L) hw A j = A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) := by
  apply le_antisymm (Finset.sup_le hmax)
  apply le_sup (f := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw))
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _, LayeredForest.job_pair j key, ?_⟩
  simpa only [LayeredForest.position_pair] using hk

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_other_f.source:
theorem advance_other_frontier (j i : Fin jobs) (hi : i ≠ j) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) :
    (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).frontier i = P.frontier i := by
  simp only [frontier, boundary, advance, if_neg hi]
  rfl

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_new_fro.source:
theorem advance_new_frontier_parent (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q)
    (v : Fin (jobs * work)) (hv : v ∈ (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).frontier j) :
    ((P.advance j key hk q hq hp).toInstance L hw).edge (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) v := by
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  rw [advance_closed, advance_boundary] at hv'
  constructor
  · simpa only [LayeredForest.job_pair] using hv'.1.symm
  · have hlo := hv'.2.1
    have hhi := hv'.2.2
    dsimp only [boundary] at hlo hhi
    simp [advance, boundary, hv'.1, hlo, hhi]

/-- Advancing a last key never moves the earliest possible remaining
frontier completion backwards. Other frontiers retain an unprocessed
vertex, and the new frontier waits for the committed key. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_finishT.source:
theorem advance_finishTime_ge {m L t : ℕ} (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
    (hbefore : ∀ i, P.closed i < work → t ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) :
    ∀ i, (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).closed i < work →
      t ≤ (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).finishTime (L := L) hw A i := by
  let I := P.toInstance L hw
  let R := P.advance j key hk q hq hp
  let J := R.toInstance L hw
  let k : Fin (jobs * work) := finProdFinEquiv (j, key)
  have ht : t ≤ A.schedule I k := by
    have hj : P.closed j < work := by have := P.fits j; dsimp [boundary] at hk; omega
    have h := hbefore j hj
    rwa [P.finishTime_eq_key hw A j key hk hmax] at h
  have hs := P.advance_preserves (L := L) hw A j key hk hmax q hq hp
  intro i hi
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst i
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := R.frontier_nonempty j hi
    have hedge := P.advance_new_frontier_parent L hw j key hk q hq hp v hv
    have htime := (A.valid J).precedence hedge
    change A.schedule J k < A.schedule J v at htime
    have hkTime := hs.2.1 k le_rfl
    have hvt : t ≤ A.schedule J v := by change A.schedule J k = A.schedule I k at hkTime; omega
    exact hvt.trans (le_sup (f := A.schedule J) hv)
  · have hclosed : R.closed i = P.closed i := by simp [R, advance, hij]
    have hiP : P.closed i < work := by rwa [hclosed] at hi
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hlast⟩ := exists_max_image (P.frontier i) (A.schedule I)
      (P.frontier_nonempty i hiP)
    have hvt : t ≤ A.schedule I v := (hbefore i hiP).trans (Finset.sup_le hlast)
    have he : executionPrefix (A.schedule I) t = executionPrefix (A.schedule J) t :=
      executionPrefix_eq_of_slots (by intro u hu; exact hs.1 u (hu.le.trans ht))
    have hnew : t ≤ A.schedule J v := by
      by_contra hn
      have hm : v.val ∈ executionPrefix (A.schedule J) t := (val_mem_executionPrefix v).mpr (by omega)
      rw [← he] at hm
      have := (val_mem_executionPrefix v).mp hm
      omega
    have hvR : v ∈ R.frontier i := by
      rw [show R.frontier i = P.frontier i from P.advance_other_frontier j i hij key hk q hq hp]
      exact hv
    exact hnew.trans (le_sup (f := A.schedule J) hvR)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.CompletionRun.p.source:
theorem CompletionRun.preserves_slots {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    (h : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q) (t : ℕ)
    (hbefore : ∀ i, P.closed i < work → t ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i) :
    ∀ u ≤ t, executionSlot (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw)) u =
      executionSlot (A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw)) u := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => intros; rfl
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest tail ih =>
    have ht : t ≤ A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) := by
      have hj : P.closed j < work := by have := P.fits j; dsimp [boundary] at hk; omega
      have h := hbefore j hj
      rwa [P.finishTime_eq_key hw A j key hk hmax] at h
    have hs := P.advance_preserves hw A j key hk hmax
      (rule.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
      (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)
    have hb := P.advance_finishTime_ge hw A j key hk hmax hbefore
      (rule.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
      (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)
    intro u hu
    exact (hs.1 u (by omega)).trans (ih hb u hu)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.head_times_in_f.source:
theorem head_times_in_final {m L : ℕ} (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work) (Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work)
    (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
    (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < work →
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
    (tail : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule
      (P.advance j key hk
        (rule.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
        (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)) Q) :
    ∀ v, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) →
      A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw) v = A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v := by
  let t := A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))
  let q := rule.size j (P.boundary j) (t + 1)
  have hs := P.advance_preserves hw A j key hk hmax q
    (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)
  have hb := P.advance_finishTime_ge hw A j key hk hmax hearliest q
    (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)
  have ht := tail.preserves_slots t hb
  intro v hv
  have he := (hs.1 (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v) hv).trans
    (ht (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v) hv)
  have hm : v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw)) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v) :=
    (val_mem_executionSlot v).mpr rfl
  rw [he] at hm
  exact (val_mem_executionSlot v).mp hm

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.CompletionRun.p.source:
theorem CompletionRun.parent_visible {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    (h : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q) :
    ∀ j (v : Fin work), v.val < P.boundary j → Q.parent j v = P.parent j v := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => intros; rfl
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest tail ih =>
    intro i v hv
    have hb := P.advance_boundary_ge j key hk
      (rule.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
      (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _) i
    rw [ih i v (hv.trans_le hb)]
    exact P.advance_parent_visible j key hk _ _ _ i v hv

end Scheduling.LayeredPrefix

Scheduling.inForcingWindow.source:
def inForcingWindow (c L j t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  firstForcingTime c L j ≤ t ∧ t < firstForcingTime c L j + L / 2

Scheduling.narrowEvents.source:
noncomputable def narrowEvents {jobs work : ℕ} (c L j : ℕ)
    (rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) : ℕ :=
  (rs.filter (fun r => inForcingWindow c L j (r.time + 1))).length

/-- The distinct times at which narrow layers are requested lie in a
single half-epoch. Counting requests also counts a harmless possible
request after the job's final layer. -/

Scheduling.narrowEvents_le.source:
theorem narrowEvents_le {jobs work c L j : ℕ} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : rs.Pairwise (fun a b => a.time < b.time)) : narrowEvents c L j rs ≤ L / 2 := by
  classical
  let selected := rs.filter (fun r => inForcingWindow c L j (r.time + 1))
  let times := selected.map (fun r => r.time + 1)
  have hp : times.Pairwise (fun a b => a < b) := by
    rw [List.pairwise_map]
    exact (h.filter _).imp (by intro a b hab; omega)
  have hn : times.Nodup := hp.imp (by intro a b hab; omega)
  have hsub : times.toFinset ⊆ Ico (firstForcingTime c L j) (firstForcingTime c L j + L / 2) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp ht)
    have hwin := of_decide_eq_true (List.mem_filter.mp hr).2
    exact mem_Ico.mpr hwin
  have hc := card_le_card hsub
  rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn] at hc
  simpa [times, selected, narrowEvents] using hc

namespace JobLayers
variable {jobs work m c L : ℕ} {hm : 0 < m} {j : Fin jobs}

/-- Charge every full wide layer `2m` units of work. A narrow-layer
request pays for one extra layer, and one partial final layer is allowed. -/

Scheduling.JobLayers.forcing_budget.source:
theorem forcing_budget {a w : ℕ} {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : JobLayers (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) j a w rs)
    (narrow : Bool)
    (hwidth : w = min (work - a) (if narrow then 1 else 2 * m)) :
    2 * m * rs.length + a + 1 ≤
      work + 2 * m * (1 + (if narrow then 1 else 0) + narrowEvents c L j.val rs) := by
  induction h generalizing narrow with
  | done =>
    simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.mul_zero, narrowEvents, List.filter_nil, Nat.add_zero]
    split_ifs <;> nlinarith
