  | step a w r rs ho ha hb hp hf tail ih =>
    by_cases hempty : rs = []
    · subst rs
      have haw : a < work := by omega
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil]
      have hn : 0 ≤ narrowEvents c L j.val [r] := Nat.zero_le _
      have hh : 1 ≤ 1 + (if narrow then 1 else 0) + narrowEvents c L j.val [r] := by omega
      have hm' := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m) hh
      nlinarith
    · have hrem : r.stop < work := tail.nonempty_iff.mp hempty
      let next : Bool := decide (inForcingWindow c L j.val (r.time + 1))
      have hwNext : (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm).size j r.stop (r.time + 1) =
          min (work - r.stop) (if next then 1 else 2 * m) := by
        dsimp only [forcingLayerRule]
        by_cases hwin : inForcingWindow c L j.val (r.time + 1)
        · have hn : next = true := decide_eq_true hwin
          have hh : firstForcingTime c L j.val ≤ r.time + 1 ∧
              r.time + 1 < firstForcingTime c L j.val + L / 2 := hwin
          rw [if_pos hh, hn]
          rfl
        · have hn : next = false := decide_eq_false hwin
          have hh : ¬ (firstForcingTime c L j.val ≤ r.time + 1 ∧
              r.time + 1 < firstForcingTime c L j.val + L / 2) := hwin
          rw [if_neg hh, hn]
          rfl
      have hi := ih next hwNext
      have hwExact : w = if narrow then 1 else 2 * m := by
        have : w < work - a := by omega
        omega
      have hcount : narrowEvents c L j.val (r :: rs) =
          (if next then 1 else 0) + narrowEvents c L j.val rs := by
        simp only [narrowEvents, List.filter_cons, next]
        split_ifs <;> simp [Nat.add_comm]
      simp only [List.length_cons, hcount]
      rw [hb] at hi
      cases narrow <;> simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, ite_true] at hwExact ⊢ <;>
        nlinarith

/-- The adversary's job has at most `L` layers: at most `L/2` wide or
final partial layers, plus at most `L/2` narrow-layer requests. -/

Scheduling.JobLayers.forcing_length_le.source:
theorem forcing_length_le {rs : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : JobLayers (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm) j 0 (min (2 * m) work) rs)
    (hw : work = m * L) (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (htimes : rs.Pairwise (fun a b => a.time < b.time)) : rs.length ≤ L := by
  have hb := h.forcing_budget false (by simp [Nat.min_comm])
  have hn := narrowEvents_le (c := c) (L := L) (j := j.val) htimes
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false, Nat.add_zero] at hb
  have hscale := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m) hn
  have hm0 : 0 < 2 * m := by omega
  have hwork : 2 * m * (L / 2) = work := by rw [hw]; nlinarith
  have hbound : rs.length ≤ L / 2 + narrowEvents c L j.val rs := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hge := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * m)
      (show L / 2 + narrowEvents c L j.val rs + 1 ≤ rs.length by omega)
    nlinarith
  omega

end JobLayers

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work m c L : ℕ} {hm : 0 < m} {hwpos : 0 < work}
  {A : DeterministicScheduler m} {Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.for.source:
theorem RecordedRun.forcing_layer_count
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hwpos A (forcingLayerRule jobs work m c L hm)
      (initial m hm) Q records)
    (hw : work = m * L) (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length ≤ L :=
  (h.job_layers j).forcing_length_le hw hhalf (h.job_times_pairwise j)

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

Scheduling.LayerRecord.source:
structure LayerRecord (jobs work : ℕ) where
  owner : Fin jobs
  start : ℕ
  stop : ℕ
  key : Fin work
  time : ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work : ℕ}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.source:
inductive RecordedRun {m L : ℕ} (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work) :
    LayeredPrefix jobs work → LayeredPrefix jobs work → List (LayerRecord jobs work) → Prop
  | done (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (h : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) :
      RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P P []
  | step (P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
      (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
      (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
      (hearliest : ∀ i, P.closed i < work →
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) ≤ P.finishTime (L := L) hw A i)
      (records : List (LayerRecord jobs work))
      (tail : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule
        (P.advance j key hk
          (rule.size j (P.boundary j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1))
          (rule.fits _ _ _ (P.fits j)) (rule.positive _ _ _)) Q records) :
      RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q (P.record (L := L) hw A j key :: records)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.com.source:
theorem RecordedRun.completion {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => exact CompletionRun.done P hd
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    exact CompletionRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest ih

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.CompletionRun.r.source:
theorem CompletionRun.records {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
    (h : CompletionRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q) :
    ∃ records, RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => exact ⟨[], RecordedRun.done P hd⟩
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest tail ih =>
    obtain ⟨records, hr⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨_, RecordedRun.step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records hr⟩

/-- Every committed layer really has its selected key last in the final,
fixed instance. Both the layer interval and its exact closing time are
retained by the certificate. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.fin.source:
theorem RecordedRun.final_times {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    ∀ r ∈ records,
      r.start ≤ r.key.val ∧ r.key.val < r.stop ∧ r.stop ≤ work ∧
      A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (r.owner, r.key)) = r.time ∧
      ∀ v : Fin (jobs * work), job v = r.owner → r.start ≤ (position v).val → (position v).val < r.stop →
        A.schedule (Q.toInstance L hw) v ≤ r.time := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => simp
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro r hr
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr
    · have htimes := P.head_times_in_final hw A rule Q j key hk hmax hearliest tail.completion
      refine ⟨hk.1, hk.2, P.fits j, htimes _ le_rfl, ?_⟩
      intro v hj hlo hhi
      have hv : v ∈ P.frontier j := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hj, hlo, hhi⟩
      have hvtime := hmax v hv
      rw [htimes v hvtime]
      exact hvtime
    · exact ih r hr

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.sta.source:
theorem RecordedRun.start_lower {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    ∀ r ∈ records, P.closed r.owner ≤ r.start := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => simp
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro r hr
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr
    · exact le_rfl
    · have hh := ih r hr
      by_cases he : r.owner = j
      · simp only [advance, he] at hh
        dsimp [boundary] at hh
        rw [he]
        omega
      · simpa only [advance, if_neg he] using hh

/-- The recorded layer intervals cover exactly the suffix that was not
already closed when the construction started. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.cov.source:
theorem RecordedRun.covers {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    ∀ j (k : Fin work), P.closed j ≤ k.val →
      ∃ r ∈ records, r.owner = j ∧ r.start ≤ k.val ∧ k.val < r.stop := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd =>
    intro j k hk
    have := k.isLt
    rw [hd] at hk
    omega
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro i k hki
    by_cases he : i = j
    · subst i
      by_cases hc : k.val < P.boundary j
      · exact ⟨P.record hw A j key, List.mem_cons_self, rfl, hki, hc⟩
      · obtain ⟨r, hr, ho, hlo, hhi⟩ := ih j k (by rw [advance_closed]; omega)
        exact ⟨r, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr, ho, hlo, hhi⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, ho, hlo, hhi⟩ := ih i k (by simpa only [advance, if_neg he] using hki)
      exact ⟨r, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr, ho, hlo, hhi⟩

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.ord.source:
theorem RecordedRun.ordered_intervals {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    records.Pairwise (fun a b => a.owner = b.owner → a.stop ≤ b.start) := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => exact List.Pairwise.nil
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    rw [List.pairwise_cons]
    refine ⟨?_, ih⟩
    intro r hr he
    have hl := tail.start_lower r hr
    change j = r.owner at he
    rw [← he, advance_closed] at hl
    exact hl

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.nex.source:
theorem RecordedRun.next_parents {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    ∀ r ∈ records, ∀ v : Fin work, r.stop ≤ v.val →
      v.val < r.stop + rule.size r.owner r.stop (r.time + 1) →
      Q.parent r.owner v = some r.key := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => simp
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro r hr v hlo hhi
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hr with rfl | hr
    · have hp := tail.completion.parent_visible j v (by rw [advance_boundary]; exact hhi)
      change Q.parent j v = some key
      rw [hp]
      change (if j = j ∧ P.boundary j ≤ v.val ∧
        v.val < P.boundary j + rule.size j (P.boundary j)
          (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) + 1) then some key else _) = some key
      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, hlo, hhi⟩]
    · exact ih r hr v hlo hhi

/-- Every newly installed parent is one of the committed layer keys. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.par.source:
theorem RecordedRun.parent_origins {m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
    {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work} {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}
    (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) :
    ∀ j v u, Q.parent j v = some u →
      P.parent j v = some u ∨ ∃ r ∈ records, r.owner = j ∧ r.key = u := by
  induction h with
  | done P hd => intro j v u hp; exact Or.inl hp
  | step P Q j key hk hmax hearliest records tail ih =>
    intro i v u hp
    rcases ih i v u hp with hprev | ⟨r, hr, ho, hkey⟩
    · change (if i = j ∧ P.boundary j ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < P.boundary j + _ then some key else P.parent i v) =
        some u at hprev
      split_ifs at hprev with hnew
      · exact Or.inr ⟨P.record hw A j key, List.mem_cons_self, hnew.1.symm, Option.some.inj hprev⟩
      · exact Or.inl hprev
    · exact Or.inr ⟨r, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr, ho, hkey⟩

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

Scheduling.LayeredForest.key.source:
def key (j : Fin jobs) (l : Fin (F.depth j)) : Fin (jobs * work) :=
  finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨l.val, l.isLt.trans_le (F.depth_le j)⟩)

Scheduling.LayeredForest.vertexLevel.source: def vertexLevel (v : Fin (jobs * work)) : ℕ := F.level (job v) (position v)

Scheduling.LayeredForest.job_key.source:
@[simp] theorem job_key (j : Fin jobs) (l : Fin (F.depth j)) : job (F.key j l) = j := by
  simp [key]

Scheduling.LayeredForest.position_key.source:
@[simp] theorem position_key (j : Fin jobs) (l : Fin (F.depth j)) :
    (position (F.key j l)).val = l.val := by simp [key]

Scheduling.LayeredForest.vertexLevel_key.source:
@[simp] theorem vertexLevel_key (j : Fin jobs) (l : Fin (F.depth j)) :
    F.vertexLevel (F.key j l) = l.val := by
  simp [vertexLevel, key, level, l.isLt]

Scheduling.LayeredForest.key_parent.source:
theorem key_parent {L : ℕ} (v : Fin (jobs * work))
    (hp : 0 < F.vertexLevel v) :
    (F.toInstance L).edge
      (F.key (job v) ⟨F.vertexLevel v - 1, by have := F.level_lt (job v) (position v); unfold vertexLevel at *; omega⟩) v := by
  constructor
  · simp
  · simp only [position_key]
    change F.vertexLevel v - 1 + 1 = F.vertexLevel v
    omega

Scheduling.LayeredForest.keyTime_mono.source:
theorem keyTime_mono {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (j : Fin jobs) :
    Monotone (fun l : Fin (F.depth j) => S (F.key j l)) := by
  have aux : ∀ b, ∀ hb : b < F.depth j, ∀ a, ∀ ha : a < F.depth j,
      a ≤ b → S (F.key j ⟨a, ha⟩) ≤ S (F.key j ⟨b, hb⟩) := by
    intro b
    induction b with
    | zero =>
      intro hb a ha hab
      have : a = 0 := by omega
      subst a
      rfl
    | succ b ih =>
      intro hb a ha hab
      by_cases he : a = b + 1
      · subst a; rfl
      · have hb' : b < F.depth j := by omega
        have hi := ih hb' a ha (by omega)
        have hedge : (F.toInstance L).edge (F.key j ⟨b, hb'⟩) (F.key j ⟨b + 1, hb⟩) := by
          constructor
          · simp
          · change (position (F.key j ⟨b, hb'⟩)).val + 1 =
              F.vertexLevel (F.key j ⟨b + 1, hb⟩)
            simp
        exact hi.trans (hS.precedence hedge).le
  intro a b hab
  exact aux b.val b.isLt a.val a.isLt hab

/-- This is the property supplied by hidden-key selection: the key is
processed in the last slot used by its layer. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.KeyLast.source:
def KeyLast (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)) : Prop :=
  ∀ v, S v ≤ S (F.key (job v) ⟨F.vertexLevel v, F.level_lt (job v) (position v)⟩)

Scheduling.LayeredForest.earlier_layer_b.source:
theorem earlier_layer_before_parent {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * work)} (hj : job u = job v)
    (hl : F.vertexLevel u < F.vertexLevel v) :
    ∃ p, (F.toInstance L).edge p v ∧ S u ≤ S p := by
  have hp : 0 < F.vertexLevel v := by omega
  let p := F.key (job v) ⟨F.vertexLevel v - 1, by
    have := F.level_lt (job v) (position v); change F.vertexLevel v < F.depth (job v) at this; omega⟩
  refine ⟨p, F.key_parent v hp, ?_⟩
  have hk := hkey u
  have hu : F.vertexLevel u < F.depth (job v) := by
    rw [← hj]; exact F.level_lt (job u) (position u)
  have he : F.key (job u) ⟨F.vertexLevel u, F.level_lt (job u) (position u)⟩ =
      F.key (job v) ⟨F.vertexLevel u, hu⟩ := by
    apply congrArg finProdFinEquiv
    exact Prod.ext hj (Fin.ext rfl)
  rw [he] at hk
  exact hk.trans (F.keyTime_mono hS (job v) (show (⟨F.vertexLevel u, hu⟩ : Fin (F.depth (job v))) ≤
    ⟨F.vertexLevel v - 1, by have := F.level_lt (job v) (position v); unfold vertexLevel at *; omega⟩ by
      change F.vertexLevel u ≤ F.vertexLevel v - 1; omega))

Scheduling.LayeredForest.layer_execution.source:
theorem layer_execution_order {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * work)} (hj : job u = job v)
    (hl : F.vertexLevel u < F.vertexLevel v) : S u < S v := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hu⟩ := F.earlier_layer_before_parent hS hkey hj hl
  exact hu.trans_lt (hS.precedence hp)

Scheduling.LayeredForest.ready_same_laye.source:
theorem ready_same_layer {m L t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * work)} (hj : job u = job v)
    (hu : (F.toInstance L).Ready S t u) (hv : (F.toInstance L).Ready S t v) :
    F.vertexLevel u = F.vertexLevel v := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (F.vertexLevel u) (F.vertexLevel v) with h | h | h
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hup⟩ := F.earlier_layer_before_parent hS hkey hj h
    have := hv.2.2 p hp
    have := hu.2.1
    omega
  · exact h
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, hvp⟩ := F.earlier_layer_before_parent hS hkey hj.symm h
    have := hu.2.2 p hp
    have := hv.2.1
    omega

Scheduling.LayeredForest.simultaneous_sa.source:
theorem simultaneous_same_layer {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * work)} (hj : job u = job v) (ht : S u = S v) :
    F.vertexLevel u = F.vertexLevel v := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy (F.vertexLevel u) (F.vertexLevel v) with h | h | h
  · have := F.layer_execution_order hS hkey hj h; omega
  · exact h
  · have := F.layer_execution_order hS hkey hj.symm h; omega

Scheduling.LayeredForest.layerVertices.source:
noncomputable def layerVertices (j : Fin jobs) (l : ℕ) : Finset (Fin (jobs * work)) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ F.vertexLevel v = l)

Scheduling.LayeredForest.ready_card_le_w.source:
theorem ready_card_le_width {m L t W : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    (hwidth : ∀ j l, (F.layerVertices j l).card ≤ W) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ (F.toInstance L).Ready S t v)).card ≤ W := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ (F.toInstance L).Ready S t v)
  by_cases hR : R.Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hR
    have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hsub : R ⊆ F.layerVertices j (F.vertexLevel v) := by
      intro u hu
      have hu' := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hu'.1,
        F.ready_same_layer hS hkey (hu'.1.trans hv'.1.symm) hu'.2 hv'.2⟩
    exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (hwidth _ _)
  · have he : R = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hR
    change R.card ≤ W
    rw [he, card_empty]
    omega

end Scheduling.LayeredForest

Scheduling.LayeredForest.ready_iff_revea.source:
theorem ready_iff_reveal {L t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (v : Fin (jobs * work)) :
    (F.toInstance L).Ready S t v ↔ F.revealTime S L v ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S v := by
  unfold revealTime
  by_cases hp : 0 < F.vertexLevel v
  · rw [dif_pos hp]
    have hedge := F.key_parent (L := L) v hp
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨max_le h.1 (by have := h.2.2 _ hedge; omega), h.2.1⟩
    · intro h
      refine ⟨(le_max_left _ _).trans h.1, h.2, ?_⟩
      intro u hu
      have he := F.at_most_one_parent L hu hedge
      rw [he]
      have := (le_max_right _ _).trans h.1
      omega
  · rw [dif_neg hp, max_eq_left (Nat.zero_le _)]
    constructor
    · intro h; exact ⟨h.1, h.2.1⟩
    · intro h
      refine ⟨h.1, h.2, ?_⟩
      intro u hu
      have he : (position u).val + 1 = F.vertexLevel v := hu.2
      omega

Scheduling.LayeredForest.reveal_le_execu.source:
theorem reveal_le_execution {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (v : Fin (jobs * work)) :
    F.revealTime S L v ≤ S v :=
  ((F.ready_iff_reveal v).mp ⟨hS.release v, le_rfl, fun _ he => hS.precedence he⟩).1

/-- A forcing interval may begin with one wide frontier. Every layer
revealed strictly after its beginning and before its end must be narrow. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.interval_job_wo.source:
theorem interval_job_work {m L a b W : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    (hwidth : ∀ j l, (F.layerVertices j l).card ≤ W)
    (hnarrow : F.NewLayersNarrow S L a b) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card ≤ W + (b - a) := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => job v = j ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)
  let Q := R.filter (fun v => (F.toInstance L).Ready S a v)
  let N := R.filter (fun v => ¬ (F.toInstance L).Ready S a v)
  have hQ : Q.card ≤ W := by
    apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ (F.toInstance L).Ready S a v)) ?_).trans
      (F.ready_card_le_width hS hkey hwidth j)
    intro v hv
    have hv' := mem_filter.mp hv
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hv'.1).2.1, hv'.2⟩
  have hN : N.card ≤ b - a := by
    have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn S (s := N) (t := Ico a b)
      (by intro v hv; exact mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp (mem_filter.mp hv).1).2.2)
      (by
        intro u hu v hv he
        have hu' := mem_filter.mp hu
        have hv' := mem_filter.mp hv
        have hur := (mem_filter.mp hu'.1).2
        have hvr := (mem_filter.mp hv'.1).2
        have hlevel := F.simultaneous_same_layer hS hkey (hur.1.trans hvr.1.symm) he
        have hreveal : a < F.revealTime S L u := by
          have hn := hu'.2
          rw [F.ready_iff_reveal] at hn
          omega
        have hcard := hnarrow u hreveal ((F.reveal_le_execution hS u).trans_lt hur.2.2)
        apply card_le_one.mp hcard
        · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, rfl, rfl⟩
        · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hvr.1.trans hur.1.symm, hlevel.symm⟩)
    simpa using hc
  have he := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := R) (fun v => (F.toInstance L).Ready S a v)
  change Q.card + N.card = R.card at he
  change R.card ≤ W + (b - a)
  omega

/-- Summing over alive jobs derives the local processed-work bound used
by the forcing-capacity calculation. No work inequality is assumed. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.interval_work.source:
theorem interval_work {m L a b W : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    (hwidth : ∀ j l, (F.layerVertices j l).card ≤ W)
    (hnarrow : F.NewLayersNarrow S L a b)
    (harrivals : ∀ v, a ≤ S v → S v < b → (job v).val * L ≤ a) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card ≤
      ((F.toInstance L).alive S a).card * (W + (b - a)) := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)
  have hf : ∀ v ∈ R, job v ∈ (F.toInstance L).alive S a := by
    intro v hv
    have ht := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, harrivals v ht.1 ht.2, v, rfl, ht.1⟩
  have he := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise hf
  change R.card ≤ _
  rw [he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ (F.toInstance L).alive S a, (W + (b - a)) := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j _
      have hset : R.filter (fun v => job v = j) =
          univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b) := by
        ext v
        simp only [R, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
        tauto
      rw [hset]
      exact F.interval_job_work hS hkey hwidth hnarrow j
    _ = _ := by simp

/-- A forcing half-epoch loses capacity, derived from its layer structure. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.forcing_epoch_i.source:
theorem forcing_epoch_idle {m L c i : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L)
    (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    (hwidth : ∀ j l, (F.layerVertices j l).card ≤ 2 * m)
    (hnarrow : F.NewLayersNarrow S L (i * L) (i * L + L / 2))
    (halive : ((F.toInstance L).alive S (i * L)).card ≤ c) :
    (F.toInstance L).epochWork S L i < m * L := by
  have hhalf_le : L / 2 ≤ L := Nat.div_le_self _ _
  have hw := F.interval_work hS hkey hwidth hnarrow (by
    intro v _ hvt
    exact (F.toInstance L).regular_epoch_no_arrivals hS hL (by intros; rfl) v (by nlinarith))
  simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] at hw
  have hscaled : 2 * (univ.filter (fun v => i * L ≤ S v ∧ S v < i * L + L / 2)).card ≤
      ((F.toInstance L).alive S (i * L)).card * (4 * m + L) := by
    have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hw
    have he : 2 * (2 * m + L / 2) = 4 * m + L := by omega
    nlinarith
  have hgap := Accounting.forcing_capacity_gap hm hL halive hcL hcm hscaled
  have hdeficit : (univ.filter (fun v => i * L ≤ S v ∧ S v < i * L + L / 2)).card <
      m * (i * L + L / 2 - i * L) := by
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hidle⟩ := (F.toInstance L).interval_deficit_has_idle hS hdeficit
  apply (F.toInstance L).epochWork_lt_of_idle hS hL (t := t) _ hidle
  have ht' := mem_Ico.mp ht
  exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨ht'.1, by nlinarith⟩

/-- The full deterministic accounting argument on layered forests.
The remaining adversarial construction must supply `KeyLast` and the
narrow-layer condition; it need not assume any idle-capacity or backlog bound. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.forcing_flow_lo.source:
theorem forcing_flow_lower {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (hn : jobs = c * (c * (m * L))) (hw : work = m * L)
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    (hwidth : ∀ j l, (F.layerVertices j l).card ≤ 2 * m)
    (hnarrow : ∀ k < c * (m * L),
      F.NewLayersNarrow S L ((c * k) * L) ((c * k) * L + L / 2)) :
    c * L ≤ (F.toInstance L).maxFlow S := by
  by_contra h
  have hf : (F.toInstance L).FlowBound S (c * L) :=
    ((F.toInstance L).flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hb := (F.toInstance L).regular_forcing_flow_lower hm hL hc hn hS
    (by intros; rfl) (by intro j; exact (F.jobVertices_card L j).trans hw) (by
      intro k hk
      exact F.forcing_epoch_idle hm hL hhalf hcL hcm hS hkey hwidth (hnarrow k hk)
        ((F.toInstance L).regular_alive_card_le hL (by intros; rfl) hf (c * k)))
  exact h hb

/-- Quantitative comparison with the attained offline optimum, conditional
only on the stated forest and layer-selection properties. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.forcing_competi.source:
theorem forcing_competitive_lower {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * work)}
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hL : 0 < L) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hhalf : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (hn : jobs = c * (c * (m * L))) (hw : work = m * L)
    (hd : ∀ j, F.depth j ≤ L)
    (hS : (F.toInstance L).Valid m S) (hkey : F.KeyLast S)
    (hwidth : ∀ j l, (F.layerVertices j l).card ≤ 2 * m)
    (hnarrow : ∀ k < c * (m * L),
      F.NewLayersNarrow S L ((c * k) * L) ((c * k) * L + L / 2)) :
    c * (F.toInstance L).optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * (F.toInstance L).maxFlow S := by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  have hj : 0 < jobs := by rw [hn]; exact Nat.mul_pos hc (Nat.mul_pos hc (Nat.mul_pos hm0 hL))
  have ho := (F.optimum_bounds hm hj hw hd).2
  have hf := F.forcing_flow_lower hm0 hL hc hhalf hcL hcm hn hw hS hkey hwidth hnarrow
  have := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c ho
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.LayeredForest

Scheduling.LayeredForest.source:
structure LayeredForest (jobs work : ℕ) where
  depth : Fin jobs → ℕ
  depth_pos : ∀ j, 0 < depth j
  depth_le : ∀ j, depth j ≤ work
  leafLevel : (j : Fin jobs) → Fin work → Fin (depth j)

namespace LayeredForest
variable {jobs work : ℕ} (F : LayeredForest jobs work)

Scheduling.LayeredForest.level.source:
def level (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin work) : ℕ :=
  if k.val < F.depth j then k.val else (F.leafLevel j k).val

Scheduling.LayeredForest.level_lt.source:
theorem level_lt (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin work) : F.level j k < F.depth j := by
  unfold level
  split_ifs with h
  · exact h
  · exact (F.leafLevel j k).isLt

Scheduling.LayeredForest.level_le_positi.source:
theorem level_le_position (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin work) : F.level j k ≤ k.val := by
  have := F.level_lt j k
  unfold level
  split_ifs <;> omega

Scheduling.LayeredForest.job.source: def job (v : Fin (jobs * work)) : Fin jobs := (finProdFinEquiv.symm v).1

Scheduling.LayeredForest.position.source: def position (v : Fin (jobs * work)) : Fin work := (finProdFinEquiv.symm v).2

Scheduling.LayeredForest.coordinates_inj.source:
theorem coordinates_injective : Function.Injective
    (fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => (job v, (position v).val)) := by
  intro u v h
  apply finProdFinEquiv.symm.injective
  have h₁ : job u = job v := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.1) h
  have h₂ : (position u).val = (position v).val := congrArg (fun p : Fin jobs × ℕ => p.2) h
  exact Prod.ext h₁ (Fin.ext h₂)

Scheduling.LayeredForest.job_pair.source:
@[simp] theorem job_pair (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin work) :
    job (finProdFinEquiv (j, k)) = j := by simp [job]

Scheduling.LayeredForest.position_pair.source:
@[simp] theorem position_pair (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin work) :
    position (finProdFinEquiv (j, k)) = k := by simp [position]

/-- Each vertex of a noninitial layer has just the preceding layer's key
as parent. Initial-layer vertices are roots. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.toInstance.source:
def toInstance (L : ℕ) : Instance jobs (jobs * work) where
  owner := job
  release j := j.val * L
  edge u v := job u = job v ∧ (position u).val + 1 = F.level (job v) (position v)
  same_job h := h.1
  rank v := (position v).val
  rank_increases := by
    intro u v h
    have := F.level_le_position (job v) (position v)
    omega
  nonempty_job := by
    intro j
    have hw : 0 < work := lt_of_lt_of_le (F.depth_pos j) (F.depth_le j)
    exact ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, hw⟩), by simp⟩

Scheduling.LayeredForest.at_most_one_par.source:
theorem at_most_one_parent (L : ℕ) {u v w : Fin (jobs * work)}
    (hu : (F.toInstance L).edge u w) (hv : (F.toInstance L).edge v w) : u = v := by
  apply coordinates_injective
  refine Prod.ext (hu.1.trans hv.1.symm) ?_
  change (position u).val = (position v).val
  have h₁ : (position u).val + 1 = F.level (job w) (position w) := hu.2
  have h₂ : (position v).val + 1 = F.level (job w) (position w) := hv.2
  omega

Scheduling.LayeredForest.edge_from_key.source:
theorem edge_from_key (L : ℕ) {u v : Fin (jobs * work)}
    (h : (F.toInstance L).edge u v) :
    (position u).val < F.depth (job u) ∧ (position u).val < (position v).val := by
  have hl := F.level_lt (job v) (position v)
  have hp := F.level_le_position (job v) (position v)
  have he := h.2
  rw [h.1]
  omega

Scheduling.LayeredForest.jobVertices_eq.source:
theorem jobVertices_eq (L : ℕ) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (F.toInstance L).jobVertices j =
      univ.image (fun k : Fin work => finProdFinEquiv (j, k)) := by
  classical
  ext v
  simp only [Instance.jobVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]
  constructor
  · intro h
    refine ⟨position v, ?_⟩
    change job v = j at h
    rw [← h]
    exact finProdFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply v
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact job_pair j k

Scheduling.LayeredForest.jobVertices_car.source:
theorem jobVertices_card (L : ℕ) (j : Fin jobs) :
    ((F.toInstance L).jobVertices j).card = work := by
  classical
  rw [F.jobVertices_eq, card_image_of_injective]
  · simp
  · intro a b hab
    exact congrArg Prod.snd (finProdFinEquiv.injective hab)

/-- The concrete two-epoch schedule from the general lower bound. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.offline_schedul.source:
theorem offline_schedule {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hw : work = m * L)
    (hd : ∀ j, F.depth j ≤ L) :
    ∃ O, (F.toInstance L).Valid m O ∧ (F.toInstance L).FlowBound O (2 * L) := by
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * work) => (position v).val
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * L := by intro v; exact (position v).isLt.trans_eq hw
  refine ⟨fun v => pipelineTime m L (job v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (F.toInstance L).pipeline_valid hm pos hpos coordinates_injective (by intros; rfl)
    intro u v huv
    have h := F.edge_from_key L huv
    exact ⟨h.1.trans_le (hd _), h.2⟩
  · exact (F.toInstance L).pipeline_flowBound hm pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

/-- Lemma 6's offline comparison: any such forest family with `mL` work
per job and at most `L` layers has optimum between `L` and `2L`. -/

Scheduling.LayeredForest.optimum_bounds.source:
theorem optimum_bounds {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hj : 0 < jobs)
    (hw : work = m * L) (hd : ∀ j, F.depth j ≤ L) :
    L ≤ (F.toInstance L).optimum m (by omega) ∧
      (F.toInstance L).optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * L := by
  have hm0 : 0 < m := by omega
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := (F.toInstance L).optimum_attained hm0
  have hwork := (F.toInstance L).job_work_bound hO hflow ⟨0, hj⟩
  rw [F.jobVertices_card] at hwork
  refine ⟨Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left (hw.symm.le.trans hwork) hm0, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P, hP, hb⟩ := F.offline_schedule hm hw hd
  exact (F.toInstance L).optimum_le hm0 hP hb

end LayeredForest
end Scheduling

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.source:
structure LayeredPrefix (jobs work : ℕ) where
  closed : Fin jobs → ℕ
  width : Fin jobs → ℕ
  fits : ∀ j, closed j + width j ≤ work
  frontier_pos : ∀ j, closed j < work → 0 < width j
  parent : Fin jobs → Fin work → Option (Fin work)
  parent_lt : ∀ j v u, parent j v = some u → u.val < v.val

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work : ℕ} (P : LayeredPrefix jobs work)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.boundary.source: def boundary (j : Fin jobs) : ℕ := P.closed j + P.width j

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.toInstance.source:
def toInstance (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) : Instance jobs (jobs * work) where
  owner := job
  release j := j.val * L
  edge u v := job u = job v ∧
    if (position v).val < P.boundary (job v) then
      P.parent (job v) (position v) = some (position u)
    else P.closed (job v) ≤ (position u).val ∧ (position u).val < P.boundary (job v)
  same_job h := h.1
  rank v := (position v).val
  rank_increases := by
    intro u v h
    have hh := h.2
    split_ifs at hh with hv
    · exact P.parent_lt _ _ _ hh
    · omega
  nonempty_job j := ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, hw⟩), by simp⟩

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.frontier.source:
noncomputable def frontier (j : Fin jobs) : Finset (Fin (jobs * work)) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ P.closed j ≤ (position v).val ∧ (position v).val < P.boundary j)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.hidden.source:
noncomputable def hidden (j : Fin jobs) : Finset (Fin (jobs * work)) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => job v = j ∧ P.boundary j ≤ (position v).val)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.frontier_nonemp.source:
theorem frontier_nonempty (j : Fin jobs) (hj : P.closed j < work) : (P.frontier j).Nonempty := by
  have hp := P.frontier_pos j hj
  refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨P.closed j, hj⟩), ?_⟩
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  simp only [LayeredForest.job_pair, LayeredForest.position_pair]
  exact ⟨trivial, le_rfl, by dsimp [boundary]; omega⟩

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.frontier_hidden.source:
theorem frontier_hidden_edge (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * work)} (hu : u ∈ P.frontier j) (hv : v ∈ P.hidden j) :
    (P.toInstance L hw).edge u v := by
  have hu' := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  refine ⟨hu'.1.trans hv'.1.symm, ?_⟩
  rw [hv'.1, if_neg (by omega)]
  exact hu'.2

/-- Commit one layer's key and choose the size of the next frontier. All
vertices of that new frontier acquire the chosen key as their parent. -/

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance.source:
def advance (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work)
    (hqpos : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) : LayeredPrefix jobs work where
  closed i := if i = j then P.boundary j else P.closed i
  width i := if i = j then q else P.width i
  fits := by intro i; by_cases hi : i = j <;> simp [hi, hq, P.fits]
  frontier_pos := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = j
    · simpa [hi] using hqpos
    · simpa [hi] using P.frontier_pos i
  parent i v := if i = j ∧ P.boundary j ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < P.boundary j + q then some key else P.parent i v
  parent_lt := by
    intro i v u h
    split_ifs at h with hv
    · have he : key = u := Option.some.inj h
      subst u
      omega
    · exact P.parent_lt _ _ _ h

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_closed.source:
@[simp] theorem advance_closed (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) :
    (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).closed j = P.boundary j := by simp [advance]

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_boundar.source:
@[simp] theorem advance_boundary (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) :
    (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).boundary j = P.boundary j + q := by simp [boundary, advance]

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_edge_ou.source:
theorem advance_edge_outside (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q)
    (u v : Fin (jobs * work)) (hv : v ∉ P.hidden j) :
    (P.toInstance L hw).edge u v ↔ ((P.advance j key hk q hq hp).toInstance L hw).edge u v := by
  by_cases hj : job v = j
  · have hlt : (position v).val < P.boundary j := by
      simp only [hidden, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hj, true_and, not_le] at hv
      exact hv
    have hlt' : (position v).val < P.boundary j + q := by omega
    dsimp only [boundary] at hlt hlt'
    simp [toInstance, hj, hlt, hlt', advance, boundary, show ¬ P.closed j + P.width j ≤ (position v).val by omega]
  · simp only [toInstance, advance, boundary, hj, if_false, false_and]
    rfl

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_hidden_.source:
theorem advance_hidden_blocked (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work) (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q)
    (v : Fin (jobs * work)) (hv : v ∈ P.hidden j) :
    ∃ u, ((P.advance j key hk q hq hp).toInstance L hw).edge u v ∧
      (u = finProdFinEquiv (j, key) ∨ u ∈ P.hidden j) := by
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have hbound : P.boundary j < work := hv'.2.trans_lt (position v).isLt
  have hqpos := hp hbound
  by_cases hnew : (position v).val < P.boundary j + q
  · refine ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, key), ?_, Or.inl rfl⟩
    constructor
    · simpa using hv'.1.symm
    · have hb := hv'.2
      dsimp only [boundary] at hnew hb
      simp [advance, boundary, hv'.1, hnew, hb]
  · let first : Fin (jobs * work) := finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨P.boundary j, hbound⟩)
    have hfirst : first ∈ P.hidden j := by simp [first, hidden]
    refine ⟨first, ?_, Or.inr hfirst⟩
    constructor
    · simpa [first] using hv'.1.symm
    · dsimp only [boundary] at hnew
      simp [advance, boundary, hv'.1, hnew, first, hqpos]

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_preserv.source:
theorem advance_preserves {m L : ℕ} (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (hmax : ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
      A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)))
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) :
    let I := P.toInstance L hw
    let J := (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).toInstance L hw
    let t := A.schedule I (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))
    (∀ u ≤ t, executionSlot (A.schedule I) u = executionSlot (A.schedule J) u) ∧
      (∀ v, A.schedule I v ≤ t → A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule J v ≤ A.schedule J (finProdFinEquiv (j, key))) := by
  let I := P.toInstance L hw
  let J := (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).toInstance L hw
  let k : Fin (jobs * work) := finProdFinEquiv (j, key)
  have hkmem : k ∈ P.frontier j := by
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_univ _, LayeredForest.job_pair j key, ?_⟩
    simpa only [k, LayeredForest.position_pair] using hk
  have hI : ∀ v ∈ P.hidden j, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ A.schedule I k ≤ A.schedule I u := by
    intro v hv
    exact ⟨k, P.frontier_hidden_edge L hw j hkmem hv, le_rfl⟩
  have hJ : ∀ v ∈ P.hidden j, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ A.schedule I k ≤ A.schedule I u := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hloc⟩ := P.advance_hidden_blocked L hw j key hk q hq hp v hv
    refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
    rcases hloc with he | he
    · change u = k at he; rw [he]
    · exact ((A.valid I).precedence (P.frontier_hidden_edge L hw j hkmem he)).le
  have h := A.hidden_replacement I J (P.hidden j) rfl rfl
    (P.advance_edge_outside L hw j key hk q hq hp) hI hJ
  refine ⟨h.1, h.2, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rw [h.2 v (hmax v hv), h.2 k le_rfl]
  exact hmax v hv

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.exists_last_key.source:
theorem exists_last_key {m L : ℕ} (hw : 0 < work) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (j : Fin jobs) (hj : P.closed j < work) :
    ∃ key : Fin work, (P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j) ∧
      ∀ v ∈ P.frontier j, A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) v ≤
        A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw) (finProdFinEquiv (j, key)) := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hmax⟩ := exists_max_image (P.frontier j) (A.schedule (P.toInstance L hw))
    (P.frontier_nonempty j hj)
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  refine ⟨position v, hv'.2, ?_⟩
  have he : finProdFinEquiv (j, position v) = v := by
    rw [← hv'.1]
    exact finProdFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply v
  rwa [he]

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.remainingMass.source: def remainingMass : ℕ := ∑ j : Fin jobs, (work - P.closed j)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_mass_lt.source:
theorem advance_mass_lt (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) :
    (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).remainingMass < P.remainingMass := by
  unfold remainingMass
  apply sum_lt_sum
  · intro i _
    by_cases hi : i = j
    · subst i
      simp only [advance_closed]
      dsimp [boundary]
      omega
    · simp [advance, hi]
  · refine ⟨j, mem_univ _, ?_⟩
    rw [advance_closed]
    have hf := P.fits j
    dsimp [boundary] at hk ⊢
    omega

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.no_barrier_at_c.source:
theorem no_barrier_at_completion (L : ℕ) (hw : 0 < work)
    (hdone : ∀ j, P.closed j = work) {u v w : Fin (jobs * work)}
    (hu : (P.toInstance L hw).edge u w) (hv : (P.toInstance L hw).edge v w) : u = v := by
  have hb : (position w).val < P.boundary (job w) := by
    have := (position w).isLt
    simp only [boundary, hdone]
    omega
  have hpu := hu.2
  have hpv := hv.2
  rw [if_pos hb] at hpu hpv
  have he : position u = position v := Option.some.inj (hpu.symm.trans hpv)
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  exact Prod.ext (hu.1.trans hv.1.symm) (congrArg Fin.val he)

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_boundar.source:
theorem advance_boundary_ge (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q) (i : Fin jobs) :
    P.boundary i ≤ (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).boundary i := by
  by_cases hi : i = j
  · subst i; rw [advance_boundary]; omega
  · simp only [boundary, advance, if_neg hi]
    exact le_rfl

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.advance_parent_.source:
theorem advance_parent_visible (j : Fin jobs) (key : Fin work)
    (hk : P.closed j ≤ key.val ∧ key.val < P.boundary j)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : P.boundary j + q ≤ work) (hp : P.boundary j < work → 0 < q)
    (i : Fin jobs) (v : Fin work) (hv : v.val < P.boundary i) :
    (P.advance j key hk q hq hp).parent i v = P.parent i v := by
  change (if i = j ∧ P.boundary j ≤ v.val ∧ v.val < P.boundary j + q then _ else _) = _
  rw [if_neg]
  rintro ⟨rfl, hge, _⟩
  omega

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.source:
structure Instance (jobs vertices : ℕ) where
  owner : Fin vertices → Fin jobs
  release : Fin jobs → ℕ
  edge : Fin vertices → Fin vertices → Prop
  same_job : ∀ {u v}, edge u v → owner u = owner v
  rank : Fin vertices → ℕ
  rank_increases : ∀ {u v}, edge u v → rank u < rank v
  nonempty_job : ∀ j, ∃ v, owner v = j

Scheduling.Assignment.source:
abbrev Assignment {vertices : ℕ} := Fin vertices → ℕ

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- All three schedule constraints in Section 2 of the paper. -/

Scheduling.Instance.Valid.source:
structure Valid (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) : Prop where
  release : ∀ v, I.release (I.owner v) ≤ S v
  precedence : ∀ {u v}, I.edge u v → S u < S v
  capacity : ∀ t, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card ≤ m

Scheduling.Instance.jobVertices.source:
noncomputable def jobVertices (j : Fin jobs) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => I.owner v = j)

Scheduling.Instance.completion.source:
noncomputable def completion (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (j : Fin jobs) : ℕ :=
  (I.jobVertices j).sup (fun v => S v + 1)

Scheduling.Instance.maxFlow.source:
noncomputable def maxFlow (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) : ℕ :=
  univ.sup (fun j => I.completion S j - I.release j)

/-- An offline comparison schedule with maximum flow at most `L`. -/

Scheduling.Instance.Ready.source:
def Ready (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) (v : Fin vertices) : Prop :=
  I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S v ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u v → S u < t

Scheduling.Instance.alive.source:
noncomputable def alive (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin jobs) :=
  univ.filter (fun j => I.release j ≤ t ∧ ∃ v, I.owner v = j ∧ t ≤ S v)

Scheduling.Instance.remaining.source:
noncomputable def remaining (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S v)

/-- Work conservation and job-level FIFO priority. Ties between equal release
times may be broken arbitrarily. Both conditions inspect only ready vertices. -/

Scheduling.Instance.IsFIFO.source:
structure IsFIFO (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) : Prop where
  work_conserving : ∀ t v, I.Ready S t v → S v ≠ t →
    (univ.filter (fun u => S u = t)).card = m
  fifo_priority : ∀ t v u, I.Ready S t v → S v ≠ t → S u = t →
    I.release (I.owner u) ≤ I.release (I.owner v)

Scheduling.Instance.flowBound_iff_maxFlo.source:
theorem flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (L : ℕ) :
    I.FlowBound S L ↔ I.maxFlow S ≤ L := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro j _
    apply Nat.sub_le_iff_le_add.mpr
    apply Finset.sup_le
    intro v hv
    have ho : I.owner v = j := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have := h v
    rw [ho] at this
    omega
  · intro h v
    have h₁ : S v + 1 ≤ I.completion S (I.owner v) :=
      Finset.le_sup (f := fun v => S v + 1) (by simp [jobVertices])
    have h₂ : I.completion S (I.owner v) - I.release (I.owner v) ≤ L :=
      (Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => I.completion S j - I.release j) (mem_univ _)).trans h
    omega

Scheduling.Instance.flowBound_pos.source:
theorem flowBound_pos {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {m L : ℕ}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : I.FlowBound S L) (v : Fin vertices) : 0 < L := by
  have := hS.release v
  have := hL v
  omega

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.batchedTime.source:
def batchedTime (m L j k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  j * L + if k < L then k else (k - L) / (m - 1)

Scheduling.batched_epoch_bounds.source:
theorem batched_epoch_bounds {m L j k : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk : k < m * L) :
    j * L ≤ batchedTime m L j k ∧ batchedTime m L j k < (j + 1) * L := by
  have hr := pipeline_remainder_lt hm hk
  dsimp [batchedTime]
  generalize (k - L) / (m - 1) = q at *
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] <;> omega

Scheduling.batched_injective.source:
theorem batched_injective {m L j k j' k' : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hk : k < m * L) (hk' : k' < m * L)
    (ht : batchedTime m L j k = batchedTime m L j' k')
    (hp : pipelineLane m L k = pipelineLane m L k') : j = j' ∧ k = k' := by
  have he := batched_epoch_bounds (j := j) hm hk
  have he' := batched_epoch_bounds (j := j') hm hk'
  rw [← ht] at he'
  have hj := epoch_index_unique he he'
  subst j'
  have htime : pipelineTime m L j k = pipelineTime m L j k' := by
    by_cases ha : k < L <;> by_cases hb : k' < L
    · simpa only [pipelineTime, batchedTime, if_pos ha, if_pos hb] using ht
    · simp only [pipelineLane, if_pos ha, if_neg hb] at hp
      omega
    · simp [pipelineLane, ha, hb] at hp
    · simp only [batchedTime, if_neg ha, if_neg hb] at ht
      simp only [pipelineTime, if_neg ha, if_neg hb]
      omega
  exact pipeline_injective hm hk hk' htime hp

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- The prefix-balance condition is used to place each leaf late enough
for its parent key. Capacity and all other constraints follow from the
key-first indexing itself. -/

Scheduling.Instance.batched_valid.source:
theorem batched_valid {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (position : Fin vertices → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ v, position v < m * L)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => (I.owner v, position v)))
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hedge : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → position u < L ∧
      (if position v < L then position u < position v
       else (position u + 1) * (m - 1) ≤ position v - L)) :
    I.Valid m (fun v => batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v)) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    rw [hrelease]
    exact (batched_epoch_bounds hm (hpos v)).1
  · intro u v huv
    have ho := I.same_job huv
    have he := hedge u v huv
    change batchedTime m L (I.owner u).val (position u) <
      batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v)
    simp only [batchedTime, ho, if_pos he.1]
    by_cases hv : position v < L
    · simp only [if_pos hv] at he ⊢
      omega
    · simp only [if_neg hv] at he ⊢
      have hdiv := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (show 0 < m - 1 by omega)).mpr he.2
      omega
  · intro t
    have hlane : ∀ v, pipelineLane m L (position v) < m := by
      intro v
      have hr := Nat.mod_lt (position v - L) (show 0 < m - 1 by omega)
      unfold pipelineLane
      split_ifs <;> omega
    let f : Fin vertices → Fin m := fun v => ⟨pipelineLane m L (position v), hlane v⟩
    have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn f
      (t := (univ : Finset (Fin m))) (s := univ.filter (fun v =>
        batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v) = t)) (by simp) (by
        intro u hu v hv heq
        have ht := (mem_filter.mp hu).2.trans (mem_filter.mp hv).2.symm
        have he := batched_injective hm (hpos u) (hpos v) ht (congrArg Fin.val heq)
        exact hinj (Prod.ext (Fin.ext he.1) he.2))
    simpa using hc

Scheduling.Instance.batched_flowBound.source:
theorem batched_flowBound {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (position : Fin vertices → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ v, position v < m * L)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L) :
    I.FlowBound (fun v => batchedTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v)) L := by
  intro v
  rw [hrelease]
  have hh := (batched_epoch_bounds hm (hpos v) (j := (I.owner v).val)).2
  simpa only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul] using hh

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.pipelineTime.source:
def pipelineTime (m L j k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  j * L + if k < L then k else L + (k - L) / (m - 1)

Scheduling.pipelineLane.source:
def pipelineLane (m L k : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if k < L then 0 else 1 + (k - L) % (m - 1)

Scheduling.pipeline_remainder_lt.source:
theorem pipeline_remainder_lt {m L k : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk : k < m * L) :
    (k - L) / (m - 1) < L := by
  have hp : 0 < m - 1 := by omega
  apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hp).mpr
  have he : m - 1 + 1 = m := by omega
  by_cases h : k < L
  · have hL : 0 < L := by nlinarith
    have : k - L = 0 := by omega
    rw [this]
    exact Nat.mul_pos hL hp
  · have : k - L + L = k := Nat.sub_add_cancel (by omega)
    nlinarith

Scheduling.pipeline_epoch_bounds.source:
theorem pipeline_epoch_bounds {m L j k : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hk : k < m * L) :
    let e := j + if k < L then 0 else 1
    e * L ≤ pipelineTime m L j k ∧ pipelineTime m L j k < (e + 1) * L := by
  have hr := pipeline_remainder_lt hm hk
  dsimp [pipelineTime]
  generalize (k - L) / (m - 1) = q at *
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_zero] <;> omega

Scheduling.epoch_index_unique.source:
theorem epoch_index_unique {L t j k : ℕ}
    (hj : j * L ≤ t ∧ t < (j + 1) * L)
    (hk : k * L ≤ t ∧ t < (k + 1) * L) : j = k := by
  rcases lt_trichotomy j k with h | h | h
  · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show j + 1 ≤ k by omega)
    omega
  · exact h
  · have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show k + 1 ≤ j by omega)
    omega

Scheduling.pipeline_injective.source:
theorem pipeline_injective {m L j k j' k' : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hk : k < m * L) (hk' : k' < m * L)
    (ht : pipelineTime m L j k = pipelineTime m L j' k')
    (hp : pipelineLane m L k = pipelineLane m L k') : j = j' ∧ k = k' := by
  have he := pipeline_epoch_bounds (j := j) hm hk
  have he' := pipeline_epoch_bounds (j := j') hm hk'
  rw [← ht] at he'
  have hj := epoch_index_unique he he'
  have hd := Nat.div_add_mod (k - L) (m - 1)
  have hd' := Nat.div_add_mod (k' - L) (m - 1)
  by_cases ha : k < L <;> by_cases hb : k' < L
  · simp only [ha, hb, if_pos, Nat.add_zero] at hj
    subst j'
    simp only [pipelineTime, if_pos ha, if_pos hb] at ht
    exact ⟨rfl, by omega⟩
  · simp only [pipelineLane, if_pos ha, if_neg hb] at hp
    exact False.elim (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.zero_lt_succ _) (by omega : 0 = (k' - L) % (m - 1) + 1))
  · simp [pipelineLane, ha, hb] at hp
  · simp only [ha, hb, if_false] at hj
    have hjj : j = j' := by omega
    subst j'
    simp only [pipelineTime, if_neg ha, if_neg hb] at ht
    simp only [pipelineLane, if_neg ha, if_neg hb] at hp
    have hq : (k - L) / (m - 1) = (k' - L) / (m - 1) := by omega
    rw [hq] at hd
    exact ⟨rfl, by omega⟩

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- A key-first ordering is enough for the two-epoch offline schedule.
The hypotheses concern the graph and its ordering, not a presumed schedule. -/

Scheduling.Instance.pipeline_valid.source:
theorem pipeline_valid {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (position : Fin vertices → ℕ)
    (hpos : ∀ v, position v < m * L)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => (I.owner v, position v)))
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hedge : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → position u < L ∧ position u < position v) :
    I.Valid m (fun v => pipelineTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v)) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    rw [hrelease]
    unfold pipelineTime
    omega
  · intro u v huv
    have ho := I.same_job huv
    have he := hedge u v huv
    change pipelineTime m L (I.owner u).val (position u) <
      pipelineTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v)
    simp only [pipelineTime, ho, if_pos he.1]
    generalize (position v - L) / (m - 1) = q
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · intro t
    have hlane : ∀ v, pipelineLane m L (position v) < m := by
      intro v
      have hr := Nat.mod_lt (position v - L) (show 0 < m - 1 by omega)
      unfold pipelineLane
      split_ifs <;> omega
    let f : Fin vertices → Fin m := fun v => ⟨pipelineLane m L (position v), hlane v⟩
    have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn f
      (t := (univ : Finset (Fin m))) (s := univ.filter (fun v =>
        pipelineTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v) = t)) (by simp)
      (by
        intro u hu v hv heq
        have ht := (mem_filter.mp hu).2.trans (mem_filter.mp hv).2.symm
        have he := pipeline_injective hm (hpos u) (hpos v) ht (congrArg Fin.val heq)
        exact hinj (Prod.ext (Fin.ext he.1) he.2))
    simpa using hc

Scheduling.Instance.pipeline_flowBound.source:
theorem pipeline_flowBound {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (position : Fin vertices → ℕ) (hpos : ∀ v, position v < m * L)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L) :
    I.FlowBound (fun v => pipelineTime m L (I.owner v).val (position v)) (2 * L) := by
  intro v
  have hr := pipeline_remainder_lt hm (hpos v)
  rw [hrelease]
  dsimp only [pipelineTime]
  split_ifs <;> omega

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.serialSchedule.source:
noncomputable def serialSchedule : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  fun v => univ.sup I.release + I.rank v * (vertices + 1) + v.val

Scheduling.Instance.serialSchedule_injec.source:
theorem serialSchedule_injective : Function.Injective I.serialSchedule := by
  intro u v huv
  have hu := u.isLt
  have hv := v.isLt
  have he : I.rank u * (vertices + 1) + u.val = I.rank v * (vertices + 1) + v.val := by
    dsimp [serialSchedule] at huv
    omega
  have hr : I.rank u = I.rank v := by
    by_contra hn
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hn with h | h
    · have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (vertices + 1) (show I.rank u + 1 ≤ I.rank v by omega)
      nlinarith
    · have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (vertices + 1) (show I.rank v + 1 ≤ I.rank u by omega)
      nlinarith
  apply Fin.ext
  rw [hr] at he
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.serialSchedule_valid.source:
theorem serialSchedule_valid {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : I.Valid m I.serialSchedule := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    have hr : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ univ.sup I.release := le_sup (mem_univ _)
    dsimp [serialSchedule]
    omega
  · intro u v he
    have hr := I.rank_increases he
    have hu := u.isLt
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (vertices + 1) (show I.rank u + 1 ≤ I.rank v by omega)
    dsimp [serialSchedule]
    nlinarith
  · intro t
    have hc : (univ.filter (fun v => I.serialSchedule v = t)).card ≤ 1 := by
      apply card_le_one.mpr
      intro u hu v hv
      exact I.serialSchedule_injective ((mem_filter.mp hu).2.trans (mem_filter.mp hv).2.symm)
    omega

Scheduling.Instance.exists_offline_bound.source:
theorem exists_offline_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ L, ∃ O : Assignment (vertices := vertices), I.Valid m O ∧ I.FlowBound O L := by
  classical
  refine ⟨univ.sup (fun v => I.serialSchedule v + 1), I.serialSchedule,
    I.serialSchedule_valid hm, ?_⟩
  intro v
  have h : I.serialSchedule v + 1 ≤ univ.sup (fun v => I.serialSchedule v + 1) := le_sup (f := fun v => I.serialSchedule v + 1) (mem_univ v)
  omega

/-- The minimum possible maximum flow time, whose existence is proved above. -/

Scheduling.Instance.optimum.source: noncomputable def optimum (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : ℕ := Nat.find (I.exists_offline_bound hm)

Scheduling.Instance.optimum_attained.source:
theorem optimum_attained {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ O : Assignment (vertices := vertices), I.Valid m O ∧ I.FlowBound O (I.optimum m hm) :=
  Nat.find_spec (I.exists_offline_bound hm)

Scheduling.Instance.optimum_pos.source:
theorem optimum_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs) : 0 < I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  obtain ⟨v, _⟩ := I.nonempty_job ⟨0, hj⟩
  exact I.flowBound_pos hO hL v

Scheduling.Instance.optimum_eq_minimum.source:
theorem optimum_eq_minimum {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ O : Assignment (vertices := vertices), I.Valid m O ∧ I.maxFlow O = I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  exact ⟨O, hO, Nat.le_antisymm ((I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le O _).mp hL) (I.optimum_le_maxFlow hm hO)⟩

/-- The paper's exact FIFO competitive factor relative to the actual minimum
offline maximum flow, expressed without division. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_competitive.source:
theorem fifo_competitive {m : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hS : I.Valid m S) (hF : I.IsFIFO m S) :
    m * I.maxFlow S ≤ (m * m + m - 1) * I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  exact I.fifo_maxFlow_bound hm hS hF hO hL

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.Packing.indices.source:
def indices (n a b : ℕ) : Finset (Fin n) :=
  univ.filter (fun i => a ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b)

Scheduling.Packing.indices_card.source:
theorem indices_card (n a b : ℕ) : (indices n a b).card = min b n - a := by
  have he : (indices n a b).image Fin.val = Ico a (min b n) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      have h := (mem_filter.mp hi).2
      exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨h.1, lt_min h.2 i.isLt⟩
    · intro hx
      have h := mem_Ico.mp hx
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨⟨x, (lt_min_iff.mp h.2).2⟩,
        mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, h.1, (lt_min_iff.mp h.2).1⟩, rfl⟩
  have hc := card_image_of_injective (indices n a b) Fin.val_injective
  rw [he, Nat.card_Ico] at hc
  exact hc.symm

Scheduling.Packing.slice.source:
def slice (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  (indices s.card a b).image (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl)

Scheduling.Packing.slice_card.source:
theorem slice_card (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) : (slice s a b).card = min b s.card - a := by
  rw [slice, card_image_of_injective _ (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective, indices_card]

Scheduling.Packing.slice_subset.source:
theorem slice_subset (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) : slice s a b ⊆ s := by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hv
  exact orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _

Scheduling.Packing.mem_slice_iff.source:
theorem mem_slice_iff (s : Finset V) (a b : ℕ) (v : V) :
    v ∈ slice s a b ↔ ∃ i : Fin s.card, a ≤ i.val ∧ i.val < b ∧ s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i = v := by
  simp only [slice, indices, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, he⟩; exact ⟨i, hi.1, hi.2, he⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, h₁, h₂, he⟩; exact ⟨i, ⟨h₁, h₂⟩, he⟩

Scheduling.Packing.slices_disjoint.source:
theorem slices_disjoint (s : Finset V) {a b c d : ℕ} (hbc : b ≤ c) :
    Disjoint (slice s a b) (slice s c d) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro v hv hw
  obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hv
  obtain ⟨j, hj₁, hj₂, hj⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hw
  have he := (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).injective (hi.trans hj.symm)
  have he' := congrArg Fin.val he
  omega

/-- An omitted element of the initial slice implies the slice is full. -/

Scheduling.Packing.first_slice_full.source:
theorem first_slice_full {s : Finset V} {m : ℕ} {v : V}
    (hv : v ∈ s) (hn : v ∉ slice s 0 m) : (slice s 0 m).card = m := by
  let i := (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hi : s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i = v :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have him : m ≤ i.val := by
    by_contra h
    exact hn ((mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨i, Nat.zero_le _, by omega, hi⟩)
  rw [slice_card, Nat.sub_zero, min_eq_left (by omega)]

/-- Every selected element precedes every omitted element. -/

Scheduling.Packing.first_slice_lt.source:
theorem first_slice_lt {s : Finset V} {m : ℕ} {u v : V}
    (hu : u ∈ slice s 0 m) (hv : v ∈ s) (hn : v ∉ slice s 0 m) : u < v := by
  obtain ⟨i, _, him, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hu
  let j := (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hj : s.orderEmbOfFin rfl j = v :=
    congrArg Subtype.val ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have hjm : m ≤ j.val := by
    by_contra h
    exact hn ((mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨j, Nat.zero_le _, by omega, hj⟩)
  rw [← hi, ← hj]
  exact (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).strictMono (by show i.val < j.val; omega)

Scheduling.Packing.duration.source: def duration (n m : ℕ) : ℕ := max 1 ((n + m - 1) / m)

Scheduling.Packing.slot.source: def slot (s : Finset V) (m k : ℕ) : Finset V := slice s (k * m) ((k + 1) * m)

Scheduling.Packing.duration_pos.source:
theorem duration_pos (n m : ℕ) : 0 < duration n m := by
  unfold duration
  omega

Scheduling.Packing.slot_card_le.source:
theorem slot_card_le (s : Finset V) (m k : ℕ) : (slot s m k).card ≤ m := by
  rw [slot, slice_card]
  have he : (k + 1) * m = k * m + m := by ring
  omega

Scheduling.Packing.before_last_full.source:
theorem before_last_full (s : Finset V) {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hk : k + 1 < duration s.card m) : (slot s m k).card = m := by
  have hq : k + 1 < (s.card + m - 1) / m := by unfold duration at hk; omega
  have hp := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hm).mp (show k + 2 ≤ (s.card + m - 1) / m by omega)
  rw [slot, slice_card]
  have hmul : (k + 2) * m = (k + 1) * m + m := by ring
  have hsub : s.card + m - 1 + 1 = s.card + m := by omega
  have hle : (k + 1) * m ≤ s.card := by omega
  rw [min_eq_left hle]
  have he : (k + 1) * m = k * m + m := by ring
  omega

Scheduling.Packing.slot_disjoint.source:
theorem slot_disjoint (s : Finset V) {m i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) :
    Disjoint (slot s m i) (slot s m j) := by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
  · exact slices_disjoint s (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (show i + 1 ≤ j by omega))
  · exact (slices_disjoint s (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m (show j + 1 ≤ i by omega))).symm

Scheduling.Packing.covers.source:
theorem covers (s : Finset V) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {v : V} (hv : v ∈ s) :
    ∃ k < duration s.card m, v ∈ slot s m k := by
  let i := (s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hi : s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i = v := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((s.orderIsoOfFin rfl).apply_symm_apply ⟨v, hv⟩)
  have hmod := Nat.mod_lt i.val hm
  have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div i.val m
  rw [Nat.mul_comm m] at hdiv
  have hcover : s.card ≤ duration s.card m * m := by
    have hquot := Nat.mod_lt (s.card + m - 1) hm
    have hdecomp := Nat.mod_add_div (s.card + m - 1) m
    rw [Nat.mul_comm m] at hdecomp
    have hceil : s.card ≤ ((s.card + m - 1) / m) * m := by omega
    have hmax : (s.card + m - 1) / m ≤ duration s.card m := le_max_right _ _
    exact hceil.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hmax)
  have hk : i.val / m < duration s.card m := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hm).mpr
    exact i.isLt.trans_le hcover
  refine ⟨i.val / m, hk, (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨i, ?_, ?_, hi⟩⟩
  · omega
  · have he : (i.val / m + 1) * m = i.val / m * m + m := by ring
    omega

end Scheduling.Packing

Scheduling.Packing.slice_image.source:
theorem slice_image (s : Finset V) (f : V → W) (hf : StrictMono f) (a b : ℕ) :
    (slice s a b).image f = slice (s.image f) a b := by
  classical
  have hc : (s.image f).card = s.card := card_image_of_injective _ hf.injective
  have henum : (fun i : Fin s.card => f (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i)) =
      (s.image f).orderEmbOfFin hc := by
    apply orderEmbOfFin_unique hc
    · intro i
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨_, orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _, rfl⟩
    · exact hf.comp (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl).strictMono
  have hcast (i : Fin s.card) :
      (s.image f).orderEmbOfFin rfl (i.cast hc.symm) = f (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl i) := by
    rw [congrFun henum i]
    exact orderEmbOfFin_eq_orderEmbOfFin_iff.mpr rfl
  ext y
  constructor
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hv
    refine (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨i.cast hc.symm, hi₁, hi₂, ?_⟩
    rw [hcast, hi]
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂, hi⟩ := (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mp hy
    let j : Fin s.card := i.cast hc
    have he : f (s.orderEmbOfFin rfl j) = y := by
      rw [← hcast]
      exact hi
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨_, (mem_slice_iff _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨j, hi₁, hi₂, rfl⟩, he⟩

Scheduling.Packing.slot_image.source:
theorem slot_image (s : Finset V) (f : V → W) (hf : StrictMono f) (m k : ℕ) :
    (slot s m k).image f = slot (s.image f) m k :=
  slice_image s f hf _ _

end Scheduling.Packing

Scheduling.Instance.PhaseFails.source:
def PhaseFails (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s B : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ t, s ≤ t ∧ ∃ v, t = I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ∧ t ≤ S v

Scheduling.Instance.failureTime.source:
noncomputable def failureTime {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) : ℕ := Nat.find hf

Scheduling.Instance.failureTime_spec.source:
theorem failureTime_spec {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) :
    s ≤ I.failureTime hf ∧ ∃ v,
      I.failureTime hf = I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ∧ I.failureTime hf ≤ S v :=
  Nat.find_spec hf

Scheduling.Instance.failureTime_le.source:
theorem failureTime_le {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) (v : Fin vertices)
    (hs : s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (hv : I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ S v) :
    I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 :=
  Nat.find_min' hf ⟨hs, v, rfl, hv⟩

Scheduling.Instance.failure_remaining_ag.source:
theorem failure_remaining_age {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : I.failureTime hf ≤ S v) :
    I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  by_contra hn
  have hstart := hs v ((I.failureTime_spec hf).1.trans hv)
  have hle := I.failureTime_le hf v hstart (by omega)
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.failure_completed_ag.source:
theorem failure_completed_age {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hsv : s ≤ S v) (hv : S v < I.failureTime hf) :
    S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  by_contra hn
  have hle := I.failureTime_le hf v (hs v hsv) (by omega)
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.no_failure_flow.source:
theorem no_failure_flow {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : ¬ I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hsv : s ≤ S v) :
    S v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  by_contra hn
  exact hf ⟨I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2, hs v hsv, v, rfl, by omega⟩

Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_start_bound.source:
theorem sffPhase_start_bound {m B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    ∀ v, s ≤ I.sffPhase m B hB S s v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  classical
  intro v hv
  have hsur := (I.splice_survives _ v).mp hv
  have h := hs v (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hsur⟩)
  nlinarith

/-- A failed SFF phase certifies that its guess was too small. -/

Scheduling.Instance.failed_guess_lt.source:
theorem failed_guess_lt {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B) : B < I.optimum m hm := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  obtain ⟨ht, v, he, hv⟩ := I.failureTime_spec hf
  have hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s :=
    mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (I.splice_survives _ v).mp (ht.trans hv)⟩
  have hbound := I.sffPhase_survivor_bound hm hB hs (by omega) v hsur
  omega

/-- At a restart every survivor's new artificial release is after the new
phase start. This is the invariant needed for local-clock transport. -/

Scheduling.Instance.doubled_phase_start.source:
theorem doubled_phase_start {m B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B) :
    ∀ v ∈ I.survivors (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (I.failureTime hf),
      I.failureTime hf ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * (2 * B) ^ 2 := by
  intro v hv
  have h := I.failure_remaining_age hf (I.sffPhase_start_bound hB hs) v (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.Accounting

Scheduling.Accounting.combined_sff_budge.source:
theorem combined_sff_budget {B m O : ℕ} (hO : B ≤ 2 * O) (hm : B < 2 * m) :
    88 * B ^ 2 ≤ 352 * O * min m O := by
  rcases le_total m O with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO (le_of_lt hm)
    nlinarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO hO
    nlinarith

Scheduling.Accounting.combined_fifo_budg.source:
theorem combined_fifo_budget {B m O : ℕ} (hO : B ≤ 2 * O) (hm : B < 2 * m)
    (hswitch : m ≤ B) : 44 * B ^ 2 + 44 * m * O ≤ 352 * O * min m O := by
  rcases le_total m O with h | h
  · rw [min_eq_left h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO (le_of_lt hm)
    nlinarith
  · rw [min_eq_right h]
    have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hO hO
    have hmo := Nat.mul_le_mul_right O (hswitch.trans hO)
    nlinarith

end Scheduling.Accounting

Scheduling.deadlineVisible.source:
def deadlineVisible (B t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : Bool :=
  decide (∃ x ∈ Q, (ofLex x).1 + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t)

Scheduling.deadlineVisible_iff.source:
theorem deadlineVisible_iff (B t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) :
    deadlineVisible B t Q = true ↔ ∃ x ∈ Q, (ofLex x).1 + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t := by
  simp [deadlineVisible]

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- Splicing a future continuation preserves all completed work at every
earlier time, including the restart boundary before that slot executes. -/

Scheduling.Instance.splice_prefix_time.source:
theorem splice_prefix_time {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s t : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (ht : t ≤ s) (v : Fin vertices) :
    I.splice S s T v < t ↔ S v < t := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : S v < s
  · rw [I.splice_preserves_prefix T hv]
  · have hs : v ∈ I.survivors S s := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
    simp only [splice, dif_pos hs]
    omega

/-- The recursive controller never revises the executed prefix, without
requiring any offline bound or performance invariant. -/

Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_prefix_t.source:
theorem combinedAux_prefix_time {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (ht : t ≤ s) (v : Fin vertices) :
    I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v < t ↔ S v < t := by
  classical
  induction fuel generalizing B S s with
  | zero => exact I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hswitch : B < m
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_pos hswitch]
      by_cases hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B
      · rw [dif_pos hf]
        have hs := (I.failureTime_spec hf).1
        exact (ih (2 * B) (by omega) (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)
          (I.failureTime hf) (ht.trans hs)).trans (I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v)
      · rw [dif_neg hf]
        exact I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_neg hswitch]
      exact I.splice_prefix_time _ ht v

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_pre.source:
theorem readyObservation_prefix {S T : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {t : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ v, S v < t ↔ T v < t) : I.readyObservation S t = I.readyObservation T t := by
  unfold readyObservation
  congr 1
  ext v
  have hv : t ≤ S v ↔ t ≤ T v := by have := h v; omega
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hv, h]

Scheduling.Instance.splice_readyObservat.source:
theorem splice_readyObservation {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s t : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (ht : t ≤ s) :
    I.readyObservation (I.splice S s T) t = I.readyObservation S t :=
  I.readyObservation_prefix (I.splice_prefix_time T ht)

Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_readyObs.source:
theorem combinedAux_readyObservation {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (ht : t ≤ s) :
    I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s) t = I.readyObservation S t :=
  I.readyObservation_prefix (I.combinedAux_prefix_time hm fuel B hB S s t ht)

/-- The first failed deadline is visible from the exposed ready frontier. -/

Scheduling.Instance.failureTime_visible.source:
theorem failureTime_visible {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B) :
    deadlineVisible B (I.failureTime hf) (I.readyObservation S (I.failureTime hf)) = true := by
  obtain ⟨_, v, he, hv⟩ := I.failureTime_spec hf
  have hr : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ I.failureTime hf := by omega
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hready⟩ := I.exists_ready (S := S) hr ⟨v, rfl, hv⟩
  apply (deadlineVisible_iff _ _ _).mpr
  refine ⟨I.fifoPriority w, (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mpr ⟨w, hready, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  change I.release (I.owner w) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ I.failureTime hf
  rw [hw]
  omega

/-- No earlier time in a phase can trigger the public failure detector. -/

Scheduling.Instance.before_failure_not_v.source:
theorem before_failure_not_visible {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B t : ℕ}
    (hf : I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (hst : s ≤ t) (ht : t < I.failureTime hf) :
    deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false := by
  apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hd⟩ := (deadlineVisible_iff _ _ _).mp h
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp hx
  change I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t at hd
  have hstart := hs v (hst.trans hv.2.1)
  have hmin := I.failureTime_le hf v hstart (hd.trans hv.2.1)
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.no_failure_not_visib.source:
theorem no_failure_not_visible {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s B t : ℕ}
    (hf : ¬ I.PhaseFails S s B)
    (hs : ∀ v, s ≤ S v → s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2)
    (hst : s ≤ t) : deadlineVisible B t (I.readyObservation S t) = false := by
  apply Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr
  intro h
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hd⟩ := (deadlineVisible_iff _ _ _).mp h
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp hx
  change I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 ≤ t at hd
  exact hf ⟨_, hs v (hst.trans hv.2.1), v, rfl, hd.trans hv.2.1⟩

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.delayObservation.source:
def delayObservation (D s t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : FIFOObservation :=
  (Q.filter (fun x => (ofLex x).1 + D ≤ t)).image
    (fun x => toLex ((ofLex x).1 + D - s, (ofLex x).2))

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- Extend the increasing residual reindexing to a total increasing map on
public labels. Values outside the residual domain are never observed. -/

Scheduling.Instance.residualLabel.source:
noncomputable def residualLabel (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (n : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  if hn : n < R.card then (I.residualVertex R ⟨n, hn⟩).val else vertices + n

Scheduling.Instance.residualLabel_strict.source:
theorem residualLabel_strictMono (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) : StrictMono (I.residualLabel R) := by
  intro a b hab
  unfold residualLabel
  split_ifs with ha hb hb
  · exact I.residualVertex_strictMono R hab
  · have hh := (I.residualVertex R ⟨a, ha⟩).isLt
    omega
  · omega
  · omega

Scheduling.Instance.residualLabel_apply.source:
@[simp] theorem residualLabel_apply (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) :
    I.residualLabel R v.val = (I.residualVertex R v).val := by
  simp [residualLabel]

Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_mem.source:
theorem residualVertex_mem (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) :
    I.residualVertex R v ∈ R := (R.orderIsoOfFin rfl v).property

Scheduling.Instance.survivorIndex_residu.source:
@[simp] theorem survivorIndex_residualVertex {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card) :
    I.survivorIndex (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v)
      (I.residualVertex_mem _ v) = v := by
  exact ((I.survivors S s).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm_apply_apply v

Scheduling.Instance.splice_residualVerte.source:
@[simp] theorem splice_residualVertex {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card) :
    I.splice S s T (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v) = s + T v := by
  simp only [splice, dif_pos (I.residualVertex_mem _ v), I.survivorIndex_residualVertex]

Scheduling.Instance.phase_release_owner.source:
@[simp] theorem phase_release_owner (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ) (v : Fin R.card) :
    (I.phaseInstance R D s).release ((I.phaseInstance R D s).owner v) =
      I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex R v)) + D - s := by
  simp [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance]

/-- Local readiness is precisely global readiness of a survivor, together
with its artificial-release eligibility. Removed predecessors have already
finished before the restart. -/

Scheduling.Instance.phase_ready_iff.source:
theorem phase_ready_iff {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {D s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card))
