    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D)
    (u : ℕ) (v : Fin (I.survivors S s).card) :
    (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).Ready T u v ↔
      I.Ready (I.splice S s T) (s + u) (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v) ∧
        I.release (I.owner (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) v)) + D ≤ s + u := by
  classical
  have hstart := hs _ (I.residualVertex_mem _ v)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hr, hv, hp⟩
    rw [I.phase_release_owner] at hr
    refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
    · rw [I.splice_residualVertex]
      omega
    · intro w hw
      by_cases hsur : w ∈ I.survivors S s
      · have hedge : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge (I.survivorIndex w hsur) v := by
          simpa only [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance, I.residualVertex_survivorIndex] using hw
        have ht := hp _ hedge
        simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur]
        omega
      · have ht : S w < s := by simpa [survivors] using hsur
        rw [I.splice_preserves_prefix T ht]
        omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨_, hv, hp⟩, hr⟩
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [I.phase_release_owner]
      omega
    · rw [I.splice_residualVertex] at hv
      omega
    · intro w hw
      have ht := hp (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) w) hw
      rw [I.splice_residualVertex] at ht
      omega

Scheduling.Instance.phase_readyObservati.source:
theorem phase_readyObservation {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {D s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card))
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D)
    [DecidableRel I.edge] [DecidableRel (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge]
    (u : ℕ) :
    renameObservation (I.residualLabel (I.survivors S s))
      ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).readyObservation T u) =
      delayObservation D s (s + u) (I.readyObservation (I.splice S s T) (s + u)) := by
  classical
  let R := I.survivors S s
  let J := I.phaseInstance R D s
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (J.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp hy
    have hg := (I.phase_ready_iff T hs u v).mp hv
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨I.fifoPriority (I.residualVertex R v), ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨(I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mpr ⟨_, hg.1, rfl⟩, hg.2⟩
    · simp [renameKey, fifoPriority, J, R]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp (mem_filter.mp hy).1
    have hvtime := hv.2.1
    have hdelay : I.release (I.owner v) + D ≤ s + u := (mem_filter.mp hy).2
    have hsur : v ∈ R := by
      have hh := (I.splice_survives T v).mp (show s ≤ I.splice S s T v by omega)
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hh⟩
    let w := I.survivorIndex v hsur
    have hw : I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) w = v := I.residualVertex_survivorIndex v hsur
    have hlocal : J.Ready T u w := (I.phase_ready_iff T hs u w).mpr
      ⟨by simpa only [hw] using hv, by simpa only [hw] using hdelay⟩
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨J.fifoPriority w, (J.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mpr ⟨w, hlocal, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    simp [renameKey, fifoPriority, J, R, hw]

Scheduling.Instance.splice_execution_set.source:
theorem splice_execution_set {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (u : ℕ) :
    univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u) =
      (univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s)) := by
  classical
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s :=
      mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (I.splice_survives T v).mp (by omega)⟩
    refine mem_image.mpr ⟨I.survivorIndex v hsur, ?_, I.residualVertex_survivorIndex v hsur⟩
    simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur] at he
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
  · intro hv
    obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hv
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [I.splice_residualVertex, (mem_filter.mp hw).2]⟩

Scheduling.Instance.splice_execution_pub.source:
theorem splice_execution_public {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (u : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u)).image Fin.val =
      ((univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image Fin.val).image (I.residualLabel (I.survivors S s)) := by
  classical
  rw [I.splice_execution_set, image_image, image_image]
  apply image_congr
  intro v _
  exact (I.residualLabel_apply _ v).symm

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

/-- An SFF phase, after restoring the original identifiers, realizes the
public SFF policy on delayed observations. This includes residual graphs
with fewer vertices and jobs than the original instance. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_publicPolic.source:
theorem sffPhase_publicPolicy {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (u : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.sffPhase m B hB S s v = s + u)).image Fin.val =
      (sffRawPolicy m B).decision
        (fun a => delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + a)
          (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (s + a))) u := by
  classical
  let R := I.survivors S s
  let J := I.phaseInstance R (44 * B ^ 2) s
  let T := J.sffSchedule m B hB
  have hobs : (fun a => renameObservation (I.residualLabel R) (J.readyObservation T a)) =
      fun a => delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + a)
        (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) (s + a)) := by
    funext a
    exact I.phase_readyObservation T hs a
  change (univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u)).image Fin.val = _
  rw [I.splice_execution_public]
  have he := J.sffSchedule_publicPolicy hm hB u
  change (univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image Fin.val = _ at he
  rw [he, ← sffRawPolicy_decision_rename (I.residualLabel_strictMono R), hobs]

/-- The permanent FIFO phase likewise uses only delayed ready observations
and the original public identifiers. -/

Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_publicPoli.source:
theorem fifoPhase_publicPolicy {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (u : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = s + u)).image Fin.val =
      fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + u)
        (I.readyObservation (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) (s + u))) := by
  classical
  let R := I.survivors S s
  let J := I.phaseInstance R (44 * B ^ 2) s
  let T := J.fifoSchedule m hm
  change (univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = s + u)).image Fin.val = _
  rw [I.splice_execution_public]
  have he := J.fifoSchedule_publicPolicy hm u
  change (univ.filter (fun v => T v = u)).image Fin.val = _ at he
  rw [he, ← fifoPolicy_rename (I.residualLabel_strictMono R)]
  congr 1
  exact I.phase_readyObservation T hs u

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.rebase.source:
def rebase (s : ℕ) : Instance jobs vertices :=
  { I with release := fun j => I.release j - s }

Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule.source:
def rebaseSchedule (_I : Instance jobs vertices) (O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) :
    Assignment (vertices := vertices) := fun v => O v - s

Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule_valid.source:
theorem rebaseSchedule_valid {m s : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hs : ∀ j, s ≤ I.release j) :
    (I.rebase s).Valid m (I.rebaseSchedule O s) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    exact Nat.sub_le_sub_right (hO.release v) s
  · intro u v he
    have hp := hO.precedence he
    have hu := (hs (I.owner u)).trans (hO.release u)
    change O u - s < O v - s
    omega
  · intro t
    have hsub : univ.filter (fun v => I.rebaseSchedule O s v = t) ⊆
        univ.filter (fun v => O v = t + s) := by
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hl := (hs (I.owner v)).trans (hO.release v)
      dsimp [rebaseSchedule] at he
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
    exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (hO.capacity _)

Scheduling.Instance.rebaseSchedule_flowB.source:
theorem rebaseSchedule_flowBound {m L s : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (hs : ∀ j, s ≤ I.release j) :
    (I.rebase s).FlowBound (I.rebaseSchedule O s) L := by
  intro v
  have h := hL v
  have ho := hO.release v
  have hr := hs (I.owner v)
  change O v - s < I.release (I.owner v) - s + L
  omega

/-- The phase instance retains exactly `R`, delays releases by `D`, then
sets its clock to zero at global time `s`. -/

Scheduling.Instance.phaseInstance.source:
noncomputable def phaseInstance (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ) :
    Instance (R.image I.owner).card R.card := (I.residualInstance R D).rebase s

Scheduling.Instance.phase_releases_after.source:
theorem phase_releases_after_start {R : Finset (Fin vertices)} {D s : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) :
    ∀ j, s ≤ (I.residualInstance R D).release j := by
  intro j
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (I.residualInstance R D).nonempty_job j
  have h := hs (I.residualVertex R v) ((R.orderIsoOfFin rfl) v).property
  have he : I.residualJob R j = I.owner (I.residualVertex R v) := by
    rw [← hv]
    exact I.residualJob_owner R v
  simpa [residualInstance, he] using h

Scheduling.Instance.phase_offline_bound.source:
theorem phase_offline_bound {m L : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) :
    ∃ T, (I.phaseInstance R D s).Valid m T ∧ (I.phaseInstance R D s).FlowBound T L := by
  let J := I.residualInstance R D
  refine ⟨J.rebaseSchedule (I.residualSchedule R D O) s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact J.rebaseSchedule_valid (I.residualSchedule_valid hO R D)
      (I.phase_releases_after_start hs)
  · exact J.rebaseSchedule_flowBound (I.residualSchedule_valid hO R D)
      (I.residualSchedule_flowBound hL R D)
      (I.phase_releases_after_start hs)

Scheduling.Instance.phase_optimum_le.source:
theorem phase_optimum_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D s : ℕ)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ R, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D) :
    (I.phaseInstance R D s).optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTL⟩ := I.phase_offline_bound hO hL R D s hs
  exact (I.phaseInstance R D s).optimum_le hm hT hTL

/-- Vertices not yet executed at the start, including future arrivals. -/

Scheduling.Instance.survivors.source:
noncomputable def survivors (_I : Instance jobs vertices) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin vertices) := univ.filter (fun v => s ≤ S v)

Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_survi.source:
@[simp] theorem residualVertex_survivorIndex {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s) (I.survivorIndex v hv) = v := by
  simp [residualVertex, survivorIndex]

/-- Keep the executed prefix and use a phase-local schedule for every
survivor. This operation does not reschedule any completed vertex. -/

Scheduling.Instance.splice.source:
noncomputable def splice (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ)
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  fun v => if hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s then s + T (I.survivorIndex v hv) else S v

Scheduling.Instance.splice_valid.source:
theorem splice_valid {m D s : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card))
    (hT : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).Valid m T) :
    I.Valid m (I.splice S s T) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    by_cases hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s
    · have hr := hT.release (I.survivorIndex v hv)
      simp only [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance, residualJob_owner,
        I.residualVertex_survivorIndex] at hr
      simp only [splice, dif_pos hv]
      omega
    · simpa only [splice, dif_neg hv] using hS.release v
  · intro u v he
    by_cases hu : u ∈ I.survivors S s
    · have hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s := by
        have hh := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
        have hp := hS.precedence he
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
      have hedge : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).edge
          (I.survivorIndex u hu) (I.survivorIndex v hv) := by
        simpa [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance] using he
      have hp := hT.precedence hedge
      simpa only [splice, dif_pos hu, dif_pos hv, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_left] using hp
    · have hus : S u < s := by
        simpa [survivors] using hu
      by_cases hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s
      · simp only [splice, dif_neg hu, dif_pos hv]
        omega
      · simpa only [splice, dif_neg hu, dif_neg hv] using hS.precedence he
  · intro t
    by_cases ht : t < s
    · apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)) ?_).trans (hS.capacity t)
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      by_cases hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s
      · simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur] at he
        omega
      · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by simpa only [splice, dif_neg hsur] using he⟩
    · let A := univ.filter (fun v => T v = t - s)
      have hsub : univ.filter (fun v => I.splice S s T v = t) ⊆
          A.image (I.residualVertex (I.survivors S s)) := by
        intro v hv
        have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
        have hsur : v ∈ I.survivors S s := by
          by_contra hn
          simp only [splice, dif_neg hn] at he
          have hlt : S v < s := by simpa [survivors] using hn
          omega
        refine mem_image.mpr ⟨I.survivorIndex v hsur, ?_, I.residualVertex_survivorIndex v hsur⟩
        simp only [splice, dif_pos hsur] at he
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
      exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_image_le.trans (hT.capacity (t - s)))


/-- A phase's local flow bound gives a global bound for its survivors. -/

Scheduling.Instance.splice_survivor_boun.source:
theorem splice_survivor_bound {D s K : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    {T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + D)
    (hT : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) D s).FlowBound T K)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.splice S s T v < I.release (I.owner v) + D + K := by
  have ht := hT (I.survivorIndex v hv)
  simp only [phaseInstance, rebase, residualInstance, residualJob_owner,
    I.residualVertex_survivorIndex] at ht
  have hr := hs v hv
  simp only [splice, dif_pos hv]
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.splice_survives.source:
theorem splice_survives {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {s : ℕ}
    (T : Assignment (vertices := (I.survivors S s).card)) (v : Fin vertices) :
    s ≤ I.splice S s T v ↔ s ≤ S v := by
  classical
  by_cases hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s
  · have hs := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    simp only [splice, dif_pos hv]
    omega
  · simp only [splice, dif_neg hv]

/-- A fresh SFF phase with artificial delay `44 B²`, expressed as a global
assignment by splicing its local run into the completed prefix. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase.source:
noncomputable def sffPhase (m B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice S s ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).sffSchedule m B hB)

Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase.source:
noncomputable def fifoPhase (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (B : ℕ)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s : ℕ) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice S s ((I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).fifoSchedule m hm)

Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_valid.source:
theorem sffPhase_valid {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hS : I.Valid m S) :
    I.Valid m (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice_valid hS _ ((I.phaseInstance _ _ _).sffSchedule_valid hm hB)

Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_valid.source:
theorem fifoPhase_valid {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hS : I.Valid m S) :
    I.Valid m (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) := by
  classical
  exact I.splice_valid hS _ ((I.phaseInstance _ _ _).fifoSchedule_valid hm)

Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_survivor_bo.source:
theorem sffPhase_survivor_bound {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (hguess : I.optimum m hm ≤ B) (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.sffPhase m B hB S s v < I.release (I.owner v) + 88 * B ^ 2 := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hTL⟩ := I.phase_offline_bound hO hL (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s hs
  have hTB : (I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s).FlowBound T B := by
    intro w; exact (hTL w).trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left hguess _)
  have hb := (I.phaseInstance _ _ _).sffSchedule_bound hm hB hT hTB
  have hf := ((I.phaseInstance _ _ _).flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mpr hb
  have hg := I.splice_survivor_bound hs hf v hv
  change I.sffPhase m B hB S s v < _ at hg
  nlinarith

Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_survivor_b.source:
theorem fifoPhase_survivor_bound {m B s : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2)
    (v : Fin vertices) (hv : v ∈ I.survivors S s) :
    I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v <
      I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2 + 44 * m * I.optimum m hm := by
  classical
  let J := I.phaseInstance (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s
  have ho := I.phase_optimum_le hm (I.survivors S s) (44 * B ^ 2) s hs
  change J.optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm at ho
  have hb := J.fifoSchedule_competitive hm
  have hflow : J.maxFlow (J.fifoSchedule m hm) ≤ 44 * m * I.optimum m hm := by
    have hc : m * m + m - 1 ≤ 44 * m * m := by
      have hsq := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m (show 1 ≤ m by omega)
      have hsub := Nat.sub_le (m * m + m) 1
      nlinarith
    have hcomp := Nat.mul_le_mul hc ho
    nlinarith
  exact I.splice_survivor_bound hs ((J.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le _ _).mpr hflow) v hv

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.phaseHistory.source:
def phaseHistory (B s : ℕ) (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (u : ℕ) : FIFOObservation :=
  delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s (s + u) (history (s + u))

/-- Only failures observed by the queried time are searched. In particular,
the public controller never tests whether a phase will fail in the future. -/

Scheduling.publicFailures.source:
def publicFailures (B s : ℕ) (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (t : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  (Icc s t).filter (fun u => deadlineVisible B u (history u) = true)

Scheduling.publicCombined.source:
def publicCombined (m : ℕ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → (ℕ → FIFOObservation) → ℕ → Finset ℕ
  | 0, B, s, history, t => fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s t (history t))
  | fuel + 1, B, s, history, t =>
    if B < m then
      if hf : (publicFailures B s history t).Nonempty then
        publicCombined m fuel (2 * B) ((publicFailures B s history t).min' hf) history t
      else (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s history) (t - s)
    else fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s t (history t))

Scheduling.publicFailures_congr.source:
theorem publicFailures_congr (B s t : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → FIFOObservation)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) : publicFailures B s a t = publicFailures B s b t := by
  apply filter_congr
  intro u hu
  rw [h u (mem_Icc.mp hu).2]

/-- Causality of the public controller, independently of any scheduling
instance: equal observation prefixes give equal decisions. -/

Scheduling.publicCombined_causal.source:
theorem publicCombined_causal (m fuel B s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (a b : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (h : ∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) :
    publicCombined m fuel B s a t = publicCombined m fuel B s b t := by
  induction fuel generalizing B s with
  | zero => simp only [publicCombined, h t le_rfl]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hswitch : B < m
    · simp only [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, publicFailures_congr B s t a b h]
      by_cases hf : (publicFailures B s b t).Nonempty
      · simp only [dif_pos hf]
        have ht := (mem_Icc.mp (mem_filter.mp (min'_mem _ hf)).1).2
        exact ih (2 * B) _ ht
      · simp only [dif_neg hf]
        apply (sffRawPolicy m B).decision_eq_of_history_eq
        intro u hu
        have hle : s + u ≤ t := by omega
        simp only [phaseHistory, h (s + u) hle]
    · simp only [publicCombined, if_neg hswitch, h t le_rfl]

Scheduling.publicFailures_empty.source:
theorem publicFailures_empty {B s t : ℕ} {history : ℕ → FIFOObservation}
    (h : ∀ u, s ≤ u → u ≤ t → deadlineVisible B u (history u) = false) :
    publicFailures B s history t = ∅ := by
  apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
  intro u hu
  have hh := mem_filter.mp hu
  have ht := mem_Icc.mp hh.1
  have he := h u ht.1 ht.2
  simp [he] at hh

Scheduling.publicFailures_min_eq.source:
theorem publicFailures_min_eq {B s t f : ℕ} {history : ℕ → FIFOObservation}
    (hs : s ≤ f) (ht : f ≤ t)
    (hvisible : deadlineVisible B f (history f) = true)
    (hbefore : ∀ u, s ≤ u → u < f → deadlineVisible B u (history u) = false)
    (hne : (publicFailures B s history t).Nonempty) :
    (publicFailures B s history t).min' hne = f := by
  have hmem : f ∈ publicFailures B s history t :=
    mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hs, ht⟩, hvisible⟩
  apply le_antisymm (min'_le _ _ hmem)
  by_contra hn
  have hx := mem_filter.mp (min'_mem _ hne)
  have hh := hbefore _ (mem_Icc.mp hx.1).1 (by omega)
  simp [hh] at hx

Scheduling.phaseDecision_congr.source:
theorem phaseDecision_congr (m B s t : ℕ) (hst : s ≤ t)
    (a b : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (h : ∀ u ≤ t, a u = b u) :
    (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s a) (t - s) =
      (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s b) (t - s) := by
  apply (sffRawPolicy m B).decision_eq_of_history_eq
  intro u hu
  have ht : s + u ≤ t := by omega
  simp only [phaseHistory, h (s + u) ht]

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_executio.source:
theorem combinedAux_execution_prefix {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (ht : t < s) :
    univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t) =
      univ.filter (fun v => S v = t) := by
  classical
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  have h₀ := I.combinedAux_prefix_time hm fuel B hB S s t ht.le v
  have h₁ := I.combinedAux_prefix_time hm fuel B hB S s (t + 1) (by omega) v
  omega

variable [DecidableRel I.edge]

Scheduling.Instance.sffPhase_publicPolic.source:
theorem sffPhase_publicPolicy_at {m B s t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hB : 0 < B)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.sffPhase m B hB S s v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (sffRawPolicy m B).decision (phaseHistory B s (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)))
        (t - s) := by
  have h := I.sffPhase_publicPolicy hm hB hs (t - s)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hst] at h
  exact h

Scheduling.Instance.fifoPhase_publicPoli.source:
theorem fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at {m B s t : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoPhase m hm B S s v = t)).image Fin.val =
      fifoPolicy m (delayObservation (44 * B ^ 2) s t (I.readyObservation (I.fifoPhase m hm B S s) t)) := by
  have h := I.fifoPhase_publicPolicy hm hs (t - s)
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hst] at h
  exact h

/-- The finite phase construction realizes the causal public-history
controller. This proof uses no optimum or performance bound. -/

Scheduling.Instance.combinedAux_publicPo.source:
theorem combinedAux_publicPolicy {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (fuel B : ℕ) (hB : 0 < B) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (s t : ℕ)
    (hst : s ≤ t)
    (hs : ∀ v ∈ I.survivors S s, s ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 44 * B ^ 2) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s v = t)).image Fin.val =
      publicCombined m fuel B s (I.readyObservation (I.combinedAux m hm fuel B hB S s)) t := by
  classical
  induction fuel generalizing B S s with
  | zero => exact I.fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hst hs
  | succ fuel ih =>
    by_cases hswitch : B < m
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_pos hswitch]
      by_cases hf : I.PhaseFails (I.sffPhase m B hB S s) s B
      · rw [dif_pos hf]
        let C := I.sffPhase m B hB S s
        let f := I.failureTime hf
        let A := I.combinedAux m hm fuel (2 * B) (by omega) C f
        have hsf : s ≤ f := (I.failureTime_spec hf).1
        have hobs : ∀ u ≤ f, I.readyObservation A u = I.readyObservation C u := by
          intro u hu
          exact I.combinedAux_readyObservation hm fuel (2 * B) (by omega) C f u hu
        have hstart := I.sffPhase_start_bound (m := m) hB hs
        have hbefore : ∀ u, s ≤ u → u < f →
            deadlineVisible B u (I.readyObservation A u) = false := by
          intro u hsu huf
          rw [hobs u huf.le]
          exact I.before_failure_not_visible hf hstart hsu huf
        change (univ.filter (fun v => A v = t)).image Fin.val =
          publicCombined m (fuel + 1) B s (I.readyObservation A) t
        by_cases htf : t < f
        · have he : publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation A) t = ∅ :=
            publicFailures_empty (by intro u hsu hut; exact hbefore u hsu (by omega))
          have hn : ¬ (publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation A) t).Nonempty := by
            rw [he]
            exact Finset.not_nonempty_empty
          rw [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, dif_neg hn]
          have hexec := I.combinedAux_execution_prefix hm fuel (2 * B) (by omega) C f t htf
          change univ.filter (fun v => A v = t) = univ.filter (fun v => C v = t) at hexec
          rw [hexec]
          exact (I.sffPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hB hst hs).trans
            (phaseDecision_congr m B s t hst _ _ (by intro u hu; exact (hobs u (by omega)).symm))
        · have hft : f ≤ t := by omega
          have hv : deadlineVisible B f (I.readyObservation A f) = true := by
            rw [hobs f le_rfl]
            exact I.failureTime_visible hf
          have hne : (publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation A) t).Nonempty :=
            ⟨f, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_Icc.mpr ⟨hsf, hft⟩, hv⟩⟩
          rw [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, dif_pos hne,
            publicFailures_min_eq hsf hft hv hbefore hne]
          exact ih (2 * B) (by omega) C f hft (I.doubled_phase_start hB hs hf)
      · rw [dif_neg hf]
        have hstart := I.sffPhase_start_bound (m := m) hB hs
        have he : publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)) t = ∅ :=
          publicFailures_empty (by intro u hsu _; exact I.no_failure_not_visible hf hstart hsu)
        have hn : ¬ (publicFailures B s (I.readyObservation (I.sffPhase m B hB S s)) t).Nonempty := by
          rw [he]
          exact Finset.not_nonempty_empty
        rw [publicCombined, if_pos hswitch, dif_neg hn]
        exact I.sffPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hB hst hs
    · simp only [combinedAux, if_neg hswitch, publicCombined]
      exact I.fifoPhase_publicPolicy_at hm hst hs

Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_pub.source:
theorem combinedSchedule_publicPolicy {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      publicCombined m m 1 0 (I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm)) t :=
  I.combinedAux_publicPolicy hm m 1 (by omega) I.serialSchedule 0 t (by omega) (by intros; omega)

/-- Full cross-instance non-clairvoyance of the combined scheduler. Its
guesses, restarts, and execution decisions require only observed history. -/

Scheduling.Instance.combinedSchedule_non.source:
theorem combinedSchedule_nonclairvoyant {otherJobs otherVertices m : ℕ}
    (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, I.readyObservation (I.combinedSchedule m hm) u =
      J.readyObservation (J.combinedSchedule m hm) u) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (univ.filter (fun v => J.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val := by
  rw [I.combinedSchedule_publicPolicy hm, J.combinedSchedule_publicPolicy hm]
  exact publicCombined_causal m m 1 0 t (by omega) _ _ h

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.GraphObservation.source:
structure GraphObservation where
  arrivals : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)
  visible : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)
  edges : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)
  ready : Finset ℕ
  deriving DecidableEq

Scheduling.val_mem_executionPrefix.source:
@[simp] theorem val_mem_executionPrefix {vertices t : ℕ}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (v : Fin vertices) :
    v.val ∈ executionPrefix S t ↔ S v < t := by
  simp only [executionPrefix, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hval⟩
    have : w = v := Fin.ext hval
    subst w
    exact hw
  · intro h; exact ⟨v, h, rfl⟩

Scheduling.val_mem_executionSlot.source:
@[simp] theorem val_mem_executionSlot {vertices t : ℕ}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (v : Fin vertices) :
    v.val ∈ executionSlot S t ↔ S v = t := by
  simp only [executionSlot, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, hw, hval⟩
    have : w = v := Fin.ext hval
    subst w
    exact hw
  · intro h; exact ⟨v, h, rfl⟩

Scheduling.mem_executionPrefix.source:
theorem mem_executionPrefix {vertices n t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} :
    n ∈ executionPrefix S t ↔ ∃ u < t, n ∈ executionSlot S u := by
  simp only [executionPrefix, executionSlot, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hn⟩
    exact ⟨S v, hv, v, rfl, hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, v, hv, hn⟩
    exact ⟨v, by omega, hn⟩

Scheduling.executionPrefix_eq_of_slots.source:
theorem executionPrefix_eq_of_slots {vertices otherVertices t : ℕ}
    {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {T : Assignment (vertices := otherVertices)}
    (h : ∀ u < t, executionSlot S u = executionSlot T u) :
    executionPrefix S t = executionPrefix T t := by
  ext n
  simp only [mem_executionPrefix]
  constructor <;> rintro ⟨u, hu, hn⟩
  · exact ⟨u, hu, by rwa [← h u hu]⟩
  · exact ⟨u, hu, by rwa [h u hu]⟩

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

Scheduling.Instance.revealedVertices.source:
noncomputable def revealedVertices (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => I.release (I.owner v) ≤ t ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u v → u.val ∈ done)

Scheduling.Instance.graphObservation.source:
noncomputable def graphObservation (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ) : GraphObservation where
  arrivals := (univ.filter (fun j => I.release j ≤ t)).image (fun j => (j.val, I.release j))
  visible := (I.revealedVertices done t).image (fun v => (v.val, (I.owner v).val))
  edges := ((I.revealedVertices done t).product (I.revealedVertices done t)).filter
    (fun e => I.edge e.1 e.2) |>.image (fun e => (e.1.val, e.2.val))
  ready := ((I.revealedVertices done t).filter (fun v => v.val ∉ done)).image Fin.val

Scheduling.Instance.graphObservation_con.source:
theorem graphObservation_congr (J : Instance jobs vertices) (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ)
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (hv : I.revealedVertices done t = J.revealedVertices done t)
    (he : ∀ u ∈ I.revealedVertices done t, ∀ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t,
      I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v) : I.graphObservation done t = J.graphObservation done t := by
  have hedges :
      ((I.revealedVertices done t).product (I.revealedVertices done t)).filter (fun e => I.edge e.1 e.2) =
      ((I.revealedVertices done t).product (I.revealedVertices done t)).filter (fun e => J.edge e.1 e.2) := by
    apply filter_congr
    intro e he'
    exact he _ (mem_product.mp he').1 _ (mem_product.mp he').2
  unfold graphObservation
  rw [hedges, ho, hr, hv]

Scheduling.Instance.hidden_graphObservat.source:
theorem hidden_graphObservation_congr (J : Instance jobs vertices)
    (hidden : Finset (Fin vertices)) (done : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ)
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (he : ∀ u v, v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v))
    (hI : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ u.val ∉ done)
    (hJ : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ u.val ∉ done) :
    I.graphObservation done t = J.graphObservation done t := by
  have houtside : ∀ v ∈ I.revealedVertices done t, v ∉ hidden := by
    intro v hv hhidden
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hn⟩ := hI v hhidden
    exact hn ((mem_filter.mp hv).2.2 u hu)
  apply I.graphObservation_congr J done t ho hr
  · ext v
    simp only [revealedVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    by_cases hv : v ∈ hidden
    · obtain ⟨u, hu, hn⟩ := hI v hv
      obtain ⟨w, hw, hm⟩ := hJ v hv
      constructor
      · intro h; exact False.elim (hn (h.2 u hu))
      · intro h; exact False.elim (hm (h.2 w hw))
    · simp only [ho, hr]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨h.1, fun u hu => h.2 u ((he u v hv).mpr hu)⟩
      · intro h
        exact ⟨h.1, fun u hu => h.2 u ((he u v hv).mp hu)⟩
  · intro u _ v hv
    exact he u v (houtside v hv)

end Instance

/-- Extensional formulation of a deterministic online scheduler. Total
assignments suffice for lower bounds against algorithms with finite flow.
The causality field uses the full revealed graph, not just ready labels. -/

Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.source:
structure DeterministicScheduler (m : ℕ) where
  schedule : {jobs vertices : ℕ} → Instance jobs vertices → Assignment (vertices := vertices)
  valid : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices), I.Valid m (schedule I)
  causal : ∀ {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices) (t : ℕ),
    (∀ u ≤ t, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (schedule J) u) u) →
    executionSlot (schedule I) t = executionSlot (schedule J) t

namespace DeterministicScheduler
variable {m : ℕ} (A : DeterministicScheduler m)

/-- An adaptive replacement can be checked along the old execution alone.
If it changes no observations through `T`, the new instance reproduces
every old decision through `T`. This removes the apparent circularity in
changing hidden edges while preserving a scheduler's past behavior. -/

Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.transf.source:
theorem transfer_slots {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices T : ℕ}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) :
    ∀ t ≤ T, executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = executionSlot (A.schedule J) t := by
  intro t
  induction t using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h t ih =>
    intro ht
    apply A.causal I J t
    intro u hu
    have hp : executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u = executionPrefix (A.schedule J) u :=
      executionPrefix_eq_of_slots (by
        intro k hk
        exact ih k (by omega) (by omega))
    rw [← hp]
    exact h u (by omega)

theorem transfer_prefix {jobs vertices otherJobs otherVertices T : ℕ}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u) :
    executionPrefix (A.schedule I) (T + 1) = executionPrefix (A.schedule J) (T + 1) :=
  executionPrefix_eq_of_slots (by intro u hu; exact A.transfer_slots I J h u (by omega))

theorem transfer_time {jobs vertices T : ℕ}
    (I J : Instance jobs vertices)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) u) u)
    (v : Fin vertices) (ht : A.schedule I v ≤ T) : A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v := by
  have he := A.transfer_slots I J h (A.schedule I v) ht
  have hm : v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule I) (A.schedule I v) :=
    mem_image.mpr ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [he] at hm
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hv⟩ := mem_image.mp hm
  have heq : w = v := Fin.ext hv
  subst w
  exact (mem_filter.mp hw).2

Scheduling.DeterministicScheduler.hidden.source:
theorem hidden_replacement {jobs vertices T : ℕ}
    (I J : Instance jobs vertices) (hidden : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (ho : I.owner = J.owner) (hr : I.release = J.release)
    (he : ∀ u v, v ∉ hidden → (I.edge u v ↔ J.edge u v))
    (hI : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, I.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u)
    (hJ : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧ T ≤ A.schedule I u) :
    (∀ t ≤ T, executionSlot (A.schedule I) t = executionSlot (A.schedule J) t) ∧
      (∀ v, A.schedule I v ≤ T → A.schedule J v = A.schedule I v) := by
  have hobs : ∀ t ≤ T, I.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) t) t =
      J.graphObservation (executionPrefix (A.schedule I) t) t := by
    intro t ht
    apply I.hidden_graphObservation_congr J hidden _ t ho hr he
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, htime⟩ := hI v hv
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      simp only [executionPrefix, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      rintro ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩
      have : w = u := Fin.ext hwu
      subst w
      omega
    · intro v hv
      obtain ⟨u, hu, htime⟩ := hJ v hv
      refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
      simp only [executionPrefix, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      rintro ⟨w, hw, hwu⟩
      have : w = u := Fin.ext hwu
      subst w
      omega
  exact ⟨A.transfer_slots I J hobs, A.transfer_time I J hobs⟩

end DeterministicScheduler
end Scheduling

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.source:
structure PublicSnapshot where
  support : Finset ℕ
  ready : ℕ → Finset ℕ
  supported : ∀ b, b ∈ support ↔ (ready b).Nonempty

namespace PublicSnapshot

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.ext_ready.source:
theorem ext_ready {Q R : PublicSnapshot} (h : Q.ready = R.ready) : Q = R := by
  cases Q with
  | mk qs qr qp =>
    cases R with
    | mk rs rr rp =>
      change qr = rr at h
      subst rr
      have hs : qs = rs := by
        ext b
        exact (qp b).trans (rp b).symm
      subst rs
      rfl

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.small.source:
def small (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Q.support.filter (fun b => (Q.ready b).card ≤ m)

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.large.source:
def large (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Q.support.filter (fun b => m < (Q.ready b).card)

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.smallFront.source: def smallFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ := (Q.small m).biUnion Q.ready

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.filler.source:
def filler (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Option ℕ :=
  if h : (Q.large m).Nonempty then some ((Q.large m).min' h) else none

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.fillerFront.source:
def fillerFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  match Q.filler m with | none => ∅ | some b => Q.ready b

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.duration.source: def duration (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m : ℕ) : ℕ := Packing.duration (Q.smallFront m).card m

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.action.source:
def action (Q : PublicSnapshot) (m k : ℕ) : Finset ℕ :=
  Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k ∪
    if k + 1 = Q.duration m then
      Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0 (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card)
    else ∅

end PublicSnapshot

namespace ReadySnapshot
variable {vertices batches : ℕ} (Q : ReadySnapshot (Fin vertices) batches)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose.source:
def expose : PublicSnapshot where
  support := (univ.filter (fun b => (Q.ready b).Nonempty)).image Fin.val
  ready := fun n => if hn : n < batches then (Q.ready ⟨n, hn⟩).image Fin.val else ∅
  supported := by
    intro n
    by_cases hn : n < batches
    · simp only [dif_pos hn, image_nonempty, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨b, hb, he⟩
        have hb' : b = ⟨n, hn⟩ := Fin.ext he
        simpa [hb'] using hb
      · intro h
        exact ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, h, rfl⟩
    · simp only [dif_neg hn, Finset.not_nonempty_empty, iff_false, mem_image, mem_filter,
        mem_univ, true_and]
      rintro ⟨b, _, he⟩
      exact hn (he ▸ b.isLt)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_ready.source:
@[simp] theorem expose_ready (b : Fin batches) :
    Q.expose.ready b.val = (Q.ready b).image Fin.val := by
  simp [expose]

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.mem_expose_read.source:
theorem mem_expose_ready (b n : ℕ) : n ∈ Q.expose.ready b ↔
    ∃ c : Fin batches, c.val = b ∧ ∃ v, v ∈ Q.ready c ∧ v.val = n := by
  by_cases hb : b < batches
  · simp only [expose, dif_pos hb, mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, he⟩
      exact ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, rfl, v, hv, he⟩
    · rintro ⟨c, hc, v, hv, he⟩
      have hcb : c = ⟨b, hb⟩ := Fin.ext hc
      exact ⟨v, by simpa [hcb] using hv, he⟩
  · simp only [expose, dif_neg hb, notMem_empty, false_iff]
    rintro ⟨c, hc, _⟩
    exact hb (hc ▸ c.isLt)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_small.source:
theorem expose_small (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.small m = (Q.small m).image Fin.val := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    have hn' := mem_filter.mp hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn'.1
    have hp : 0 < (Q.ready b).card := card_pos.mpr (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    have hc : (Q.ready b).card ≤ m := by
      simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hn'.2
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hp, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    have hb' := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, card_pos.mp hb'.1⟩, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hb'.2

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_large.source:
theorem expose_large (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.large m = (Q.large m).image Fin.val := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    have hn' := mem_filter.mp hn
    obtain ⟨b, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn'.1
    have hc : m < (Q.ready b).card := by
      simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hn'.2
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hc⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    have hb' := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, card_pos.mp (by omega)⟩, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [Q.expose_ready, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective] using hb'

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_smallFro.source:
theorem expose_smallFront (m : ℕ) :
    Q.expose.smallFront m = (Q.smallFront m).image Fin.val := by
  ext n
  constructor
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hv⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hn
    rw [Q.expose_small] at hk
    obtain ⟨b, hb, he⟩ := mem_image.mp hk
    subst k
    rw [Q.expose_ready] at hv
    obtain ⟨v, hw, he⟩ := mem_image.mp hv
    subst n
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨b, hb, hw⟩, rfl⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hv⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hv
    apply mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨b.val, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Q.expose_small]
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    · rw [Q.expose_ready]
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_filler.source:
theorem expose_filler (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.filler m = (Q.filler m).map Fin.val := by
  unfold PublicSnapshot.filler ReadySnapshot.filler
  rw [Q.expose_large]
  by_cases h : (Q.large m).Nonempty
  · simp only [h, image_nonempty, ↓reduceDIte, Option.map_some]
    congr 1
    exact min'_image (f := Fin.val) (show Monotone (Fin.val : Fin batches → ℕ) from fun _ _ hab => hab) _ _
  · simp only [h, image_nonempty, ↓reduceDIte, Option.map_none]

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_fillerFr.source:
theorem expose_fillerFront (m : ℕ) :
    Q.expose.fillerFront m = (Q.fillerFront m).image Fin.val := by
  unfold PublicSnapshot.fillerFront ReadySnapshot.fillerFront
  rw [Q.expose_filler]
  cases h : Q.filler m with
  | none => simp
  | some b => simp only [Option.map_some, Q.expose_ready]

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_duration.source:
theorem expose_duration (m : ℕ) : Q.expose.duration m = Q.duration m := by
  unfold PublicSnapshot.duration ReadySnapshot.duration
  rw [Q.expose_smallFront, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective]

/-- The public planner computes exactly the finite executor's round actions. -/

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.expose_action.source:
theorem expose_action (m k : ℕ) : Q.expose.action m k = (Q.action m k).image Fin.val := by
  have hmono : StrictMono (Fin.val : Fin vertices → ℕ) := fun _ _ h => h
  unfold PublicSnapshot.action ReadySnapshot.action
  rw [Q.expose_smallFront, Q.expose_fillerFront, Q.expose_duration]
  rw [← Packing.slot_image _ _ hmono, card_image_of_injective _ Fin.val_injective]
  rw [image_union]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Packing.slice_image _ _ hmono, image_empty]

end ReadySnapshot
end Scheduling

Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler.source:
structure RandomizedScheduler (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (m : ℕ) where
  scheduler : Ω → DeterministicScheduler m
  measurableFlow : ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices),
    Measurable (fun ω => (I.maxFlow ((scheduler ω).schedule I) : ℝ≥0∞))

namespace RandomizedScheduler
variable {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] {m : ℕ}

/-- Extended nonnegative expectation also covers infinite expected flow. -/

Scheduling.RandomizedScheduler.expectedF.source:
noncomputable def expectedFlow (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) (μ : Measure Ω)
    {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices) : ℝ≥0∞ :=
  ∫⁻ ω, (I.maxFlow ((A.scheduler ω).schedule I) : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ

end RandomizedScheduler

namespace FiniteAmplification

/-- Finite-input averaging over an arbitrary probability space of seeds.
The selected input is independent of the seed. -/

Scheduling.FiniteAmplification.exists_ex.source:
theorem exists_expected_large {β Ω : Type*} [Fintype β] [Nonempty β]
    [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
    (cost : β → Ω → ℕ) (F : ℕ)
    (hmeas : ∀ b, Measurable (fun ω => (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞)))
    (hlower : ∀ ω, Fintype.card β * F ≤ 2 * ∑ b, cost b ω) :
    ∃ b, (F : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * ∫⁻ ω, (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ := by
  have hp : ∀ ω, (Fintype.card β : ℝ≥0∞) * F ≤ 2 * ∑ b, (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞) := by
    intro ω
    exact_mod_cast hlower ω
  have hi := lintegral_mono hp (μ := μ)
  rw [lintegral_const, measure_univ, mul_one,
    lintegral_const_mul' _ _ (by norm_num), lintegral_finsetSum univ (fun b _ => hmeas b)] at hi
  have hs : (∑ _b : β, (F : ℝ≥0∞)) ≤ ∑ b : β, 2 * ∫⁻ ω, (cost b ω : ℝ≥0∞) ∂μ := by
    simpa only [sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, ← mul_sum] using hi
  obtain ⟨b, _, hb⟩ := ENNReal.exists_le_of_sum_le (s := univ) univ_nonempty hs
  exact ⟨b, hb⟩

end FiniteAmplification

namespace InstanceSequence
variable {α Ω : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α] [MeasurableSpace Ω] {m : ℕ}

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.sum_flow_low.source:
theorem sum_flow_lower (G : α → PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ) (A : DeterministicScheduler m)
    (hgap : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + F ≤ D)
    (hhard : ∀ P : PackedInstance, ∀ d, ∃ x, F ≤ (P.append (G x) d).onlineFlow A) :
    Fintype.card (Fin (Fintype.card α) → α) * F ≤
      2 * ∑ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α, (concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).onlineFlow A :=
  FiniteAmplification.cost_sum_lower (fun xs => (concatenate G D xs).onlineFlow A) F
    (bad_persists G D F A hgap) (exists_bad_next G D F A hhard)

Scheduling.InstanceSequence.exists_expec.source:
theorem exists_expected_flow (G : α → PackedInstance) (D F : ℕ)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m)
    (hgap : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + F ≤ D)
    (hhard : ∀ B : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ P : PackedInstance, ∀ d,
      ∃ x, F ≤ (P.append (G x) d).onlineFlow B) :
    ∃ w : Fin (Fintype.card α) → α,
      (F : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ (concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).graph := by
  apply FiniteAmplification.exists_expected_large μ
    (fun w ω => (concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)).onlineFlow (A.scheduler ω)) F
  · intro w
    exact A.measurableFlow _
  · intro ω
    exact sum_flow_lower G D F (A.scheduler ω) hgap (hhard _)

end InstanceSequence
end Scheduling

Scheduling.HardFamily.expected_lower.source:
theorem expected_lower {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    {jobs m L b c : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m)
    (S : Finset (ForestCode jobs (m * L)))
    (hopt : ∀ P ∈ S, L ≤ (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ∧
      (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)).optimum m hm ≤ b * L)
    (hhard : ∀ B : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ Q : PackedInstance, ∀ d,
      ∃ P ∈ S, c * L ≤ (Q.graph.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)) d).maxFlow
        (B.schedule (Q.graph.append (P.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)) d))) :
    ∃ Q : PackedInstance,
      (∀ u v w, Q.graph.edge u w → Q.graph.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ Q.graph.optimum m hm ∧ Q.graph.optimum m hm ≤ b * L ∧
      (∀ j, L ∣ Q.graph.release j) ∧ (c * L : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ Q.graph := by
  let α := {P // P ∈ S}
  have hΩ := nonempty_of_isProbabilityMeasure μ
  obtain ⟨ω⟩ := hΩ
  obtain ⟨P, hP, _⟩ := hhard (A.scheduler ω) PackedInstance.empty 0
  let : Nonempty α := ⟨⟨P, hP⟩⟩
  let G : α → PackedInstance := fun x => ⟨jobs, jobs * (m * L), x.val.toInstance L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL)⟩
  let D := (jobs + b + c) * L
  have hgapB : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + b * L ≤ D := by
    intro x j
    have hj := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (Nat.le_of_lt j.isLt)
    change j.val * L + b * L ≤ (jobs + b + c) * L
    nlinarith
  have hgapC : ∀ x j, (G x).graph.release j + c * L ≤ D := by
    intro x j
    have hj := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (Nat.le_of_lt j.isLt)
    change j.val * L + c * L ≤ (jobs + b + c) * L
    nlinarith
  have hoff : ∀ x, ∃ O, (G x).graph.Valid m O ∧ (G x).graph.FlowBound O (b * L) := by
    intro x
    obtain ⟨O, hO, hf⟩ := (G x).graph.optimum_attained hm
    refine ⟨O, hO, ?_⟩
    intro v
    exact (hf v).trans_le (Nat.add_le_add_left (hopt x.val x.property).2 _)
  have hnext : ∀ B : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ Q : PackedInstance, ∀ d,
      ∃ x, c * L ≤ (Q.append (G x) d).onlineFlow B := by
    intro B Q d
    obtain ⟨P, hP, hf⟩ := hhard B Q d
    exact ⟨⟨P, hP⟩, hf⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := InstanceSequence.exists_expected_flow G D (c * L) μ A hgapC hnext
  have hne : List.ofFn w ≠ [] := by
    intro he
    have hh := congrArg List.length he
    simp only [List.length_ofFn, List.length_nil] at hh
    exact (Nat.ne_of_gt (Fintype.card_pos (α := α))) hh
  let Q := InstanceSequence.concatenate G D (List.ofFn w)
  refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact InstanceSequence.outForest G D (fun x _ _ _ hu hv => x.val.outForest L (Nat.mul_pos hm hL) hu hv) _
  · exact InstanceSequence.optimum_ge G D L hm (fun x => (hopt x.val x.property).1) _ hne
  · obtain ⟨O, hO, hf⟩ := InstanceSequence.offline G D (b * L) m hoff hgapB (List.ofFn w)
    exact Q.graph.optimum_le hm hO hf
  · exact InstanceSequence.batched_releases G D L (dvd_mul_left L _) (fun x j => dvd_mul_left L j.val) _
  · simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using hw

end Scheduling.HardFamily

Scheduling.randomized_lower_bound.source:
theorem randomized_lower_bound {m c L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hL : 0 < L)
    (heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L) (hcL : 16 * c ≤ L) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ I.optimum m (by omega) ∧ I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * L ∧
      (c * L : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  obtain ⟨Q, hf, hlo, hhi, _, hexp⟩ := HardFamily.expected_lower (b := 2) (c := c)
    (by omega : 0 < m) hL μ A (HardFamily.general (c * (c * (m * L))) m L (by omega) hL)
    (fun P hP => (HardFamily.mem_general P).mp hP)
    (fun B Q d => HardFamily.general_hard_after hm hc hL heven hcL hcm B Q.graph d)
  exact ⟨Q.jobs, Q.vertices, Q.graph, hf, hlo, hhi, hexp⟩

/-- The `Ω(min(m, OPT))` lower bound for arbitrary measurable randomized
causal schedulers, at every positive scale divisible by sixteen. -/

Scheduling.randomized_competitive_lower.source:
theorem randomized_competitive_lower {m L : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hL : 16 ≤ L) (hdiv : 16 ∣ L)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      L ≤ I.optimum m (by omega) ∧ I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * L ∧
      (↑(min m (I.optimum m (by omega))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        128 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  let c := min (m / 2) (L / 16)
  have hc : 0 < c := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hcL : 16 * c ≤ L := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hcm : 2 * c ≤ m := by dsimp [c]; omega
  have hmod := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
  have heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L := by omega
  obtain ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hlo, hhi, hexp⟩ :=
    randomized_lower_bound hm hc (by omega) heven hcL hcm μ A
  refine ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hlo, hhi, ?_⟩
  have hmin : min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) ≤ 32 * c := by
    by_cases hh : m / 2 ≤ L / 16
    · have he : c = m / 2 := min_eq_left hh
      omega
    · have he : c = L / 16 := min_eq_right (by omega)
      omega
  have hn : min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 64 * (c * L) := by
    have h₁ := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (I.optimum m (by omega)) hmin
    have h₂ := Nat.mul_le_mul_left c hhi
    nlinarith
  calc
    (↑(min m (I.optimum m (by omega))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        64 * (c * L : ℝ≥0∞) := by
          have hh : (↑(min m (I.optimum m (by omega)) * I.optimum m (by omega)) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ↑(64 * (c * L)) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
          simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hh
    _ ≤ 64 * (2 * A.expectedFlow μ I) := mul_le_mul le_rfl hexp zero_le zero_le
    _ = 128 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by ring

/-- Randomized batched lower bound with exact optimum and releases at
multiples of that optimum. The entire instance is fixed before the seed. -/

Scheduling.randomized_batched_lower_boun.source:
theorem randomized_batched_lower_bound {m c : ℕ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
      (∀ j, I.optimum m (by omega) ∣ I.release j) ∧
      (c : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 2 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  let L := 8 * c * 5 ^ c
  have hL : 0 < L := Nat.mul_pos (Nat.mul_pos (by omega) hc) (pow_pos (by omega) c)
  have hdiv : 2 ∣ L := ⟨4 * c * 5 ^ c, by dsimp [L]; ring⟩
  have heven : 2 * (L / 2) = L := by
    have := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
    omega
  obtain ⟨Q, hf, hlo, hhi, hrel, hexp⟩ := HardFamily.expected_lower (b := 1) (c := c)
    (by omega : 0 < m) hL μ A (HardFamily.batched (c * (m * L)) m L (by omega) hL)
    (fun P hP => by
      have he := (HardFamily.mem_batched P).mp hP
      exact ⟨he.ge, by simpa only [one_mul] using he.le⟩)
    (fun B Q d => HardFamily.batched_hard_after hm hc hL heven hcm rfl B Q.graph d)
  simp only [one_mul] at hhi
  have he : Q.graph.optimum m (by omega) = L := le_antisymm hhi hlo
  refine ⟨Q.jobs, Q.vertices, Q.graph, hf, he, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [he] using hrel
  · simpa only [he] using hexp

/-- The logarithmic batched lower bound for randomized causal schedulers. -/

Scheduling.randomized_batched_competitiv.source:
theorem randomized_batched_competitive_lower {m c : ℕ}
    (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hc : 0 < c) (hcm : 2 * c ≤ m)
    (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (A : RandomizedScheduler Ω m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) = 8 * c * 5 ^ c ∧
      (∀ j, I.optimum m (by omega) ∣ I.release j) ∧
      (↑(min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        14 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by
  obtain ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hopt, hrel, hexp⟩ := randomized_batched_lower_bound hm hc hcm μ A
  refine ⟨jobs, vertices, I, hf, hopt, hrel, ?_⟩
  have hlog : Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)) ≤ 7 * c := by
    rw [hopt]
    exact batched_scale_clog_le hc
  have hmin := (min_le_right m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)))).trans hlog
  have hn := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (I.optimum m (by omega)) hmin
  calc
    (↑(min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega)))) : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega) ≤
        7 * ((c : ℝ≥0∞) * I.optimum m (by omega)) := by
          have hh : (↑(min m (Nat.clog 2 (I.optimum m (by omega))) * I.optimum m (by omega)) : ℝ≥0∞) ≤ ↑((7 * c) * I.optimum m (by omega)) := Nat.cast_le.mpr hn
          simpa only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat, mul_assoc] using hh
    _ ≤ 7 * (2 * A.expectedFlow μ I) := mul_le_mul le_rfl hexp zero_le zero_le
    _ = 14 * A.expectedFlow μ I := by ring

end Scheduling

Scheduling.recordedKeys_append.source:
theorem recordedKeys_append {jobs work : ℕ} (a b : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs) :
    recordedKeys (a ++ b) j = recordedKeys a j ∪ recordedKeys b j := by
  simp [recordedKeys, List.filter_append, image_union]

Scheduling.recordedKeys_prefix_le.source:
theorem recordedKeys_prefix_le {jobs work p : ℕ} (a b : List (LayerRecord jobs work)) (j : Fin jobs)
    (hb : ∀ k ∈ recordedKeys b j, p ≤ k.val) :
    ((recordedKeys (a ++ b) j).filter (fun k => k.val < p)).card ≤
      (a.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length := by
  have hs : (recordedKeys (a ++ b) j).filter (fun k => k.val < p) ⊆ recordedKeys a j := by
    intro k hk
    obtain ⟨hk, hlt⟩ := mem_filter.mp hk
    rw [recordedKeys_append] at hk
    rcases mem_union.mp hk with h | h
    · exact h
    · have hh := hb k h
      omega
  exact (card_le_card hs).trans (recordedKeys_card_le a j)

namespace LayeredPrefix
variable {jobs work m L : ℕ} {hw : 0 < work} {A : DeterministicScheduler m}
variable {rule : LayerSizeRule jobs work} {P Q : LayeredPrefix jobs work}
variable {records : List (LayerRecord jobs work)}

Scheduling.LayeredPrefix.RecordedRun.key.source:
theorem RecordedRun.keys_lower (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records)
    (j : Fin jobs) (k : Fin work) (hk : k ∈ recordedKeys records j) : P.closed j ≤ k.val := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hkey⟩ := mem_image.mp hk
  obtain ⟨hr, ho⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp hr)
  have ho' : r.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true ho
  have hs := h.start_lower r hr
  have ht := (h.final_times r hr).1
  rw [ho'] at hs
  rw [hkey] at ht
  omega

theorem RecordedRun.keys_card (h : RecordedRun (L := L) hw A rule P Q records) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (recordedKeys records j).card = (records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)).length := by
  let rs := records.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)
  have hpair : rs.Pairwise (fun a b => a.key < b.key) := by
    have hp := h.ordered_intervals.filter (fun r => r.owner = j)
    apply hp.imp_of_mem
    intro a b ha hb hab
    obtain ⟨ha', hoa⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp ha
    obtain ⟨hb', hob⟩ := List.mem_filter.mp hb
    have hoa' : a.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true hoa
    have hob' : b.owner = j := of_decide_eq_true hob
    have hstop := hab (hoa'.trans hob'.symm)
    have hka := (h.final_times a ha').2.1
    have hkb := (h.final_times b hb').1
    change a.key.val < b.key.val
    omega
  have hn : (rs.map LayerRecord.key).Nodup := by
    rw [List.nodup_iff_pairwise_ne, List.pairwise_map]
    exact hpair.imp (fun h => ne_of_lt h)
  change (rs.toFinset.image LayerRecord.key).card = rs.length
  have he : rs.toFinset.image LayerRecord.key = (rs.map LayerRecord.key).toFinset := by
    ext k
    simp
  rw [he, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn, List.length_map]

end LayeredPrefix
end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.interval_card_eq_sum.source:
theorem interval_card_eq_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (a b : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card =
      ∑ t ∈ Ico a b, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card := by
  classical
  rw [card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := S)
    (fun v hv => mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2)]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · exact And.right
  · intro he
    exact ⟨by rw [he]; exact mem_Ico.mp ht, he⟩

Scheduling.Instance.interval_deficit_has.source:
theorem interval_deficit_has_idle {m a b : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S)
    (hdeficit : (univ.filter (fun v => a ≤ S v ∧ S v < b)).card < m * (b - a)) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ico a b, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by
  classical
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have he : ∀ t ∈ Ico a b, (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m := by
    intro t ht; exact (hS.capacity t).antisymm (hn t ht)
  rw [interval_card_eq_sum S a b, sum_congr rfl he] at hdeficit
  simp [Nat.mul_comm] at hdeficit

Scheduling.Instance.epochWork.source:
noncomputable def epochWork (_I : Instance jobs vertices)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (L i : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter (fun v => S v / L = i)).card

Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_eq_sum.source:
theorem epochWork_eq_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) {L : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (i : ℕ) :
    I.epochWork S L i = ∑ t ∈ Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L),
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card := by
  rw [← interval_card_eq_sum S]
  unfold epochWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  have hd := Nat.div_add_mod (S v) L
  have hr := Nat.mod_lt (S v) hL
  generalize S v % L = r at *
  constructor
  · intro he; rw [he] at hd; constructor <;> nlinarith
  · intro h
    have hlo := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hL).mpr h.1
    have hhi := (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mpr h.2
    omega

Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_lt_of_idle.source:
theorem epochWork_lt_of_idle {m L i t : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L) (ht : t ∈ Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L))
    (hidle : (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m) : I.epochWork S L i < m * L := by
  rw [I.epochWork_eq_sum S hL i]
  have h := sum_lt_sum (s := Ico (i * L) ((i + 1) * L))
    (f := fun t => (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card) (g := fun _ => m)
    (by intro u _; exact hS.capacity u) ⟨t, ht, hidle⟩
  have hlen : (i + 1) * L - i * L = L := by rw [Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
  simp only [sum_const, Nat.card_Ico, hlen] at h
  simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using h

Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_le.source:
theorem epochWork_le {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L) (i : ℕ) : I.epochWork S L i ≤ m * L := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_slots S m (i * L) ((i + 1) * L)
    (univ.filter (fun v => S v / L = i)) hS.capacity (by
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hd := Nat.div_add_mod (S v) L
      have hr := Nat.mod_lt (S v) hL
      rw [he] at hd
      generalize S v % L = r at *
      constructor <;> nlinarith)
  simpa only [epochWork, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left] using h

Scheduling.Instance.regular_vertex_count.source:
theorem regular_vertex_count {W : ℕ}
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = W) : vertices = jobs * W := by
  classical
  have h := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := (univ : Finset (Fin vertices)))
    (t := (univ : Finset (Fin jobs))) (f := I.owner) (by simp)
  simp only [jobVertices] at hwork
  simpa [hwork] using h

Scheduling.Instance.regular_alive_card_l.source:
theorem regular_alive_card_le {L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hL : 0 < L) (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L)) (i : ℕ) : (I.alive S (i * L)).card ≤ c := by
  classical
  have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.val (s := I.alive S (i * L))
    (t := Ico (i + 1 - c) (i + 1)) (by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hr, v, ho, ht⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
      rw [hrelease] at hr
      have hf := hflow v
      rw [ho, hrelease] at hf
      have hji : j.val ≤ i := by
        by_contra hn
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show i + 1 ≤ j.val by omega)
        nlinarith
      have hij : i < j.val + c := by
        by_contra hn
        have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show j.val + c ≤ i by omega)
        nlinarith
      exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
    (by intro u _ v _ huv; exact Fin.ext huv)
  have hcard : (Ico (i + 1 - c) (i + 1)).card ≤ c := by rw [Nat.card_Ico]; omega
  exact hc.trans hcard

Scheduling.Instance.regular_epoch_no_arr.source:
theorem regular_epoch_no_arrivals {m L i : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (_hL : 0 < L)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (v : Fin vertices) (ht : S v < (i + 1) * L) : I.release (I.owner v) ≤ i * L := by
  have hr := hS.release v
  rw [hrelease] at hr ⊢
  have hj : (I.owner v).val ≤ i := by
    by_contra hn
    have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show i + 1 ≤ (I.owner v).val by omega)
    omega
  exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right L hj

Scheduling.Instance.epochWork_sum.source:
theorem epochWork_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) {L : ℕ}
    (hL : 0 < L) (N : ℕ) :
    ∑ i ∈ range N, I.epochWork S L i = (univ.filter (fun v => S v < N * L)).card := by
  classical
  have h := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise
    (s := univ.filter (fun v : Fin vertices => S v < N * L))
    (t := range N) (f := fun v => S v / L) (by
      intro v hv
      exact mem_range.mpr ((Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mpr (mem_filter.mp hv).2))
  rw [h]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  unfold epochWork
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · intro he
    exact ⟨(Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hL).mp (by rw [he]; exact mem_range.mp hi), he⟩
  · exact And.right

/-- The abstract sum of idle capacity is exactly the number of vertices
unfinished after the last arrival epoch. -/

Scheduling.Instance.idleBacklog_eq_remai.source:
theorem idleBacklog_eq_remaining {m L N : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L) (hvertices : vertices = N * (m * L)) :
    Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) N =
      (univ.filter (fun v => N * L ≤ S v)).card := by
  have hc := Accounting.idleBacklog_conservation (I.epochWork_le hS hL) N
  rw [I.epochWork_sum S hL] at hc
  have hp := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ)
    (fun v : Fin vertices => S v < N * L)
  simp only [not_lt, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hp
  omega

Scheduling.Instance.regular_idleBacklog_.source:
theorem regular_idleBacklog_eq {m L : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hS : I.Valid m S) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L) :
    Accounting.idleBacklog (m * L) (I.epochWork S L) jobs =
      (univ.filter (fun v => jobs * L ≤ S v)).card := by
  classical
  have hc := Accounting.idleBacklog_conservation (I.epochWork_le hS hL) jobs
  rw [I.epochWork_sum S hL] at hc
  have hp := card_filter_add_card_filter_not (s := univ) (fun v : Fin vertices => S v < jobs * L)
  simp only [not_lt, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] at hp
  have ht := I.regular_vertex_count hwork
  omega

/-- Under a `cL` flow bound, only the last `c-1` jobs can remain at `jobs*L`.
The count includes all unrevealed vertices of those jobs. -/

Scheduling.Instance.regular_young_backlo.source:
theorem regular_young_backlog {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hc : c ≤ jobs) (_hL : 0 < L)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L)
    (hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L)) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => jobs * L ≤ S v)).card ≤ (c - 1) * (m * L) := by
  classical
  let R := univ.filter (fun v : Fin vertices => jobs * L ≤ S v)
  have hyoung : ∀ v ∈ R, (I.owner v).val ∈ Ioo (jobs - c) jobs := by
    intro v hv
    have ht := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hf := hflow v
    rw [hrelease] at hf
    have hj := (I.owner v).isLt
    have ho : jobs < (I.owner v).val + c := by
      by_contra hn
      have := Nat.mul_le_mul_right L (show (I.owner v).val + c ≤ jobs by omega)
      nlinarith
    exact mem_Ioo.mpr ⟨by omega, hj⟩
  have he := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (s := R) (f := fun v => (I.owner v).val) hyoung
  rw [show (univ.filter (fun v => jobs * L ≤ S v)).card = R.card from rfl, he]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ _j ∈ Ioo (jobs - c) jobs, m * L := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      have hjn := (mem_Ioo.mp hj).2
      have hsub : R.filter (fun v => (I.owner v).val = j) ⊆ I.jobVertices ⟨j, hjn⟩ := by
        intro v hv
        simp only [jobVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
        exact Fin.ext (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (hwork ⟨j, hjn⟩).le
    _ ≤ (c - 1) * (m * L) := by
      have hcard : (Ioo (jobs - c) jobs).card ≤ c - 1 := by
        rw [Nat.card_Ioo]
        omega
      simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (m * L) hcard

/-- The deterministic lower-bound contradiction for a concrete schedule.
Only the adversary's idle-slot property remains as a hypothesis. -/

Scheduling.Instance.regular_forcing_flow.source:
theorem regular_forcing_flow_lower {m L c : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hn : jobs = c * (c * (m * L)))
    (hS : I.Valid m S)
    (hrelease : ∀ j, I.release j = j.val * L)
    (hwork : ∀ j, (I.jobVertices j).card = m * L)
    (hidle : ∀ k < c * (m * L), I.epochWork S L (c * k) < m * L) :
    c * L ≤ I.maxFlow S := by
  by_contra h
  have hflow : I.FlowBound S (c * L) :=
    (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mpr (by omega)
  have hcap : 0 < m * L := Nat.mul_pos hm hL
  have hcj : c ≤ jobs := by
    rw [hn]
    have hp : 0 < c * (m * L) := Nat.mul_pos hc hcap
    simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left c (show 1 ≤ c * (m * L) by omega)
  have hy := I.regular_young_backlog hcj hL hrelease hwork hflow
  rw [← I.regular_idleBacklog_eq hS hL hwork] at hy
  conv at hy => lhs; arg 3; rw [hn]
  exact Accounting.forcing_backlog_contradiction hc hcap hidle hy

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.renameKey.source: def renameKey (f : ℕ → ℕ) (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ := toLex ((ofLex x).1, f (ofLex x).2)

Scheduling.renameObservation.source: def renameObservation (f : ℕ → ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : FIFOObservation := Q.image (renameKey f)

Scheduling.renameKey_strictMono.source:
theorem renameKey_strictMono {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) : StrictMono (renameKey f) := by
  intro x y h
  rw [Prod.Lex.lt_iff] at h ⊢
  rcases h with h | ⟨he, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨he, hf h⟩

Scheduling.fifoPolicy_rename.source:
theorem fifoPolicy_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) :
    fifoPolicy m (renameObservation f Q) = (fifoPolicy m Q).image f := by
  unfold fifoPolicy renameObservation
  rw [← Packing.slice_image _ _ (renameKey_strictMono hf), image_image, image_image]
  rfl

namespace PublicSnapshot

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename.source:
def rename (Q : PublicSnapshot) (f : ℕ → ℕ) : PublicSnapshot where
  support := Q.support
  ready := fun b => (Q.ready b).image f
  supported := by intro b; simpa only [image_nonempty] using Q.supported b

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_small.source:
theorem rename_small (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).small m = Q.small m := by
  simp only [small, rename, card_image_of_injective _ hf]

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_large.source:
theorem rename_large (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).large m = Q.large m := by
  simp only [large, rename, card_image_of_injective _ hf]

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_smallFr.source:
theorem rename_smallFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).smallFront m = (Q.smallFront m).image f := by
  unfold smallFront
  rw [Q.rename_small hf, biUnion_image]
  rfl

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_filler.source:
theorem rename_filler (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).filler m = Q.filler m := by
  unfold filler
  simp only [Q.rename_large hf]

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_fillerF.source:
theorem rename_fillerFront (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).fillerFront m = (Q.fillerFront m).image f := by
  unfold fillerFront
  rw [Q.rename_filler hf]
  cases Q.filler m <;> simp only [rename, image_empty]

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_duratio.source:
theorem rename_duration (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (m : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).duration m = Q.duration m := by
  unfold duration
  rw [Q.rename_smallFront hf, card_image_of_injective _ hf]

Scheduling.PublicSnapshot.rename_action.source:
theorem rename_action (Q : PublicSnapshot) {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m k : ℕ) :
    (Q.rename f).action m k = (Q.action m k).image f := by
  unfold action
  rw [Q.rename_smallFront hf.injective, Q.rename_fillerFront hf.injective,
    Q.rename_duration hf.injective, ← Packing.slot_image _ _ hf,
    card_image_of_injective _ hf.injective, image_union]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [Packing.slice_image _ _ hf, image_empty]

end PublicSnapshot

Scheduling.renameMemory.source:
def renameMemory (f : ℕ → ℕ) (state : SFFMemory) : SFFMemory :=
  state.map (fun plan => (plan.1.rename f, plan.2))

Scheduling.sffStep_rename.source:
theorem sffStep_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m t : ℕ)
    (Q : PublicSnapshot) (state : SFFMemory) :
    sffStep m t (Q.rename f) (renameMemory f state) =
      ((sffStep m t Q state).1.image f, renameMemory f (sffStep m t Q state).2) := by
  cases state with
  | none =>
    simp only [sffStep, renameMemory, Option.map_none, Option.getD_none,
      PublicSnapshot.rename_action _ hf, PublicSnapshot.rename_duration _ hf.injective]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | some plan =>
    rcases plan with ⟨R, k⟩
    simp only [sffStep, renameMemory, Option.map_some, Option.getD_some,
      PublicSnapshot.rename_action _ hf, PublicSnapshot.rename_duration _ hf.injective]
    split_ifs <;> rfl

Scheduling.sffPolicy_state_rename.source:
theorem sffPolicy_state_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m : ℕ)
    (history : ℕ → PublicSnapshot) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffPolicy m).state (fun u => (history u).rename f) t =
      renameMemory f ((sffPolicy m).state history t) := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [OnlinePolicy.state]
    rw [ih]
    exact congrArg Prod.snd (sffStep_rename hf m t (history t) _)

Scheduling.sffPolicy_decision_rename.source:
theorem sffPolicy_decision_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m : ℕ)
    (history : ℕ → PublicSnapshot) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffPolicy m).decision (fun u => (history u).rename f) t =
      ((sffPolicy m).decision history t).image f := by
  unfold OnlinePolicy.decision
  rw [sffPolicy_state_rename hf]
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (sffStep_rename hf m t (history t) _)

Scheduling.batchObservation_rename.source:
theorem batchObservation_rename (f : ℕ → ℕ) (L t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) :
    batchObservation L t (renameObservation f Q) = (batchObservation L t Q).rename f := by
  apply PublicSnapshot.ext_ready
  funext b
  ext n
  rw [mem_batchObservation]
  change _ ↔ n ∈ ((batchObservation L t Q).ready b).image f
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb, he, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨(ofLex y).2,
      (mem_batchObservation _ _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨y, hy, hb, he, rfl⟩, hn⟩
  · intro hn
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hb, he, rfl⟩ := (mem_batchObservation _ _ _ _ _).mp hv
    exact ⟨renameKey f y, mem_image.mpr ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hb, he, rfl⟩

Scheduling.sffRawPolicy_decision_rename.source:
theorem sffRawPolicy_decision_rename {f : ℕ → ℕ} (hf : StrictMono f) (m L : ℕ)
    (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffRawPolicy m L).decision (fun u => renameObservation f (history u)) t =
      ((sffRawPolicy m L).decision history t).image f := by
  rw [sffRawPolicy_decision, sffRawPolicy_decision]
  simp_rw [batchObservation_rename]
  exact sffPolicy_decision_rename hf m _ t

end Scheduling

Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex.source:
noncomputable def residualVertex (_I : Instance jobs vertices) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) : Fin vertices :=
  ((R.orderIsoOfFin rfl) v).val

Scheduling.Instance.residualJob.source:
noncomputable def residualJob (R : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (j : Fin (R.image I.owner).card) : Fin jobs :=
  (((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).val

Scheduling.Instance.residualOwner.source:
noncomputable def residualOwner (R : Finset (Fin vertices))
    (v : Fin R.card) : Fin (R.image I.owner).card :=
  ((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨I.owner (I.residualVertex R v),
    mem_image.mpr ⟨I.residualVertex R v, ((R.orderIsoOfFin rfl) v).property, rfl⟩⟩

Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_injec.source:
theorem residualVertex_injective (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    Function.Injective (I.residualVertex R) := by
  intro u v h
  apply (R.orderIsoOfFin rfl).injective
  exact Subtype.ext h

Scheduling.Instance.residualVertex_stric.source:
theorem residualVertex_strictMono (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    StrictMono (I.residualVertex R) := by
  intro u v huv
  exact (R.orderIsoOfFin rfl).strictMono huv

Scheduling.Instance.residualJob_injectiv.source:
theorem residualJob_injective (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) :
    Function.Injective (I.residualJob R) := by
  intro u v h
  apply ((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl).injective
  exact Subtype.ext h

Scheduling.Instance.residualJob_owner.source:
@[simp] theorem residualJob_owner (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (v : Fin R.card) :
    I.residualJob R (I.residualOwner R v) = I.owner (I.residualVertex R v) := by
  simp [residualJob, residualOwner]

/-- The induced DAGs on any chosen set of surviving vertices, with all
release times shifted by D. Jobs with no surviving vertex are removed. -/

Scheduling.Instance.residualInstance.source:
noncomputable def residualInstance (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    Instance (R.image I.owner).card R.card where
  owner := I.residualOwner R
  release := fun j => I.release (I.residualJob R j) + D
  edge := fun u v => I.edge (I.residualVertex R u) (I.residualVertex R v)
  same_job := by
    intro u v he
    apply I.residualJob_injective R
    simpa using I.same_job he
  rank := fun v => I.rank (I.residualVertex R v)
  rank_increases := by intro u v he; exact I.rank_increases he
  nonempty_job := by
    intro j
    have hj : I.residualJob R j ∈ R.image I.owner :=
      (((R.image I.owner).orderIsoOfFin rfl) j).property
    obtain ⟨v, hv, ho⟩ := mem_image.mp hj
    refine ⟨(R.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm ⟨v, hv⟩, ?_⟩
    apply I.residualJob_injective R
    simpa [residualVertex] using ho

Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule.source:
noncomputable def residualSchedule (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ)
    (O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) : Assignment (vertices := R.card) :=
  fun v => O (I.residualVertex R v) + D

Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule_val.source:
theorem residualSchedule_valid {m : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    (I.residualInstance R D).Valid m (I.residualSchedule R D O) := by
  classical
  constructor
  · intro v
    have h := hO.release (I.residualVertex R v)
    simpa [residualInstance, residualSchedule] using Nat.add_le_add_right h D
  · intro u v he
    have h := hO.precedence he
    simpa [residualSchedule] using Nat.add_lt_add_right h D
  · intro t
