    let A := univ.filter (fun v => I.residualSchedule R D O v = t)
    have hinj := I.residualVertex_injective R
    have him : (A.image (I.residualVertex R)).card = A.card := card_image_of_injective A hinj
    have hsub : A.image (I.residualVertex R) ⊆ univ.filter (fun v => O v = t - D) := by
      intro w hw
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hw
      have ht := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      dsimp [residualSchedule] at ht
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩
    have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (hO.capacity (t - D))
    rw [him] at hc
    exact hc

Scheduling.Instance.residualSchedule_flo.source:
theorem residualSchedule_flowBound {L : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    (I.residualInstance R D).FlowBound (I.residualSchedule R D O) L := by
  intro v
  have h := hL (I.residualVertex R v)
  simpa [residualInstance, residualSchedule, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]
    using Nat.add_lt_add_right h D

/-- The artificial residual instance's optimum is no larger than the original
optimum. The result holds for every vertex restriction and every common shift. -/

Scheduling.Instance.residual_optimum_le.source:
theorem residual_optimum_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (R : Finset (Fin vertices)) (D : ℕ) :
    (I.residualInstance R D).optimum m hm ≤ I.optimum m hm := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  exact (I.residualInstance R D).optimum_le hm
    (I.residualSchedule_valid hO R D) (I.residualSchedule_flowBound hL R D)

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.source:
structure ReadySnapshot (V : Type*) (batches : ℕ) where
  batchOf : V → Fin batches
  ready : Fin batches → Finset V
  ready_batch : ∀ b v, v ∈ ready b → batchOf v = b

namespace ReadySnapshot
variable {V : Type*} [LinearOrder V] {batches : ℕ} (Q : ReadySnapshot V batches)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.small.source:
def small (m : ℕ) : Finset (Fin batches) :=
  univ.filter (fun b => 0 < (Q.ready b).card ∧ (Q.ready b).card ≤ m)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.large.source:
def large (m : ℕ) : Finset (Fin batches) :=
  univ.filter (fun b => m < (Q.ready b).card)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.smallFront.source: def smallFront (m : ℕ) : Finset V := (Q.small m).biUnion Q.ready

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler.source:
def filler (m : ℕ) : Option (Fin batches) :=
  if h : (Q.large m).Nonempty then some ((Q.large m).min' h) else none

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.fillerFront.source:
def fillerFront (m : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  match Q.filler m with | none => ∅ | some b => Q.ready b

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.duration.source: def duration (m : ℕ) : ℕ := Packing.duration (Q.smallFront m).card m

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.action.source:
def action (m k : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k ∪
    if k + 1 = Q.duration m then
      Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0 (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card)
    else ∅

omit [LinearOrder V] in

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler_mem.source:
theorem filler_mem {m : ℕ} {b : Fin batches} (hb : Q.filler m = some b) : b ∈ Q.large m := by
  unfold filler at hb
  split_ifs at hb with h
  · have he := Option.some.inj hb
    rw [← he]
    exact min'_mem _ _

omit [LinearOrder V] in

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler_oldest.source:
theorem filler_oldest {m : ℕ} {b c : Fin batches}
    (hb : Q.filler m = some b) (hc : c ∈ Q.large m) : b ≤ c := by
  unfold filler at hb
  split_ifs at hb with h
  · have he := Option.some.inj hb
    rw [← he]
    exact min'_le _ _ hc

omit [LinearOrder V] in

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.filler_exists.source:
theorem filler_exists {m : ℕ} (h : (Q.large m).Nonempty) : ∃ b, Q.filler m = some b := by
  exact ⟨(Q.large m).min' h, by simp [filler, h]⟩

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.smallFront_read.source:
theorem smallFront_ready {m : ℕ} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.smallFront m) :
    Q.batchOf v ∈ Q.small m ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v) := by
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hv⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hv
  have he := Q.ready_batch b v hv
  rw [he]
  exact ⟨hb, hv⟩

omit [LinearOrder V] in

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.fillerFront_rea.source:
theorem fillerFront_ready {m : ℕ} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.fillerFront m) :
    Q.filler m = some (Q.batchOf v) ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v) := by
  unfold fillerFront at hv
  cases he : Q.filler m with
  | none => simp [he] at hv
  | some b =>
    rw [he] at hv
    have ho := Q.ready_batch b v hv
    exact ⟨by simp [ho], by simpa [ho] using hv⟩

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.frontiers_disjo.source:
theorem frontiers_disjoint (m : ℕ) : Disjoint (Q.smallFront m) (Q.fillerFront m) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro v hv hw
  have hs := Q.smallFront_ready hv
  have hf := Q.fillerFront_ready hw
  have hl := Q.filler_mem hf.1
  have h₁ := (mem_filter.mp hs.1).2.2
  have h₂ := (mem_filter.mp hl).2
  omega

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.action_scope.source:
theorem action_scope {m k : ℕ} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.action m k) :
    (Q.batchOf v ∈ Q.small m ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v)) ∨
      (Q.filler m = some (Q.batchOf v) ∧ v ∈ Q.ready (Q.batchOf v)) := by
  rcases mem_union.mp hv with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Q.smallFront_ready (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ h))
  · split_ifs at h with hk
    · exact Or.inr (Q.fillerFront_ready (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ h))
    · exact False.elim (notMem_empty _ h)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.action_card_le.source:
theorem action_card_le (m k : ℕ) : (Q.action m k).card ≤ m := by
  have hp := Packing.slot_card_le (Q.smallFront m) m k
  unfold action
  split_ifs with hk
  · have hf : (Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0
        (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card)).card ≤
        m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card := by
      rw [Packing.slice_card]
      omega
    have hu := card_union_le (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k)
      (Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0 (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card))
    omega
  · simpa using hp

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.clears_small.source:
theorem clears_small {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {b : Fin batches} (hb : b ∈ Q.small m)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.ready b) : ∃ k < Q.duration m, v ∈ Q.action m k := by
  have hvP : v ∈ Q.smallFront m := mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨b, hb, hv⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hvk⟩ := Packing.covers _ hm hvP
  exact ⟨k, hk, mem_union_left _ hvk⟩

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.nonfinal_full.source:
theorem nonfinal_full {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hk : k + 1 < Q.duration m) :
    (Q.action m k).card = m := by
  have he : k + 1 ≠ Q.duration m := by omega
  simp only [action, if_neg he, union_empty]
  exact Packing.before_last_full _ hm hk

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.full_with_large.source:
theorem full_with_large {m k : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hk : k < Q.duration m)
    (hl : (Q.large m).Nonempty) : (Q.action m k).card = m := by
  by_cases hlast : k + 1 = Q.duration m
  · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Q.filler_exists hl
    have hbig := (mem_filter.mp (Q.filler_mem hb)).2
    have he : Q.fillerFront m = Q.ready b := by simp [fillerFront, hb]
    have hc := Packing.slot_card_le (Q.smallFront m) m k
    have hd : Disjoint (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k)
        (Packing.slice (Q.fillerFront m) 0 (m - (Packing.slot (Q.smallFront m) m k).card)) := by
      exact (Q.frontiers_disjoint m).mono (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _) (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _)
    simp only [action, if_pos hlast, card_union_of_disjoint hd, Packing.slice_card, Nat.sub_zero]
    rw [he, min_eq_left (by omega)]
    omega
  · exact Q.nonfinal_full hm (by omega)

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.actions_disjoin.source:
theorem actions_disjoint {m i j : ℕ} (hij : i ≠ j) : Disjoint (Q.action m i) (Q.action m j) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro v hv hw
  rcases mem_union.mp hv with hv | hv <;> rcases mem_union.mp hw with hw | hw
  · exact disjoint_left.mp (Packing.slot_disjoint (Q.smallFront m) hij) hv hw
  · split_ifs at hw with hj
    · exact disjoint_left.mp (Q.frontiers_disjoint m)
        (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ hv) (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ hw)
    · exact notMem_empty _ hw
  · split_ifs at hv with hi
    · exact disjoint_left.mp (Q.frontiers_disjoint m)
        (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ hw) (Packing.slice_subset _ _ _ hv)
    · exact notMem_empty _ hv
  · split_ifs at hv hw with hi hj
    all_goals simp_all
    all_goals omega

/-- A bounded, executable search for a vertex's unique slot in the round. -/

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.assignSlot_soun.source:
theorem assignSlot_sound {m k : ℕ} {v : V} (h : Q.assignSlot m v = some k) :
    k < Q.duration m ∧ v ∈ Q.action m k := by
  dsimp only [assignSlot] at h
  split_ifs at h with hn
  have he := Option.some.inj h
  have hm := mem_filter.mp (min'_mem _ hn)
  rw [he] at hm
  exact ⟨mem_range.mp hm.1, hm.2⟩

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.assignSlot_comp.source:
theorem assignSlot_complete {m k : ℕ} {v : V}
    (hk : k < Q.duration m) (hv : v ∈ Q.action m k) : Q.assignSlot m v = some k := by
  let A := (range (Q.duration m)).filter (fun j => v ∈ Q.action m j)
  have hmem : k ∈ A := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr hk, hv⟩
  have hn : A.Nonempty := ⟨k, hmem⟩
  have hm := (mem_filter.mp (min'_mem A hn)).2
  have he : A.min' hn = k := by
    by_contra he
    exact disjoint_left.mp (Q.actions_disjoint he) hm hv
  change (if h : A.Nonempty then some (A.min' h) else none) = some k
  rw [dif_pos hn, he]

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.progress.source:
theorem progress {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {b : Fin batches} {v : V} (hv : v ∈ Q.ready b) :
    ∃ w k, k < Q.duration m ∧ Q.assignSlot m w = some k := by
  have hp : 0 < (Q.ready b).card := card_pos.mpr ⟨v, hv⟩
  by_cases hs : (Q.ready b).card ≤ m
  · have hb : b ∈ Q.small m := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hp, hs⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hvk⟩ := Q.clears_small hm hb hv
    exact ⟨v, k, hk, Q.assignSlot_complete hk hvk⟩
  · have hl : (Q.large m).Nonempty := ⟨b, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega⟩⟩
    have hk : 0 < Q.duration m := Packing.duration_pos _ _
    have hc := Q.full_with_large hm hk hl
    have hn : (Q.action m 0).Nonempty := card_pos.mp (by omega)
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hn
    exact ⟨w, 0, hk, Q.assignSlot_complete hk hw⟩

/-- Local observation noninterference: every computed round decision is
determined by the exposed ready frontiers. Even the ownership function and
the proofs attached to the observation cannot affect the output. -/

Scheduling.ReadySnapshot.ready_only.source:
theorem ready_only (Q' : ReadySnapshot V batches) (h : Q.ready = Q'.ready) (m : ℕ) :
    Q.duration m = Q'.duration m ∧ Q.filler m = Q'.filler m ∧
      Q.action m = Q'.action m ∧ Q.assignSlot m = Q'.assignSlot m := by
  cases Q with
  | mk owner ready sound =>
    cases Q' with
    | mk owner' ready' sound' =>
      change ready = ready' at h
      subst ready'
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

end ReadySnapshot
end Scheduling

Scheduling.SFFRounds.boundary_ge_index.source:
theorem boundary_ge_index (k : ℕ) : k ≤ R.boundary k := by
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := R.strict (show k < k + 1 by omega)
    omega

Scheduling.SFFRounds.exists_admission.source:
theorem exists_admission (b : Fin batches) : ∃ k, B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary k :=
  ⟨B.eligible b, R.boundary_ge_index _⟩

Scheduling.SFFRounds.admission.source: noncomputable def admission (b : Fin batches) : ℕ := Nat.find (R.exists_admission b)

Scheduling.SFFRounds.admitted.source:
theorem admitted (b : Fin batches) : B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary (R.admission b) :=
  Nat.find_spec (R.exists_admission b)

Scheduling.SFFRounds.admission_delay.source:
theorem admission_delay (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (b : Fin batches) :
    R.boundary (R.admission b) ≤ B.eligible b + 4 * L := by
  have hp : 0 < R.admission b := by
    have h := R.admitted b
    by_contra hn
    have hz : R.admission b = 0 := by omega
    rw [hz, R.starts_zero] at h
    have := B.eligible_positive hLp b
    omega
  have hprev : R.boundary (R.admission b - 1) < B.eligible b := by
    by_contra hn
    have hmin := Nat.find_min' (R.exists_admission b) (show B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary (R.admission b - 1) by omega)
    change R.admission b ≤ R.admission b - 1 at hmin
    omega
  have hround := (R.round_bounds hm hLp hO hL (R.admission b - 1)).2
  have he : R.admission b - 1 + 1 = R.admission b := by omega
  rw [he] at hround
  have hmono := R.strict.monotone (Nat.sub_le (R.admission b) 1)
  omega

/-- Theorem 10, for any schedule obeying the operational SFF round routine.
The 44L² bound is derived here from backlog, interference, round lengths,
eligibility spacing, and frontier progress. None is an assumed guarantee. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.flow_bound.source:
theorem flow_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) : I.FlowBound S (44 * L ^ 2) := by
  intro v
  let b := B.vertexBatch v
  let A := R.admission b
  have hadmit : B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary A := R.admitted b
  have hdelay : R.boundary A ≤ B.eligible b + 4 * L := R.admission_delay hm hLp hO hL b
  have hrel : B.eligible b ≤ I.release (I.owner v) + 2 * L := by
    have hl := B.lower (I.owner v)
    dsimp [b, Batching.eligible, Batching.vertexBatch]
    nlinarith
  by_cases hearly : S v < R.boundary A
  · have harith : 6 * L ≤ 44 * L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    omega
  · have hAv : R.boundary A ≤ S v := by omega
    have hAK : A ≤ S v + 1 := by have := R.boundary_ge_index A; omega
    have hKv : S v < R.boundary (S v + 1) := by have := R.boundary_ge_index (S v + 1); omega
    obtain ⟨r, hAr, hrK, hrv, hvr⟩ := R.containing_round hAK hAv hKv
    have hactive : ∀ k, A ≤ k → k < r + 1 → B.Active S (R.boundary k) b := by
      intro k hAk hkr
      have h₁ := R.strict.monotone hAk
      have h₂ := R.strict.monotone (show k ≤ r by omega)
      exact ⟨by omega, v, rfl, by omega⟩
    have hd := R.unfinished_interval_bound hm hLp hO hL (show A ≤ r + 1 by omega) hadmit hactive
    have ht := R.strict.monotone (show A ≤ r + 1 by omega)
    have harith : 32 * L ^ 2 + 10 * L ≤ 44 * L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    omega

Scheduling.SFFRounds.maxFlow_bound.source:
theorem maxFlow_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) : I.maxFlow S ≤ 44 * L ^ 2 :=
  (I.flowBound_iff_maxFlow_le S _).mp (R.flow_bound hm hLp hO hL)

end Scheduling.SFFRounds

namespace Scheduling.Instance
open Finset
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

/-- Canonical number of 2L-windows, allowing empty intermediate batches. -/

Scheduling.Instance.batchCount.source:
def batchCount (L : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  univ.sup (fun j => I.release j / (2 * L) + 1)

Scheduling.Instance.canonicalBatching.source:
def canonicalBatching (L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Batching I L (I.batchCount L) where
  index := fun j => ⟨I.release j / (2 * L), by
    have h : I.release j / (2 * L) + 1 ≤ I.batchCount L :=
      le_sup (f := fun j => I.release j / (2 * L) + 1) (mem_univ j)
    omega⟩
  lower := by
    intro j
    have h := Nat.mod_add_div (I.release j) (2 * L)
    dsimp
    omega
  upper := by
    intro j
    have h := Nat.mod_add_div (I.release j) (2 * L)
    have hm := Nat.mod_lt (I.release j) (show 0 < 2 * L by omega)
    dsimp
    nlinarith

/-- Theorem 10 specialized to canonical batches and the actual attained
offline optimum, for a nonempty collection of jobs. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sff_known_optimum.source:
theorem sff_known_optimum {m : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs)
    (R : SFFRounds (I.canonicalBatching (I.optimum m hm) (I.optimum_pos hm hj)) m S) :
    I.maxFlow S ≤ 44 * (I.optimum m hm) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  exact R.maxFlow_bound hm (I.optimum_pos hm hj) hO hL

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.Batching.execution_rounds.source:
def execution_rounds {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : SFFRounds B m (B.execution m) where
  boundary := fun k => (B.run m k).clock
  starts_zero := rfl
  strict := B.run_clock_strict m
  filler := fun k => (B.observe (B.run m k)).filler m
  clear_small := by
    classical
    intro k b hb v hv hr
    have hq : b ∈ (B.observe (B.run m k)).small m := by rwa [B.observed_small_eq hm]
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hb).2.1.1
    have hready := (B.observed_ready_iff hm b v).mpr ⟨hv, he, hr⟩
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hvj⟩ := (B.observe (B.run m k)).clears_small hm hq hready
    have ht := (B.action_iff_execution hm hj v).mp hvj
    change B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m
    omega
  large_service := by
    classical
    intro k v ht₁ ht₂ hl
    have hj : B.execution m v - (B.run m k).clock < (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m := by
      change B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m at ht₂
      omega
    have hv := (B.action_iff_execution hm hj v).mpr (by omega)
    rcases (B.observe (B.run m k)).action_scope hv with hs | hf
    · have hs' : B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock := by
        have hs₀ := hs.1
        rw [B.observed_small_eq hm] at hs₀
        exact hs₀
      exact False.elim (disjoint_left.mp (B.small_large_disjoint m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock) hs' hl)
    · exact hf.1
  length_eq := by
    classical
    intro k
    change ((B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m) - (B.run m k).clock = _
    rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
    change Packing.duration ((B.observe (B.run m k)).smallFront m).card m = _
    rw [B.observed_smallFront_eq hm]
    rfl
  eligible_service := by
    classical
    intro v
    exact ((B.run_safe m B.completionRound).stamps v (B.execution m v) (B.execution_stamp hm v)).1
  packed := by
    classical
    intro k t ht₁ ht₂
    have htend : t < (B.run m (k + 1)).clock := by omega
    rw [B.execution_slot_eq hm ht₁ htend]
    apply (B.observe (B.run m k)).nonfinal_full hm
    change t + 1 < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m at ht₂
    omega
  fill_last := by
    classical
    intro k hl t ht₁ ht₂
    have hq : ((B.observe (B.run m k)).large m).Nonempty := by rwa [B.observed_large_eq hm]
    rw [B.execution_slot_eq hm ht₁ ht₂]
    apply (B.observe (B.run m k)).full_with_large hm ?_ hq
    change t < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m at ht₂
    omega
  service_scope := by
    classical
    intro k v ht₁ ht₂
    have hj : B.execution m v - (B.run m k).clock < (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m := by
      change B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m at ht₂
      omega
    have hv := (B.action_iff_execution hm hj v).mpr (by omega)
    rcases (B.observe (B.run m k)).action_scope hv with hs | hf
    · have hs' : B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m (B.execution m) (B.run m k).clock := by
        have hs₀ := hs.1
        rw [B.observed_small_eq hm] at hs₀
        exact hs₀
      exact Or.inl ⟨hs', ((B.observed_ready_iff hm _ v).mp hs.2).2.2⟩
    · exact Or.inr hf.1
  filler_oldest := by
    classical
    intro k b c hb hc
    have hc' : c ∈ (B.observe (B.run m k)).large m := by rwa [B.observed_large_eq hm]
    have hle := (B.observe (B.run m k)).filler_oldest hb hc'
    change b.val ≤ c.val at hle
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * L) (by omega)

Scheduling.Batching.execution_flow_bound.source:
theorem execution_flow_bound {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) :
    I.maxFlow (B.execution m) ≤ 44 * L ^ 2 :=
  (B.execution_rounds hm).maxFlow_bound hm hLp hO hL

end Scheduling.Batching

namespace Scheduling.Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices) [DecidableRel I.edge]

/-- The executable scheduler takes a positive flow upper-bound guess L.
The finite horizon is used only to extract all timestamps from its online
round execution, whose decisions depend on ready snapshots. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sffSchedule.source:
def sffSchedule (m L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  (I.canonicalBatching L hL).execution m

Scheduling.Instance.sffSchedule_valid.source:
theorem sffSchedule_valid {m L : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) :
    I.Valid m (I.sffSchedule m L hL) :=
  (I.canonicalBatching L hL).execution_valid hm

Scheduling.Instance.sffSchedule_bound.source:
theorem sffSchedule_bound {m L : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) :
    I.maxFlow (I.sffSchedule m L hLp) ≤ 44 * L ^ 2 :=
  (I.canonicalBatching L hLp).execution_flow_bound hm hLp hO hL

/-- The SFF guarantee for the constructed scheduler at the actual optimum.
Unlike `sff_known_optimum`, this theorem takes no round-execution witness. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sffSchedule_known_op.source:
theorem sffSchedule_known_optimum {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hj : 0 < jobs) :
    I.maxFlow (I.sffSchedule m (I.optimum m hm) (I.optimum_pos hm hj)) ≤
      44 * (I.optimum m hm) ^ 2 := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hL⟩ := I.optimum_attained hm
  exact I.sffSchedule_bound hm (I.optimum_pos hm hj) hO hL

omit [DecidableRel I.edge] in
/-- The existence part of the known-bound upper theorem, with no assumed
SFF execution. Decidable readiness is used only by the environment simulator. -/

Scheduling.Instance.exists_sff_schedule.source:
theorem exists_sff_schedule {m L : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) :
    ∃ S : Assignment (vertices := vertices), I.Valid m S ∧ I.maxFlow S ≤ 44 * L ^ 2 := by
  classical
  exact ⟨I.sffSchedule m L hLp, I.sffSchedule_valid hm hLp, I.sffSchedule_bound hm hLp hO hL⟩

end Scheduling.Instance

Scheduling.SFFMemory.source:
abbrev SFFMemory := Option (PublicSnapshot × ℕ)

/-- At a boundary, cache the public frontier and begin slot zero. During a
round, use the cached frontier and ignore newly revealed work until the
next boundary, exactly as in the fixed-frontier executor. -/

Scheduling.sffPolicy.source:
def sffPolicy (m : ℕ) : OnlinePolicy PublicSnapshot SFFMemory (Finset ℕ) where
  initial := none
  step := sffStep m

Scheduling.roundMemory.source:
def roundMemory (m : ℕ) (Q : PublicSnapshot) (j : ℕ) : SFFMemory :=
  if 0 < j ∧ j < Q.duration m then some (Q, j) else none

Scheduling.sffStep_roundMemory.source:
theorem sffStep_roundMemory (m t j : ℕ) (Q observation : PublicSnapshot)
    (hj : j < Q.duration m) (hobs : j = 0 → observation = Q) :
    sffStep m t observation (roundMemory m Q j) =
      (Q.action m j, roundMemory m Q (j + 1)) := by
  by_cases hz : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [hobs rfl]
    simp [sffStep, roundMemory]
  · have hp : 0 < j := by omega
    simp [sffStep, roundMemory, hp, hj]

Scheduling.sffPolicy_round_state.source:
theorem sffPolicy_round_state (m : ℕ) (history : ℕ → PublicSnapshot)
    (a : ℕ) (Q : PublicSnapshot)
    (ha : (sffPolicy m).state history a = none) (hQ : history a = Q)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ Q.duration m) :
    (sffPolicy m).state history (a + j) = roundMemory m Q j := by
  induction j with
  | zero => simpa [roundMemory] using ha
  | succ j ih =>
    have hprev := ih (by omega)
    have hstep := sffStep_roundMemory m (a + j) j Q (history (a + j))
      (by omega) (by intro hz; simpa [hz] using hQ)
    change ((sffPolicy m).step (a + j) (history (a + j))
      ((sffPolicy m).state history (a + j))).2 = _
    rw [hprev]
    exact congrArg Prod.snd hstep

Scheduling.sffPolicy_round_decision.source:
theorem sffPolicy_round_decision (m : ℕ) (history : ℕ → PublicSnapshot)
    (a : ℕ) (Q : PublicSnapshot)
    (ha : (sffPolicy m).state history a = none) (hQ : history a = Q)
    (j : ℕ) (hj : j < Q.duration m) :
    (sffPolicy m).decision history (a + j) = Q.action m j := by
  unfold OnlinePolicy.decision
  rw [sffPolicy_round_state m history a Q ha hQ j hj.le]
  exact congrArg Prod.fst (sffStep_roundMemory m (a + j) j Q (history (a + j))
    hj (by intro hz; simpa [hz] using hQ))

namespace Batching
variable {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Instance jobs vertices}
variable (B : Batching I L batches) [DecidableRel I.edge]

/-- The environment reveals ready frontiers based on work completed strictly
before the current slot. The result has no hidden-instance size parameter. -/

Scheduling.Batching.publicHistory.source:
def publicHistory (m t : ℕ) : PublicSnapshot :=
  (B.observe ⟨t, fun v => if B.execution m v < t then some (B.execution m v) else none⟩).expose

Scheduling.Batching.publicHistory_bounda.source:
theorem publicHistory_boundary {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) :
    B.publicHistory m (B.run m k).clock = (B.observe (B.run m k)).expose := by
  unfold publicHistory
  have he : (⟨(B.run m k).clock,
      fun v => if B.execution m v < (B.run m k).clock then some (B.execution m v) else none⟩ :
      ExecutionState vertices) = B.run m k := by
    have hstamp := funext (fun v => (B.run_stamp_exact hm k v).symm)
    cases h : B.run m k with
    | mk c stamp =>
      simp only [h] at hstamp ⊢
      exact congrArg (ExecutionState.mk c) hstamp
  rw [he]

Scheduling.Batching.publicPolicy_boundar.source:
theorem publicPolicy_boundary_state {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) :
    (sffPolicy m).state (B.publicHistory m) (B.run m k).clock = none := by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := sffPolicy_round_state m (B.publicHistory m) (B.run m k).clock
      (B.observe (B.run m k)).expose ih (B.publicHistory_boundary hm k)
      ((B.observe (B.run m k)).expose.duration m) le_rfl
    rw [ReadySnapshot.expose_duration] at h
    change (sffPolicy m).state (B.publicHistory m)
      ((B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m) = none
    simpa only [roundMemory, ReadySnapshot.expose_duration, lt_self_iff_false,
      and_false, ↓reduceIte] using h

Scheduling.Batching.exists_execution_rou.source:
theorem exists_execution_round (m t : ℕ) :
    ∃ k, (B.run m k).clock ≤ t ∧ t < (B.run m (k + 1)).clock := by
  have hex : ∃ k, t < (B.run m k).clock :=
    ⟨t + 1, lt_of_lt_of_le (by omega) (B.run_clock_ge m (t + 1))⟩
  let n := Nat.find hex
  have hn : t < (B.run m n).clock := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hnpos : 0 < n := by
    by_contra h
    have he : n = 0 := by omega
    simp [he, run, ExecutionState.initial] at hn
  refine ⟨n - 1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_contra h
    have hmin := Nat.find_min' hex (show t < (B.run m (n - 1)).clock by omega)
    change n ≤ n - 1 at hmin
    omega
  · simpa [Nat.sub_add_cancel (show 1 ≤ n by omega)] using hn

/-- The finite scheduling assignment is exactly the slot-by-slot public
policy on its environment's observation history. -/

Scheduling.Batching.execution_publicPoli.source:
theorem execution_publicPolicy {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => B.execution m v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (sffPolicy m).decision (B.publicHistory m) t := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk₁, hk₂⟩ := B.exists_execution_round m t
  have hj : t - (B.run m k).clock < (B.observe (B.run m k)).expose.duration m := by
    rw [ReadySnapshot.expose_duration]
    change t < (B.run m k).clock + (B.observe (B.run m k)).duration m at hk₂
    omega
  have hp := sffPolicy_round_decision m (B.publicHistory m) (B.run m k).clock
    (B.observe (B.run m k)).expose (B.publicPolicy_boundary_state hm k)
    (B.publicHistory_boundary hm k) (t - (B.run m k).clock) hj
  rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le hk₁, ReadySnapshot.expose_action] at hp
  rw [B.execution_slot_eq hm hk₁ hk₂]
  exact hp.symm

/-- Equal public history prefixes force equal SFF decisions across arbitrary
finite hidden domains. No equality of hidden DAGs, domain sizes, or future
batch sets is required. -/

Scheduling.Batching.execution_nonclairvo.source:
theorem execution_nonclairvoyant {otherJobs otherVertices otherBatches otherL m : ℕ}
    {J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices} (C : Batching J otherL otherBatches)
    [DecidableRel J.edge] (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, B.publicHistory m u = C.publicHistory m u) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => B.execution m v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (univ.filter (fun v => C.execution m v = t)).image Fin.val := by
  rw [B.execution_publicPolicy hm, C.execution_publicPolicy hm]
  exact (sffPolicy m).decision_eq_of_history_eq _ _ t h

end Batching
end Scheduling

Scheduling.SFFRounds.smallFront.source:
noncomputable def smallFront (k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k) ∧ I.Ready S (R.boundary k) v)

Scheduling.SFFRounds.youngFront.source:
noncomputable def youngFront (a k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  (R.smallFront k).filter (fun v => a < B.eligible (B.vertexBatch v))

Scheduling.SFFRounds.oldService.source:
noncomputable def oldService (a k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => B.eligible (B.vertexBatch v) ≤ a ∧
    R.boundary k ≤ S v ∧ S v < R.boundary (k + 1))

Scheduling.SFFRounds.capacity_le_front_p.source:
theorem capacity_le_front_plus_one (k : ℕ) :
    m * (R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k) ≤ (R.smallFront k).card + m := by
  have hmul := Nat.div_mul_le_self ((R.smallFront k).card + m - 1) m
  rw [R.length_eq k]
  change m * max 1 (((R.smallFront k).card + m - 1) / m) ≤ _
  by_cases hq : 1 ≤ ((R.smallFront k).card + m - 1) / m
  · rw [max_eq_right hq]
    calc
      _ = ((R.smallFront k).card + m - 1) / m * m := Nat.mul_comm _ _
      _ ≤ (R.smallFront k).card + m - 1 := hmul
      _ ≤ (R.smallFront k).card + m := Nat.sub_le _ _
  · have hq' : ((R.smallFront k).card + m - 1) / m ≤ 1 := by omega
    rw [max_eq_left hq']
    omega

Scheduling.SFFRounds.small_front_partiti.source:
theorem small_front_partition (a k : ℕ) :
    (R.smallFront k).card ≤ (R.oldService a k).card + (R.youngFront a k).card := by
  classical
  have hsub : R.smallFront k ⊆ R.oldService a k ∪ R.youngFront a k := by
    intro v hv
    have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    by_cases he : a < B.eligible (B.vertexBatch v)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hv, he⟩)
    · apply mem_union_left
      exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega, hv'.2.2.1,
        R.clear_small k (B.vertexBatch v) hv'.1 v rfl hv'.2⟩
  exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_union_le _ _)

/-- The only per-round exceptional capacity is one slot when the target batch
is small. When it is large, the oldest filler belongs to the old prefix. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.round_interference.source:
theorem round_interference (_hm : 0 < m) {b : Fin batches} {a k : ℕ}
    (hba : B.eligible b ≤ a) (hb : B.Active S (R.boundary k) b) :
    m * (R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k) ≤
      (R.oldService a k).card + (R.youngFront a k).card +
        (if b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k) then m else 0) := by
  classical
  by_cases hs : b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)
  · rw [if_pos hs]
    have hc := R.capacity_le_front_plus_one k
    have hp := R.small_front_partition a k
    omega
  · rw [if_neg hs]
    have hl : b ∈ B.large m S (R.boundary k) := (B.active_small_or_large hb).resolve_left hs
    have hf : (I.executedDuring S (R.boundary k) (R.boundary (k + 1))).card =
        m * (R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k) :=
      I.executedDuring_card (fun t ht ht' => R.fill_last k ⟨b, hl⟩ t ht ht')
    have hsub : I.executedDuring S (R.boundary k) (R.boundary (k + 1)) ⊆
        R.oldService a k ∪ R.youngFront a k := by
      intro v hv
      have htime := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      by_cases he : B.eligible (B.vertexBatch v) ≤ a
      · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, he, htime⟩)
      · apply mem_union_right
        have hscope := R.service_scope k v htime.1 htime.2
        rcases hscope with hsmall | hfill
        · exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hsmall⟩, by omega⟩
        · have ho := R.filler_oldest k (B.vertexBatch v) b hfill hl
          omega
    have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_union_le _ _)
    rw [hf] at hc
    omega

/-- Old service charges are to distinct vertices in disjoint round intervals. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.old_service_sum_bou.source:
theorem old_service_sum_bound {A K : ℕ} (_hAK : A ≤ K) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico A K, (R.oldService (R.boundary A) k).card) ≤
      (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary A)).card := by
  classical
  have hd : (↑(Ico A K) : Set ℕ).PairwiseDisjoint (R.oldService (R.boundary A)) := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro v hvi hvj
    have hvi' := (mem_filter.mp hvi).2
    have hvj' := (mem_filter.mp hvj).2
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with h | h
    · have ht := R.strict.monotone (show i + 1 ≤ j by omega)
      omega
    · have ht := R.strict.monotone (show j + 1 ≤ i by omega)
      omega
  rw [← card_biUnion hd]
  apply card_le_card
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hv⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hv
  have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  have ht := R.strict.monotone (mem_Ico.mp hk).1
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv'.1, by omega⟩

/-- Telescoping the round lengths does not lose time to natural subtraction. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.lengths_sum.source:
theorem lengths_sum {A K : ℕ} (hAK : A ≤ K) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico A K, (R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k)) = R.boundary K - R.boundary A := by
  induction K, hAK using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => simp
  | succ K hAK ih =>
    have he : Ico A (K + 1) = insert K (Ico A K) := by
      ext x; simp only [mem_Ico, mem_insert]; omega
    rw [he, sum_insert (by simp), ih]
    have h₁ := R.strict.monotone hAK
    have h₂ := R.strict.monotone (show K ≤ K + 1 by omega)
    omega

/-- The small frontiers of all younger batches cost at most mL per batch
over the whole interval, not m times the interval's length per batch. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.young_front_sum_bou.source:
theorem young_front_sum_bound (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    {A K : ℕ} (_hAK : A ≤ K) :
    (∑ k ∈ Ico A K, (R.youngFront (R.boundary A) k).card) ≤
      (univ.filter (fun b => R.boundary A < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary K)).card * (L * m) := by
  classical
  let N := univ.filter (fun b => R.boundary A < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary K)
  have hper : ∀ k ∈ Ico A K, (R.youngFront (R.boundary A) k).card ≤
      ∑ b ∈ N, if b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k) then m else 0 := by
    intro k hk
    have heq : (R.youngFront (R.boundary A) k).card =
        ∑ b ∈ N, ((R.youngFront (R.boundary A) k).filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b)).card :=
      card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by
        intro v hv
        have hv' := mem_filter.mp hv
        have hsmall := (mem_filter.mp hv'.1).2.1
        have helig := (mem_filter.mp hsmall).2.1.1
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv'.2, helig.trans (R.strict.monotone (by have := (mem_Ico.mp hk).2; omega))⟩)
    rw [heq]
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro b hb
    by_cases hsmall : b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)
    · rw [if_pos hsmall]
      have hsub : (R.youngFront (R.boundary A) k).filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b) ⊆
          B.frontier S (R.boundary k) b := by
        intro v hv
        have hi := mem_filter.mp hv
        have hr := (mem_filter.mp (mem_filter.mp hi.1).1).2.2
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hi.2, hr⟩
      exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (mem_filter.mp hsmall).2.2
    · rw [if_neg hsmall]
      apply Nat.le_zero.mpr
      apply card_eq_zero.mpr
      apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
      intro v hv
      have hi := mem_filter.mp hv
      have hs := (mem_filter.mp (mem_filter.mp hi.1).1).2.1
      rw [hi.2] at hs
      exact hsmall hs
  have hs := sum_le_sum hper
  rw [sum_comm] at hs
  have hb : ∀ b ∈ N, (∑ k ∈ Ico A K, if b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k) then m else 0) ≤ L * m := by
    intro b hb
    have hsub : (Ico A K).filter (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)) ⊆
        Instance.markedRounds (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)) K := by
      intro k hk
      have hk' := mem_filter.mp hk
      simp only [Instance.markedRounds, mem_filter, mem_range]
      exact ⟨(mem_Ico.mp hk'.1).2, hk'.2⟩
    have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (R.small_round_count hO hL b K)
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hc
    simpa [sum_ite] using hm
  have hh := hs.trans (sum_le_sum hb)
  simpa [N] using hh

/-- Aggregate interference while the target batch remains unfinished at all
round starts. The count is derived from frontier service and eligibility
spacing; no interference bound is assumed in the round specification. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.interval_capacity_b.source:
theorem interval_capacity_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    {A K : ℕ} {b : Fin batches} (hAK : A ≤ K)
    (hba : B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary A)
    (hactive : ∀ k, A ≤ k → k < K → B.Active S (R.boundary k) b) :
    m * (R.boundary K - R.boundary A) ≤
      16 * m * L ^ 2 +
      (univ.filter (fun c => R.boundary A < B.eligible c ∧ B.eligible c ≤ R.boundary K)).card * (L * m) + L * m := by
  classical
  have hs := sum_le_sum (s := Ico A K) (fun k hk =>
    R.round_interference hm hba (hactive k (mem_Ico.mp hk).1 (mem_Ico.mp hk).2))
  rw [← mul_sum, R.lengths_sum hAK, sum_add_distrib, sum_add_distrib] at hs
  have ho := (R.old_service_sum_bound hAK).trans (R.remaining_work_bound hm hLp hO hL A)
  have hy := R.young_front_sum_bound hO hL hAK
  have hmcount : (∑ k ∈ Ico A K, if b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k) then m else 0) ≤ L * m := by
    have hsub : (Ico A K).filter (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)) ⊆
        Instance.markedRounds (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)) K := by
      intro k hk
      have hk' := mem_filter.mp hk
      simp only [Instance.markedRounds, mem_filter, mem_range]
      exact ⟨(mem_Ico.mp hk'.1).2, hk'.2⟩
    have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (R.small_round_count hO hL b K)
    simpa [sum_ite] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right m hc
  omega

/-- The full SFF duration estimate for every finite prefix of unfinished
rounds, now proved using the concrete schedule and operational round routine. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.unfinished_interval.source:
theorem unfinished_interval_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    {A K : ℕ} {b : Fin batches} (hAK : A ≤ K)
    (hba : B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary A)
    (hactive : ∀ k, A ≤ k → k < K → B.Active S (R.boundary k) b) :
    R.boundary K - R.boundary A ≤ 32 * L ^ 2 + 4 * L := by
  have hcap := R.interval_capacity_bound hm hLp hO hL hAK hba hactive
  have hnew := B.eligible_count_scaled hLp (R.strict.monotone hAK)
  have hscaled := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hnew
  have hmul : m * (R.boundary K - R.boundary A) ≤ m * (32 * L ^ 2 + 4 * L) := by
    nlinarith
  exact Nat.le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul hm

end Scheduling.SFFRounds

Scheduling.Batching.source:
structure Batching (I : Instance jobs vertices) (L batches : ℕ) where
  index : Fin jobs → Fin batches
  lower : ∀ j, 2 * L * (index j).val ≤ I.release j
  upper : ∀ j, I.release j < 2 * L * ((index j).val + 1)

namespace Batching
variable {I : Instance jobs vertices} {L : ℕ} (B : Batching I L batches)

Scheduling.Batching.vertexBatch.source: def vertexBatch (v : Fin vertices) : Fin batches := B.index (I.owner v)

Scheduling.Batching.eligible.source: def eligible (_B : Batching I L batches) (b : Fin batches) : ℕ := 2 * L * (b.val + 1)

Scheduling.Batching.batchVertices.source:
noncomputable def batchVertices (b : Fin batches) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b)

Scheduling.Batching.frontier.source:
noncomputable def frontier (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) (b : Fin batches) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b ∧ I.Ready S t v)

Scheduling.Batching.Active.source:
def Active (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) (b : Fin batches) : Prop :=
  B.eligible b ≤ t ∧ ∃ v, B.vertexBatch v = b ∧ t ≤ S v

Scheduling.Batching.small.source:
noncomputable def small (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin batches) :=
  univ.filter (fun b => B.Active S t b ∧ (B.frontier S t b).card ≤ m)

Scheduling.Batching.large.source:
noncomputable def large (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin batches) :=
  univ.filter (fun b => B.Active S t b ∧ m < (B.frontier S t b).card)

Scheduling.Batching.predecessor_closed.source:
theorem predecessor_closed (b : Fin batches) : I.PredecessorClosed (B.batchVertices b) := by
  intro u v hv he
  have ho := I.same_job he
  have h := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by simpa [vertexBatch, ho] using h⟩

Scheduling.Batching.released_by_eligible.source:
theorem released_by_eligible {v : Fin vertices} {b : Fin batches} (hv : B.vertexBatch v = b) :
    I.release (I.owner v) < B.eligible b := by
  have h := B.upper (I.owner v)
  change B.index (I.owner v) = b at hv
  rw [hv] at h
  exact h

Scheduling.Batching.active_small_or_larg.source:
theorem active_small_or_large {m : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {t : ℕ} {b : Fin batches}
    (ha : B.Active S t b) : b ∈ B.small m S t ∨ b ∈ B.large m S t := by
  by_cases h : (B.frontier S t b).card ≤ m
  · exact Or.inl (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ha, h⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ha, by omega⟩)

Scheduling.Batching.small_large_disjoint.source:
theorem small_large_disjoint (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (B.small m S t) (B.large m S t) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro b hs hl
  have hs' := (mem_filter.mp hs).2.2
  have hl' := (mem_filter.mp hl).2.2
  omega

Scheduling.Batching.active_at_earlier.source:
theorem active_at_earlier {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)} {a t : ℕ} {b : Fin batches}
    (ha : B.eligible b ≤ a) (hat : a ≤ t) (ht : B.Active S t b) : B.Active S a b := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hs⟩ := ht.2
  exact ⟨ha, v, hv, by omega⟩

Scheduling.Batching.eligible_positive.source:
theorem eligible_positive (hL : 0 < L) (b : Fin batches) : 0 < B.eligible b := by
  dsimp [eligible]
  positivity

Scheduling.Batching.batch_work_bound.source:
theorem batch_work_bound {m : ℕ} {O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (b : Fin batches) :
    (B.batchVertices b).card ≤ 3 * m * L := by
  classical
  let a := 2 * L * b.val
  let z := 2 * L * (b.val + 1)
  have h := card_le_slots O m a (z + L) (B.batchVertices b) hO.capacity (by
    intro v hv
    have hi := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have hl := B.lower (I.owner v)
    have hu := B.upper (I.owner v)
    change 2 * L * (B.vertexBatch v).val ≤ _ at hl
    change _ < 2 * L * ((B.vertexBatch v).val + 1) at hu
    rw [hi] at hl hu
    have hr := hO.release v
    have hf := hL v
    exact ⟨by dsimp [a]; omega, by dsimp [z]; omega⟩)
  have hz : z = a + 2 * L := by dsimp [z, a]; ring
  have he : z + L - a = 3 * L := by rw [hz]; omega
  rw [he] at h
  nlinarith

/-- The number of batch eligibility times in a bounded interval. The +1
allows either position of the endpoints relative to the eligibility grid. -/

Scheduling.Batching.eligible_count_bound.source:
theorem eligible_count_bound {u v : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (hspan : v ≤ u + 4 * L ^ 2) :
    (univ.filter (fun b : Fin batches => u < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ v)).card ≤ 2 * L + 1 := by
  classical
  let A := univ.filter (fun b : Fin batches => u < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ v)
  let lo := u / (2 * L)
  have hmod := Nat.mod_lt u (show 0 < 2 * L by omega)
  have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div u (2 * L)
  have hsub : A.image Fin.val ⊆ Ico lo (lo + (2 * L + 1)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    have ht := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    dsimp [eligible] at ht
    apply mem_Ico.mpr
    constructor
    · dsimp [lo]
      by_contra hn
      have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * L) (show b.val + 1 ≤ u / (2 * L) by omega)
      have hu : 2 * L * (u / (2 * L)) ≤ u := by omega
      exact Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hm.trans hu) ht.1
    · dsimp [lo]
      by_contra hn
      have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * L)
        (show u / (2 * L) + (2 * L + 1) ≤ b.val by omega)
      nlinarith
  have he : (A.image Fin.val).card = A.card := card_image_of_injective A Fin.val_injective
  have hc := card_le_card hsub
  rw [he] at hc
  simpa [A, Nat.card_Ico] using hc

/-- Denominator-free eligibility counting, for interference over any interval. -/

Scheduling.Batching.eligible_count_scale.source:
theorem eligible_count_scaled {u v : ℕ} (hL : 0 < L) (huv : u ≤ v) :
    2 * L * (univ.filter (fun b : Fin batches => u < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ v)).card
      ≤ v - u + 2 * L := by
  classical
  let A := univ.filter (fun b : Fin batches => u < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ v)
  have hd : 0 < 2 * L := by omega
  have hu := Nat.mod_add_div u (2 * L)
  have hv := Nat.mod_add_div v (2 * L)
  have hum := Nat.mod_lt u hd
  have hvm := Nat.mod_lt v hd
  have hsub : A.image Fin.val ⊆ Ico (u / (2 * L)) (v / (2 * L)) := by
    intro x hx
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
    have ht := (mem_filter.mp hb).2
    change u < 2 * L * (b.val + 1) ∧ 2 * L * (b.val + 1) ≤ v at ht
    apply mem_Ico.mpr
    constructor
    · by_contra hn
      have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * L) (show b.val + 1 ≤ u / (2 * L) by omega)
      have hle : 2 * L * (u / (2 * L)) ≤ u := by omega
      exact Nat.not_lt_of_ge (hm.trans hle) ht.1
    · have hle : b.val + 1 ≤ v / (2 * L) := by
        apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hd).mpr
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using ht.2
      omega
  have hc := card_le_card hsub
  rw [card_image_of_injective A Fin.val_injective, Nat.card_Ico] at hc
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 * L) hc
  have hq : u / (2 * L) ≤ v / (2 * L) := Nat.div_le_div_right huv
  have hsum := Nat.sub_add_cancel hq
  have hscaled := congrArg (fun n => 2 * L * n) hsum
  have hvu : v - u + u = v := Nat.sub_add_cancel huv
  try dsimp only at hscaled
  rw [Nat.mul_add] at hscaled
  change 2 * L * A.card ≤ _
  omega

end Batching

/-- Operational round specification for SFF. There is no small-batch-count,
round-length upper bound, depth-drop assumption, or backlog bound in this
structure. Its fields describe the paper's fixed-frontier round routine. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.source:
structure SFFRounds {I : Instance jobs vertices} {L : ℕ}
    (B : Batching I L batches) (m : ℕ) (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) where
  boundary : ℕ → ℕ
  starts_zero : boundary 0 = 0
  strict : StrictMono boundary
  clear_small : ∀ k b, b ∈ B.small m S (boundary k) →
    ∀ v, B.vertexBatch v = b → I.Ready S (boundary k) v → S v < boundary (k + 1)
  filler : ℕ → Option (Fin batches)
  large_service : ∀ k v, boundary k ≤ S v → S v < boundary (k + 1) →
    B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.large m S (boundary k) → filler k = some (B.vertexBatch v)
  length_eq : ∀ k, boundary (k + 1) - boundary k =
    max 1 (((univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m S (boundary k) ∧
      I.Ready S (boundary k) v)).card + m - 1) / m)
  eligible_service : ∀ v, B.eligible (B.vertexBatch v) ≤ S v
  packed : ∀ k t, boundary k ≤ t → t + 1 < boundary (k + 1) →
    (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m
  fill_last : ∀ k, (B.large m S (boundary k)).Nonempty →
    ∀ t, boundary k ≤ t → t < boundary (k + 1) →
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card = m
  service_scope : ∀ k v, boundary k ≤ S v → S v < boundary (k + 1) →
    (B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m S (boundary k) ∧ I.Ready S (boundary k) v) ∨
      filler k = some (B.vertexBatch v)
  filler_oldest : ∀ k b c, filler k = some b → c ∈ B.large m S (boundary k) →
    B.eligible b ≤ B.eligible c

end Scheduling

Scheduling.batchObservation.source:
def batchObservation (L t : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) : PublicSnapshot where
  support := (Q.filter (fun x => 2 * L * ((ofLex x).1 / (2 * L) + 1) ≤ t)).image
    (fun x => (ofLex x).1 / (2 * L))
  ready := fun b => ((Q.filter (fun x => 2 * L * ((ofLex x).1 / (2 * L) + 1) ≤ t)).filter
    (fun x => (ofLex x).1 / (2 * L) = b)).image (fun x => (ofLex x).2)
  supported := by
    intro b
    simp only [mem_image, image_nonempty, filter_nonempty_iff]

Scheduling.mem_batchObservation.source:
theorem mem_batchObservation (L t b n : ℕ) (Q : FIFOObservation) :
    n ∈ (batchObservation L t Q).ready b ↔
      ∃ x ∈ Q, (ofLex x).1 / (2 * L) = b ∧ 2 * L * (b + 1) ≤ t ∧ (ofLex x).2 = n := by
  simp only [batchObservation, mem_image, mem_filter]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨⟨hx, he⟩, hb⟩, hn⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, hb, by simpa [hb] using he, hn⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb, he, hn⟩
    exact ⟨x, ⟨⟨hx, by simpa [hb] using he⟩, hb⟩, hn⟩

Scheduling.sffRawPolicy.source:
def sffRawPolicy (m L : ℕ) : OnlinePolicy FIFOObservation SFFMemory (Finset ℕ) where
  initial := none
  step := fun t Q state => sffStep m t (batchObservation L t Q) state

Scheduling.sffRawPolicy_state.source:
theorem sffRawPolicy_state (m L : ℕ) (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffRawPolicy m L).state history t =
      (sffPolicy m).state (fun u => batchObservation L u (history u)) t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [OnlinePolicy.state]
    rw [ih]
    rfl

Scheduling.sffRawPolicy_decision.source:
theorem sffRawPolicy_decision (m L : ℕ) (history : ℕ → FIFOObservation) (t : ℕ) :
    (sffRawPolicy m L).decision history t =
      (sffPolicy m).decision (fun u => batchObservation L u (history u)) t := by
  unfold OnlinePolicy.decision
  rw [sffRawPolicy_state]
  rfl

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices) [DecidableRel I.edge]

/-- All currently ready vertices, labeled by their release time and public
identifier. No future job or unrevealed vertex is present. -/

Scheduling.Instance.mem_readyObservation.source:
theorem mem_readyObservation (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    x ∈ I.readyObservation S t ↔ ∃ v, I.Ready S t v ∧ I.fifoPriority v = x := by
  simp only [readyObservation, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Ready]

Scheduling.Instance.fifo_readyObservatio.source:
theorem fifo_readyObservation {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    I.readyObservation (I.fifoSchedule m hm) t = I.fifoObservation m t := by
  unfold readyObservation fifoObservation
  congr 1
  ext v
  simpa only [mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Ready] using (I.fifo_ready_iff hm v t).symm

Scheduling.Instance.fifoSchedule_publicP.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_publicPolicy {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      fifoPolicy m (I.readyObservation (I.fifoSchedule m hm) t) := by
  rw [I.fifo_readyObservation hm, ← I.fifo_action_eq hm, I.fifoAction_public]

end Instance

namespace Batching
variable {jobs vertices batches L : ℕ} {I : Instance jobs vertices}
variable (B : Batching I L batches) [DecidableRel I.edge]

Scheduling.Batching.observe_schedule_rea.source:
theorem observe_schedule_ready (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ)
    (b : Fin batches) (v : Fin vertices) :
    v ∈ (B.observe ⟨t, fun u => if S u < t then some (S u) else none⟩).ready b ↔
      B.vertexBatch v = b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ t ∧ I.Ready S t v := by
  have hnone (u : Fin vertices) : (if S u < t then some (S u) else none) = none ↔ t ≤ S u := by
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  have hdone (u : Fin vertices) : (if S u < t then some (S u) else none) ≠ none ↔ S u < t := by
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  simp only [observe, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, hnone, hdone, Instance.Ready]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hb, he, hv, hp⟩
    have hr := B.released_by_eligible hb
    exact ⟨hb, he, by omega, hv, hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨hb, he, _, hv, hp⟩
    exact ⟨hb, he, hv, hp⟩

end Batching

namespace Instance
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices) [DecidableRel I.edge]

/-- The SFF environment's admitted frontiers are computable from the raw
ready observation; the finite batch count does not add information. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sff_publicHistory_eq.source:
theorem sff_publicHistory_eq (m L : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (t : ℕ) :
    (I.canonicalBatching L hL).publicHistory m t =
      batchObservation L t (I.readyObservation (I.sffSchedule m L hL) t) := by
  let B := I.canonicalBatching L hL
  apply PublicSnapshot.ext_ready
  funext b
  ext n
  rw [mem_batchObservation]
  change n ∈ (B.observe ⟨t, fun v => if B.execution m v < t
    then some (B.execution m v) else none⟩).expose.ready b ↔ _
  rw [ReadySnapshot.mem_expose_ready]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨c, hc, v, hv, hn⟩
    have hv' := (B.observe_schedule_ready _ t c v).mp hv
    refine ⟨I.fifoPriority v, (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mpr ⟨v, hv'.2.2, rfl⟩, ?_, ?_, hn⟩
    · have he := congrArg Fin.val hv'.1
      change I.release (I.owner v) / (2 * L) = c.val at he
      exact he.trans hc
    · have he := hv'.2.1
      change 2 * L * (c.val + 1) ≤ t at he
      simpa [hc] using he
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hb, he, hn⟩
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation _ _ _).mp hx
    let c := B.vertexBatch v
    have hc : c.val = b := hb
    refine ⟨c, hc, v, (B.observe_schedule_ready _ _ _ _).mpr ⟨rfl, ?_, hv⟩, hn⟩
    change 2 * L * (c.val + 1) ≤ t
    simpa [hc] using he

/-- SFF is non-clairvoyant with respect to ordinary ready observations,
even across instances with different hidden jobs, vertices, and batches. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sffSchedule_nonclair.source:
theorem sffSchedule_nonclairvoyant {otherJobs otherVertices m L : ℕ}
    (J : Instance otherJobs otherVertices) [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ u ≤ t, I.readyObservation (I.sffSchedule m L hL) u =
      J.readyObservation (J.sffSchedule m L hL) u) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.sffSchedule m L hL v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (univ.filter (fun v => J.sffSchedule m L hL v = t)).image Fin.val := by
  apply (I.canonicalBatching L hL).execution_nonclairvoyant (J.canonicalBatching L hL) hm t
  intro u hu
  rw [I.sff_publicHistory_eq, J.sff_publicHistory_eq, h u hu]

/-- The constructed SFF schedule realizes a single stateful policy whose
inputs are raw ready observations, the processor count, and the guess. -/

Scheduling.Instance.sffSchedule_publicPo.source:
theorem sffSchedule_publicPolicy {m L : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hL : 0 < L) (t : ℕ) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => I.sffSchedule m L hL v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (sffRawPolicy m L).decision (I.readyObservation (I.sffSchedule m L hL)) t := by
  rw [sffRawPolicy_decision]
  have he : (I.canonicalBatching L hL).publicHistory m =
      fun u => batchObservation L u (I.readyObservation (I.sffSchedule m L hL) u) :=
    funext (fun u => I.sff_publicHistory_eq m L hL u)
  rw [← he]
  exact (I.canonicalBatching L hL).execution_publicPolicy hm t

end Instance
end Scheduling

Scheduling.SFFRounds.small_round_count.source:
theorem small_round_count (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    (b : Fin batches) (K : ℕ) :
    (Instance.markedRounds (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)) K).card ≤ L := by
  classical
  apply I.frontier_round_count_bound hO hL (B.batchVertices b) (B.predecessor_closed b)
    R.boundary R.strict.monotone (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k))
  · intro k hk v hv
    have ha := (mem_filter.mp hk).2.1.1
    exact (B.released_by_eligible (mem_filter.mp hv).2).le.trans ha
  · intro k hk v hv hr
    exact R.clear_small k b hk v (mem_filter.mp hv).2 hr
  · intro k hk
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hu⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hk).2.1.2
    exact ⟨v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv⟩, hu⟩

Scheduling.SFFRounds.small_rounds_before.source:
theorem small_rounds_before_lt (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    {b : Fin batches} {K : ℕ} (hb : b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary K)) :
    (Instance.markedRounds (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k)) K).card < L := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hu⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hb).2.1.2
  have hp := I.frontier_round_progress hO (B.batchVertices b) (B.predecessor_closed b)
    R.boundary R.strict.monotone (fun k => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k))
    (by
      intro k hk w hw
      have ha := (mem_filter.mp hk).2.1.1
      exact (B.released_by_eligible (mem_filter.mp hw).2).le.trans ha)
    (by intro k hk w hw hr; exact R.clear_small k b hk w (mem_filter.mp hw).2 hr)
    K v (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv⟩) hu
  have hl := hL v
  omega

Scheduling.SFFRounds.switches.source:
noncomputable def switches (k : ℕ) : Finset (Fin batches) :=
  (B.large m S (R.boundary k)).filter (fun b => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary (k + 1)))

/-- A batch can shrink from large to small only if one of its vertices is
processed during the round. Readiness depends only on its own predecessors. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.switch_has_service.source:
theorem switch_has_service {k : ℕ} {b : Fin batches} (hb : b ∈ R.switches k) :
    ∃ v, B.vertexBatch v = b ∧ R.boundary k ≤ S v ∧ S v < R.boundary (k + 1) := by
  classical
  have hl := (mem_filter.mp (mem_filter.mp hb).1).2.2
  have hs := (mem_filter.mp (mem_filter.mp hb).2).2.2
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hsub : B.frontier S (R.boundary k) b ⊆ B.frontier S (R.boundary (k + 1)) b := by
    intro v hv
    have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    have ht := hn v hv'.1 hv'.2.2.1
    refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv'.1, hv'.2.1.trans (R.strict.monotone (by omega)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · omega
    · intro u he
      exact (hv'.2.2.2 u he).trans_le (R.strict.monotone (by omega))
  have hc := card_le_card hsub
  omega

Scheduling.SFFRounds.switches_card_le_on.source:
theorem switches_card_le_one (k : ℕ) : (R.switches k).card ≤ 1 := by
  apply card_le_one.mpr
  intro b hb c hc
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hv₁, hv₂⟩ := R.switch_has_service hb
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hw₁, hw₂⟩ := R.switch_has_service hc
  have hf₁ := R.large_service k v hv₁ hv₂ (by simpa [hv] using (mem_filter.mp hb).1)
  have hf₂ := R.large_service k w hw₁ hw₂ (by simpa [hw] using (mem_filter.mp hc).1)
  rw [hv] at hf₁
  rw [hw] at hf₂
  exact Option.some.inj (hf₁.symm.trans hf₂)

Scheduling.SFFRounds.round_length_le_sma.source:
theorem round_length_le_small_count (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) :
    R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k ≤ max 1 (B.small m S (R.boundary k)).card := by
  classical
  let P := univ.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k) ∧ I.Ready S (R.boundary k) v)
  have heq : P.card = ∑ b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k), (P.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by intro v hv; exact (mem_filter.mp hv).2.1)
  have hc : P.card ≤ (B.small m S (R.boundary k)).card * m := by
    rw [heq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary k), m := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro b hb
        have hsub : P.filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b) ⊆ B.frontier S (R.boundary k) b := by
          intro v hv
          have hv' := mem_filter.mp hv
          exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv'.2, (mem_filter.mp hv'.1).2.2⟩
        exact (card_le_card hsub).trans (mem_filter.mp hb).2.2
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hdiv : (P.card + m - 1) / m ≤ (B.small m S (R.boundary k)).card := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hm).mpr
    have hminus : P.card + m - 1 + 1 = P.card + m := by omega
    nlinarith
  rw [R.length_eq k]
  exact max_le_max le_rfl hdiv

/-- Sum a bound on earlier round lengths over any suffix of the past. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.boundary_span.source:
theorem boundary_span {K a D : ℕ} (ha : a ≤ K)
    (hprev : ∀ k < K, R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k ≤ D) :
    R.boundary K ≤ R.boundary a + (K - a) * D := by
  have h : ∀ n, a ≤ n → n ≤ K → R.boundary n ≤ R.boundary a + (n - a) * D := by
    intro n hn
    induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => intro _; simp
    | succ n hn ih =>
      intro hnK
      have hip := ih (by omega)
      have hd := hprev n (by omega)
      have hm := R.strict.monotone (show n ≤ n + 1 by omega)
      have he : n + 1 - a = n - a + 1 := by omega
      rw [he, Nat.add_mul]
      omega
  exact h K ha le_rfl

/-- Every currently small batch either became eligible recently or crossed
from large to small at one of the recent boundaries. The depth argument
rules out an old batch that was small in every one of the preceding L rounds. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.small_cover.source:
theorem small_cover (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (hLp : 0 < L) (K : ℕ) :
    B.small m S (R.boundary K) ⊆
      univ.filter (fun b => R.boundary (K - L) < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary K) ∪
      (Ico (K - L) K).biUnion R.switches := by
  classical
  intro b hb
  have ha := (mem_filter.mp hb).2.1
  by_cases hnew : R.boundary (K - L) < B.eligible b
  · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hnew, ha.1⟩)
  · apply mem_union_right
    by_contra hn
    have hold : B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary (K - L) := by omega
    have hLK : L ≤ K := by
      by_contra hh
      have he : K - L = 0 := by omega
      rw [he, R.starts_zero] at hold
      have := B.eligible_positive hLp b
      omega
    have hnoswitch : ∀ r, K - L ≤ r → r < K → b ∉ R.switches r := by
      intro r hr hrK hsw
      exact hn (mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨r, mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hr, hrK⟩, hsw⟩)
    have back : ∀ d r, r + d = K → K - L ≤ r → b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary r) := by
      intro d
      induction d with
      | zero =>
        intro r he _
        have her : r = K := by omega
        rw [her]
        exact hb
      | succ d ih =>
        intro r he hr
        have hnext := ih (r + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
        have har : B.Active S (R.boundary r) b :=
          B.active_at_earlier (hold.trans (R.strict.monotone hr))
            (R.strict.monotone (by omega)) ha
        rcases B.active_small_or_large (m := m) har with hs | hl
        · exact hs
        · exfalso
          exact hnoswitch r hr (by omega) (mem_filter.mpr ⟨hl, hnext⟩)
    have hsub : Ico (K - L) K ⊆ Instance.markedRounds
        (fun r => b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary r)) K := by
      intro r hr
      have hr' := mem_Ico.mp hr
      simp only [Instance.markedRounds, mem_filter, mem_range]
      exact ⟨hr'.2, back (K - r) r (by omega) hr'.1⟩
    have hc := card_le_card hsub
    have hcL : (Ico (K - L) K).card = L := by simp; omega
    rw [hcL] at hc
    have hs := R.small_rounds_before_lt hO hL hb
    omega

/-- Lemma 12. Both bounds are proved simultaneously by strong induction on
the round index, from the operational fixed-frontier routine. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.round_bounds.source:
theorem round_bounds (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (K : ℕ) :
    (B.small m S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 4 * L ∧
    R.boundary (K + 1) - R.boundary K ≤ 4 * L := by
  classical
  induction K using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h K ih =>
    have hprev : ∀ k < K, R.boundary (k + 1) - R.boundary k ≤ 4 * L :=
      fun k hk => (ih k hk).2
    have hspan := R.boundary_span (a := K - L) (Nat.sub_le K L) hprev
    have hwin : R.boundary K ≤ R.boundary (K - L) + 4 * L ^ 2 := by
      have hd : K - (K - L) ≤ L := by omega
      have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (4 * L) hd
      nlinarith
    have hnew := B.eligible_count_bound hLp hwin
    have hturn : ((Ico (K - L) K).biUnion R.switches).card ≤ L := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ∑ r ∈ Ico (K - L) K, (R.switches r).card := card_biUnion_le
        _ ≤ ∑ _r ∈ Ico (K - L) K, 1 := by
          apply sum_le_sum
          intro r _
          exact R.switches_card_le_one r
        _ ≤ L := by simp; omega
    have hcover := card_le_card (R.small_cover hO hL hLp K)
    have hu := card_union_le
      (univ.filter (fun b => R.boundary (K - L) < B.eligible b ∧ B.eligible b ≤ R.boundary K))
      ((Ico (K - L) K).biUnion R.switches)
    have hsmall : (B.small m S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 4 * L := by omega
    refine ⟨hsmall, (R.round_length_le_small_count hm K).trans ?_⟩
    exact max_le (by omega) hsmall

end Scheduling.SFFRounds

Scheduling.Batching.eligibleWork.source:
noncomputable def eligibleWork (u v : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun w => u < B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ∧ B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ v)

Scheduling.Batching.admittedRemaining.source:
noncomputable def admittedRemaining (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t : ℕ) : Finset (Fin vertices) :=
  univ.filter (fun w => B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S w)

/-- Work admitted through an interval of eligibility times (Lemma 11). -/

Scheduling.Batching.eligible_work_bound.source:
theorem eligible_work_bound (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L)
    {u v : ℕ} (huv : u ≤ v) : (B.eligibleWork u v).card ≤ m * (v - u + 3 * L) := by
  classical
  have h := card_le_slots O m (u - 2 * L) (v + L) (B.eligibleWork u v) hO.capacity (by
    intro w hw
    have hw' := (mem_filter.mp hw).2
    have hl := B.lower (I.owner w)
    have hu := B.upper (I.owner w)
    have he : B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ I.release (I.owner w) + 2 * L := by
      dsimp [eligible, vertexBatch]
      nlinarith
    have hp := hO.release w
    have hf := hL w
    have hrel := B.released_by_eligible (v := w) rfl
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
  have he : v + L - (u - 2 * L) ≤ v - u + 3 * L := by omega
  exact h.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left m he)

/-- Conservation of all admitted work, including unrevealed vertices. -/

Scheduling.Batching.admitted_accounting.source:
theorem admitted_accounting (hE : ∀ w, B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ S w)
    {u v : ℕ} (huv : u ≤ v) :
    (B.admittedRemaining S v).card + (I.executedDuring S u v).card ≤
      (B.admittedRemaining S u).card + (B.eligibleWork u v).card := by
  classical
  have hd : Disjoint (B.admittedRemaining S v) (I.executedDuring S u v) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro w hw hz
    have hw' := (mem_filter.mp hw).2
    have hz' := (mem_filter.mp hz).2
    omega
  have hsub : B.admittedRemaining S v ∪ I.executedDuring S u v ⊆
      B.admittedRemaining S u ∪ B.eligibleWork u v := by
    intro w hw
    have hs : u ≤ S w := by
      rcases mem_union.mp hw with h | h
      · have := (mem_filter.mp h).2; omega
      · exact (mem_filter.mp h).2.1
    have he : B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ v := by
      rcases mem_union.mp hw with h | h
      · exact (mem_filter.mp h).2.1
      · have := (mem_filter.mp h).2; have := hE w; omega
    by_cases hold : B.eligible (B.vertexBatch w) ≤ u
    · exact mem_union_left _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hold, hs⟩)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by omega, he⟩)
  have hc := (card_le_card hsub).trans (card_union_le _ _)
  simpa [card_union_of_disjoint hd] using hc

end Scheduling.Batching

namespace Scheduling.Instance
open Finset
variable {jobs vertices : ℕ} (I : Instance jobs vertices)

Scheduling.Instance.executedDuring_card_.source:
theorem executedDuring_card_sum (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (u v : ℕ) :
    (I.executedDuring S u v).card = ∑ t ∈ Ico u v, (univ.filter (fun w => S w = t)).card := by
  classical
  have h := card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (f := S) (s := I.executedDuring S u v) (t := Ico u v)
    (by intro w hw; exact mem_Ico.mpr (mem_filter.mp hw).2)
  rw [h]
  apply sum_congr rfl
  intro t ht
  have ht' := mem_Ico.mp ht
  congr 1
  ext w
  simp only [executedDuring, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · exact fun h => h.2
  · intro h; exact ⟨by omega, h⟩

/-- Full service except possibly at one timestep loses at most m capacity. -/

Scheduling.Instance.service_except_one.source:
theorem service_except_one {m u v bad : ℕ} {S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
    (hfull : ∀ t, u ≤ t → t < v → t ≠ bad → (univ.filter (fun w => S w = t)).card = m) :
    m * (v - u) ≤ (I.executedDuring S u v).card + m := by
  classical
  have hslot : ∀ t ∈ Ico u v,
      m ≤ (univ.filter (fun w => S w = t)).card + (if t = bad then m else 0) := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases he : t = bad
    · simp [he]
    · rw [if_neg he, hfull t (mem_Ico.mp ht).1 (mem_Ico.mp ht).2 he]
      omega
  have hs := sum_le_sum hslot
  rw [sum_add_distrib, ← I.executedDuring_card_sum] at hs
  have hbad : (∑ t ∈ Ico u v, if t = bad then m else 0) ≤ m := by
    simp only [sum_ite_eq']
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have hc : (∑ _t ∈ Ico u v, m) = m * (v - u) := by simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  rw [hc] at hs
  omega

end Scheduling.Instance

namespace Scheduling.SFFRounds
open Finset
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {jobs vertices batches m L : ℕ} {I : Instance jobs vertices}
variable {B : Batching I L batches} {S O : Assignment (vertices := vertices)}
variable (R : SFFRounds B m S)

Scheduling.SFFRounds.sparse_work_bound.source:
theorem sparse_work_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) {K : ℕ}
    (hn : B.large m S (R.boundary K) = ∅) :
    (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 12 * m * L ^ 2 := by
  classical
  have heq : (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card =
      ∑ b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary K),
        ((B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).filter (fun v => B.vertexBatch v = b)).card :=
    card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (by
      intro v hv
      have hv' := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have ha : B.Active S (R.boundary K) (B.vertexBatch v) := ⟨hv'.1, v, rfl, hv'.2⟩
      rcases B.active_small_or_large (m := m) ha with hs | hl
      · exact hs
      · rw [hn] at hl; exact False.elim (notMem_empty _ hl))
  have hc : (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤
      (B.small m S (R.boundary K)).card * (3 * m * L) := by
    rw [heq]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _b ∈ B.small m S (R.boundary K), 3 * m * L := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro b _
        apply (card_le_card (t := B.batchVertices b) ?_).trans (B.batch_work_bound hO hL b)
        intro v hv
        exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, (mem_filter.mp hv).2⟩
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hcount := (R.round_bounds hm hLp hO hL K).1
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (3 * m * L) hcount
  nlinarith

Scheduling.SFFRounds.containing_round.source:
theorem containing_round {u K t : ℕ} (huK : u ≤ K)
    (htu : R.boundary u ≤ t) (htK : t < R.boundary K) :
    ∃ r, u ≤ r ∧ r < K ∧ R.boundary r ≤ t ∧ t < R.boundary (r + 1) := by
  classical
  let A := (range (K + 1)).filter (fun r => R.boundary r ≤ t)
  have hu : u ∈ A := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), htu⟩
  have hn : A.Nonempty := ⟨u, hu⟩
  let r := A.max' hn
  have hr := mem_filter.mp (Finset.max'_mem A hn)
  have hur : u ≤ r := le_max' A u hu
  have hrK : r < K := by
    have hrle : r ≤ K := by have := mem_range.mp hr.1; omega
    by_contra hge
    have he : r = K := by omega
    have hr' : R.boundary r ≤ t := hr.2
    rw [he] at hr'
    omega
  refine ⟨r, hur, hrK, hr.2, ?_⟩
  by_contra hn'
  have hnext : r + 1 ∈ A := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), by omega⟩
  have hmax := le_max' A (r + 1) hnext
  change r + 1 ≤ r at hmax
  omega

/-- Lemma 13. The last boundary with no large batch resets the backlog;
all later rounds are full, except possibly the last slot of that one round. -/

Scheduling.SFFRounds.remaining_work_boun.source:
theorem remaining_work_bound (hm : 0 < m) (hLp : 0 < L)
    (hO : I.Valid m O) (hL : I.FlowBound O L) (K : ℕ) :
    (B.admittedRemaining S (R.boundary K)).card ≤ 16 * m * L ^ 2 := by
  classical
  let E := (range (K + 1)).filter (fun k => B.large m S (R.boundary k) = ∅)
  have hzero : B.large m S (R.boundary 0) = ∅ := by
    apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro b hb
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hb).2.1.1
    rw [R.starts_zero] at he
    have hp := B.eligible_positive hLp b
    omega
  have he0 : 0 ∈ E := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), hzero⟩
  have hne : E.Nonempty := ⟨0, he0⟩
  let u := E.max' hne
  have hu := mem_filter.mp (Finset.max'_mem E hne)
  have huK : u ≤ K := by have := mem_range.mp hu.1; omega
  have hwu := R.sparse_work_bound hm hLp hO hL hu.2
  have hlarge : ∀ r, u < r → r ≤ K → (B.large m S (R.boundary r)).Nonempty := by
    intro r hur hrK
    by_contra hn
    have he : r ∈ E := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_range.mpr (by omega), not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn⟩
    have hmax := le_max' E r he
    change r ≤ u at hmax
    omega
  have htimes : R.boundary u ≤ R.boundary K := R.strict.monotone huK
  have hserved : m * (R.boundary K - R.boundary u) ≤
      (I.executedDuring S (R.boundary u) (R.boundary K)).card + m := by
    apply I.service_except_one (bad := R.boundary (u + 1) - 1)
    intro t htu htK htbad
    obtain ⟨r, hur, hrK, htr, hrt⟩ := R.containing_round huK htu htK
    by_cases he : r = u
    · subst r
      apply R.packed u t htr
      omega
    · exact R.fill_last r (hlarge r (by omega) (by omega)) t htr hrt
  have hacc := B.admitted_accounting R.eligible_service htimes
  have harr := B.eligible_work_bound hO hL htimes
  have hl : 3 * L + 1 ≤ 4 * L ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hmL := Nat.mul_le_mul_left m hl
  nlinarith

end Scheduling.SFFRounds

Scheduling.Instance.mem_graph_ready.source:
theorem mem_graph_ready (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (t n : ℕ) :
    n ∈ (I.graphObservation (executionPrefix S t) t).ready ↔
      ∃ v, I.Ready S t v ∧ v.val = n := by
  simp only [graphObservation, mem_image, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and,
    revealedVertices, val_mem_executionPrefix, not_lt, Ready]
  aesop

/-- The frontier interface of the executable algorithms is determined
by the full revealed-graph observation used in the lower bounds. -/

Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_sub.source:
theorem readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq
    [DecidableRel I.edge] [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (T : Assignment (vertices := otherVertices)) (t : ℕ)
    (h : I.graphObservation (executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t) :
    I.readyObservation S t ⊆ J.readyObservation T t := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := (I.mem_readyObservation S t x).mp hx
  have hr : v.val ∈ (J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t).ready := by
    rw [← h]
    exact (I.mem_graph_ready S t v.val).mpr ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hval⟩ := (J.mem_graph_ready T t v.val).mp hr
  have hvrevealed : v ∈ I.revealedVertices (executionPrefix S t) t := by
    simp only [revealedVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, val_mem_executionPrefix]
    exact ⟨hv.1, hv.2.2⟩
  have hvis : (v.val, (I.owner v).val) ∈ (J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t).visible := by
    rw [← h]
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨v, hvrevealed, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨z, _, hz⟩ := mem_image.mp hvis
  have hzw : z = w := Fin.ext ((congrArg Prod.fst hz).trans hval.symm)
  subst z
  have howner : (J.owner w).val = (I.owner v).val := congrArg Prod.snd hz
  have ha : ((I.owner v).val, I.release (I.owner v)) ∈
      (J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t).arrivals := by
    rw [← h]
    exact mem_image.mpr ⟨I.owner v, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hv.1⟩, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨j, _, hj⟩ := mem_image.mp ha
  have hjw : j = J.owner w := Fin.ext ((congrArg Prod.fst hj).trans howner.symm)
  subst j
  have hrelease : J.release (J.owner w) = I.release (I.owner v) := congrArg Prod.snd hj
  apply (J.mem_readyObservation T t _).mpr
  exact ⟨w, hw, by simp only [fifoPriority, hrelease, hval]⟩

Scheduling.Instance.readyObservation_eq_.source:
theorem readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq
    [DecidableRel I.edge] [DecidableRel J.edge]
    (S : Assignment (vertices := vertices)) (T : Assignment (vertices := otherVertices)) (t : ℕ)
    (h : I.graphObservation (executionPrefix S t) t = J.graphObservation (executionPrefix T t) t) :
    I.readyObservation S t = J.readyObservation T t :=
  subset_antisymm (I.readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq J S T t h)
    (J.readyObservation_subset_of_graphObservation_eq I T S t h.symm)

end Instance

/-- Executable FIFO, packaged in the same causal scheduler model used
by all the quantified lower bounds. -/

Scheduling.fifoScheduler.source:
noncomputable def fifoScheduler (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : DeterministicScheduler m where
  schedule I := I.fifoSchedule m hm
  valid I := I.fifoSchedule_valid hm
  causal I J t h := by
    change (univ.filter (fun v => I.fifoSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val =
      (univ.filter (fun v => J.fifoSchedule m hm v = t)).image Fin.val
    rw [I.fifoSchedule_publicPolicy hm, J.fifoSchedule_publicPolicy hm]
    rw [I.readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq J _ _ t (h t le_rfl)]

/-- The combined upper-bound algorithm, in the shared scheduler model. -/

Scheduling.combinedScheduler.source:
noncomputable def combinedScheduler (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) : DeterministicScheduler m where
  schedule I := I.combinedSchedule m hm
  valid := by
    intro jobs vertices I
    by_cases hj : 0 < jobs
    · exact (I.combinedSchedule_spec hm hj).1
    · have hzero : jobs = 0 := by omega
      have hv : ∀ v : Fin vertices, False := by intro v; have := (I.owner v).isLt; omega
      refine ⟨fun v => (hv v).elim, fun {u} {_} _ => (hv u).elim, ?_⟩
      intro t
      have he : (univ.filter (fun v => I.combinedSchedule m hm v = t)) = ∅ := by
        apply eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
        intro v _
        exact hv v
      simp only [he, card_empty, Nat.zero_le]
  causal I J t h := by
    apply I.combinedSchedule_nonclairvoyant J hm
    intro u hu
    exact I.readyObservation_eq_of_graphObservation_eq J _ _ u (h u hu)

Scheduling.fifoScheduler_isFIFO.source:
theorem fifoScheduler_isFIFO {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {jobs vertices : ℕ}
    (I : Instance jobs vertices) : I.IsFIFO m ((fifoScheduler m hm).schedule I) :=
  I.fifoSchedule_isFIFO hm

/-- Theorem 2 as a single existence statement about a causal algorithm. -/

Scheduling.exists_optimal_order_schedule.source:
theorem exists_optimal_order_scheduler {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ A : DeterministicScheduler m, ∀ {jobs vertices} (I : Instance jobs vertices),
      I.maxFlow (A.schedule I) ≤ 352 * I.optimum m hm * min m (I.optimum m hm) := by
  refine ⟨combinedScheduler m hm, ?_⟩
  intro jobs vertices I
  by_cases hj : 0 < jobs
  · exact (I.combinedSchedule_spec hm hj).2
  · have hz : jobs = 0 := by omega
    subst jobs
    simp [Instance.maxFlow]

/-- The constant-optimum lower bound applies to the constructed FIFO
algorithm as well as to the abstract class of causal FIFO schedulers. -/

Scheduling.fifoSchedule_constant_optimum.source:
theorem fifoSchedule_constant_optimum_lower {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∃ jobs vertices, ∃ I : Instance jobs vertices,
      (∀ u v w, I.edge u w → I.edge v w → u = v) ∧
      I.optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 ∧
      3 * (m - 1) ≤ I.maxFlow (I.fifoSchedule m (by omega)) :=
  fifo_constant_optimum_lower hm (fifoScheduler m (by omega)) (fun I => fifoScheduler_isFIFO (by omega) I)

end Scheduling

Scheduling.StarChain.toInstance.source:
def toInstance (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) : Instance jobs (jobs * (3 * m)) where
  owner := job
  release j := j.val * 3
  edge u v := job u = job v ∧
    if long (job v) then
      ((position u).val = 0 ∧ (position v).val = 1) ∨
      ((position u).val = 1 ∧ 2 ≤ (position v).val)
    else (position u).val = 0 ∧ 1 ≤ (position v).val
  same_job h := h.1
  rank v := (position v).val
  rank_increases := by
    intro u v h
    have hh := h.2
    split_ifs at hh <;> omega
  nonempty_job j := ⟨finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, by omega⟩), by simp⟩

Scheduling.StarChain.root.source:
def root (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) :=
  finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨0, by omega⟩)

Scheduling.StarChain.middle.source:
def middle (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) :=
  finProdFinEquiv (j, ⟨1, by omega⟩)

Scheduling.StarChain.job_root.source: @[simp] theorem job_root (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : job (root hm j) = j := by simp [root]

Scheduling.StarChain.position_root.source: @[simp] theorem position_root (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : (position (root hm j)).val = 0 := by simp [root]

Scheduling.StarChain.job_middle.source: @[simp] theorem job_middle (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : job (middle hm j) = j := by simp [middle]

Scheduling.StarChain.position_middle.source: @[simp] theorem position_middle (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) : (position (middle hm j)).val = 1 := by simp [middle]

Scheduling.StarChain.eq_root.source:
theorem eq_root (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : (position v).val = 0) :
    v = root hm (job v) := by
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  exact Prod.ext (by simp) (by simpa using hv)

Scheduling.StarChain.eq_middle.source:
theorem eq_middle (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : (position v).val = 1) :
    v = middle hm (job v) := by
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  exact Prod.ext (by simp) (by simpa using hv)

Scheduling.StarChain.IsLeaf.source:
def IsLeaf (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : Prop :=
