  if long (job v) then 2 ≤ (position v).val else 1 ≤ (position v).val

Scheduling.StarChain.IsMiddle.source:
def IsMiddle (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : Prop :=
  long (job v) = true ∧ (position v).val = 1

Scheduling.StarChain.vertex_kinds.source:
theorem vertex_kinds (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) :
    (position v).val = 0 ∨ IsMiddle long v ∨ IsLeaf long v := by
  unfold IsMiddle IsLeaf
  cases long (job v) <;> simp <;> omega

Scheduling.StarChain.no_parent_root.source:
theorem no_parent_root (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs)
    (u : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : ¬ (toInstance long hm).edge u (root hm j) := by
  simp [toInstance, root]

Scheduling.StarChain.middle_parent.source:
theorem middle_parent (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm j) (middle hm j) := by
  constructor
  · simp
  · simp [root, middle]

Scheduling.StarChain.at_most_one_parent.source:
theorem at_most_one_parent (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    {u v w : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))}
    (hu : (toInstance long hm).edge u w) (hv : (toInstance long hm).edge v w) : u = v := by
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  refine Prod.ext (hu.1.trans hv.1.symm) ?_
  have h₁ := hu.2
  have h₂ := hv.2
  change (position u).val = (position v).val
  split_ifs at h₁ h₂ <;> omega

Scheduling.StarChain.parent_exists.source:
theorem parent_exists (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : 0 < (position v).val) :
    ∃ u, (toInstance long hm).edge u v := by
  by_cases hl : long (job v) = true
  · by_cases hmid : (position v).val = 1
    · refine ⟨root hm (job v), ?_⟩
      simp [toInstance, root, hl, hmid]
    · refine ⟨middle hm (job v), ?_⟩
      simp [toInstance, middle, hl, show 2 ≤ (position v).val by omega]
  · refine ⟨root hm (job v), ?_⟩
    simp [toInstance, root, hl, show 1 ≤ (position v).val by omega]

Scheduling.StarChain.parent_position.source:
theorem parent_position (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (he : (toInstance long hm).edge u v) :
    (position u).val ≤ 1 := by
  have hh := he.2
  split_ifs at hh <;> omega

Scheduling.StarChain.root_before_nonroot.source:
theorem root_before_nonroot (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    {S : Assignment} (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : 0 < (position v).val) :
    S (root hm (job v)) < S v := by
  obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists long hm v hv
  have hu := parent_position long hm he
  have ho := he.1
  have ht := hS.precedence he
  by_cases hz : (position u).val = 0
  · rw [eq_root hm u hz, ho] at ht
    exact ht
  · have hone : (position u).val = 1 := by omega
    rw [eq_middle hm u hone, ho] at ht
    exact (hS.precedence (middle_parent long hm (job v))).trans ht

/-- Every vertex is at distance at most two from its job's root. Together
with unique parents, this certifies rooted out-trees of height at most three. -/

Scheduling.StarChain.root_reaches.source:
theorem root_reaches (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) :
    v = root hm (job v) ∨ (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job v)) v ∨
      ∃ u, (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job v)) u ∧ (toInstance long hm).edge u v := by
  by_cases hz : (position v).val = 0
  · exact Or.inl (eq_root hm v hz)
  · obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists long hm v (by omega)
    have hu := parent_position long hm he
    have ho := he.1
    by_cases hu0 : (position u).val = 0
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (by rwa [eq_root hm u hu0, ho] at he))
    · refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨u, ?_, he⟩)
      rw [eq_middle hm u (by omega), ho]
      exact middle_parent long hm _

Scheduling.StarChain.offline_schedule.source:
theorem offline_schedule (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    ∃ O, (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).Valid m O ∧ (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).FlowBound O 6 := by
  let I := toInstance long (show 0 < m by omega)
  let pos := fun v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) => (position v).val
  have hpos : ∀ v, pos v < m * 3 := by intro v; have := (position v).isLt; dsimp [pos]; omega
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun v => (I.owner v, pos v)) := LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  have hedge : ∀ u v, I.edge u v → pos u < 3 ∧ pos u < pos v := by
    intro u v he
    have hp := I.rank_increases he
    have hh := he.2
    change (position u).val < 3 ∧ (position u).val < (position v).val
    split_ifs at hh <;> omega
  refine ⟨fun v => pipelineTime m 3 (I.owner v).val (pos v), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact I.pipeline_valid hm pos hpos hinj (by intros; rfl) hedge
  · exact I.pipeline_flowBound hm pos hpos (by intros; rfl)

Scheduling.StarChain.optimum_le_six.source:
theorem optimum_le_six (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 2 ≤ m) :
    (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).optimum m (by omega) ≤ 6 := by
  obtain ⟨O, hO, hflow⟩ := offline_schedule long hm
  exact (toInstance (m := m) long (by omega)).optimum_le (by omega) hO hflow

Scheduling.StarChain.jobVertices_card.source:
theorem jobVertices_card (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (j : Fin jobs) :
    ((toInstance long hm).jobVertices j).card = 3 * m := by
  have he : (toInstance long hm).jobVertices j =
      univ.image (fun p : Fin (3 * m) => finProdFinEquiv (j, p)) := by
    ext v
    simp only [Instance.jobVertices, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, mem_image]
    change job v = j ↔ ∃ p : Fin (3 * m), finProdFinEquiv (j, p) = v
    constructor
    · intro ho
      refine ⟨position v, ?_⟩
      apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
      simp only [LayeredForest.job_pair, LayeredForest.position_pair]
      exact Prod.ext ho.symm rfl
    · rintro ⟨p, rfl⟩
      simp
  rw [he, card_image_of_injective]
  · simp
  · intro p q hpq
    exact (Prod.mk.inj (finProdFinEquiv.injective hpq)).2

end Scheduling.StarChain

Scheduling.StarChain.TypeConsistent.source:
def TypeConsistent (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m)
    (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (3 * m))) (j : Fin jobs) : Prop :=
  long j = true ↔ ¬ MiddleAt long hm S (S (root hm j))

/-- A job's type can be chosen after the slot executing its root. All of
its nonroot vertices are still hidden at the beginning of that slot. -/

Scheduling.StarChain.change_type.source:
theorem change_type (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (j : Fin jobs) (b : Bool) :
    let I := toInstance long hm
    let J := toInstance (Function.update long j b) hm
    ∀ t ≤ A.schedule I (root hm j), ∀ v,
      A.schedule I v = t ↔ A.schedule J v = t := by
  dsimp only
  let I := toInstance long hm
  let J := toInstance (Function.update long j b) hm
  let hidden := univ.filter (fun v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m)) =>
    job v = j ∧ 0 < (position v).val)
  have hparent : ∀ v ∈ hidden, ∃ u, J.edge u v ∧
      A.schedule I (root hm j) ≤ A.schedule I u := by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨ho, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists (Function.update long j b) hm v hp
    refine ⟨u, he, ?_⟩
    have hu := parent_position (Function.update long j b) hm he
    have howner : job u = j := he.1.trans ho
    by_cases hz : (position u).val = 0
    · rw [eq_root hm u hz, howner]
    · have hone : (position u).val = 1 := by omega
      rw [eq_middle hm u hone, howner]
      exact Nat.le_of_lt ((A.valid I).precedence (middle_parent long hm j))
  have hreplace := A.hidden_replacement I J hidden rfl rfl (by
    intro u v hv
    by_cases ho : job v = j
    · have hz : (position v).val = 0 := by
        simp only [hidden, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, ho, true_and] at hv
        omega
      rw [eq_root hm v hz]
      exact iff_of_false (no_parent_root long hm _ u)
        (no_parent_root (Function.update long j b) hm _ u)
    · change (job u = job v ∧ _) ↔ (job u = job v ∧ _)
      simp only [Function.update_of_ne ho]) (by
    intro v hv
    obtain ⟨ho, hp⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    obtain ⟨u, he⟩ := parent_exists long hm v hp
    refine ⟨u, he, ?_⟩
    have hu := parent_position long hm he
    have howner : job u = j := he.1.trans ho
    by_cases hz : (position u).val = 0
    · rw [eq_root hm u hz, howner]
    · have hone : (position u).val = 1 := by omega
      rw [eq_middle hm u hone, howner]
      exact Nat.le_of_lt ((A.valid I).precedence (middle_parent long hm j))) hparent
  intro t ht v
  have he := hreplace.1 t ht
  simpa only [val_mem_executionSlot] using
    (show v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule I) t ↔
      v.val ∈ executionSlot (A.schedule J) t from by rw [he])

/-- Choosing a type cannot change which middle vertices execute in any
slot up to and including this job's root slot. -/

Scheduling.StarChain.change_type_middle.source:
theorem change_type_middle (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (j : Fin jobs) (b : Bool)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j)) :
    MiddleAt long hm (A.schedule (toInstance long hm)) t ↔
      MiddleAt (Function.update long j b) hm
        (A.schedule (toInstance (Function.update long j b) hm)) t := by
  have hs := change_type A hm long j b t ht
  have hmid := (A.valid (toInstance long hm)).precedence (middle_parent long hm j)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, htime⟩
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; omega
    exact ⟨i, by simpa [Function.update_of_ne hij] using hi, (hs _).mp htime⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, htime⟩
    have htime' := (hs _).mpr htime
    have hij : i ≠ j := by rintro rfl; omega
    exact ⟨i, by simpa [Function.update_of_ne hij] using hi, htime'⟩

Scheduling.StarChain.Settled.source:
def Settled (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (fixed : Finset (Fin jobs)) : Prop :=
  (∀ j ∈ fixed, TypeConsistent long hm (A.schedule (toInstance long hm)) j) ∧
    ∀ j ∈ fixed, ∀ k ∉ fixed,
      A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j) ≤
        A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm k)

Scheduling.StarChain.settle_next.source:
theorem settle_next (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (fixed : Finset (Fin jobs))
    (hfixed : Settled A hm long fixed) (j : Fin jobs) (hj : j ∉ fixed)
    (hmin : ∀ k ∉ fixed, A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j) ≤
      A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm k)) :
    ∃ long', Settled A hm long' (insert j fixed) := by
  let S := A.schedule (toInstance long hm)
  let t := S (root hm j)
  let b := decide (¬ MiddleAt long hm S t)
  let long' := Function.update long j b
  let S' := A.schedule (toInstance long' hm)
  have hslot : ∀ u ≤ t, ∀ v, S v = u ↔ S' v = u := change_type A hm long j b
  have htime : ∀ v, S v ≤ t → S' v = S v := by
    intro v hv
    exact (hslot _ hv v).mp rfl
  have hmiddle : ∀ u ≤ t, MiddleAt long hm S u ↔ MiddleAt long' hm S' u :=
    change_type_middle A hm long j b
  have hnew : S' (root hm j) = t := htime _ le_rfl
  have hearly : ∀ i ∈ fixed, S' (root hm i) = S (root hm i) := by
    intro i hi
    exact htime _ (hfixed.2 i hi j hj)
  have hlate : ∀ k ∉ fixed, t ≤ S' (root hm k) := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hn
    have hh : S' (root hm k) ≤ t := by omega
    have he := (hslot _ hh (root hm k)).mpr rfl
    have hle := hmin k hk
    change t ≤ S (root hm k) at hle
    omega
  refine ⟨long', ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i hi
    rcases mem_insert.mp hi with hij | hi
    · subst i
      change long' j = true ↔ ¬ MiddleAt long' hm S' (S' (root hm j))
      rw [hnew, ← hmiddle t le_rfl]
      simp only [long', Function.update_self, b, decide_eq_true_eq]
    · have hij : i ≠ j := by intro heq; exact hj (heq ▸ hi)
      change long' i = true ↔ ¬ MiddleAt long' hm S' (S' (root hm i))
      rw [hearly i hi, ← hmiddle _ (hfixed.2 i hi j hj)]
      simpa only [long', Function.update_of_ne hij, TypeConsistent, S] using hfixed.1 i hi
  · intro i hi k hk
    have hk' : k ∉ fixed := fun h => hk (mem_insert_of_mem h)
    change S' (root hm i) ≤ S' (root hm k)
    rcases mem_insert.mp hi with rfl | hi
    · rw [hnew]
      exact hlate k hk'
    · rw [hearly i hi]
      exact (hfixed.2 i hi j hj).trans (hlate k hk')

/-- The adaptive rule is realized by a fixed star-and-chain instance for
every deterministic non-clairvoyant scheduler. Simultaneous roots receive
the same rule; changing one of them leaves that slot's middle set intact. -/

Scheduling.StarChain.exists_type_consist.source:
theorem exists_type_consistent (A : DeterministicScheduler m) (hm : 0 < m)
    (jobs : ℕ) : ∃ long : Fin jobs → Bool,
      ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm (A.schedule (toInstance long hm)) j := by
  have extend : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (fixed : Finset (Fin jobs)),
      (univ \ fixed).card = n → Settled A hm long fixed →
      ∃ final : Fin jobs → Bool,
        ∀ j, TypeConsistent final hm (A.schedule (toInstance final hm)) j := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro long fixed hn hf
      by_cases hempty : (univ \ fixed).Nonempty
      · obtain ⟨j, hj, hmin⟩ := exists_min_image (univ \ fixed)
          (fun j => A.schedule (toInstance long hm) (root hm j)) hempty
        have hj' : j ∉ fixed := (mem_sdiff.mp hj).2
        obtain ⟨long', hf'⟩ := settle_next A hm long fixed hf j hj' (by
          intro k hk
          exact hmin k (mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hk⟩))
        have he : univ \ insert j fixed = (univ \ fixed).erase j := by
          ext k
          simp only [mem_sdiff, mem_univ, mem_insert, mem_erase, true_and]
          tauto
        have hlt : (univ \ insert j fixed).card < n := by
          rw [he, ← hn]
          exact card_erase_lt_of_mem hj
        exact ih _ hlt long' (insert j fixed) rfl hf'
      · refine ⟨long, fun j => hf.1 j ?_⟩
        by_contra hj
        exact hempty ⟨j, mem_sdiff.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hj⟩⟩
  exact extend _ (fun _ => true) ∅ rfl ⟨by simp, by simp⟩

end Scheduling.StarChain

Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_positive.source:
theorem leaf_positive {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : IsLeaf long v) :
    0 < (position v).val := by
  unfold IsLeaf at hv
  split_ifs at hv <;> omega

Scheduling.StarChain.nonleaf_position.source:
theorem nonleaf_position {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : ¬ IsLeaf long v) :
    (position v).val ≤ 1 := by
  unfold IsLeaf at hv
  split_ifs at hv <;> omega

Scheduling.StarChain.executed_ready.source:
theorem executed_ready (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) : (toInstance long hm).Ready S (S v) v :=
  ⟨hS.release v, le_rfl, fun _ he => hS.precedence he⟩

Scheduling.StarChain.alive_card_lt.source:
theorem alive_card_lt (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (t : ℕ) : ((toInstance long hm).alive S t).card < m := by
  have hc := card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.val (s := (toInstance long hm).alive S t)
    (t := Ico (t / 3 + 1 - (m - 1)) (t / 3 + 1)) (by
      intro j hj
      obtain ⟨hr, v, ho, ht⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hj).2
      have hf := hflow v
      rw [ho] at hf
      change j.val * 3 ≤ t at hr
      change S v < j.val * 3 + 3 * (m - 1) at hf
      exact mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
    (by intro u _ v _ huv; exact Fin.ext huv)
  have hlen : (Ico (t / 3 + 1 - (m - 1)) (t / 3 + 1)).card ≤ m - 1 := by
    rw [Nat.card_Ico]
    omega
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hc.trans hlen) (by omega)

Scheduling.StarChain.ready_nonleaf_injec.source:
theorem ready_nonleaf_injective (_hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    {t : ℕ} {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))}
    (hu : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t u) (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v)
    (hlu : ¬ IsLeaf long u) (hlv : ¬ IsLeaf long v) (ho : job u = job v) : u = v := by
  have hpu := nonleaf_position hlu
  have hpv := nonleaf_position hlv
  apply LayeredForest.coordinates_injective
  refine Prod.ext ho ?_
  change (position u).val = (position v).val
  by_contra hne
  have hcases : ((position u).val = 0 ∧ (position v).val = 1) ∨
      ((position v).val = 0 ∧ (position u).val = 1) := by omega
  rcases hcases with ⟨hu0, hv1⟩ | ⟨hv0, hu1⟩
  · have he : (toInstance long hm).edge u v := by
      rw [eq_root hm u hu0, eq_middle hm v hv1, ho]
      exact middle_parent long hm _
    have hh := hv.2.2 u he
    have ht := hu.2.1
    omega
  · have he : (toInstance long hm).edge v u := by
      rw [eq_root hm v hv0, eq_middle hm u hu1, ho]
      exact middle_parent long hm _
    have hh := hu.2.2 v he
    have ht := hv.2.1
    omega

Scheduling.StarChain.no_leaves_idle.source:
theorem no_leaves_idle (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (t : ℕ) (hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬ IsLeaf long v) :
    (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by
  have hcard := card_le_card_of_injOn job
    (s := univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)) (t := (toInstance long hm).alive S t) (by
      intro v hv
      have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hr := hS.release v
      refine mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, ?_, v, rfl, ?_⟩
      · change (toInstance long hm).release (job v) ≤ S v at hr
        omega
      · omega) (by
      intro u hu v hv ho
      have hut := (mem_filter.mp hu).2
      have hvt := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
      have hru : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t u := hut ▸ executed_ready hS u
      have hrv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v := hvt ▸ executed_ready hS v
      exact ready_nonleaf_injective hS hru hrv (hn u hru) (hn v hrv) ho)
  exact hcard.trans_lt (alive_card_lt hflow t)

Scheduling.StarChain.no_leaves_process_a.source:
theorem no_leaves_process_all (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (t : ℕ) (hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬ IsLeaf long v)
    (v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))) (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v) : S v = t := by
  by_contra he
  have hfull := hfifo.work_conserving t v hv he
  have hidle := no_leaves_idle hS hflow t hn
  omega

/-- Ready leaves are older than every unprocessed root and exclude
ready middle vertices. -/

Scheduling.StarChain.StateInvariant.source:
def StateInvariant (long : Fin jobs → Bool) (hm : 0 < m) (S : Assignment (vertices := jobs * (3 * m))) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  (∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → IsLeaf long v →
    ∀ j, t ≤ S (root hm j) → (job v).val < j.val) ∧
  (∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → IsLeaf long v →
    ∀ w, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w → ¬ IsMiddle long w)

Scheduling.StarChain.ready_root_iff.source:
theorem ready_root_iff (t : ℕ) (j : Fin jobs) :
    (toInstance long hm).Ready S t (root hm j) ↔ j.val * 3 ≤ t ∧ t ≤ S (root hm j) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa [toInstance] using h.1, h.2.1⟩
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa [toInstance] using h.1, h.2,
      fun u he => False.elim (no_parent_root long hm j u he)⟩

Scheduling.StarChain.ready_nonroot_iff.source:
theorem ready_nonroot_iff (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    {u v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (he : (toInstance long hm).edge u v) (t : ℕ) :
    (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v ↔ t ≤ S v ∧ S u < t := by
  constructor
  · intro h; exact ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2 u he⟩
  · intro h
    have hr := hS.release u
    rw [(toInstance long hm).same_job he] at hr
    exact ⟨by omega, h.1, fun w hw => by
      rw [at_most_one_parent long hm hw he]
      exact h.2⟩

Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_parent_edge.source:
theorem leaf_parent_edge {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : IsLeaf long v) :
    (toInstance long hm).edge (leafParent long hm v) v := by
  unfold leafParent IsLeaf at *
  split_ifs at * <;> simp_all [toInstance]

Scheduling.StarChain.fresh_leaf_has_midd.source:
theorem fresh_leaf_has_middle (_hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j)
    {t : ℕ} {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (_hv : IsLeaf long v)
    (hparent : S (leafParent long hm v) = t) : MiddleAt long hm S t := by
  by_cases hl : long (job v) = true
  · exact ⟨job v, hl, by simpa [leafParent, hl] using hparent⟩
  · have hr : S (root hm (job v)) = t := by simpa [leafParent, hl] using hparent
    have hh := hc (job v)
    unfold TypeConsistent at hh
    rw [hr] at hh
    by_contra hn
    exact hl (hh.mpr hn)

Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_persists.source:
theorem leaf_persists (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) {t : ℕ}
    (hinv : StateInvariant long hm S t)
    (hex : ∃ w, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w ∧ IsLeaf long w)
    {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S (t + 1) v)
    (hl : IsLeaf long v) : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwl⟩ := hex
  have hp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) (t + 1)).mp hv
  have hne : S (leafParent long hm v) ≠ t := by
    intro he
    obtain ⟨j, hj, ht⟩ := fresh_leaf_has_middle hS hc hl he
    have hr : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t (middle hm j) := ht ▸ executed_ready hS _
    exact hinv.2 w hw hwl _ hr ⟨by simpa, by simp⟩
  exact (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩

Scheduling.StarChain.stateInvariant_zero.source:
theorem stateInvariant_zero (_hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S) :
    StateInvariant long hm S 0 := by
  have hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S 0 v → ¬ IsLeaf long v := by
    intro v hv hl
    have hp := hv.2.2 _ (leaf_parent_edge hl)
    omega
  exact ⟨fun v hv hl => False.elim (hn v hv hl),
    fun v hv hl => False.elim (hn v hv hl)⟩

Scheduling.StarChain.stateInvariant_step.source:
theorem stateInvariant_step (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) {t : ℕ}
    (hinv : StateInvariant long hm S t) : StateInvariant long hm S (t + 1) := by
  by_cases hex : ∃ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v ∧ IsLeaf long v
  · have hpersist := fun v hv hl => leaf_persists hS hc hinv hex (v := v) hv hl
    constructor
    · intro v hv hl j hj
      exact hinv.1 v (hpersist v hv hl) hl j (by omega)
    · intro v hv hl w hw hmid
      have hvt := hpersist v hv hl
      have hwpos := hmid.2
      have he : (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job w)) w := by
        rw [eq_middle hm w hwpos]
        simpa only [job_middle] using middle_parent long hm (job w)
      have hwp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS he (t + 1)).mp hw
      by_cases heq : S (root hm (job w)) = t
      · have hne : S v ≠ t := by have := hv.2.1; omega
        have hprio := hfifo.fifo_priority t v (root hm (job w)) hvt hne heq
        have hold := hinv.1 v hvt hl (job w) (by omega)
        simp only [toInstance, job_root] at hprio
        omega
      · have hwold : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w :=
          (ready_nonroot_iff hS he t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        exact hinv.2 v hvt hl w hwold hmid
  · have hn : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v → ¬ IsLeaf long v := by
      intro v hv hl
      exact hex ⟨v, hv, hl⟩
    have hall := no_leaves_process_all hS hfifo hflow t hn
    have hroots : ∀ j, t + 1 ≤ S (root hm j) → t < j.val * 3 := by
      intro j hj
      by_contra hh
      have hr : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t (root hm j) :=
        (ready_root_iff t j).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
      have he := hall _ hr
      omega
    constructor
    · intro v hv hl j hj
      have hp := hv.2.2 _ (leaf_parent_edge hl)
      have hr := hS.release (leafParent long hm v)
      have howner : job (leafParent long hm v) = job v := by
        unfold leafParent
        split_ifs <;> simp
      change (job (leafParent long hm v)).val * 3 ≤ S (leafParent long hm v) at hr
      rw [howner] at hr
      have hh := hroots j hj
      omega
    · intro v hv hl w hw hmid
      have hp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) (t + 1)).mp hv
      have hpt : S (leafParent long hm v) = t := by
        by_contra hh
        have hvold : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t v :=
          (ready_nonroot_iff hS (leaf_parent_edge hl) t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        exact hn v hvold hl
      have hmiddle := fresh_leaf_has_middle hS hc hl hpt
      have he : (toInstance long hm).edge (root hm (job w)) w := by
        rw [eq_middle hm w hmid.2]
        simpa only [job_middle] using middle_parent long hm (job w)
      have hwp := (ready_nonroot_iff hS he (t + 1)).mp hw
      have hrt : S (root hm (job w)) = t := by
        by_contra hh
        have hwold : (toInstance long hm).Ready S t w :=
          (ready_nonroot_iff hS he t).mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
        have hdone := hall w hwold
        omega
      have hnone := (hc (job w)).mp hmid.1
      rw [hrt] at hnone
      exact hnone hmiddle

Scheduling.StarChain.stateInvariant_all.source:
theorem stateInvariant_all (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) (t : ℕ) : StateInvariant long hm S t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact stateInvariant_zero hS
  | succ t ih => exact stateInvariant_step hS hfifo hflow hc ih

Scheduling.StarChain.leaf_run_subset.source:
theorem leaf_run_subset (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) (a n : ℕ)
    (hex : ∀ k < n, ∃ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + k) v ∧ IsLeaf long v)
    {v : Fin (jobs * (3 * m))} (hv : (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + n) v)
    (hl : IsLeaf long v) : (toInstance long hm).Ready S a v := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simpa using hv
  | succ n ih =>
    have hprev := leaf_persists hS hc (stateInvariant_all hS hfifo hflow hc (a + n))
      (hex n (by omega)) (by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hv) hl
    exact ih (fun k hk => hex k (by omega)) hprev

/-- Every block of `3(m-1)+1` slots wastes capacity if the maximum flow
were at most `3(m-1)`. A continuous run of ready leaves can only shrink,
so no such run can last longer than the assumed flow bound. -/

Scheduling.StarChain.block_has_idle.source:
theorem block_has_idle (hS : (toInstance long hm).Valid m S)
    (hfifo : (toInstance long hm).IsFIFO m S)
    (hflow : (toInstance long hm).FlowBound S (3 * (m - 1)))
    (hc : ∀ j, TypeConsistent long hm S j) (a : ℕ) :
    ∃ t ∈ Ico a (a + (3 * (m - 1) + 1)),
      (univ.filter (fun v => S v = t)).card < m := by
  by_contra hn
  push Not at hn
  have hex : ∀ k ≤ 3 * (m - 1),
      ∃ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + k) v ∧ IsLeaf long v := by
    intro k hk
    by_contra hnone
    have hno : ∀ v, (toInstance long hm).Ready S (a + k) v → ¬ IsLeaf long v := by
      intro v hv hl; exact hnone ⟨v, hv, hl⟩
    have hidle := no_leaves_idle hS hflow (a + k) hno
    have hfull := hn (a + k) (mem_Ico.mpr ⟨by omega, by omega⟩)
    omega
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hl⟩ := hex _ le_rfl
  have hstart := leaf_run_subset hS hfifo hflow hc a (3 * (m - 1))
    (fun k hk => hex k (by omega)) hv hl
  have hr := hstart.1
  have ht := hv.2.1
  have hf := hflow v
  omega

end Scheduling.StarChain

Scheduling.Batching.exists_ready_unfinis.source:
theorem exists_ready_unfinished (s : ExecutionState vertices)
    (hu : ∃ v, s.stamp v = none) :
    ∃ v, s.stamp v = none ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u v → s.stamp u ≠ none := by
  have aux : ∀ n v, I.rank v = n → s.stamp v = none →
      ∃ w, s.stamp w = none ∧ ∀ u, I.edge u w → s.stamp u ≠ none := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro v hv hs
      by_cases hp : ∀ u, I.edge u v → s.stamp u ≠ none
      · exact ⟨v, hs, hp⟩
      · push Not at hp
        obtain ⟨u, he, hu⟩ := hp
        exact ih (I.rank u) (by have := I.rank_increases he; omega) u rfl hu
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hu
  exact aux (I.rank v) v rfl hv

Scheduling.Batching.advance_progress.source:
theorem advance_progress {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (s : ExecutionState vertices)
    (he : ∀ b, B.eligible b ≤ s.clock) (hu : ∃ v, s.stamp v = none) :
    s.completed.card + 1 ≤ (B.advance m s).completed.card := by
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hp⟩ := exists_ready_unfinished (I := I) s hu
  have hobs : v ∈ (B.observe s).ready (B.vertexBatch v) :=
    mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, rfl, he _, hv, hp⟩
  obtain ⟨w, k, hk, hw⟩ := (B.observe s).progress hm hobs
  have hready := B.selected_ready hw
  have hn : w ∉ s.completed := by simp [ExecutionState.completed, hready.2.1]
  have hd : w ∈ (B.advance m s).completed := by
    simp [ExecutionState.completed, advance, hw]
  have hc := card_le_card (insert_subset_iff.mpr ⟨hd, B.completed_mono m s⟩)
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hn] at hc
  exact hc

Scheduling.Batching.run_clock_ge.source:
theorem run_clock_ge (m k : ℕ) : k ≤ (B.run m k).clock := by
  induction k with
  | zero => omega
  | succ k ih =>
    have h := B.clock_strict m (B.run m k)
    change (B.run m k).clock < (B.run m (k + 1)).clock at h
    omega

Scheduling.Batching.run_preserves_stamp.source:
theorem run_preserves_stamp {m a b : ℕ} (hab : a ≤ b) {v : Fin vertices} {t : ℕ}
    (hv : (B.run m a).stamp v = some t) : (B.run m b).stamp v = some t := by
  induction b, hab using Nat.le_induction with
  | base => exact hv
  | succ b hab ih => exact B.preserves_stamp ih

Scheduling.Batching.completionRound.source:
def completionRound : ℕ := B.lastEligibility + vertices

omit [DecidableRel I.edge] in

Scheduling.Batching.eligible_by_last.source:
theorem eligible_by_last (b : Fin batches) : B.eligible b ≤ B.lastEligibility :=
  le_sup (mem_univ b)

/-- Once all batches are eligible, each unfinished round completes at least
one new vertex. Consequently the construction assigns every finite vertex
an execution time after at most lastEligibility + vertices rounds. -/

Scheduling.Batching.terminates.source:
theorem terminates {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v ≠ none := by
  intro hn
  have hfinal : v ∉ (B.run m B.completionRound).completed := by
    simp [ExecutionState.completed, hn]
  have hcount : ∀ i, i ≤ vertices → i ≤ (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).completed.card := by
    intro i
    induction i with
    | zero => intro _; omega
    | succ i ih =>
      intro hi
      have hip := ih (by omega)
      have hv : (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).stamp v = none := by
        by_contra hne
        have hmem : v ∈ (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).completed :=
          mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hne⟩
        have hsub := B.run_completed_mono m (show B.lastEligibility + i ≤ B.completionRound by unfold completionRound; omega)
        exact hfinal (hsub hmem)
      have he : ∀ b, B.eligible b ≤ (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).clock := by
        intro b
        have h₁ := B.eligible_by_last b
        have h₂ := B.run_clock_ge m (B.lastEligibility + i)
        omega
      have hp := B.advance_progress hm (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)) he ⟨v, hv⟩
      have hidx : B.lastEligibility + i + 1 = B.lastEligibility + (i + 1) := by omega
      change (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i)).completed.card + 1 ≤
        (B.run m (B.lastEligibility + i + 1)).completed.card at hp
      rw [hidx] at hp
      omega
  have hc := hcount vertices le_rfl
  change vertices ≤ (B.run m B.completionRound).completed.card at hc
  have heq : (B.run m B.completionRound).completed = univ :=
    eq_of_subset_of_card_le (subset_univ _) (by simpa using hc)
  rw [heq] at hfinal
  exact hfinal (mem_univ _)

Scheduling.Batching.execution.source:
def execution (m : ℕ) : Assignment (vertices := vertices) :=
  fun v => ((B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v).getD 0

Scheduling.Batching.execution_stamp.source:
theorem execution_stamp {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (v : Fin vertices) :
    (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v = some (B.execution m v) := by
  have hn := B.terminates hm v
  cases h : (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v with
  | none => exact False.elim (hn h)
  | some t => simp [execution, h]

/-- The executable construction produces a valid scheduling assignment.
It does not take an offline comparison schedule as input. -/

Scheduling.Batching.execution_valid.source:
theorem execution_valid {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) : I.Valid m (B.execution m) := by
  have hs := B.run_safe m B.completionRound
  constructor
  · intro v
    have ht := (hs.stamps v (B.execution m v) (B.execution_stamp hm v)).1
    have hr := B.released_by_eligible (v := v) rfl
    omega
  · intro u v he
    have ht := (hs.stamps v (B.execution m v) (B.execution_stamp hm v)).2.2 u he
    obtain ⟨a, ha, hav⟩ := ht
    have heq := Option.some.inj (ha.symm.trans (B.execution_stamp hm u))
    omega
  · intro t
    apply (card_le_card (t := univ.filter (fun v =>
      (B.run m B.completionRound).stamp v = some t)) ?_).trans (hs.capacity t)
    intro v hv
    have he := (mem_filter.mp hv).2
    exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, by rw [B.execution_stamp hm v, he]⟩

end Scheduling.Batching
